Blood Remedy 
Quaterly Once OR Halfyearly once OR in Anti month. Donate Blood, Organize Blood Donation 
Camps, Drop 01 or 02 drops of blood on grass/garden/earth /mud. Visit surgical Hospital sit

Offer water to sun daily Only if Driver is not 8, Dosuryanamaskar, Take blessing from father 
daily, onate water to thirst , offer water to birds daily, Walk in sunlight, Wake up before 
sunrise pray to sun, Donate wheat to needy. 
2. Chandra 
(Moon) 
Siva upasana, Offer water or panchamruth to sivaling in sivemandir, donate white 
things(sugar,rice,clothes) to needy, Walk in moon light on poornima, fasting on poornima, 
Take blessing of mother daily, Drink water & milk in silver glass, wear and donate silver, 
read sive chalisa or mantra.  
3. Guru 
(Jupiter) 
Khesar tilak on forehead daily. Drink Khesar milk or water daily or atleast on thursdays, 
Donate bananas, Give or donate yellow pulses/ fruits to needy, Offer yellow clothes to 
temple/ pandit/needy. Offer Haldi water on banana plant on thursday, fast on thursday, 
Offer chana Dall and Gur (Jaggery) to cow on thursday.  
4/7. Rahu/ 
Ketu 
Feed birds crow even dogs daily, Feed street dogs biscuits bread etc. Donate electronics to 
needy, Donate mustard oil, Donate pencil, lead black stuff. Donate Sesame ( til) oil. Put coal 
in flowiing water on Saturday / Tuesday. Visit kalbhairav temple on Saturday/ tuesday. Read 
hanman chalisa, visit hanuman mandir regularly. Pay at Shani mandir on saturday. Or siva 
Temple Do durga pooja/ paath. 
5 
Budh(Mercury) 
Free parrot, green bird on Wednesday .  every year or once in two years. Feed cow on 
Wednesday green grass / palak green vegetables. Donate green to needy or temple on 
Wednesday. Walk bear foot on green grass. Plant or donate plants. Wear green bracelets / 
green cloths on wednesday. Eat tulsi leaves daily. Visit Ganesh temple on Wednesday. Eat 
more green vegetables. Donate palak / green vegetables to needy. Donate notebooks/ 
stationry to kids. Donate or contribute to child education/ charity.

Mangal(Mars) 
Read Hanuman chalisa / Sunderakanda on Tuesdays. Visit Hanuman Temple on Tuesday.

tomatoes etc.

Golden Plane | 4, 5, 6 | Progress after marriage/childbirth; aggressive yet balanced; purpose-driven; can become popular and powerful after choosing a path.
Silver Plane | 2, 5, 8 | Earth element; property and stability; patient, focused, determined and goal-oriented; avoids unnecessary show.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Numerology studies show how the numbers affect our life, the vibration, and features
inherent to each number, the mixture of which speaks volumes for the personality
and future path in life. One of the most intriguing aspects of numerology is the
Driver-Conductor Combination, where the "Driver" represents the primary force of
one's life (calculated from the date of birth) and the "Conductor" symbolizes the
secondary support system. 
Don't know how to calculate your Driver and Conductor numbers? See our blog, How
 To Calculate Driver Number  and How To Calculate Conductor Number , for a
detailed guide on how to obtain your numbers and what each of them means.  
 This blog talks of all the possible combinations where the Driver is Number 1
representing kingship, ambition and independence. We shall be discussing how well
these combinations work in all aspects, their star rating and professional life,
meaning potential and issues. 
1/ Driver 1 and Conductor 1: The Reign of Two Kings 
When both the Driver and Conductor happen to be 1, they form an unmatched
leadership/authority alignment. This combination is rare and strong - two kings rule,
their ambition and confidence amping up. 
  Traits: They are bold, charismatic and self-reliant. They normally take charge
of things; inspire others with vision, determination. 
  Challenges: The double leadership sometimes creates conflict if ego clashes
occur. However, often their strong will overrules the petty differences. 
  Career Path: This combination thrives at business, politics, and any other
field requiring the leadership of a person. Entrepreneurs, CEOs, and leaders
in any creative industries often have this pairing. 
"When two kings unite, destiny bends to their will." 
2/ Driver 1, Conductor 2. The King and the Queen 
In combining the active, aspiring personality of a Number 1 and intuitive, caring
nature of Number 2, it sets a balance between power and sensitivity.It is one of the
most harmonious combinations where the King (1) leads and the Queen (2) follows
graciously.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Traits: These people have the ideal mix of logic and emotion that makes
them great decision-makers. They are great at building connections and
maintaining harmony in personal and professional relationships. 
  Challenges: Overdependence on the supportive nature of Number 2 can lead
to indecision at times, particularly if the individual doesn't assert their own
authority. 
  Career Paths: Ideal professions include fields involving water (such as the
Navy), education, counseling, or healing professions like nursing or therapy. 
“The King leads the way, but the Queen ensures the journey is smooth.” 
3/ Driver 1 and Conductor 3: The King and Jupiter 
Number 1's leadership qualities couple with the expansive wisdom of Number 3,
which is ruled by J upiter. This combination indicates intellectual development,
creativity, and a skill for leading others. 
  Characteristics: These people are resourceful, knowledgeable, and
persuasive. They are good communicators who perform well in careers that
involve teaching or mentoring. 
  Weaknesses: Their high intellect can make them overly critical or impatient
with those who do not have the same level of thinking.  
  Career Paths: Education, consultancy, writing, and public speaking are all
good options. They tend to be great mentors or spiritual guides.  
"Knowledge lights the path for the King." 
4/ Driver 1 and Conductor 4: The King and the Gangster 
It is a combination of Number 1's regal energy with Number 4's rebellious and
unpredictable vibes. The result is a unique mix of creativity and strategy.  
  Traits: Such personalities are bold, without the fear of taking risk. They have
the capabilities of changing the status quo and innovation in ways other
cannot.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Challenges: Such nature may lead to unstable circumstances if not handled
in proper management. 
  Career Paths: Suitable places include politics, speculative venture, and
entrepreneurial projects related to the most unconventional of industries.  
"When the rogue unites with the king, innovation strikes." 
5/ Driver 1 and Conductor 5: The King and the Prince 
 This one brings together Number 1's tenacity with a dash of the flexibility, charm, and
adaptability of Number 5. It is energetic and nimble and very likely a winning
combination. 
  Traits: One is extremely flexible, affable, and adaptable. With these qualities,
such people should do very well in networking occupations, careers
demanding flexibility or communication skills. 
  Challenges: Their ambitious drive may sometime clash with their desire for
freedom and spontaneity, leaving them unfocused. 
  Career Paths: Banking, finance, sales, and commerce suit them. They also
flourish in areas that require communication with the public and skills in
negotiation. 
"The King and the Prince conquer every arena with their synergy." 
6/ Driver 1 and Conductor 6: The King and Venus 
 The majesty of Number 1 blends with the grace and beauty of Number 6, ruled by
Venus. This produces a creative and harmonious individual with a keen eye for
aesthetics. 
  Traits: Warm, charismatic, and artistically inclined, these people add a dash
of sophistication to everything they do and are good at building relationships.  
  Challenges: Their concern for aesthetics and harmony may sometimes lead
them to lose track of practical goals. 
  Career Paths: Media, entertainment, hospitality, travel, and luxury industries
like jewelry, liquor, or high-end fashion suit them well.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
"The King rules with charm and elegance." 
7/ Driver 1 and Conductor 7: The King and Ketu 
 This combination combines the leadership aspect of Number 1 with the introspective
and spiritual energy of Number 7. It produces a reflective, mystical personality who is
quite inclined towards spirituality or research. 
  Traits: These people are thinkers, often metaphysical or philosophical in
nature. They are great at analytical and intuitive types of work.  
  Challenges: They may face problems of isolation, self-doubt, and the inability
to express emotions. Their journey to success is often through overcoming
inner conflicts. 
  Career Paths: Education, research, spirituality, and occult sciences are ideal
for them. 
"The King embarks on a spiritual quest." 
8/ Driver 1 and Conductor 8: The King and Saturn 
Number 1 and Number 8 energies are highly contrasting; they create tension and
often struggle. Number 1 is ambitious and optimistic while Number 8 brings in
heaviness, delays, and obstacles. 
  Traits: These people are hard working and determined but face significant
challenges in relationships, health, and career. Their journey is often marked
by struggle and perseverance. 
  Challenges: Delays, misunderstandings, and a lack of harmony are common.
Balancing these energies requires patience and resilience. 
  Career Paths: Success is possible in industries involving hard work, such as
manufacturing, construction, or law enforcement. 
“The King battles with Saturn’s trials.” 
9/ Driver 1 and Conductor 9: The King and Mars

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
The most powerful combination is when the sun (1) and the mars (9) combined,
making it an unbearable energy that cannot be stood against. It symbolises
unmatched success and ambition 
  Traits: These people never fear, are action lovers, and natural leaders. Its
energy and determination allow any field they choose to be reached at.  
  Challenges: This combination can be very impatient or impulsive sometimes,
but that is minor in comparison to their potential. 
  Career Paths: They do great in fields that need leadership, strategy, and
action. Business, politics, and defense are good fields. 
"The King and the Warrior forge a legacy of triumph." 
Driver-Conductor Combinations with 1 
  Leadership at the Core: Number 1, as the Driver, ensures a personality that
is centered on leadership, ambition, and independence. 
  Compatibility is Crucial: The combination of Driver and Conductor numbers
shapes the balance of traits and outcomes in life. 
  Challenges Can Be Managed: Even less favorable combinations like 1 –8
can be navigated with remedies, self-awareness, and effort. 
Harnessing the Power of Numerology 
By understanding Driver-Conductor combinations, individuals can: 
  Choose careers aligned with their strengths. 
  Enhance relationships by knowing compatibility. 
  Get rid of problems with the help of numerology tools, such as mantras,
gemstones, or changing lifestyles. 
Love the Power of Number 1 
 The Driver 1 combinations are full of success potential, and the hallmark of
leadership and ambition define them. Whether you are a 1 –9 achiever like Mukesh
Ambani or navigating the hurdles of a 1 –8 pairing, numerology offers profound
insights into your life's journey.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Wherein the driver number happens to be 2 and which is ruled by the Moon, people
are extremely sensitive, intuitive, and imaginative but may also exhibit sudden
emotional fluctuations. In each of these cases, either the lunar traits would enhance
or reduce the driver traits, thereby influencing each specific area of their life-like
relationships, career, challenges, etc. 
Here is a detailed exploration of all the possible driver-conductor combinations
involving the number 2 and an overview of relationships, career paths, and problems
for each. 
1/ Driver 2- Conductor 1: Moon and Sun 
It is one of the nice combinations involving the sensitivity of the moon with the self-
confidence, charisma, and outgoing nature of the sun. People of this combination are
balanced with an optimistic attitude, driven for success, and natural leadership with a
strong emotional background. 
  Relationships: With all that emotional depth and charisma, they are very
caring and attentive partners. They thrive well in relationships where mutual
respect and admiration are present. However, sometimes they can be over-
analytical to the point of misunderstanding a situation at times.  
  Career Path: This combination fits careers that require leadership, creativity,
and public engagement. Ideal professions include entertainment, politics,
business, public speaking, or teaching. 
  Challenges: While their confidence moves them to success, they are
sometimes overcome with self-doubt when they feel low. They need self-
discipline and emotional equilibrium. 
2/ Driver 2- Conductor 2: Double Moon 
Moon in both the driver and conductor positions intensifies sensitivity and intuition.
However, the double effect can render individuals indecisive and overthinking.  
  Relationships: These people are caring and sensitive partners, who are also
very emotional. They live in a world of sensitivity and feelings. However, their
unstable minds can lead to problems in communication and decision-making
in relationships.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Career Path: They find success in careers that require a lot of emotional
intelligence and creativity, such as counseling, writing, hospitality, or careers
associated with water or dairy industries. 
  Challenges: Their main challenges come from indecisiveness and problems
with multi-tasking. They will struggle with handling complicated
circumstances, thus often missing their opportunities. 
3/ Driver 2-Conductor 3: Moon and Jupiter 
In this combination, the energy of the Moon is integrated with J upiter's wisdom and
expanse. Although this conjunction is not a naturally harmonic one, it does show
potential for success in the intellectual and spiritual fields. 
  Relationships: They are thoughtful and philosophical in relationships, and
they value meaningful conversations and emotional depth. However, they
tend to overanalyze situations, which creates misunderstandings with their
partners. 
  Career Path: They are best suited for roles in education, research, teaching,
or spiritual practices. They thrive in environments that encourage knowledge
sharing and intellectual growth. 
  Challenges: They may not find stability early in life because they need a lot of
effort to balance emotional sensitivity with practical decision-making. 
4/ Driver 2-Conductor 4: Moon and Rahu 
 The combination of the Moon and Rahu creates an intense, unpredictable dynamic.
Rahu amplifies the Moon’s emotional tendencies, resulting in heightened sensitivity,
overthinking, and fluctuating life circumstances. This is often considered a
challenging pairing, as it brings periods of instability and confusion. However, it also
offers the potential for profound growth through self-awareness and spiritual
exploration. 
  Relationships: Relationships are complex for individuals with this
combination. They may experience emotional highs and lows, making it
difficult for them to maintain steady connections. Rahu’s influence can create
misunderstandings or trust issues in partnerships. However, when they
develop emotional balance, they can be deeply empathetic and devoted
partners. 
  Career Path: Rahu’s influence makes these individuals drawn to
unconventional or modern fields. They may succeed in technology, media,

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)

passages.content:
Career Path: Administrative roles, banking, teaching, and the army are ideal
for this combination. Their quick thinking and decisiveness make them
valuable in high-pressure situations. 
  Challenges: Impatience and impulsiveness can hinder their progress. A more
measured approach will help them achieve their goals. 
 The driver-conductor combinations for number 5 are Mercury, and they are indeed
spectacular in their versatility and ability to transform. Posing with the Sun, Moon, or
Saturn, they each have their unique strength and challenge, thereby illuminating the
dynamic interplay between intellect, adaptability, and ambition. 
Mark Zuckerberg, the founder of Facebook, is a classic example of the influence of
Mercury. Innovative thinking, adaptability, and great communication skills are all
attributes of Mercury's dynamic energy. Zuckerberg's ability to navigate the ever-
changing tech industry and his visionary approach underscore how individuals with a
strong Mercury influence can leave a lasting impact on the world.  
Finally, individuals with a driver number 5 have the potential to achieve remarkable
success when they harness Mercury's energy effectively. By balancing adaptability
with focus, persistence, and discipline, they can unlock their true potential and create
a life filled with innovation, achievement, and meaningful relationships.  
Driver 6 is numerologically associated with the planet Venus which rules beauty,
luxury, romance, as well as music. These traits are characterized as creative and
nurturing qualities in a person by an attraction for everything beautiful or fine in life.
 Their Venus-driven personality makes them charismatic and innovative as they
blossom with warmth and kindness in their interactions, but the conductor number
modifies this energy and determines how qualities of Venus express in those
different aspects of life, such as relationships, career, and personal growth.
Each driver-conductor combination that includes the number 6 has a different story
of strengths, challenges, and opportunities.
Don't know how to calculate your Driver and Conductor numbers? See our blog, How
 To Calculate Driver Number and How To Calculate Conductor Number , for a
detailed guide on how to obtain your numbers and what each of them means.
Let's look at these combinations in more detail and see how they shape the
destinies of individuals.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
6 –1: Venus and Sun – The Radiant Leader 
 This combination brings the creative power of Venus with the strong will of the Sun
and brings out individuals with innate leadership qualities. They are bold, ambitious,
and charismatic, which makes them unique in any group.
  Relationship: They are passionate lovers but sometimes too argumentative
because of their assertiveness. They seek loyalty and harmony but need to
adjust the over-assertiveness in their attitude for smoother relationships. 
  Career Path: Fields like law, politics, luxury goods, and high-end hospitality
are ideal. They also flourish in glamorous industries such as entertainment
and media where their charisma and leadership qualities shine. 
  Challenges: Overconfidence and impulsive behavior can lead to a few
failures. Cultivating patience and humility will help them gain success in the
long run. 
6 –2: Venus and Moon – The Compassionate Visionary 
 The combination of Venus and the Moon results in emotionally intelligent and
nurturing individuals. This is an amiable combination, focusing on creativity,
compassion, and practicality.
  Relationships: These people are loving and empathetic partners who put
family and close relationships first. However, their heightened sensitivity
sometimes leads to emotional instability. 
  Career Path: They thrive in hospitality, arts, and food businesses, especially
those that require a personal touch. Sweet businesses, such as bakeries or
catering, are well-suited to them. 
  Challenges: They may have indecision and over-reliance on others for
emotional support. Resilience building and focusing on their goals can help
them overcome these challenges. 
6 –3: Venus and Jupiter – The Conflicted Idealist 
 This match marries Venus's appreciation for luxury with J upiter's spiritual acumen,
creating a struggle between material and moral values. They often struggle within
but can be highly successful professionally.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Relationships: The relationship is not always easy because of the opposing
values. Venus wants beauty and harmony, while J upiter desires discipline and
higher ideals. It takes a balancing act. 
  Career Path: Ideal fields include law, finance, education, and consultancy,
where they can combine their charm with intellectual pursuits. 
  Challenges: Health issues and marital discord are common pitfalls.
Cultivating self-discipline and aligning their goals with their values can lead to
a more harmonious life. 
6 –4: Venus and Rahu – The Ambitious Innovator 
Venus and Rahu create a dynamic and ambitious combination, emphasizing luxury,
innovation, and material success. Rahu amplifies Venus's desire for recognition,
making these individuals bold risk-takers.
  Relationships: Passionate and intense in their relationships, they often
attract partners who admire their drive and charisma. However, Rahu’s
influence can lead to unpredictability in personal interactions. 
  Career Path: They succeed in luxury industries, entertainment, and high-
profile ventures. Their creative thinking also makes them successful in
entrepreneurial ventures. 
  Challenges: Their pursuit of success can sometimes lead to unethical
compromises. It is important to ground them in integrity and to give them
emotional attachment over material gain. 
6 –5: Venus and Mercury – The Balanced Diplomat 
 This is one of the most harmonious combinations, combining the charm of Venus
with the intellect of Mercury. These are flexible and versatile people who make
excellent communicators.
  Relationships: They are very loving and charismatic companions who are
respectful and considerate to each other. Socially adept, they are quite
popular and liked. 
  Career: Media, luxury travel, hospitality, and public relations would be their
fields of work since they will be great at jobs which require creativity and
communication.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Challenges: They can be prone to procrastination and overindulgence in
material pleasures. Discipline and focus will be the guarantee of long-term
success. 
6 –6: Double Venus – The Artistic Powerhouse 
Venus in both the driver and conductor positions amplifies the creative, charming,
and love-for-luxury qualities. These are born artists and visionaries.
  Relationships: They are extremely romantic and look for harmony in their
relationships. Sometimes, they can be a little too good and thus disappointed.  
  Career: They should be into acting, modeling, music, or designing. They do
well in luxury business as well as high-end retailing. 
  Challenges: Indulgence in the concept of vanity or extravagance leads to
financial instability. The art of living in balance is of paramount importance. 
6 –7: Venus and Ketu – The Spiritual Artist 
 This combination brings Venus creativity and Ketu spiritual depth. These natives are
reflective and creative with a tendency to strive for balancing material success with
inner fulfillment.
  Relationship: They are faithful and affectionate lovers, but their withdrawn
nature makes them hide their feelings. 
  Career Path: They work well in research, arts, and sports fields as they do
well in positions that call for analytical and creative thinking. 
  Challenges: Delayed recognition and self-doubt can affect their performance.
Confidence building and maintaining a clear idea of what they want is
important. 
6 –8: Venus and Saturn – The Pragmatic Achiever 
Venus's attraction blended with Saturn's sensibility results in practical and
industrious people. They are grounded and ambitious and can really make things
happen by just being persistent.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Relationships: They are loyal and dependable partners who value stability
and commitment. They sometimes have problems with the expression of
emotions. 
  Career Path: They are especially suited to fields like law, real estate, or
luxury industries. Their methodical approach also makes them successful in
administrative positions. 
  Challenges: Over-exertion and lack of individual self-care can result in
burnout. Self-management and work-life balance needs to be given
importance 
6 –9: Venus and Mars – The Fiery Visionary 
 This aspect combines Venus's love of luxury with Mars's more action-oriented
energy. A person born under this sign is ambitious, energetic and goal-oriented.
  Relationship: Their relationships are passionate and at times volatile
because of the Mars assertiveness. This means they have to learn patience
and compromise. 
  Career Path: These are sportsmen, luxury product producers, and
administrators in governments. They use all this assertiveness and quickness
of decision-making. 
  Challenges: Impulsiveness, controversy, and scandals make it difficult for
them to continue smoothly. They need emotional equilibrium and strategic
thinking. 
Ratan Tata, a former chairman of Tata Sons, is an iconic Indian industrialist,
exemplifying qualities related to driver number 6. Humble, graceful, and with a vision,
Ratan Tata was a classic reflection of the Venusian virtues of nurturing and
creativity. With his vision, the Tata Group expanded its operations worldwide without
compromising its commitment to social causes and ethics in business.
 The luxury and innovation are represented through projects such as Tata Nano and
the acquisition of J aguar-Land Rover by Ratan Tata, which are reflective of the
planet Venus. His charitable pursuits bring out the nurturant and compassionate
facets of Venus, making it show materialistic success along with an emotional
fulfillment.
Venus's Power in Numerology

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
The driver-conductor combinations involving Venus reveal profound influences on
personality, relationships, and career paths. Whether it's the balanced diplomacy of
the 6 –5 combination, the artistic brilliance of 6 –6, or the fiery ambition of 6 –9,
Venus's energy manifests in diverse and impactful ways.
For people with driver number 6, the key to success is in using Venus's charm,
creativity, and nurturing energy while staying grounded and disciplined. By aligning
their goals with their inner values, they can achieve not only material success but
also emotional harmony and personal growth.
In numerology, the number 7 is under the guidance of Ketu, the planet representing
introspection, spiritual wisdom, and detachment from materialistic pursuit. People
whose driver number is 7 are more intellectual, analytical, and introspective. They
are a unique blend of wisdom and curiosity that propels them to explore the
mysteries of life. Ketu's energy pushes them toward spiritual pursuits, research, and
self-discovery, making them seekers of deeper truths rather than mere material
gains. 
 The number of the conductor changes the qualities of the core of the driver and thus
the ways those qualities may appear in different spheres such as relationships,
careers, and self-actualization.
Don't know how to calculate your Driver and Conductor numbers? See our blog, How
 To Calculate Driver Number and How To Calculate Conductor Number , for a
detailed guide on how to obtain your numbers and what each of them means.  
Let's now go through the combinations of the driver 7 and try to clarify how wisdom
and sensibleness mix with emotional troubles. 
7 –1: Ketu and Sun – The Wise Leader 
People who have Ketu combined with the Sun's authority possess a lot of sense of
direction and leadership. Such people are generally respected for their insight and
charm and are normally a good guide or mentor. 
  Relationships: These are reliable and dependable mates, though sometimes
their secretive nature gives an impression of being emotionally very detached.
 They have a deeper need for mental and spiritual communication rather than
material and physical interaction. 
  Career Path: Fields like teaching, occult sciences, and leadership roles are
suited for this combination. Their ability to guide and inspire others makes
them good teachers or spiritual leaders.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Challenges: They can over-analyze situations and end up not making a
decision. The need to balance the intellectual pursuit with action is a success
factor. 
7 –2: Ketu and Moon – The Intuitive Thinker 
 This combination brings out the wisdom of Ketu and emotional depth of the Moon.
 These individuals have increased intuition and creativity. Both the planets are soft;
yet, when combined, they bring in deep insight and empathy into relationships.  
  Relationships: They make compassionate and empathetic mates, often
taking precedence of emotional balance. But this can lead to mood swings or
a sense of inferiority. 
  Career Path: healing, occult, creative arts, where their intuition and sympathy
can shine. Their capacity to establish deep connections with others makes
them excellent counselors. 
  Challenges: Emotional unsteadiness and over-sensitivity can stand as
stumbling blocks. Developing emotional toughness is the way ahead.  
7 –3: Ketu and Jupiter – The Knowledge Seeker 
A combination of introspective Ketu and expansive J upiter knowledge provides these
people with a powerful intellectual and spiritual basis. They are natural philosophers
who are always attracted to teaching, healing, and higher truths. 
  Relationships: They do value loyalty and mutual respect in relationships.
However, their high intellectual standards sometimes become a source of
trouble for finding compatible mates. 
  Career Path: Fields like spiritual teaching, education, and healing are great.
 They are excellent at doing jobs that allow them to share their wisdom and
lead others. 
  Challenges: They tend to overthink and question everything, which may
make them delay decisions. This can be overcome by learning to trust their
instincts and then taking action with confidence. 
7 –4: Ketu and Rahu – The Balanced Strategist

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
This combination represents the union of Ketu’s wisdom and Rahu’s ambition,
creating a balance between introspection and practicality. These individuals are
strategic thinkers with the potential for great success. 
  Relationships: They are loyal but cautious partners, often taking their time to
build trust. Their grounded approach to relationships ensures long-lasting
connections. 
  Career Path: They excel in strategic roles, research, and administrative
fields. Their analytical mind and careful planning make them a good problem
solver. 
  Challenges: Their cautious approach may sometimes make them lose
opportunities. Building confidence and calculated risk-taking can help them
succeed. 
7 –5: Ketu and Mercury – The Analytical Genius 
 This is a harmonious combination, where the introspection of Ketu is married with
the intellect and adaptability of Mercury. Such individuals are sharp, analytical, and
good communicators. 
  Relationships: They value intellectual stimulation in their relationships and
seek partners who can match their curiosity and wit. However, they may
struggle with emotional vulnerability. 
  Career Path: They would shine in data analysis, graphic design, sales, or
marketing. Quick thinking and problem solving is a priceless attribute in these
careers. 
  Challenges: Their tendency to overanalyze can lead to indecision or missed
opportunities. They need to balance their intellectual pursuits with decisive
action. 
7 –6: Ketu and Venus – The Spiritual Artist 
 This combination brings together the spiritual depth of Ketu with the creativity and
love for beauty of Venus. They are introspective yet artistic, often finding themselves
in careers that allow them to express their individuality. 
  Relationships: They are loving and empathetic partners who cherish
emotional and intellectual connections. Their introspective nature can
sometimes make them seem distant.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Career Path: They are brilliant in the fields of arts, sports, and healing
professions. They are distinguished in their chosen fields by their creative and
intuitive approach. 
  Challenges: They are often faced with delayed success and self-doubt.
Confidence building and trust in their instincts help them realize their potential.  
7 –7: Double Ketu – The Challenged Seeker 
 This is a very challenging combination with Ketu in both driver and conductor
positions. On the one hand, it highlights wisdom and spiritual growth, but on the
other hand, it can lead to the lack of direction or grounding. 
  Relationships: These individuals often face problems in trust and emotional
vulnerability, which results in unstable relationships. 
  Career Path: Fields like occult sciences, teaching, and spiritual healing are
ideal for them because these fields allow them to channel their introspection
into meaningful pursuits. 
  Challenges: They may experience disappointment and setbacks in personal
relationships. Emotional resilience and grounding in practical goals can help
them overcome this. 
7 –8: Ketu and Saturn – The Patient Achiever 
 This combination pairs introspective Ketu with disciplined Saturn and perseverance.
 These people are patient and methodical, capable of achieving great success over
time. 
  Relationships: They are faithful and responsible companions who respect
stability and commitment. However, they can't be very expressive about their
feelings. 
  Career Path: Teaching, research, and administrative careers are apt for
them. Their disciplined approach ensures steady progress. 
  Challenges: Delayed success and a tendency to overwork can lead to
frustration. Maintaining a balanced perspective and practicing self-care is
essential.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
7 –9: Ketu and Mars – The Driven Visionary 
It joins the wisdom of Ketu and the energy of Mars together with ambition. This sort
of person is quite work-oriented and can sometimes easily succeed by will power
and energy alone. 
  Relationships: It can be pretty disputable on relationships due to
assertiveness or passion. He learns compromise and patience. 
  Career path: Teaching, healing and occult are all proper avenues in life
because it's based upon their spiritual interest along with intellectual. 
  Challenges: Impulsiveness and overcommitting can be their downfall.
Patience and long-term goals are what they must work on. 
Mahendra Singh Dhoni, the cricketing legend of India, is an example of 7-6
combination. He is known for his calm nature and strategic brilliance. He is a
reflection of the wisdom and discipline of Ketu and the grace and creativity of Venus.
His success in leading the Indian cricket team to multiple championships speaks of
the balance of intellect and intuition that defines this combination.  
Driver-conductor combinations with the number 7 show how Ketu can shape an
individual's personality, relationships, and career. Though Ketu emphasizes wisdom,
introspection, and spiritual growth, it is the conductor number that decides how these
qualities take shape in practical and emotional life. 
Driver number 7 individuals become successful only if their intellectual activities have
practical actions. This ensures that with spiritual wisdom so grounded on goals, a
person not only gains success but also inner satisfaction along with emotional
balance. When the energies of Ketu get properly utilized, personalities like Mahendra
Singh Dhoni exhibit what such a number could be to achieve success at great
heights. 
Number 8 in numerology comes under the rule of Saturn, which is the planet of
discipline, karma, and hard-earned rewards. Saturn energy brings challenges and
opportunities that build lives. If the driver number is 8, added to other conductor
numbers, it makes a unique combination and might produce a unique interplay of
traits affecting relationships, career paths, and life challenges.
Don't know how to calculate your Driver and Conductor numbers? See our blog, How
 To Calculate Driver Number and How To Calculate Conductor Number , for a
detailed guide on how to obtain your numbers and what each of them means.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Let's now look deeper into those combinations and their meanings. 
8 –1: Saturn and the Sun 
 The 8 –1 combination means a conflict of Saturn with the Sun. In this case, these two
planets enter into a confrontation; the one represents modesty and karmic justice,
while the other represents power and ego. Thus, a clash of these two creates life full
of strife and struggles. 
  Relationship: Tense relationships are typical of this combination. The forceful
natures of these personalities generally cause friction in personal
relationships. More marital disharmony is also seen in women compared to
men, as Saturn's karmic affects them more. Harmonization takes much efforts
from both sides involved. 
  Career Path: Although the 8 –1 pairing creates challenges, it also teaches
them to be resilient and develop leadership qualities. They shine in places
where service and leadership intersect, like governance, public administration,
and social work. With practice to harmonize ambition and humility, they can
become leaders. 
  Challenges: The main struggle for this combination is the tension between
ambition and discipline. Delays in professional achievements and personal
growth are common, requiring patience and persistence. 
8 –2: Saturn and the Moon 
 The 8 –2 combination combines Saturn's practical, down-to-earth nature with the
Moon's emotional, nurturing qualities, creating a dynamic yet conflicting personality
that struggles to balance logic and emotions. 
  Relationship: People with this combination often lack emotional vulnerability.
 They tend to be reserved and might not open up to their partners. Emotional
stability is important in healthy relationships since miscommunications and
misunderstandings are common. 
  Career Path: Careers in healthcare, counseling, and psychology suit this
combination. Their capacity for empathy, combined with the discipline of
Saturn, makes them effective healers and caretakers. Nursing, social work,
and humanitarian efforts are other suitable fields.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Challenges: Health problems, especially stress-related ones, are a regular
problem. Emotional stress also causes indecisiveness that may affect their
personal as well as professional life. Building emotional strength is what
would help them overcome these problems. 
8 –3: Saturn and Jupiter 
Saturn and J upiter combination (8 –3) gives discipline along with wisdom to people,
which makes them intellectual and ethical. It makes people balanced with pragmatic
optimism. It thus lays a very strong ground for growth. 
  Relationship: The relationships tend to be stable, but the tension can grow in
the relationship if such individuals focus more on professional growth than
their personal lives. J upiter's influence makes them approachable and softer
than the rigidity of Saturn. 
  Career Path: This pairing does extremely well in mental and formal work
environments, like practicing law, teaching education, or working in the
publishing world. There are good opportunities for healing arts and religious or
spiritual professions. Their stability as they pursue knowledge makes them an
excellent teacher and instructor. 
  Challenges: Delays by Saturn often lead to frustration, especially when they
start a career. However, perseverance with ethics pays off in the long run.
Stiffness or inflexibility must be overcome. 
8 –4: Saturn and Rahu 
 The 8 –4 combination unites Saturn and Rahu, both associated with struggle and
transformation. This intense pairing often results in a life filled with karmic challenges
and profound personal growth. 
  Relationship: This combination creates difficulties in forming and maintaining
permanent relationships. Saturn’s stern nature and Rahu’s unpredictable
energy lead to conflicts and misunderstandings. Distant or unconventional
relationships may fare better. 
  Career Path: People with this combination are outstanding in jobs related to
structure and transformation, like engineering, mechanics, and construction.
 They also perform well in jobs that require strength and flexibility, like disaster
management or rehabilitation.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Challenges:Constant obstacles and insecurity characterize this combination.
Personal and professional stability is achieved through a lot of hard work and
by proactively working through difficulties. 
8 –5: Saturn and Mercury 
 The 8-5 combination of Saturn's discipline and Mercury's adaptability brings together
an individual who is strategic, analytical, and resourceful. This harmonious
combination has brought balance and focus to these individuals.  
  Relationship: When it comes to relationships, Mercury's communicative
nature helps ease Saturn's reservedness. While they are dependable and
faithful, they do tend to overanalyze their emotions, which sometimes brings
misunderstandings between them. 
  Career Path: Combinations such as real estate, banking, trade, and law are
perfect. They perform well in organized jobs that demand careful planning and
strategic thinking. Success generally comes in leadership positions in
regulated industries. 
  Challenges: The greatest problem is control over stress and over-thinking.
Saturn ensures success through the sweat of one's brow, but delayed
rewards or recognition can bring frustration. Patience must be practiced. 
8 –6: Saturn and Venus 
 The combination 8 –6 mellows Saturn with the charm and creativity of Venus, so this
person blends the best of practicality with aesthetic sensibility. 
  Relationship: The relationships between couples are generally harmonious
due to Venus's softening of Saturn's sternness. However, delays in marriage
or emotional misunderstandings may occur. Such people value stability and
loyalty within a relationship. 
  Career Path: Creative professions, like media, fashion, and hospitality, suit
this combination well. They also thrive in fields that require a disciplined
approach to luxury and aesthetics, such as architecture or interior design.  
  Challenges: Saturn's influence can delay recognition in creative fields, testing
their patience and perseverance. Overcoming self-doubt is the key to
maximizing their potential. 
8 –7: Saturn and Ketu

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
The combination of Saturn (8) and Ketu (7) has very introspective and religious
personalities who relate to mysticism and soul searching. 
  Relationship: Emotional detachment is a big challenge in relationships. Due
to their reclusive personalities and trust issues, building intimate relationships
may be challenging for them. However, once they connect, they are very loyal
and supportive. 
  Career Path: Professions in astrology, yoga, teaching, and healing arts are
best suited to this nature. They are also quite suitable for jobs needing deep
analysis or providing spiritual guidance. 
  Challenges: Reversals and stagnation are the main aspects of life. This
personality needs to manage introspection along with socialization to succeed
without getting isolated in any profession. 
8 –8: Double Saturn 
When the driver and conductor numbers are both 8s, the energy of Saturn is
amplified. This combination spells very tough times but phenomenal potential for
growth. 
  Relationship: Difficulty often characterizes relationships, especially when it
comes to permanent attachments. Feelings may be bound tightly within one's
chest, leading sometimes to misunderstandings and conflicts. 
  Career Path: Fields requiring physical labor, engineering, or sports are a
perfect fit for this combination. Success often results from hard work and
determination, and Saturn rewards those who persevere. 
  Challenges: Individuals with an 8 –8 combination experience struggles and
setbacks that define their lives. However, their resilience and commitment can
turn challenges into opportunities for growth and success. 
8 –9: Saturn and Mars 
 The 8 –9 blend of energies combines Saturn's discipline with Mars's energy and
results in ambitious, aggressive individuals. This is an extremely powerful and
determined personality type. 
  Relationship: The relationships can be rough because Mars's fiery nature is
opposed by Saturn's grounded energy. On the other hand, loyalty and mutual
respect often lead to long-lasting partnerships.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Career Path: Professions in law enforcement, the military, or construction suit
this combination. Leadership positions demanding decisiveness and discipline
also work well. 
  Challenges: Balancing Mars's impulsiveness with Saturn's patience is a
challenge. Delays and conflicts may arise, but their determination ensures
eventual success. 
Saturn influence in driver-conductor combinations is powerful, making one face all
challenges and succeed by determination. Many have really excelled in such
combinations. Take, for example Narendra Modi. The individual, being a holder of an
8 –5 combination, displays a level of resilience and strategy akin to Saturn and
Mercury. On the other hand, Roger Federer, whose ruler is double Saturn at 8 –8,
gives hope for success based on diligent efforts. 
Summing up, though the number 8 combinations bring troubles, it also offers
unparalleled opportunities for growth and achievement. Those who have Saturn
ruling them can overcome the odd situations with discipline, patience, and
persistence. 
 The number 9 in numerology is the planet of Mars, the energy, courage, and
determination planet. Mars is dynamic and forceful, known for its passion and
unpredictability. If the driver number is 9 and is matched with various conductor
numbers, each combination will affect the temperament, relationships, career
trajectory, and challenges.
Don't know how to calculate your Driver and Conductor numbers? See our blog, How
 To Calculate Driver Number  and How To Calculate Conductor Number , for a
detailed guide on how to obtain your numbers and what each of them means.  
Below, we delve into the specifics of these combinations. 
9 –1: Mars and the Sun 
 The 9-1 combination is a very powerful alliance of Mars (commander) and the Sun
(king). Both numbers are capable of leadership, and therefore, when combined, they
can create individuals who are driven and ambitious to succeed. However, this
combination is also influenced by the volatile energy of Mars, which makes it
unpredictable at times.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Relationship: This combination creates strong, but intense relationships.
People here tend to take charge in their private lives, leading with passion and
assertiveness. They tend to be protective and loyal, but their dominant
characteristic may sometimes clash with equally robust partners. 
  Career: Careers that suit this combination are law enforcement, military
services, and administrative positions. Leadership positions where they can
have authority and command respect are apt for their skills.  
  Challenges: Their biggest challenge is to control their impulsiveness and
temper. They need to balance their fiery energy with diplomacy so as not to
create conflicts both in personal and professional settings. 
9 –2: Mars and the Moon 
 The 9 –2 combination brings together Mars's assertive energy and the Moon's
nurturing, emotional qualities. This combination creates a clash between aggression
and sensitivity, thus creating a personality that is passionate and moody at the same
time. 
  Relationship: Relationships for this combination are often tricky. While they
add a depth of feeling to their relationships, the energies are so different and
can sometimes be miscommunicated. Marriage is difficult, especially in terms
of emotional need meeting the mate's need. 
  Career Path: This combination excels in careers that require empathy and
action - nursing, counseling, community service. They also work well in artistic
fields where feelings are a significant part of the communication. 
  Challenges: The major challenge in balancing Mars's assertiveness with
sensitivity is the tendency to be mood-swinging. Successful achievement can
be made with constant behavior over mood swings. 
9 –3: Mars and Jupiter 
Combining the bravery of Mars with the wisdom of J upiter produces action-oriented,
optimistic individuals who are strategic. The pairing is commonly seen as auspicious
for both personal and professional development. 
  Relationship: In relationships, this combination fosters mutual respect and
intellectual stimulation. They support each other as partners of both emotional
and intellectual connections. Their love life is based on achieving common
goals and a meaning in life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Career Path: The ideal career is teaching, administrative, and also in the
armed forces. Their combination of courage and prudence makes them
excellent leadership in educational and public services. 
  Challenges: Their biggest problem is balancing the impulsiveness of Mars
with the need for planning from J upiter. They must, in other words, cultivate
patience and strategy to get the best out of things and enjoy long-term
success. 
9 –4: Mars and Rahu 
 The 9 –4 is not an easy combination as Mars and Rahu are associated with intensity
and ego. Thus, life is characterized by lots of conflict and struggle; much personal
growth may be necessary to overcome these aspects. 
  Relationship: Relationships are dramatic, often fighting, caused by ego and
miscommunication. They tend to have a hard time sustaining long-term
relationships because of their intensity and unpredictability. 
  Career: Careers in danger or adventure, such as defense, engineering, or
entrepreneurial pursuits. They will also thrive in professional or legal fields. 
  Challenges: Health problems and injuries are frequent difficulties. Mastering
control of their wild nature and ego will help prevent wars and failures in life.  
9 –5 Mars and Mercury 
 The 9 –5 combination gives Mars's energy a tie-up with Mercury's versatility and
brains. The result is an active, well-balanced individual who can score success in
most walks of life. 
  Relationship: In relationships, this combination brings energy and balance.
 They are lively and engaging partners who value communication and mutual
understanding. However, they may occasionally struggle with impulsiveness
in their interactions. 
  Career Path: The banking sector, media, and communication fields are ideal
for this combination. Their analytical and action-oriented approach makes
them successful in roles that require problem-solving and quick decision-
making. 
  Challenges: The main issue is to control their restlessness and keep focused
on long-term goals. Patience and consistency are the keys to long-term
success.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
9 –6: Mars and Venus 
 The 9 –6 combination brings together Mars's passion with Venus's charm and
creativity. This combination is often successful but is usually fraught with controversy
and personal issues. 
  Relationship: Relationships tend to be intense and unstable. Mars's fiery
nature conflicts with Venus's need for tranquility and luxury, leading to fights.
Marital harmony seems unattainable without conscious effort to resolve
conflicts. 
  Career Path: Entertainment, media, and luxury industries are good fields for
this combination. They could also do really well in careers that demand
charisma and boldness, such as public relations or acting. 
  Challenges: Controversies and relationship problems are very common.
Controlling their impulsiveness and channeling their energies into constructive
activities can further help them flourish. 
9 –7 Mars and Ketu 
 The union of 9 –7 combines the action-oriented power of Mars with the
introspectiveness and detachment of Ketu. This results in spirituality, thoughtfulness,
and bravery. 
  Relationship: Emotional distance is present in the relationship. They are
faithful and protective but at times close-pretentious. They do perfectly well in
relationships where they can find personal space and liberty. 
  Career: Teaching, healing, and spiritual practices are suited to this
combination. They also do very well in positions requiring courage and
endurance, such as social movements and emergency relief. 
  Challenges: The main challenge is balancing their active and introspective
tendencies. Overcoming indecision and embracing action can lead to greater
success and fulfillment. 
9 –8: Mars and Saturn 
 The combination of Mars and Saturn gives a bold individual with the discipline of
Saturn. Such people are determined, ambitious, and resilient in the face of
challenges.

passages.source: Numeros Vision 81-Matrix Planetary Dynamics (NV-MPD-15)
passages.content:
Relationship: This combination creates loyalty and commitment in
relationships. The conflicting energies may sometimes ignite power struggles.
Respect and compromise are keys to harmony. 
  Career Area: This combination is excellent for professions such as law
enforcement, military, and engineering. They prove adept at careers
demanding discipline and courage. They soon become leaders in their
profession. 
  Challenges: Delays and struggles are normal because Saturn tempers the
impulsiveness of Mars with lessons in patience. Perseverance and strategic
planning are required to overcome these challenges. 
9 –9: Double Mars 
When both the driver and conductor numbers are 9, Mars's energy is amplified,
making individuals who are intensely passionate and action-oriented. However, this
combination also brings stability and balance-related challenges. 
  Relationship: Those with strong personalities and independence are often
volatile, as they quarrel easily. When loyal, it is without words, and they
appear to have difficulty with vulnerability. 
  Career Path: Positions that require activity physically or otherwise that yields
some risk, leadership, or both suit the combination. Sports, defense, and
entrepreneurship are fields where they can exhibit their energy constructively. 
  Challenges: Their greatest challenge is managing their intensity and avoiding
impulsive decisions. Cultivating patience and mindfulness can help them
achieve their goals without unnecessary setbacks. 
People with a driver-conductor combination including Mars are typically very brave
and tenacious. Salman Khan is a classic example; with a 9 –6 combination, he is
imbued with the intense energy and charisma associated with Mars and Venus. His
bold and passionate nature has endured controversy to emerge with lasting success
in the entertainment industry. 
In summary, while the influence of Mars brings unpredictability and challenges, it
also fosters resilience and drive. Those with these combinations have the potential to
achieve great success through focus, discipline, and strategic action.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Introduction
Numerology uses numbers as a key to human behavior. It is an easy-to-
learn method that exercises the mind’s intuitive faculty to fathom the depths
of human personality.
Numerologists have to forget their own identities and devote themselves
totally to exploring the personalities of others. They must learn to become
calm and empty before they are able to use their intuition. Practicing the art
of numerology creates endurance, patience, and pointedness. Experience
teaches numerologists more than books can teach. The information
contained in books only opens the windows of the mind. One then has to
work with one’s personal understanding of that information. Information
alone is not knowledge; direct experience must be added before information
becomes knowledge. Numerology is simple to learn and very engaging, like
the creative arts. It teaches one sympathy toward others.
I advise my readers not simply to accept blindly the information that
follows. By observing their three numbers (psychic, destiny, and name) and
the relationship of these to the numbers of other people, they should
formulate their own language to explain what they understand. They should
remember: All numbers are both good and bad. No one number is superior
to any other. All numbers work differently through different human bodies,
each with its own genetic behavioral pattern. All numbers are influenced by
the unique qualities of their environment and by the collective unconscious.
We can try to understand them, but we have no right to judge and categorize
them.
Numerology is a method of linking the microcosm with the macrocosm.
With practice, a numerologist starts to comprehend the influence of celestial
bodies on human understanding and conduct. All objects of the material
world are related to the nine planets.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
For a numerologist the planets become embodied in a human form, and
he or she can closely observe them as a part of the cosmic play.
Those people who do not allow themselves the freedom of seeing the
influence of the celestial and astral bodies cannot observe this play. Planets
for them are objects in outer space that have no influence on their physical
and mental make-up. To them all predictive sciences are useless. People
who have time, faith, and enough patience, however, can watch this play
and learn from it the lessons that will guide the consciousness of coming
generations.
Numerology is not a complete science. It is just one branch of the
predictive sciences. To be a good numerologist one must become a good
observer and a patient listener. Study of physiognomy and astrology is very
necessary. Numerology is much simpler than astrology and does not require
complicated mathematical calculations. There are just three things a
numerologist needs to know: the day of the month a person was born, the
numerological value of his or her popular name, and the person’s total birth
information (date, month, and year). From astrology, the numerologist
needs to know about all the zodiac signs, and a person’s day of birth, sun
sign, and moon sign. In India, the season during which a person was born
also has to be known, since that has an effect on one’s temperament. Certain
information from physiognomy needs to be learned as well, such as how the
shape and form of the various body parts correlate with an individual’s
thinking process. (It is known, for example, that the perceptual world of tall
people is different from that of short people.)
The purpose of working with numbers is to save energy. People who act
without a proper understanding of the right moment to start a job waste a lot
of energy by making the wrong moves. Numerology provides the
knowledge for such things as how to select the right moment, the right
relationship, the right dwelling place—thereby saving energy.
Numerology must not be used to gain power and control over others.
Also, money should not be earned with this knowledge. Using one’s mind
to explore the personality of others for money alone will result in stress.
Through the selfless use of numerology, one earns good karma.
Simply guessing what number a stranger is could be fun, but it is more
fun to know how to practice numerology. By asking someone his or her
date of birth, one can then find out what sort of person he or she could be.
This exercise is also a good mind game. On one hand, it makes students of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
numerology use their memory (their numerological information bank) and
their intuition; on the other, it makes them stay in the present and pay
proper attention to the person in question. The student becomes free from
his or her little world and launches an adventurous trip into a new
personality.
Through numerology, all the aspects of life in various forms are explored.
The student sees how planets act differently within different people. The
study of this science requires that one have the alertness and openness of an
explorer—it also brings with it the joy that follows a successful exploration.
Having knowledge of the numbers and a good memory can save much
energy and time. A keen interest in numerology can work to enhance
memory and pointedness; it can also promote the intuitive faculty of the
mind.
The advice that accompanies the discussion of each number regarding
fasting or gemstones is based on Ayurvedic and Tantric knowledge.
Following the prescriptions given will help to create a better environment
for the microorganisms living in our bodies. As receptors of cosmic energy,
they serve to create harmony in our lives.
Thus, numerology can provide:
a better understanding of both our good and bad sides
a method of accepting our weaknesses, and those of others
a vehicle for discussing these weaknesses
a joyful way of passing time
freedom and escape from our own personal worries
a good focal point, or method of paying attention and getting attention
popularity and respect
a tool for entering into the unknown
friendly interactions.
To practice numerology, we develop:
the mind of a scholar researching life
the alertness of an explorer
a good memory and pointedness
an intuitive mind
good conversational skills.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
NUMBERS AND THE NUMEROLOGIST
For a numerologist there are only nine numbers from which all calculations
of the material world are made. All numbers beyond 9 are repetitions. By a
simple method of addition, they can be reduced to single whole numbers.
The number 10 is not a whole number; it is simply a 1 with a zero.
Zero
Zero is not a number and has no numerological value. In the Western occult
tradition, zero is regarded as a symbol of eternity. It is surprising to learn
that the zero made its first entrance into the Western hemisphere only a few
hundred years ago. Its introduction helped considerably in the development
of mathematics, science, and modern technology. In the East, where it was
known from the dawn of civilization, the zero is known as Sunya (shoonya)
or the Void, which is the foundation stone of Buddhism. Zero has no value
when it is alone, because it is abstract and numbers are concrete. When zero
combines with a number, it gives birth to arithmetical progressions and the
series of double, triple, and multiple numbers, such as 10, 100, and 1000.
When you do not know about zero, you cannot play with numbers beyond 9
(that is, beyond the material world). When you do know about it, its mystic
nature leads you towards eternity and impairs your material progress. Zero
is considered unfortunate. When a zero appears in a date of birth, it brings
misfortune. Even the tenth month of the year (October), being a 10, brings
misfortune, although to a lesser degree. The appearance of a zero in the year
of birth brings the least misfortune. The combination of zero with any
number reduces the influence of that number. People with a zero in their
birthdate numbers generally have to struggle harder than those without. The
presence of more than one zero—October (tenth month) 10, 1950—makes
one have to work even more in life. All numbers from 1 to 9 are present in
zero, and when zero combines with these numbers, a whole series of
numbers evolves. For example, when zero combines with number 1, the
numbers 11 through 19 that belong to that series evolve.1 The introduction
of zero aided the development of math, science, and the modern technology
that brought mankind to the computer age, but it does not “exist.”
QUALITIES OF NUMBERS

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Even and Odd
Numbers can be categorized into two basic groups:
Odd: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 and Even: 2, 4, 6, 8.
Odd numbers have an odd total; there are five of them. Even numbers
have an even total (four).
Odd numbers are solar, masculine, electrical, acidic, and dynamic. They
are additional (they add).
Even numbers are lunar, feminine, magnetic, alkaline, and static. They
are subtractional (they reduce). They remain without movement, because
they have an even group of pairs (2 and 4, 6 and 8). If we pair odd numbers,
one number always remains without a counterpart (1 and 3, 5 and 7, 9).
This makes them dynamic.
In general, two similar numbers (two odd numbers or two even) are not
very good.
even + even = even (static)
2 + 2 = 4
odd + even = odd (dynamic)
3 + 2 = 5
odd + odd = even (static) 3 + 3 = 6
Some numbers are friendly; some are in opposition to each other. Their
relationships are determined by the relationships between their ruling
planets (see chart on pages 188-189). When two friendly numbers come
together, they are not very productive. Like two friends, they both relax and
nothing happens. But when enemy numbers come in combination, they
make each other alert and active; both people have to work more. Seen in
this way, enemy numbers are actually friends, and friendly numbers are
really enemies that stop progress and activity.
Neutral numbers remain inactive. They do not give any support nor do
they induce or oppose activity.
Universal Friend

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Number 6 is unique in that it is common to both odd and even numbers. It
can be the result of a combination of either 3 (odd) even numbers, or 2
(even) odd numbers. In 2+2+2=6, the even number 2 is repeated three
times, which is an odd number of repetitions. In 3+3=6, the odd number 3 is
repeated twice, which is an even number of repetitions.
Being common to both groups, number 6 is therefore known as a
“universal friend.”
NUMBERS AND ASTROLOGY
There are nine single numbers. The relationship of numbers to planets is the
key to numerology. In the Hindu system, this relationship is the same as in
the West, with the two following exceptions. The number 4 in the Hindu
system corresponds to Rahu (the north node of the Moon), whereas in the
West this number is related to the Sun and Uranus. And the number 7 in the
Hindu system corresponds to Ketu (the south node of the Moon), whereas
in the West it is related to the Moon and Neptune. The nature or behavior of
a number comes from its ruling planet:
Planet Number Behavioral Qualities
Sun 1 kinglike, kind, royal, disciplined,
authoritative, strong, original
Moon 2 queenlike, royal, attractive, everchanging,
delicate
Jupiter 3 spiritual, counseling, friendly, self-
centered, disciplined
Rahu 4 rebellious, impulsive, short-tempered,
secretive
Mercury 5 princely, entertaining, wily, intelligent,
sensitive
Venus 6 romantic, slow, sensual, sweet spoken,
diplomatic, manipulative
Ketu 7 mystical, dreamlike, intuitive, inventive
Saturn 8 wise, malefic, servant-like, laborious,
struggling, suffering

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Mars 9 warlike, strong, rough, rustic, perfectionist,
doubting, fighting, alienating,
discriminating
Each individual is influenced by three numbers: psychic, name, and
destiny. The influence of these numbers is distinct from that of the nine
planets in the astrological houses. The influence of the Sun itself, for
example, changes depending on the house and the zodiac sign in which it is
posited in a natal chart. With the Sun sign change comes a change in one’s
behavior.
In numerology, all psychic number 1 people have some characteristics of
that number (1), regardless of the month in which they are born. The
difference in month, Moon sign, Sun sign, and ascendant only changes their
attitude.
All number 1 people have the same good days, dates, and years; they also
have the same colors, gems, deity, and mantra. By contrast, in astrology the
power of a planet, and therefore its ruling number, changes, depending on
the house it is in. For example, an exalted Sun posited in Aries sitting in the
eighth or twelfth house becomes fruitless, because it is posited in an
inauspicious house. The same Sun in Aries becomes great when posited in
the tenth house. Similarly, an exalted Saturn is not good in the first, fourth,
seventh, or tenth house, but is very good in the third, sixth, ninth, or
eleventh, and so on. Astrology is more precise than numerology. These
specific details help an astrologer understand the status of an individual.
Numerology is a more general study and covers only the behavioral aspect
of human personality. It has developed its own language that deals with
broad personality traits. But it is also simpler to learn than astrology. It
easily engages the mind without going into elaborate detail, such as
studying the movement of the planets. Numerology is a do-it-yourself
science.
NUMBERS AND PSYCHE, DESTINY, AND NAME
Psychic Number
Our mental make-up is directly related to the date, time, and place of our
birth—to that moment when we breathe air in for the first time from the
outer environment. It is sad that this moment starts with a cry instead of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
laughter. An astrologer gives a precise shape to this moment with a chart,
but for a numerologist the actual date of birth itself is enough.
The psychic number is obtained by making a simple whole number of the
date of birth. For example I was born on May 12 and since 1+2 equals 3,
my psychic number is 3.2
A person’s psychic number reveals the way the person looks at oneself.
The psychic number plays an important role in one’s choice of food, sex,
friendship, marriage, as well as one’s needs, ambitions, and desires. In
Hindu astrology, the Moon sign is the sign of the psyche. In the Western
system, people try to understand the psyche through the Sun sign.
Numerology does not concern itself with a Sun sign, Moon sign, or
ascendant, but rather it approaches the individual directly through numbers.
As we have seen, however, numbers are related to the influence of planets
on behavior, ambitions, needs, and desires.
The planetary influence affecting one’s psyche can be easily understood
by knowing the psychic number. This number remains active throughout
one’s life and is very powerful up to the age of thirty-five to forty. After
thirty-five the other significant number, which is called the destiny number,
becomes more active. One starts feeling a change in attitude. The psychic
number, however, never loses its importance. The psychic number can be
influenced by changing one’s name. It can also be influenced by education,
initiation, and marriage (by marrying someone whose influence changes
one’s mental make-up). The numerologist must know that each person has
two images: one’s self image and one’s image in the eyes of others—the
community, society, and world. The psychic number indicates what one
thinks about oneself; the destiny number indicates what the world thinks of
that person.
Destiny Number
The single whole number obtained from the addition of the date, month,
and year of birth is called the destiny number.
For example, I was born on May 12, 1934.
5 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 9 + 3 + 4 = 25 = 7
The 25 here must not be ignored, as the 2 and the 5 will have some effect
on one’s destiny. However, the 7 will be the dominant number. Of these

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
three digits, the 7 and the 2 play an important role, whereas the 5 will have
much less influence.
The destiny number is more important than either the psychic number or
name number. One always thinks in the same way, but destiny does not
always work the way one wants. Because destiny is more powerful after
thirty-five, one has to start compromising what one wants to have and to
achieve. The psyche is free to think, expect, and desire, but destiny brings
only what one really deserves. This is because destiny is related to one’s
past life karmas. In the Bhagavad Gita rendered by Veda Vyasa, Krishna
says to Arjuna:
O, Arjuna, man is free to perform any kind of action, but there is no
freedom in getting the fruits of one’s karmas as one wants.
So one should become selfless—in performing actions, one should not
care about the outcome, the fruits. By not caring for the fruits of one’s
karmas, one gets beyond pleasure and pain. Pain is caused by attachment to
one’s karmas. Expectations are the real cause of pain. Up to the age of
thirty-five one learns this lesson. Then, to the extent that one gets away
from expectations and performs one’s duty for its own sake, one remains
happy. The destiny number is not subject to external influences.
The destiny number is related to our samskaras—vibrational patterns
acquired by actions in past incarnations, or karmas. It allows us little
freedom of action, but much freedom in reaping the fruits of our past
karmas. Whatever we do now will be returned to us in the future or in our
next life; whatever fruits we are receiving now reflect what we have earned
in our past lives.
Life is a continuum. It is not a broken mosaic. Death is not the end. In
fact, there is no death. Death is a change from one pattern to another.
Whatever we sow, we will reap. There is no getting away from the fruits of
our action, our karmas. The residue of my karmas, good or bad, come to me
as my debits or assets. Work done in a past life comes easily; work I have
not done before brings with it challenges and obstacles. Knowing this, my
mind and my attitude direct me on a natural life course, one through which I
can easily move. My past life karmas help me and come to me as friends,
gifts, rewards, and I am able to fulfill my duties. When I have done bad
karmas, the same efforts bring enmity, opposition, loss, and punishment.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
The fruits of my karma are according to their seeds, which I have sown in
my past lives. This friendship or enmity, unexpected reward or punishment,
is all the result of pastlife karmas—its cause cannot be traced in the present
life. The fruits of karmas performed in this life can create a good and
supporting environment for a person—in this case, the cause of the fruits
can be traced.
When one’s destiny number is bad, a good psychic number, a good name
number, the use of gems, and donations to charity can create a congenial
inner environment. One will have to go through what destiny brings, but it
will be easy to bear. There are many stories of saints, and saintly beings,
who performed good karmas but had to face much opposition and suffering
during their lifetime. And, as well, there are many stories of bad people
who performed only bad karmas but lived happy and luxurious lives. These
stories point toward the destiny of these people: they performed good (or
bad) karmas in their past lives, and the good (or bad) karmas of this life did
not affect them. They either lived happily or miserably.
Name Number
This number is obtained by adding the numerological value given to the
letters of the popular name.
For example my popular name is Classical Ayurvedic Numerological Tradition. According to the
Unit System, the value of each letter is as follows:
The numerical value of my letters comes to 7.
In most cases, people are known by their first name or family name. The
numbers obtained from these two names are also important, but popular

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
name means the name with which one is identified in work—the full name.
So we find that three numbers are important:
first name number
family name number
full name or popular name number.
The influence of these three numbers is experienced in three different
circumstances. The effect of the first name number is in whichever circle
one’s first name is used. The effect of the family name number is in
whichever circle one is called by that name. And the effect of the full name
number is in the area of official documents and business. Generally the full
name, which is used with the bank and on a driver’s license and passport, is
called the name number. But it does not always work out so simply. For
example, the name on my passport is Harish Chandra Vedic Tradition, but with the
bank and on my books I use the name Classical Ayurvedic Numerological Tradition. A small group of
people in India call me by my first name, Harish, and an even smaller group
of people call me Mr. Vedic Tradition. Since my popular name is Classical Ayurvedic Numerological Tradition, and
the numerical value of this name is 7, my name number will be 7. This is
the name I am most known by in my worldly dealings. (A considerably
larger group calls me Dada, which is a 1. However, since I do not use this
name on my books and official documents, my name number will remain
7.)
While the name number has a strong influence upon an individual life,
and it does affect the psyche, it has no influence over the destiny number.
The name number plays a key role in one’s social life and marriage. This
is the reason it was popular to add the family name to the maiden name
after marriage. Adding the family name to the maiden name creates
harmony with the husband in the family name; the woman shares the
advantages of the new family name. Yet even though the addition of the
husband’s name can bring desired harmony, sometimes this addition can
change the woman’s name number into an enemy number, creating
problems in social relationships and business. Adding the family name
changes a woman’s identity and also influences her psyche. One should
check the proposed name number before adding or dropping a word or a
letter in a name. In some cases, this addition can bring good luck and
increase one’s happiness. The name number is very important for such
professionals as writers, poets, architects, and politicians because the

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
influence of one’s name number, unlike one’s psychic and destiny numbers,
continues even after one leaves one’s body.
The name number can also be changed so that it is more compatible with
either one’s psychic or destiny number. Harmony between the name number
