Number 8 in Numerology: Exploring
Meaning, Traits, and Inuence
Numerology is that part of the mystic study of numbers that unravels esoteric
structures and various influences surrounding us. Every number comes with a
unique significance attached to it. Knowing your numerology number will thus give
deep insights into the personality and destiny attached to it. This detailed blog will
deeply explore the intriguing world of numerology number 8, explaining its meaning,
characteristic strengths, weaknesses, and more.
Born on 8, 17, and 26 are ruled by Saturn
If you are born on the 8th, 17th, or 26th of any month you are ruled by the
numerology number 8. This number is governed by the planet Saturn, characterized
by its austere, self-disciplined, and karmic energies. The number 8 is very often
representative of power, ambition, and material success but holds within it such
karmic lessons like balance, responsibility, and resilience.
For instance, you were born on December 26, 1988. You see the date of birth. It is
the 26th day; then you add up the digits of that day according to the following
procedure: Add 2 to 6= 8. So in this case, the numerology number for you based on
your date of birth will be 8
Personality Traits of Number 8
  Number of Struggle: Number 8 was more synonymous with struggles. Many
a time, people coming within its influence face numerous challenges and
obstacles in life. Yet this struggle is not in vain; the very same struggle makes
them strong, resilient people. "Delay not denial" aptly describes the journey
of such people – success may be delayed but not denied.
  Unyielding and Obsessed: Driver number 8 people are known to be quite
stubborn and obsessed with their ideas. Once they decide on a track of action
comprising plans, it is pretty hard to change their minds.
Sometimes, it is their strength and sometimes their weakness, since it propels
them toward the realization of their goals and at the same time makes them
very inflexible.
  Discipline and Logic: Discipline is innate in number 8 people. They are
orderly and structured about life, and from others, they usually want the same.
Their actions are ruled by logic and practicality, and they seldom do anything
based on emotions or feelings of fancy.
  Financial Management: People with life path number 8 might have an innate
angle toward the profession of financial management. They are good with
money, knowing well how it has to be spent and managed. Hence they make
great financial consultants or advisors.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Career and Profession
The professional life of people born with life path number 8 is studded firmly with
high success achievement. Their disciplined ounces with logical perspectives and
determination can get them well-adapted to various careers. Here are those
professions where the number 8 people can perform exceedingly well:
  Law: The structured and logical setting of legal work attracts people with a
constituency aspect of 8. They have the endurance to see them through even
the most complicated matters of the law and the will to take wrongs into court.
  Machinery: Practical, no-nonsense characteristic comes with the proximity of
 working with machinery and being involved with engineering. This also
dovetails nicely with their practical and disciplined nature. They enjoy solving
technical problems and the tangible satisfaction of creating something.
  Shoe Business: The shoe business is yet another area where number 8 will
succeed due to its amazing combination of creativity and practicality. They
have developed the necessary business acumen and a high level of attention
required to thrive in such a competitive market.
  Financial Consultant: Since their financial management skills are apt for the
post of financial consultant or CA, they can work as a Financial Consultant or
CA. These people can provide good finance tips with ease and can manage
complex financial portfolios.
Famous Personalities with Number 8
Numerology number 8 has influenced many famous personalities who have marked
their presence felt in their respective fields. Some of them include:
  Narendra Modi: The incumbent Prime Minister of India, who has exhibited
quite a disciplined approach to strong leadership in running the governance of
the country.
  Manmohan Singh: His Excellency, ex-Prime Minister of India—an economist
by nature—who has played a very significant role in opening up the Indian
economy.
  Shilpa Shetty: An actress quite renowned for her disciplined life and
successful venture in entrepreneurship.
Strengths and Weaknesses of Number 8:
Further understanding of the strengths and weaknesses of number 8 can get a
further look into their personality and behavior.
Strengths:
  Better Judgment and Evaluation: Persons with a destiny number of 8 have
very good judgment and evaluation skills. They can calmly evaluate situations
and come up with a very well-thought decision.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Resilience, and hard work: Their life is often typified by struggle. But this
struggle breeds resilience. They don't give up easily and will do the necessary
hard work toward what they want.
  Adaptability: Though stubborn, number 8 individuals are adaptable. They
can grossly fit into societies and situations, hence resourceful and versatile.
  Financial Aptitude: The ability to deal with finances has already been
mentioned as a strength, but the fact is that it not only helps them in their
personal life but makes them an asset in workplaces too.
Weaknesses:
  Obstinacy and Inflexibility: Their rigid ideas and tough nature sometimes
make them quite inflexible. They often find it hard to accept new ideas or
acclimatize themselves to a change in situations.
  Egotism and Self-Righteousness: Their self-esteem and belief in their
 judgment sometimes may come across as pride. This at times leads to
conflicts and misunderstandings with others.
  Struggle and Hardship: Even though their strength is resilient, this can be
continuous struggle and hardship. Thus, it may drain mentally and
emotionally.
Love and Relationships: 8
Challenges in matters pertaining to love and relationships are common with people
born under the number 8. The self-disciplined and logical approach might just
sometimes make it hard to connect with others emotionally. But once they commit,
these are very loyal and dedicated partners.
  Family Dynamics: They can often feel like outsiders within their own families,
struggle to connect with siblings, and fight with their fathers. Their mothers, in
most cases, find themselves mediating these conflicts right in the middle.
  Love Relationships: Number 8 people form love relationships with much
difficulty. They continuously flow from one relationship to another and search
for the right partner. But when they get a person who understands their
personality and salutes it, they can have a very successful and loving
marriage. People with numerology numbers 1 and 4 are suitable for them.
Lucky and Unlucky Aspects
Knowing what is unlucky and lucky for number 8 will enable them to deal with life
circumstances accordingly.
Lucky Colors
  Green: As it signifies growth, harmony, and freshness, it goes well with the
disciplined and balanced nature of people under the number 8.
  White: It signifies purity and clarity, which is reflected in their logical and
practical minds.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Unlucky Color
  Black: Though black generally symbolizes power and authority, in the case of
the number 8 people, it is considered unlucky since it might increase
negativity and struggle.
Lucky Numbers:
  5: Symbolize liberty, adventure, and transformation. It may break through
useful energy and opportunities to people of the number 8.
  6: Harmony, balance, and care are symbolized. It complements their
disciplined nature and can bring stability into their lives as well.
Unlucky Numbers:
Although there is no generally accepted unlucky number for people born under the
number 8, matching their numbers with those numbers that may increase their
problems should be avoided, including numbers representing massive hurdles and
delays.
8 is considered one of the strongest and most influential numerology numbers
because it is ruled by the disciplined and karmic energies of the planet Saturn.
People under the influence of this number are resilient in determination and financial
acumen. They had to undergo struggles and challenges but from them emerges an
individual worth in strength.
In the professional sphere, people of the number 8 nature do well in fields that
require discipline, logic, and management of finances. They yearn for a love life
 where their person has the capacity to understand and match the peculiarities they
host in their personality system.
Knowing one's luck and ill luck in life will help in overcoming the challenges or
grasping opportunities more capably. Individuals under number 8 will be capable of
making many great achievements and meeting satisfactory lives only if they retain
their strengths and work towards the betterment of their weak points.
The journey of number 8 individuals is a story of struggle and resilience but leads
ultimately to success. They will not deny themselves success at any point in time,
even when faced with obstacles and delays. Embrace your number, understand
 what it signifies, and let that guide you toward your destiny.
Number 9 in Numerology: Exploring
Meaning, Traits, and Inuence
In numerology, each number contains a different set of vibrations and has different
influences, which are the result of spiritual forces. Among these, the driver number 9
holds a distinct place. Unlike the numbers 1 to 8, which have their specific attributes,
driver number 9 encompasses a combination of energies from all these numbers.
Being the final single-digit number, it represents completion, excellence, and
 wholeness. This number means putting duties to rest and termination; the closing of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
life cycles. It represents completeness, fullness, and divine perfection. Come with me
into the world of numerology with Driver Number 9 and know everything.
Born On 9, 18 or 27:
People who are born on the 9th, 18th, or 27th of any month are ruled by Mars.
For example, on December 18th, 1998 you were born. See the date of birth. It is the
18th day; then you add up the digits of that day according to the following procedure:
Add 1 to 8= 9. So in this case, the numerology number for you based on your date of
birth will be 9
Personality Traits of Number 9
Intelligence and Memory: Number 9 individuals are highly intelligent with excellent
memories. They can grasp complex concepts quickly and retain information
effortlessly, making them adept learners and problem solvers.
  Ego and Self-Esteem: While their self-esteem is at a very high level, they
tend to be most egoistic. Their self-worth comes first over everything else and
by no means stands for anything that hurts their dignity. That tends to often
make them look obstinate because they just never back away from what they
believe or stand for.
  Emotional Sensitivity: Number 9 people are incredibly sensitive and
emotional. They can be deeply attached to others and easily get hurt. This
sensitivity makes them empathetic and full of compassion, but such sensitivity
itself may turn them into emotional wrecks.
  Anger and Stubbornness: Their emotional nature also means they can get
angry easily. Their nature makes them quite obstinate and trying when their
expectations are not met or their values are challenged.
However, such anger is short-lived, and they easily forgive and move on very
quickly.
  Helpfulness: Despite their strong personalities, number 9 individuals are
genuinely helpful. They derive satisfaction from aiding others and making a
positive impact on the lives of those around them.
Strengths of Number 9
  Passion and Patriotism: Number 9 individuals are passionate and often very
patriotic. They are loyal to their nation and without any hesitation,
ready to defend it.
  Adventurous Spirit: They have fun, when engaging in adventurous
activities or exploring unknown places. This is why they remain
energetic and ready for new opportunities in order to have as many
dierent experiences as they can.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Sincerity and Honesty: These individuals are sincere and honest. They
despise deception and value truthfulness in themselves and others.
  Compassion, and Kindness: Their loving and kind nature makes them one
of the best friends and family one can have; any person will find their capacity
to help in times of need always available.
  Perceptiveness: Number 9 individuals are highly perceptive. They can
understand and share others' feelings and needs and hence are good at
communication and counseling.
Weaknesses of Number 9
  Blurred line between self-esteem and self-respect: Failure to
distinguish self-worth from self-respect. It is about a person’s sense
of self if self-esteem is concerned, and his principles or ethics are
involved in self-respect. This blurred line can lead to conflicts and
misunderstandings.
  Extreme Sensitivity: Their heightened sensitivity means they are easily hurt.
Small slights or criticisms can deeply affect them, leading to emotional
distress.
  Controversial Behavior: Their contentious nature can lead to difficulties in
relationships and social interactions. They may struggle with maintaining
harmony in their interactions.
  Impulsiveness: They may become too impulsive and engage in very rash
decisions most of the time, the flow of which is not guided by considerations
of consequences; this results in setbacks and challenges.
  Skepticism and Criticism: Number 9 individuals can also be skeptical and
critical of others, therefore creating an atmosphere of distrust and negatively
affecting relations.
  Vengefulness: They have a tendency to hold grudges and seek revenge.
This can create long-term conflicts and hinder their personal growth.
Famous Number 9 Personality
A notable example of a number 9 personality is the Bollywood superstar Salman
Khan. Known for his strong presence, intelligence, and emotional depth, Salman
embodies many traits of driver number 9. His philanthropic efforts and contributions
to various charitable causes also highlight the compassionate and helpful nature of
this number.
Career Paths for Number 9
Given their diverse skill set and strong personality traits, number 9 individuals excel
in various professions:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Armed Forces and Police: They have qualities of leadership and discipline
and a patriotic nature that easily succumbs to careers in the armed forces and

demands.
  NGOs and Consultancy: It is their understanding and supportive nature that
enables them to get drawn toward working in NGOs and consultancy roles.
They feel satisfied if they are doing something that would make a difference to
society and help people.

both in the educational and health sectors since they are areas where one
can apply their intellect and feelings to good advantage. They make natural
teachers and caregivers who believe in doing whatever they can to make the
lives of others better than their own.
Love and Relationships for Number 9
  Universal Love and Hope: Number 9 is often associated with universal and
eternal love. These individuals are open-hearted and ready to give and
receive love generously. They believe in the power of love to heal and
transform.
  Compatibility: In relationships, number 9 individuals are most compatible

to be deeply connected and fulfilling. Relationships with numbers 3 and 6 can
also be harmonious. Number 3 partners bring organization and sympathy,
 while number 6 partners offer joy, prosperity, and comfort.
Lucky and Unlucky Aspects for Number 9

orange, red, and green. These bright colors will fit their energetic and dynamic
nature, thus proving to be very auspicious and positive for them.
  Unlucky Colors: There are no specific unlucky colors for the number 9
individual. But it is best for them to avoid dull or dark colors that may lower

  Unlucky Numbers: There are no unlucky numbers as per number 9

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:

energies of all other numbers within it. People governed by the influence of the

importance. Even though they have been embodied with many strengths, they have

Number 9 people do differing jobs because such individualities have a penchant for
leadership, service, and creativity. In love and relationships, their universal approach
to love makes them deeply connected and empathetic partners.
Knowing the lucky and unlucky features of 9 can help such people use their potential
to the fullest and get a better grip on their lives. By being proud of their uniqueness
and learning to balance their positives and negatives, number 9 individuals can
aspire to much success and satisfaction in every walk of life.
Numerology has provided deep insight into the personality and life paths of people,
and what can be interpreted for number 9 individuals is an understanding of
themselves and their journey even more closely.
Missing Number 1 in Numerology:
Understanding the Impact and Remedies
Numerology is ancient science that supposes to have deep insights about
personality, life path, and spiritual potential. Every number holds its vibrational
energy and has a meaning of its own, that consequently adds to the person's
development. There is something like "missing number" in numerology.
In the number 1 through 9 sequence, the missing number 1 is such a big deal. We
 will talk about what the missing number 1 in numerology is and how it impacts
different aspects of your life as well as ways you could overcome the challenges it
presents.
Understanding Numerology and the Missing Number 1
Number 1 in Numerology
Number 1 relates to such qualities as independence, leadership, ambition, creativity,
and confidence. It is the number of the first pioneer and gives a natural drive to be
number one or different from others. In the numerology chart, this number usually
points to a person who takes the initiative and has love for himself, his individuality,
and has a strong sense of self.
People who belong to a strong number 1 in their chart may reflect the qualities of the
leader, the originator of something new, and the founder of new ventures. They are
confident with their choices and have the natural instinct to lead.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
However, when number 1 is not present, then the qualities it undertones may be
more challenging to live by. A person may fail to express himself or herself as an
individual, or look for self-confidence, or take charge in special areas of life .
The Consequences of Not Having Number 1 in Your Life
If number 1 is missing from your birth chart, you would face issues related to self-
expression, leadership, and independence. Here's how this absence may affect the
other areas of your life:
1/ Challenge in Self-Confidence and Self-Esteem
One of the immediate effects of this missing number 1 is a lack of self-confidence.
Such people tend to have difficulties trusting either their abilities or decisions. They
might be constantly on the lookout for validation from others and feel insecure about
their talents or worth. This makes a person incapable of taking risks or pursuing
goals with conviction.
Most likely, if you suffer from low self-esteem, you will be reluctant to be different
because you will fear criticism or outright rejection. The fear of mistakes may well
prevent you from realizing your full potential.
2/ Inability to Take Initiative
Without the number 1, you'll lack that innate assertiveness and leadership quality,
and many times, you may struggle to start things. This could be a new project, any
passion, or making a decision. Sometimes, there might not be enough of a reason to
take action, but more often than not, you will sit back more often and wait for others
to take the lead or guide you along instead of trusting yourself to get things
underway.
In professional fields, you tend to be hesitant to take up leadership positions or
express your opinion on matters that are of value. It also puts you in relationships
 where you avoid conflict and fail to express your needs and wants.
3/ Struggles with Independence
As for those individuals whose number 1 is missing, they usually find a problem
arising - inability to express independence. You may feel more comfortable simply
following the crowd rather than striking out on your own or looking to others to advise
you.
Dependence on others thus impedes personal development, subduing your sense of
frustration or powerlessness because you are not capable of finally embracing your
individuality.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Excessive reliance on others to support you may also mean that you fail to acquire
some of the skills and dence needed to handle life's trials alone.confi
4/ Lack of ambition or drive
The number 1 is very associated with ambition and goal setting and pioneering
spirits. If you don't have this number in your chart, then you might find it difficult to
 write clear aims or having the impulsion to pursue them. In that case, you may be
content staying within the status quo as long as you're happy with it.
Sometimes, this lack of ambition would mean missing out on the chance to move up
or grow personally and professionally. Unsubconscious striving to excel brings a
tendency to get stuck or unfulfilled in different aspects of life.
Remedies for Missing Number 1
  Install the fountain or aquarium in the northern corner of the house.
  Often try to follow the number 1 in every corner of your life, even in house
number, mobile number, and car number.
  Pray and worship the Surya Yantra to please the God of Number 1, the Sun,
and offer water to the Sun.
How to Deal with Problems of Missing Number 1
Although a deficiency of the number 1 in your birth chart creates problems for you, at
the same time, it is considered as an opportunity for development too, by knowing
and focusing on the regions related to this number. Thus, you can outsmart its
 weaknesses and boost your leadership, assertion ability, and also independence.
1/ Boost Self-Esteem
By repeating daily affirmations, emphasize your self-worth and potential. Examples
include "I am confident and capable.".
Justify and imagine yourself doing well and in control of your life. This thought
experiment may help you feel bold enough to act in the real world.
Do tiny, scary things for yourself. Gradually, this will be enhanced with increased
confidence and courage.
2/ Leadership Skills
Start by taking charge of small scenarios. Either it's to organize events, or perhaps
you're leading a small team at work; start as a leader.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Learn to Learn to trust your instincts and judgment. Become less dependent on
others in making decisions and in life in general.
3/ Work at Developing Independence
Another area you may need to work on is independence if you have a missing
number 1. Start by finding those areas you feel too reliant on others for emotion,
finance, or professionally. Challenge yourself by learning new skills, setting
boundaries, and making decisions without needing constant approval.
This is going to make you take on new responsibilities or force you out of your
comfort zone but, with time, you will be more independent. Remember that true
independence is about not being that separate isolated individual but confident in
facing and tackling all life's challenges as if you're doing it alone.
4/ Set Ambitious Goals
Finally, overcome the inability to be ambitious by taking some time off to set clear
goals in life. Decide what you really want from life and in the both your personal and
professional settings. Then set specific, measurable goals for realizing your desires.
Break them down into actionable steps that you can check off along the way.
Having a clear vision for the future can help reignite your motivation and drive. Dwell
 with inspiring people who encourage you to engage with your passion and hold you
accountable for achieving your targets.
In numerology, the missing number 1 implies difficulties in independence,
confidence, and positions as a leader. However, those obstacles also open up great
potential for growth. Work consciously to develop self-confidence, take on the
attitude of a leader, increase independence, and set high ambitions: that's how you'll
overcome the limitations of this numerical deficiency and accomplish your fulfillment.
Do not see the absence of the number 1 as some weakness but as a path toward
self-awareness and empowerment. This way, patiently put in work. Transform the
qualities of the number 1 into strengths and add those to both your personal and
professional life.
The understanding and awareness of what this missing number 1 represents and
how you should tackle it can make you better prepared to walk through the passage
of your life with an air of confidence and direction, as you unlock true potential as a
leader and individual.

passages.content:
Source : Self Written
Every number, in numerology, has a distinct signicance and inuences
some aspects of our life or our personalities. Lo Shu Grid, or the
numerological chart, will enable us to plot all the numbers and its relevant
elements so that we have information about our strengths, weaknesses,
and areas where energies are lacking. Probably the most critical number
in the practice of numerology is number 2 since it is associated with the
Moon and identies Earth as its element.
When the number 2 is missing from your Lo Shu Grid, you are reminded of 
an imbalance regarding the Earth element in your life. Its absence can
change your emotional rhythm, aect your relationships, and get you into
not-so-wise decisions. Well, not to worry: numerology also oers hands-on
solutions to balance things and neutralize the bad eects caused by this
missing number. Now, let's understand the signicance of missing number
2 in numerology, its impact, and some eective remedies to bring
harmony back into your life.
Importance of Number 2 in Numerology
In numerology, the Moon controls the number 2. An association for
emotions, intuition, nurturing, and receptiveness, the Moon controls
people who are governed by number 2. People who are governed by
number 2 are empathetic, caring, cooperative, and generally gentle in
nature. They create harmony in relationships and tend to be naturally
disposed toward diplomacy and peacemaking.
It can also balance emotions when the number 2 is in the Lo Shu Grid. It
usually assists people to resonate emotionally and creates harmony in
relationships. It accentuates intuition and imparts a person the ability to
believe in their instincts as well for decision-making purposes. It is

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
associated with sensitivity, patience, and sensitivity towards changes in
circumstances.
At a higher level, number 2 represents the Earth, which symbolizes
grounding, stability, nourishment, and support. In many ways the Earth is
the foundation that life stands on, providing stability; in the same way, the
number 2 provides emotional and relational security through a solid
foundation.
What does it mean if the number 2 is missing from your Lo
Shu grid?
Missing number 2 in your Lo Shu Grid means that there is a lack of the
Earth element in the energy eld. This may hence will be reected in
various aspects of life, especially emotional and relationship well-being.
Key Eects of Missing Number 2:
1/ Emotional Instability:
Without the stabilizing eect of number 2, you would have diculty
handling your emotions. Mood swings, nervousness, and overthinking
would dominate your feelings very often. What's more, you would be out
of touch with your intuition, making it all the more hard for you to rely on
instinct in making decisions.
2/ Relationship Problems:
Number 2 rules cooperation and harmony in relationships. Without it,
there is likely to be misunderstandings, arguments, and a lack of feelings
of emotional rapport in personal or professional contacts. You may feel
that others are not supportive, or you can't seem to relate to other people
emotionally.
3/ Lack of Grounding:
Earth element gives the person earthy factor, that is, it makes them
earthy and stable. Without the Earth element, they feel lost, ungrounded,
and aimless towards their intended targets. It sometimes makes one
indecisive, not an expert planner, and likes to be dispersed.
4/ Health Issues:
When a person does not get the Earth element, sometimes it may cause
problems in the digestive system and immunity as well. They might
develop stress-related diseases, or they simply do not have much energy.
5/ Mental Hyperactivity:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
An absent number 2 makes their mind restless, too active, and full of
ceaseless worries. As a matter of fact, even your sleep-wake cycle and
serenity of thought may also get aected .
 This is quite a stressful situation but the good news is that there are
remedies available that can balance it out and ease the problems created
by the lack of the number 2.
Healing Remedies for Number 2 in Numerology
It prescribes remedies to balance and energize what is missing. Well then,
suppose there is missing number 2 in your Lo Shu Grid; here are some of
the practical ways to balance the energy that contributes to the Earth
element and corresponds to the Moon's inuence by means of various
remedies:
1/ Hang Pictures of Mountains Without Water in the Southwest
Corner:
Since the Earth element pertains to grounding or stabilization, you can
energize this element in your home by hanging pictures that consist of
mountains without water bodies such as lakes, rivers, or seas in the
Southwest corner of your house.
 Traditionally, Southwest is associated with the Earth element. Mountains
are symbolic of strength, support, and stability. So, by enriching that area
you bring the Earth energy into your life, thus correcting the missing
inuence of the number 2.
2/ Place an earthen pot in the Southwest corner:
Another useful remedy is to place an earthen pot (of clay or earth
material) in the Southwest corner of your house. The earthen pot
symbolises Earth, so its energy gets enhanced in your surrounding.
 This simple exercise would result in stability and emotional grounding so
that you can feel more secure and supported in your daily life.
3/ Donate White-Colored Items:
 The Moon, which is associated with number 2, is ruled by the color white.
 To balance the imbalances that are not present in number 2, it is good
practice to share white-coloured items such as sugar, rice, white clothes,
and milk. This balances the energies of the Moon, bringing emotional
imbalances within the individual back into harmony.
Donations will be enhancing your karmic energy and will also bring within
yourselves the virtues of number 2, which includes compassion, empathy,
and kindness.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
4/ Drinking from Silver Glass:
Silver is a metallic material that is very closely attached to the Moon and
number 2 in numerology. Drinking water from a silver glass is said to help
balance your emotions, increase intuition powers, and give you clarity of
thoughts.
 This remedy also calms your mind and frees you from any kind of tension
or anxiety, which often occurs in the absence of number 2.
5/ Wearing Crystal Bracelet:
A crystal bracelet is very powerful in stabilizing the emotional aspect of
oneself and strengthening the energy of the Earth element. What might
be associated with gentle and nurturing energies of number 2. It will help
you feel balanced and emotionally centered.
 These also promote love, peace, and emotional healing which may
compensate for the relationship issues coming from the lack of number 2.
More Tips to Boost the Earth Element in Your Life
In conjunction with the remedies above, here are a few other things you
can do in your life to bring in the energy of Earth element and number 2
for emotional and mental stability:
1/ Spend time in nature:
Connect with the world around you through spending more time in parks,
gardens, or some other place covered by natural greenery. Walking
barefoot on grass or soil might enable you to feel more grounded and
connected with earth.
2/ Do more Mindfulness and Meditation:
Mindfulness and meditation will bring emotional clarity as well as mental
peace to your life. If you wish to compensate for the missing element,
focus on grounding meditations when you visualize yourself being rooted
to the Earth.
Numerology, an Earth element number 2 is absent or missing; this causes
instability in emotion, or in other words, it's causing "unstable
relationships of connecting and grounding.". However, by using the
remedies mentioned above such as hanging pictures of mountains,
donation of white-colored objects, keeping an earthen pot at the
southwest corner, wearing crystal bracelets, and drinking water in a silver
glass, you can straighten out the Earth element balances and bring in
positive energies of the Moon back into your life.

passages.content:

was there, nurture emotional healing, strengthen your relationships, and

provides life journey insight powerfully, and through these simple yet
eective remedies, you often navigate your path in greater stability, with
much grace, and harmony within.

It is this ancient metaphysics that considers the role of numbers in
personality, destiny, and life patterns. It believes that every number holds
a unique vibration ruling most aspects of human life. Ideally, the birth
chart is supposed to contain the presence of all important numbers, but
sometimes some are missing, creating energetic imbalances which aect
dierent areas of life. Remedies and spiritual practices are then advised to
rectify imbalances caused in dierent activities.
In this blog, we'll plunge deep into what Missing Number 3 in Numerology
is, the implications if it's missing from the Lo Shu Grid, and the powerful
remedies to restore the balance.
The Signicance of Number 3 in Numerology
 The expansive, optimistic planet Jupiter rules this number according to the
language of numerology. This is the number that indicates creativity, joy,
expression, and communication, growth, as well. People bearing a robust
presence of number 3 usually have a strong presence that is mostly
energetic, enthusiastic, and lively. They are found with innate talent in
creative ways, such as art, writing, public speaking, or any form of
communication.
 The number 3 brings the attributes of good fortune, freedom, and
inspiring others. It represents energy into expansion-type action-not
unlike its equivalent celestial counterpart: Jupiter, the largest planet in our

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
solar system. The number 3 allows inward growth as well as outward
growth, for one to manifest success in any given situation of their lives.
People inuenced by this number have a feeling of optimism, good sense
of humor, and show childlike enthusiasm toward life.
What Happens When Number 3 Is Missing?
When number 3 is missing in the numerology chart or Lo Shu Grid, it may
give an impression of a lack in the areas governed by Jupiter. Lacking
number 3 indicates that there is a deciency of creativity, self-expression,
and optimism. This happens in dierent ways depending on the patterns
one creates in his life pattern.
Some of the common challenges a missing number 3 person experiences
are as follows:
1/ Cannot express emotional thoughts: The person missing the
number three cannot convey his or her thoughts and feelings, and he/she
ends up in most irritating situations due to not being able to convey
feelings.
2/ Not creative: Feelings of stagnation or lack of inspiration when it
comes to doing creative work. The urge to create, innovate, or express
oneself creatively is felt dampened.
3/ Emotional stir-up: Since Jupiter governs one's sense of positivity and
positive growth, without it, one feels stagnant or emotionally stuck.
4/ Too careful or no risk-taking ability: Missing number 3 would make
the person unwilling to take risks, too cautious, or afraid of chances where
one needs to express him- or herself or engage in an act of adventure.
In the Lo Shu Grid, the number 3 has been embodied with the element of
wood. It is considered a symbol for growth, vitality, and creativity.
 Therefore, the lack of the manifestation of this number shows that life
lacks its essential elements of growth, vitality, and creativity, hence
stagnated, and it suppresses the joy and the birth of new prospects.
 The good news is that there are several remedies which can rectify this
energetic imbalance so that creative and expansive energy seen with the
number 3 return to life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Remedies for Missing Number 3
1/ Putting the Tilak on the forehead with Saron:Cure for the
missing number 3 in numerology is putting the tilak on the forehead using
saron. Known as Kesar in various parts of the world, it is used due to its

How to Apply: Dye a few strands of saron in water or milk into a paste.
After taking your morning bath, put a tiny tilak upon your third eye
chakra. This practice leads to an increase in emotional clarity, enhanced
focus, and creative energies.
2/ Bring in the Wood Element in Your Life
Since the no. 3 is much more relating to the wood element in the Lo Shu
Grid, this deciency needs to be compensated by bringing that into your
living environment. That means this element represents growth,
creativity, and progress, and the resulting negative could be stagnation.
So, in case of such a deciency, increase the amount of wood energy
brought to your immediate environment.
Putting Green Plants or Plant Sceneries in the East: The best
method to welcome the wood element into your life is by placing green

because new beginnings and growth are presented by the east direction,
and it's also where the energy of the wood element is at its peak.
Recommended Plants: Bamboo, money plant or any lush green plant
representing the two energies - life-giving and growth
Use Wooden Furniture: Wooden furniture in terms of table chairs or
decorations within your home or oce space, but especially on the east

growth that can help activate the energies of creativity and expansion.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:

Rudraksha is a seed which has been believed to possess spiritual powers.
According to its varieties, the types of Rudraksha beads are said to cater

 Three-Faced or Teen Mukhi Rudraksha and a 5 Mukhi Rudraksha.

believed to be associated with the re element and is known to generate
creativity, self-condence, and ability to face even the toughest of
challenges. A wearer of the Teen Mukhi Rudraksha is said to spark his
inner re, empowering him full of self-expression and allowing him to
overcome various odds in life.
5 Mukhi Rudraksha: The planet controlling the number 3 is Jupiter, and
thus the ruling planet of the 5 Mukhi Rudraksha. Wearing this Rudraksha
brings wisdom, knowledge, and spiritual advancement. It helps enhance
the eects of Jupiter, furthering the qualities of positivity, expansion, and
creativity in life.
4/ Wear Five Mukhi Rudraksha Tulsi Mala
Another very powerful remedy when a number is missing is wearing ve

It further enhances growth, creativity, and emotional balance in life with a

wearer's life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
5/ Respect Elders and Teachers
According to numerology, the planet is governed by Jupiter-the Guru or
teacher, who rules wisdom, guidance, and mentorship; so, in order to
facilitate a stronger missing number 3 in your life, you have to respect

Honoring the wisdom of your guides connects you to the expansive,
benevolent power of Jupiter. Maintaining acts of respect and service to

Lack of creativity or self-expression of emotions and depth can occur if

passages.content:

According to numerology, number 4 is ruled by Rahu. The number symbolizes
structure, order, discipline, responsibility, and the practical approach that needs to be
adopted for building a foundation in life. People under this number are usually very
methodical, hard-working, and well-rounded. The best way to describe them is that
they are architects who design their own fate while being excellent plan-makers and
implementers.
The energy that number 4 brings into someone's life encourages a person to be
persevering, watchful, and dependable. Material success is controlled, helping
someone establish an existence of stability and security. It brings one a bit of order,
persistence, and grounding when balanced.
What Does It Mean When Number 4 Is Missing?
When the digit 4 is absent in the numerological chart or Lo Shu Grid, it means a lack
of qualities such as stability and practicality. A person might be observed
demonstrating these shortcomings in one or more of the following ways:
1/ Lack of Discipline: They are generally unable to do routine activities, usually
disorganised, and not focused.
2/ Procrastination: There might be procrastination in essential tasks or
responsibility-avoiding.
3/ Unstable Foundations: The person with the missing number 4 struggles to
create a stable personal or professional life. He or she may be changing jobs,
homes, or even relationships too often to find stability yet is not able to maintain it.
4/ Impatience with Details: Due to the negligence of the grounding energy coming
 with number 4, people tend to miss important details, leading to mistakes or
incomplete work.
5/ Hard Struggle with Long-Term Goals: Setting and enforcing a goal may bring
unnecessary burden that results in inconsistency and frustration.
The Remedies for Missing Number 4
To counteract the lack of number 4, a number of physical as well as spiritual
remedies can be applied. These remedies are intended to boost the qualities that
characterize will-power, stability, and focus, as well as attract the grounding energy
of this number.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
1/ Access the Energy of the Earth Element
Number 4 is closely related to Earth, representing stability, grounding, and support.
Using this element in your life may also smoothen out the energies surrounding
number 4.
  Keep Earthy Colors in Your Environment: Keep your home or workspace
furnishing with earthy colors such as brown, beige, green, and all other earthy
tones, that may ensure stability.
  Spending Time in Nature: Walk barefoot on grass or spend time in natural
environments like forests, gardens, or parks to connect with the Earth element
and feel more grounded.
2/ Wear a Saffron Tilak for Stability
Apply a saffron tilak on your forehead. It has great spiritual healing properties for
missing number 4. Saffron is auspicious and helps one balance energies, enhance
focusing capabilities, and increase grounding qualities.
  Application: Mix some saffron with a few drops of water or milk and make a
paste. Apply a small dot or line on the forehead daily, preferably in the
morning after a bath. This helps cement your connection to structure and
sensibility, which are the values controlled by number 4.
3/ Create Order and Routine
4 flows best with the application of schedules and routines. When there is no such
thing, habits must be created and adhered to.
  Plan Your Day: Create a diary or to-do list to organize daily tasks.
  Set realistic goals: Divide large tasks into more manageable steps to
prevent feeling overwhelmed by your objectives.
  Commit to consistency: work on developing a culture of stability-be it
maintaining a steady work schedule, regular exercise routine, or even set
practices of self-care.
4/ Wooden Elements in Your Home
Wood is synonymous with growth and structure; therefore, using wooden elements
can fill the gap when number 4 is absent

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Furniture: Wooden furniture will do, such as tables, chairs, or shelves to keep
your living area anchored.
  Decorative Items: Fill your home or office with wooden decor or sculptures to
foster grounding stabilizing atmosphere.
  Location: Wooden elements should be kept on the east or southeast sides of
your home.
5/ Respect and Give Credit to Hard work and Responsibility
The energy of the number 4 will only get further fuelled by making us respect hard
 work and responsibility. This can be done by:
  Expression of Gratitude: Thank those people around you, your family
members, colleagues, workers; no one should be ignored.
  Assuming Responsibility: No need for procrastination and assumption of
responsibility from your actions and commitments.
  Learning Patience: Patience in times of crisis is an important aspect as the
energy of number 4 feeds on perseverance and persistence.
6/ Wearing Four-Faced (Chaar Mukhi) Rudraksha 
Four-Faced Rudraksha. This is governed by Lord Brahma and the planet Mercury,
so it is a very powerful antidote for missing number 4. Rudraksh gives extra
sharpness of the brain; it gives extra focus and creativity in the case of people who
lack number 4, which grounds us.
  Benefits: Chaar Mukhi Rudraksha fights for improving memory and enhances
organizational skills and practical decision-making abilities.
  How to Use: Wear the Rudraksha around your neck or keep it in your pocket
once properly energized by a qualified spiritual guide or astrologer.
7/ Rahu Energies Activation
Since the number 4 is dominated by Rahu, activating its positive energies may be
able to balance an otherwise missing number 4.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Rahu Beej Mantra: Repeat the mantra "Om Bhram Bhreem Bhroum Sah
Rahave Namaha" 108 times in a day to attract good energies by Rahu.
  Meditation: Sit with Ajna Chakra, third eye point, during meditation to aptly
use the energy that Rahu offers.
  Fast on Saturdays: Fasting or charity on Saturdays can balance the
imbalances in Rahu.
8/ Fill Your Mind with Inspirational Images
To imprint stability and focus, add pictures and icons that symbolize these attributes:
  Mountain or Solid Formations: Showcase paintings or photographs of
mountains, since these are stabilizing forms in real life.
  Tortoise Statues: Tortoise is the Feng Shui icon for long-term stability and
protection
9/ Respect for Labor
Number 4 is a labor-loving number, and activities that involve labor or are a gesture
of respect for labor can help build this energy.
  Volunteer work: Activities engaging the person in helping others through
practical means, like building or repairing.
  Physical activity: Activities like gardening, carpentry or yoga to balance the
grounding energies of number 4.
10. Offer Milk and Bread to Dogs
Dogs, considered loyal and grounding animals, are associated with the planet Rahu,
 which governs the energy of number 4. By feeding stray dogs, you not only nurture
their well-being but also balance the vibrations of Rahu, inviting stability, focus, and
order into your life.
  Significance:
Feeding dogs is symbolic of gratitude and service, two qualities that
help balance the karmic effects of Rahu. This simple act enhances
positive vibrations and strengthens the qualities of discipline and
responsibility tied to number 4.
  How to Do It:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
o Choose clean, fresh milk and bread.
o Offer this to stray dogs, preferably in the morning or evening.
o Perform the act with a pure heart and an intention to bring balance to
your life.
The missing number 4 in numerology symbolizes a lack of grounding, structure, and
discipline, which can lead to challenges in achieving stability and long-term goals.
However, by employing remedial measures such as application of a saffron tilak,
introduction of earthy and wooden elements, wearing four-faced Rudraksha, and
structured routine, individuals can restore balance and invite the stabilizing energies
of number 4 into their lives.
Attention and spiritual work in careful attentiveness will utterly develop inside
qualities like concentration, perseverance, and stability on the way to a more
meaningful and grounded life.
Missing Number 5 in Numerology:
Understanding the Impact and Remedies
    28 Nov, 2024

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Source : Self Written
In numerology, each number has its unique vibrations to the person's personality,
decision, and life path. Number 5 is one of the critical parts of the spectrum in
numerology, representing freedom, adaptability and versatility, and communication
and vibrational keys to movement, progress, resilience, and handling the factors in
life that are unsure. If this number is present in a chart or Lo Shu Grid with an
imbalance regarding the individual's ability to get along with changes, then it impacts
the whole aspect of personality in tune with the numerology system.
This blog post unravels the meaning behind missing number 5, the potential
obstacles it may bring, and how it might be cured to restore balance and harmony.
Meaning of the Number 5 in Numerology

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Number 5 is a Mercury planet. This digit pertains to communication, curiosity, and
dynamic energy. It rules versatility and adaptability, and the urge to explore.
Generally, such a number relates to an adventurous, communicative, and life-loving
person.
Energetically, the number 5 is the middle of numerology, between 1 and 9, and
represents the balance of transformation and coping with the ups and downs of life.
It is related to the throat chakra, which symbolizes communication and self-
expression.
Extreme versatility and negotiation skills, natural multi-taskers and flexible leaders,
the number 5 high-energy people are energized by exploring new ideas, situations,
and experiences.
What Happens When Number 5 Is Missing?
When number 5 is missing in a numerology chart or Lo Shu Grid, then the person
lacks the qualities which are being governed by Mercury. This also results in fear of
change, and they often resist changes taking place. They get cranky, irritated, or
even chafed if changes happen because they cannot cope up well. They fail to
explain themselves and thus make others misunderstand them.
  Rigidity: A missing number 5 can make individuals unyielding, where they
cannot multi-task or accept changes.
  Boredom and Stagnation: Life becomes very monotonous because there is
less curiosity or adventure due to the absence of number 5.
  Fear of the Future: Lack of the energy of Mercury makes people too
conservative and concerning about life's unpredictability.
Remedies for Missing Number 5
Some specific remedies for balancing and restoring the dynamic energy of number 5
may include enhancing adaptability, communication, and curiosity. It is important to
learn from life, change, and explore new opportunities in life.
1/ Chant Mercury Mantras
Since number 5 is ruled by Mercury, chanting the mantras associated with Mercury
can effectively activate its positive energy.
  Mantra: "Om Budhaya Namaha"

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
How to Practice: Chant this mantra 108 times daily, preferably in the early
morning or during Mercury’s planetary hour (Wednesday is especially
auspicious). Sit in a calm, quiet place and focus on the qualities you want to
strengthen, such as adaptability, communication, or mental clarity.
This practice helps balance Mercury’s energy, improving your ability to adapt and
express yourself effectively.
2/ Use Green as a Balancing Color
The color related to Mercury is green, and the number is 5. Use this color and
restore the balance with the help of adaptable progressive energy.
  Wear Green: Wear clothes or accessories or gemstones in green, such as
emerald or peridot.
  Decorate with Green: Use green plants or decor items in your home or
 workspace, particularly in the north direction, which is connected with
Mercury.
3/ Improvement of Communication Skills
Engage in practice activities to improve communication skill strength by making
communication issues like missing number 5 irrelevant.
  Public Speaking: Join a speaking group and/or take courses that help
articulate thoughts clearly and confidently so the quality of interaction
improves.
  Active Listening: Inculcate the habit of actually listening to others before
responding so that quality of interactions improves.
  Writing and Journaling: Express your thoughts through writing, which helps
refine your communication and provides a creative outlet.
4/ Wear a Five-Mukhi (Panch Mukhi) Rudraksha 
The Five-Mukhi Rudraksha is a powerful remedy for a missing number 5. This
sacred bead, governed by Mercury, helps enhance clarity, adaptability, and
communication.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Benefits: It improves self-expression, sharpens intellect, and strengthens the
throat chakra.
  How to Wear: Wear Rudraksha around neck or wrist after charging through
proper rituals. Keep it close to your body so that its energies can be felt
strongly.
5/ Flexibility or Adjustment
Since number five is an adjusting number, flexibility in your life would balance up
 with the lack of number five.
Move out of your comfort zone by doing something new; it could be taking up a
hobby, making friends, or even seeing new places.
  Multitask: Work on several projects or assignments and complete those to
achieve the agility and flexibility of a number 5.
  Travel: Take trips to places, since traveling is very much related to the
adventurous feel of number 5.
6/ Incorporate Freedom and Movement Symbolism
Incorporate symbols of freedom and movement into your space to bring moving and
changing energies to your life.
  Birds or Butterflies Images: These represent freedom and transformation,
so this actuates number 5 energy.
  Wind Bells: Mount a few wind bells in your home to mean movement and
flexibility, mainly during the north and northeast directions.
7/ Donate Green Lentils and Water to the Poor
Charitable activities related to Mercury can work to offset the energy caused by the
lack of a number 5.
  How to Practice: Donate green lentils, fresh green vegetables or water to the
poor on Wednesdays. Do it with clean intention and at heart for balancing the
energies of Mercury. Such act of charity enhances adaptability and defuses
the communications-related problems.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
8/ Foods Favorable for Mercury
Eat those foods whose energies resonate with its vibrations to intensify its influence
as well as the influence of Number 5.
  Recommended Foods: Eat green vegetables, fresh fruits, and nuts. All of
these foods will enhance your mental clarity and effective communication.
Steer clear of processed or rich foods that can dull Mercury's light, bright energy.
9/ Connect with Nature
Number 5 loves having freedom and connecting with the world outside. It will make a
difference between getting back into balance and allowing the energy of movement
and curiosity into your life by spending out of doors.
  Activities: Go for walks, hike in the mountains, or just sit in a garden or park.
  Grounding Practices: Walk on grass or sand barefoot, put your connection
 with the earth up front and center in your mind, and help to clear the head.
10/ Respect All Relationships and Partnerships
Mercury governs communication and partnership. Center the qualities of adaptability
and connection associated with number 5 by strengthening your personal and
professional relationships.
  Show Gratitude: Express appreciation for those in your life, fostering
stronger bonds.
  Resolve Conflicts: Address misunderstandings promptly to maintain
harmony in your relationships.
Missing number 5 in numerology reveals inflexibility, lack of curiosity, and being
ineffective as a communicator. It can be connected with rigidity, fear of change, or
problems in bonding with others. Equilibrium will be restored through chanting
Mercury mantras, wearing a five-mukhi Rudraksha, using green as balancing colors,
and practicing flexibility, thus inviting the dynamic energy of number 5 into one's life.
With conscious effort and spiritual practice, you can refine your Mercury influence,
 which will sharpen your abilities in communication, adaptability, and success in this
fast-changing world.

passages.content:
Source : Self Written
Numerology is one of the biggest ways of interpreting the energetic configuration of
life. Every single number has its unique vibrational influence, that turns the
dimensions ranging from personality to relationships to destiny. Whenever a number
is missing within an individual's numerological chart or Lo Shu Grid, it refers to an
energy deficiency or lack of qualities represented by the respective number.
Numbers 6, under Venus, are indicative of love, harmony, balance, beauty, and
nurturing. These hold a representation of family, relationships, and the ability to
enjoy the finer things in life. The absence of this number could cause a lot of
problems in creating harmony and showing management of relationships and
appreciating life's beauties. However, with some remedies, balance might be
restored for the energies to manifest their positive nature.
Significance of the Number 6 in Numerology
Number 6 is the number of the caretaker. It symbolizes unconditional love, home
communion, and responsibility. It is the vibration of Venus: luxury, beauty, and
relationships. Individuals attuned to the number 6 seem to flourish in careers where
they are able to nourish and care for others within parenting, teaching, or counseling.
Number 6 rules aesthetics and creativity, making one value beautiful harmonious
pleasing surroundings. Its energy dispenses love, understanding, and a feeling of
community, and healthy relations are found on this number's foundation.
What Happens When Number 6 Is Missing?
In the absence of number 6 in a numerology chart or Lo Shu Grid, the lack of
Venus's energy of smooth harmonies causes chaotic imbalances in areas
concerning love, beauty, and responsibility. This can be evidenced by:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Troubles with Relationships: It may be rather difficult to maintain
harmonious relationships; persons may feel that their loved ones either have
had misunderstandings or conflicts with them.
  Lack of Emotional Fulfillment: The absence of nurturing energy causes an
emotional lack or the inability to express love.
  Lack of Appreciation for Beauty: A person without a number 6 can lose
appreciation for art, beauty, or finer things in life. He or she might have no
inspiration or interest in his or her surroundings.
  Avoidance of Responsibilities: Missing a number 6 makes someone shy
away from household responsibilities or believe that such responsibilities are
more than he or she can handle.
  Imbalance in Working and Family Life: Inadequacy of number 6 may lead
to an imbalance in both professional and family obligations, with one being
favored at the expense of the other.

Balance the Lack of Number 6 by Conscious Cultivation of Love, Harmony, Nurturing
Qualities. Here are the fabulous remedies to attract Venus energy and bring balance
back in your life:

Number 6 is ruled by Venus, and enhancing its energy in your life can
counterbalance the ill effects of its absence.

times each day to attract positive energies of Venus.
  Wear White or Pink: These are the colors of Venus. They symbolize
harmonies and love. Wear them, or use them in your abode.
  Fast on Fridays: Fasting on Fridays, ruled by Venus, will help increase the
power of number 6 in your life.
2/ Harmonious Home Atmosphere
Since the number 6 is a home and family number, make your home a place that
contributes to the nourishment and artistic environment to help balance the energy.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Fragrances and Flowers: Fresh flowers and pleasing fragrances like rose,
 jasmine or sandalwood will make your living place beautiful and attractive.

energy to that room and makes it welcoming.
  Keep the South-East Corner Clean: The southeast direction is of Venus.
Keep this area of your house clean, decorated, and aesthetically attractive.
3/ Practice Acts of Service and Love
The number 6 is the number of service and love. To tap into its energies, focus on

  Care for Loved Ones: Always have quality time with your family and friends
and put their emotional needs ahead of yours.
  Volunteer or Donate: Be charitable and reach out to others by volunteering

  Clear Conflicts: Eliminate any unresolved issues in the relationships so that
peace and love are regained.
4/ Use Objects That Symbolize Love, Harmony, and Beauty
Mark your place with objects that symbolize love, balance, and beauty to make the

  Beautiful Family Pictures: People in the making love and taking quality time

  Fresh Plants and Flowers: House fresh plants, mainly flowering ones for
vibrancy on Venus.
  Decorate with Symmetry: Symmetrical decor arrangements would promote
balance and aesthetic appeal to align with the energy of number 6.
5/ Offer Milk and Sweets to the Needy
Giving milk and sweets to poor people or feeding the animals can attract the
nurturing energies of number 6. These good deeds attune you with the selfless
energy of Venus.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
When to Do It: Such offerings can be done on Fridays as they are ruled by
Venus.
6/ Practice Self-Care and Pampering
Number 6 cultivates self-love and appreciation for the little things in life. Self-
energetic practice keeps your energies in balance.
  Inner Beauty: Read positive affirmations and cultivate self-love and healthy
attitude since inner peace shines outwards.
  Creative Hobbies: Engage in activities like painting, dancing, or interior
designing. One should vibrate the energies of creativity emanating from
Venus.
7/ Balance Your Relations
  Balance the Energy of Number 6: Work on healthy relationships and
maintain them at their best.
  Speak Positivity: Your thanks to the people in your life with words or
gestures of love, kindness, and care.
  Develop Boundaries: While you are giving to others, make sure that it
doesn't make you emotionally drained.
  Celebrate Key Dates: Mark the years of marriage, birthdays, and
anniversaries of important events to spread love and bonding within your
family.

The Six-Faced Rudraksha, ruled by the planet Venus, is an excellent antidote to

  Benefits: The Rudraksha elevates love, beauty, and creativity while
establishing peace and harmony in a relationship.
  Wearing It: The benefits can be derived from wearing the Rudraksha, once
activated according to proper rituals, around your neck or as a bracelet.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:

Missing Number 7 in Numerology:
Understanding the Impact and Remedies
    30 Nov, 2024

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Source : Self Written
Numerology represents a very deep and old system through which a person
discovers the blueprint of his life by exploring the energies and vibrations of
numbers. Each number in numerology corresponds to unique qualities, strengths,
and lessons. If there is a missing number in the numerology chart or Lo Shu Grid,
then it indicates the lack of certain energies or traits associated with that number.
Absences of such kind lead to imbalances, which can lead to problems in areas
ruled by the number.
The number 7 is mysticism, spirituality, intuition, and introspection. Thus, it's
connected with powerful analytical thought as well as a link to the higher
consciousness. It's ruled by Ketu. Thus, it has a lot to do with an inner quest for
knowledge, spiritual awakening, and intuitive wisdom. Missing number 7 suggests
difficulties in accessing those energies-but it should be well known on how it works
and its correction should be applied so that its qualities can be integrated into life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Significance of the Number 7 in Numerology
Number 7 is often regarded as the most spiritual number in numerology. It is
associated with truth, wisdom, and understanding of life's deeper meanings. People
influenced by number 7 are natural seekers who love solitude, study, and meditation.
Their path is full of unveiling what lies deep and going to the very realms of
philosophy or spirituality.
  Spiritual Growth: Number 7 represents the soul's journey to enlightenment
and being on their path to self-awareness.
  Analytical Mind: This promotes intense observation, research, and attention
to detail.
  Intuition: The energy of number 7 brings to your life a heightened intuitive
nature with an inner knowing.
  Nature Connection: This number represents a strong energy connection with
the natural world, like water and mountains as sources of rejuvenation.
If this number is missing from your life, the lack of the energy from number 7 leaves
a vacuum in self-awareness, spirituality, and also creates an inability to trust one's
self.
Missing Number 7 Impact
A missing number 7 in your numerology chart or Lo Shu Grid can pose extremely
specific challenges. Generally, such blanks are manifested in individuals who
separate themselves from the spiritual practice, cannot trust their instincts, or have
not managed to sustain solitude and self-reflection.
1/ Inadequate intuition
Lack of the effect of number 7 means that people could not trust their gut feelings.
They may have a tendency to second-guess themselves, or even find it hard to
decode other people's hidden intentions in particular situations.
2/ Logical Over-reliance
The lack of number 7 makes people over-rely on logic, forgetting that intuition and
emotional intelligence yield a balance. This may mean that people tend to over-
analyze a situation or become logical loops in action.
3/ Spiritual Disconnection

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Number 7 combines the material and spiritual worlds. A void or in the absence of a
goal in life can be created if there is no number 7 as one cannot try to achieve such
a spiritual awareness or achieve any higher spirituality.
4/ Fear of Being Left Alone
It is in solitude that number 7 feels comfort and strength in their powers of
introspection. Without it, people shiver at the thought of solitude, are restless in their
own company, or afraid of deep reflection.
5/ Anxiety and Restlessness
Lack of grounding and spiritual energy due to number 7 leads to emotional stress,
anxiety, and imbalance in the face of uncertainty.
Remedies for Missing Number 7
The absence of number 7 does not necessarily mean one is doomed to live without
its riches. Instead, with conscious effort, it is possible to invoke the energy of number
7, strengthen its influence, and correct your life into balance. Here are practical
remedies to restore your harmony:
1/ Strengthening Ketu's Energy
Number 7 is owned by Ketu, the mystical and spiritual planet in Vedic astrology.
Strengthening the vibrations of Ketu could enhance your spiritual insight and intuitive
 wisdom.
  Ketu Mantras: Do the repetition of "Om Kem Ketave Namaha" 108 times
daily to attract the positive qualities of Ketu.
  Meditation of the Crown Chakra: The crown chakra is ruled by Ketu.
Meditation on this center creates a connection to higher consciousness.
Meditate on this center to deepen your spiritual awareness.
  Thursday Fasting: Do fasting on Thursdays, the auspicious day of Ketu,
 which may help bring balance to Ketu.
2/ The Water Element
No. 7 is connected with the water element, which symbolizes intuition, flow, and
emotional depth; therefore it will amplify the vibration by keeping water-related
objects and energies around you.
  Water Feature Use: Install a small fountain in your north side for serenity and
instinct.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Symbolic Artwork: Instill images of serene water bodies in your home or
 workspace, from oceans to rivers and waterfalls.
  Spiritual Baths: Experience purification baths under Himalayan salt, diffused
essential oils, or herbal infusions clean your energy field and keep your mind
calm.
3/ Practice Meditation and Mindfulness
Meditation is one of the best treatments to invoke the energy of number 7.
  Daily Meditation: Spend 15–30 minutes in quiet reflection, focused on your
breath or a calming mantra. This practice will strengthen your connection to
inner wisdom.
  Mindfulness Practices: Practice mindfulness in daily activities like eating,
 walking, or listening. It increases awareness and sharpens one's mental
acuities.
  Nature Connection: Spend time in natural settings, such as mountains,
forests, or near water to ground the energy and rejuvenate the spirit.
4/ Feed Stray Dogs
The dogs are connected with Ketu's Energy. Feed them and balance the spiritual
energy vibrations of Number 7, it is said.
  Feed Milk and Bread: Feed the stray dogs with milk, bread, or some simple
foods routinely. Such a good act reaps better karma and strengthens the
power of Ketu.
  Best Days: Perform this remedy on Thursdays or during the waning moon
phase for maximum benefits.
5/ Wear a Seven-Faced Rudraksha 
Seven-faced Rudraksha is an auspicious bead that works in tune with number 7 and
Ketu.
  Benefits: Wearing this Rudraksha will boost the intuition, give enlightenment
about the spiritual world, and make a person aloof from material life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
How to Use: Energize the Rudraksha by proper rituals and wear it around
your neck or wrist for full benefits.
6/ Detachment and Acceptance
Number 7 is completely filled with detachment qualities. Letting go of materialistic

Have you ever bonded with someone instantly and felt like you’ve known them
forever? Or maybe you've tried to connect with someone but the friendship always
felt… off? While chemistry and shared interests play a role, your Driver Number—
from numerology—might hold a deeper explanation.
Whether you’re a ride-or-die type or a ghost-then-text-later kind of friend, your birth
date offers clues as to how you show up in friendships — and who you’re most likely
to vibe with.
Let’s explore the unique traits of each Driver Number and how different pairings
affect friendship compatibility. This blog goes beyond surface traits and taps into the
emotional dynamics that either strengthen or stress your social bonds.
What is a Driver Number?
Your Driver Number is the core number from the day of your birth. No need for your
full birth chart or complicated math — just add up the digits of your birthday:
This number reflects your personality essence — how you approach life, love,
challenges, and relationships, including friendships.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Want to know how to calculate your driver number? Check out our blog - How To
Calculate Driver Number
1/ Driver 1 – The Natural Leader
Mantra : “I lead, I inspire.”
If you're a Driver 1, you're usually the one planning group trips, initiating
conversations, and pushing your friends to do better. You’re goal-oriented, high
energy, and deeply protective.
Example:
Think of that friend who says, “We should all start a business!” and actually gets
everyone organized — that’s the 1.
You vibe with:
  Driver 2’s emotional depth
  Driver 5’s spontaneity
  Driver 6’s loyalty
Watch out with:
  Driver 8: Too many chiefs, not enough listeners.
Reflection Prompt:
  Do I let others take the lead sometimes?
  How can I listen more intentionally to my friends’ needs?
2/ Driver 2 – The Empath
Mantra: “I feel, I connect.”
You’re the soft heart of the group — intuitive, emotionally astute, the one friends
often turn to when they’re in pain. But intense emotions can sometimes make you
feel spent or underappreciated.
Example:
You're the friend who notices someone’s quiet mood before they even speak — and
you don’t let it go unnoticed.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Best with:
  Driver 1: Confidence meets comfort
  Driver 5: Helps you open up to adventure
  Driver 6: You both love to nurture
Needs care with:
  Driver 4 & 8: They might be too practical or detached for your emotional
rhythm.
Reflection Prompt:
  Do I put my emotional needs second too often?
  Am I letting others care for me the way I care for them?
3/ Driver 3 – The Free Spirit
Mantra: “I express, I shine.”
3s are entertainers, creators, and extroverts. Friendship with you is vibrant and
playful, but sometimes friends might struggle to connect with your deeper self — if
you let them see it.
Example:
You’re the one starting the dance circle at a wedding or turning a boring Zoom call
into a themed party.
Best with:
  Driver 5: Endless fun and flow
  Driver 7: Grounds you with insight
  Driver 1: You both light up a room
Might clash with:
  Driver 6: They want structure, you want freedom
Reflection Prompt:
  Do I avoid emotional depth out of fear or habit?
  How can I show up consistently in my friendships?
4/ Driver 4 – The Loyal Builder

passages.content:
Mantra: “I build, I protect.”
You’re the rock — the one who always shows up and makes sure things are
planned, paid, and posted. Your friendships are based on commitment and loyalty.
Example:
You keep birthday reminders for everyone, organize group logistics, and show up
even when no one else does.
Perfect matches:
  Driver 1: Shared goals
  Driver 6: Values loyalty
  Driver 7: Offers depth and quiet strength
May struggle with:
  Driver 3 & 5: Their chaos might wear you out
Reflection Prompt:
  Am I being too rigid or resistant to change?
  How can I open up emotionally to let people in more?
5/ Driver 5 – The Adventurer
Mantra: “I explore, I evolve.”
Friendship with you is unpredictable in the best way. You’re the one suggesting road
trips on a Tuesday or bringing a new friend into the group chat.
Example:
You plan weekend hikes but might ghost for a month if you’re feeling restless or
overwhelmed.
Ideal friendships:
  Driver 1: Focused energy
  Driver 6: Helps you ground
  Driver 9: Shares your openness and vision

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
More challenging matches:
  Driver 2 & 4: Their emotional/structured styles can feel like a cage
Reflection Prompt:
  Do I run when things get too emotional or intense?
  How can I stay more connected, even when I crave space?
6/ Driver 6 – The Nurturer
Mantra: “I care, I protect.”
You're the parental figure of the group — always checking in, cooking, supporting,
and sometimes worrying too much. You crave deep, loyal bonds and often give more
than you take.
Example:
You’re the one with extra snacks in your bag and tissues for the group movie night
tears.
Best Friendship with:
  Driver 1: You nurture, they lead
  Driver 5: Brings you out of your comfort zone
  Driver 6: Mutual love and care
Challenges with:
  Driver 3: You want order, they want freedom
Reflection Prompt:
  Am I over-functioning in my friendships?
  Do I leave space for fun and spontaneity?
7/ Driver 7 – The Seeker
Mantra: “I reflect, I understand.”
You’re the wise, introspective friend — spiritual, philosophical, and often more
comfortable observing than jumping in. You may take time to open up, but once you

Example:

at parties while others dance.

  Driver 2: Emotional intensity
  Driver 8: May feel too focused on the material world
Reflection Prompt:
  Do I open up enough for people to truly know me?
  Am I giving my friendships the same curiosity I give myself?
8/ Driver 8 – The Powerhouse
Mantra: “I protect, I achieve.”
As friends, you’re faithful and practical and enterprising. You might not be an
emotional person, but you don’t show love through words, you’ve shown it through
deeds — lending a hand with problems, giving advice, just being a rock in difficult
situations.

during a crisis.

  Driver 5: Keeps things exciting
  Driver 6: Offers emotional balance
  Driver 1: Shares your drive

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Driver 4 & 8: Can become power struggles

Am I showing appreciation, not just loyalty?

9/ Driver 9 – The Humanitarian
Mantra: “I heal, I inspire.”
You’re the spiritual heart of your friend circle. You’re generous, wise, and emotionally
tuned in — often acting as the quiet counselor. But your idealism can sometimes set
you up for disappointment.
Example:
You’re the one sending care packages or staying up late to comfort a friend going
through heartbreak.
Best friendship with:
  Driver 1: Focus and structure
  Driver 5: Fun and depth
  Driver 6: Shared values and emotional investment
Challenges with:
  Driver 4: May lack your emotional fluidity
  Driver 2: Can create an emotional overload
Reflection Prompt:
  Am I putting friends on a pedestal and getting hurt when they fall short?
  Do I express my needs clearly or expect others to just “get it”?
Deepening Friendships With Numerology
Friendship isn’t about perfection — it’s about mutual growth. By understanding your
Driver Number, you gain clarity on:
  Your communication style
  Emotional needs in friendships
  Patterns you repeat (ghosting, over-giving, etc.)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Types of people who complement vs. trigger you
These observations are not intended to shame or categorize — but rather, to propel
you forward. Even the “difficult” relationships can become beautiful with awareness
and effort.
Friendships are sacred connections that reflect not only who we are — but who
 we’re becoming. Whether you're the heart, the brain, or the soul of your circle, your
Driver Number offers a lens through which you can better understand yourself and
others.
So next time you find yourself wondering, “Why do we click so well?” or “Why is this
friendship draining me?” — take a peek at the numbers.
Sometimes, the answers really are written in the stars — or at least in your birth
date.

Step 1: Write Down Your Birth Date
Write your birth date in numbers. For example, if you were born on 23rd July 1989, write it as
