Step 2: Reduce Day, Month, and Year to Single Digits
Break down each part of your birth date into single digits.
Day: If your birth date is 23, add the digits together: 2 + 3 = 5.
Month: If you were born in July, it’s the 7th month of the year, so the month remains 7.
Year: For 1989, add the digits together: 1 + 9 + 8 + 9 = 27, and then reduce this to a single

Step 3: Add the Reduced Numbers Together
Add the reduced numbers for the day, month, and year together: 5 (Day) + 7 (Month) + 9
(Year) = 21.
Step 4: Reduce to a Single Digit
Finally, reduce this sum to a single digit: 21 = 2 + 1 = 3.

passages.content:
Driver Number 6: Harmony and Balance
With a Driver Number of 6, you are great at creating harmony and balance. You are
caring and responsible, always looking out for other's well-being. You like to keep
things around you light and make sure everyone is happy. You might enjoy taking
care of pets, and plants, or helping your friends and family. However, sometimes you
might help too much and forget to take care of yourself. This can make you feel
anxious or tired. Set healthy boundaries and avoid saying yes even as you make
time to be alone. Care for yourself so that you are able to care for others.
Driver Number 7: Wisdom and Introspection
If your Driver Number is 7, you're like a deep thinker who loves seeking wisdom.
You're always thinking carefully and trying to understand life's deeper meanings. You
enjoy reading, learning, and solving puzzles. Sometimes, you might prefer spending
time alone to think and reflect. Your thoughtful nature helps you make wise decisions
and gain valuable insights. However, you might be too hard on yourself or others,
and you might seem distant because you enjoy solitude. You can use such a way to
find a balance by connecting more with people and sharing what’s on your mind. It is
 wonderful to be a deep thinker. But, it is just as important to be connected with other
people.
Driver Number 8: Achievement and Ambition
If you are driver number 8 then you are a really ambitious individual who works very
hard just to realize his/her dreams and be successful in life. You concentrate on your
effort and maintain the momentum even when it seems impossible; you never give
up because you always believe that you will achieve your aims no matter what.
People notice your hard work and see you as a leader. Your many achievements
show how hardworking you are.
Sometimes, people with Driver Number 8 care a lot about owning things, even more
than having big job titles. But remember, it's important to think about other people's
needs too. Being kind and caring, along with working hard, is important for true
success. It's a great feeling to succeed and help others succeed too!
Driver Number 9: Compassion and Humanitarianism
If your Driver Number is 9, you are someone who cares a lot about others and
always wants to help. You are kind, generous, and like to make a difference. You
might enjoy volunteering, helping friends, or standing up for what’s right. Your big
heart and caring nature make you a hero to many people. However, you might
sometimes forget to take care of yourself because you are so busy helping others.
This can make you feel very tired. You also need to take care of yourself, do not
forget this. Even if you find it hard, give yourself a break and concentrate on your
own demands. Even though it is true that helping others is necessary, it does not
mean that you should neglect yourself.
Now that you've discovered your Driver Number, you've unlocked a special key to
understanding yourself better and becoming even stronger.

passages.content:
Numerology - Introduction
What Is Numerology?
• Numerology is a study of numbers in your life. 
• You can uncover information about the world and also each individual person by using Numerology.
• Numerology is seen as a universal language of numbers.
• It is a Science that uncovers the events of ones life, which helps Individual plan their life’s important 
events.
• Numerology is about studying of numbers and their influence on human lives.
If you are familiar with Astrology, then you may know a little bit about Numerology; it is similar in quite a 
few ways but uses a different method to get the information and insight: Numbers.
Numerology is the idea that the universe is a system and once broken down we are left with the basic 
elements, which is numbers. These numbers can then be used to help us to better understand the world and 
ourselves as individuals.
Who started numerology?
Pythagoras.
Most numerologists credit Pythagoras with founding the field of numerology. Pythagoras was a 
philosopher who was born in Greece around 569 B.C. 
Historians don't know much about Pythagoras, since little of his original work survives and most of the 
people who wrote about him did so hundreds of years after his death.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Foundational Vibrational Courseware (NV-FVC-10A)
passages.content:
Numerology
Is numerology a science?
Numerology is not a art, but a Science. It is a science whose foundation is on the basis of 
correlation of any event on earth to a numeral or a numeral pattern. Every alphabet, word, 
idea or an event is closely associated with a corresponding numerical value.
What is difference between astrology and numerology?
The Difference Between Astrology and Numerology. ... Astrology is studying of planets, 
movement of planets and their influence on human lives. It is related to 
Astronomy. Numerology on the other hand is about studying of numbers and their influence 
on human lives.
Can we believe numerology?
Yes, believe in numerology. ... Numerological science has been used for many things 
since the ancient times. Numbers are used in almost all part of human life with their day-
today practices.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Foundational Vibrational Courseware (NV-FVC-10A)
passages.content:
Numerology
Are numerology reports accurate?
Numerology can be very accurate provided you're working with someone who knows what 
they're doing. The results will only be as accurate as the person's training, knowledge and 
experience level. Of course if they have some psychic ability that helps as well.
Can numerology predict future?
Simply using KEY numbers such as your birth date for example, can reveal so much about 
you, and where you're heading. From there you can predict your future. ... In simple 
terms, numerology is a study of numbers in your life. You can uncover information about the 
world and also each individual person by using Numerology.
Which numerology system is best?
Although it is the least popular system, many modern day numerologists are convinced that 
Chaldean numerology is the most accurate system there is. ... Whereas the Pythagorean 
and Kabbalah systems base their formulas on the numbers one through nine, 
Chaldean numerology focuses on one through eight.

passages.content: A foundational secret of Lal Kitab is the doctrine of Masnooi Grah (Artificial Planets). When two planets interact, their merged vibrational fields create the manifestation of a third planet. For example: Sun (1) + Saturn (8) = Rahu (4), meaning unresolved friction between father and son or authority and duty creates toxic illusions or sudden disruptions. Jupiter (3) + Venus (6) = Ketu (7), meaning the union of two great spiritual teachers transforms worldly desires into profound spiritual detachment and occult mastery. Mercury (5) + Venus (6) = Sun (1), meaning commercial wit and aesthetic luxury ignite sovereign solar glory. This Masnooi framework mirrors numerological compounding, where 1 + 8 forms 9 with internal 4 resonance, and 3 + 6 forms 9 with internal 7 resonance.

Rather than complex rituals, they utilize elemental materials: copper for Sun, silver for Moon, turmeric/saffron for Jupiter, green fodder for Mercury, curd/perfume for Venus, mustard oil/iron for Saturn, and blankets/dogs for Ketu. For Moon-Rahu psychic disturbances, keeping a solid silver square or drinking water from a silver glass neutralizes the shadowy frequency. For Sun-Saturn friction, offering fresh water to the rising Sun from a copper vessel while feeding black birds calms the karmic clash.

Mulank represents the conscious self and inner temperament (ages 0 to 28-32); Bhagyank represents the karmic destiny and life trajectory (ages 32 onward); Namank is the social catalyst that bridges the conscious self with destiny. When Namank is mathematically tuned to a friendly number of both Mulank and Bhagyank, obstacles dissolve, social magnetism expands, and life manifests with effortless grace.

passages.content: Mulank 1 (Ruled by Sun) with Bhagyank 1 (Ruled by Sun) Combination: Compatibility: 90%, Rating: {'s': 5, 't': "Fortune's Favourite"} Stars. Core Predictive Trajectory: When a person whose day number is 1 (Mulank 1) also carries Bhagyank 1, the Sun's influence is doubled — this creates a powerful, unmistakable profile of leadership, initiative, and personal sovereignty. Such a combination produces someone who not only thinks like a pioneer but whose life circumstances repeatedly place them in roles where they can act independently and take the lead. Their career path often involves starting things — businesses, social initiatives, or creative projects — and they feel most alive when they are breaking new ground or setting standards that others follow. Emotionally, this pairing tends to make the person proud and self-reliant; they are unlikely to be comfort-seekers and prefer to face problems head-on. This intensity of Sun energy, however, also invites lessons: repeated experiences that test humility, patience and the art of sharing power. If ego remains unchecked, relationships can become competitive — both partners (or those around them) may feel overpowered by the native's need to dominate decisions. When balance is achieved — by deliberately practicing listening, delegating, and valuing other people's contributions — this combination becomes a genuine force for constructive leadership and visible achievement. Practical life advice for this pairing includes structuring authority (clear roles rather than ad-hoc control), cultivating emotional intelligence through trusted mentors, and creating accountability systems so personal drive does not turn into isolation.

passages.content: Mulank 1 (Ruled by Sun) with Bhagyank 2 (Ruled by Moon) Combination: Compatibility: 75%, Rating: {'s': 5, 't': 'Best for Navy — governed by water and the Moon'} Stars. Core Predictive Trajectory: A Mulank 1 personality (energetic, initiative-driven) combined with Bhagyank 2 (the Moon's gentle, cooperative destiny) produces a dynamic inner tension that, when handled well, offers a unique advantage. The day-number pushes you to act and lead; the destiny number asks you to cooperate, nurture, and attend to relationships. Practically, this pairing often manifests as a leader who is unusually attuned to people's feelings — someone who wants to lead but also wants the team to feel secure and heard. This can create real charisma: direct action flavored with sensitivity, which makes the native effective in diplomatic leadership roles, family businesses, counseling positions with administrative responsibility, or community organizing where direction and empathy are both needed. The tension shows up when slower emotional rhythms (Bhagyank 2) collide with Mulank 1's impatience; the person must learn to slow down enough to read the mood of the room and to avoid steamrolling others. Successful people with this pairing deliberately schedule "listening time" into decision processes and learn to invite collaboration without feeling their authority threatened. In relationships, bonding is deep if the Mulank-1 drive is softened by the Bhagyank-2 instinct to nurture; neglect of the emotional side, however, creates distance and resentments. Overall this combination can produce an admired, people-centered leader when emotional intelligence is practiced as a daily discipline.

The native typically has a gift for framing ideas, a knack for public presentation, and the courage to put those ideas into action. Careers in entrepreneurship, creative direction, public speaking, media, teaching, or any field that rewards both initiative and expression suit this blend especially well. The major growth task here is to pair expression with follow-through: while 3s are brilliant at launching ideas and rallying enthusiasm, 1s push for execution; together they must make sure charisma does not substitute for discipline. Interpersonally, the combination can be magnetic; people are drawn to the native's confidence and charm. Yet there is a risk of impatience with collaborators who need more time to process creative input or who prefer incremental change. To manage this, structured creativity helps — set milestones, assign clear roles, and allow for collaborative editing so that the native's bright initiatives become sustainable projects rather than short-lived flashes. When aligned, this combination creates leaders who don't just command — they also move hearts and minds.

Psychologically, the mix asks the native to temper impatience with an appreciation for the slow, detailed work of construction. Emotional friction can arise when the Mulank 1 urge for speed collides with Bhagyank 4's insistence on careful planning — the key to success is creating time horizons where both instincts are honored (fast experiments with slow implementation phases, for example). Relationships benefit when leadership becomes service — when authority is used to protect and organize rather than simply to command. This combination tends to reward disciplined ambition and creates a strong capacity for legacy building.

passages.content: Health and Body Chemistry for Mulank 2 (Moon): Number 2 individuals are ruled by the Moon, which governs emotions, fluid balance, mental stability, and the nervous system. Strong lunar influence makes you intuitive, empathetic, and emotionally responsive, but imbalance may create issues such as mood swings, anxiety, insomnia, water retention, and hormonal disturbances. Because the Moon controls body fluids and emotional rhythm, you may experience frequent colds, cough, chest congestion, digestive sensitivity, or thyroid-related concerns. Emotional stress directly affects your physical health, often leading to fatigue or nervous weakness. Irregular eating habits and lack of sleep increase instability. Maintaining a calm routine, balanced hydration, emotional expression, and proper rest is essential to stabilise lunar energy and protect both mental and digestive health. Healing Mantra: Om Shraam Shreem Shraum Sah Chandraya Namah - Chanting Instructions: Sit peacefully on Monday evening or before bedtime. Focus on slow breathing and chant this mantra 108 times to calm the mind and balance emotional energy. Offering water to the Moon (Arghya) or placing a glass of water under moonlight while chanting strengthens soothing vibrations and supports mental clarity and emotional stability.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Empirical Benchmark Analytics (NV-EBA-42)
passages.location: Archival Node Health & Body Chemistry - Mula
passages.content: Health and Body Chemistry for Mulank 3 (Jupiter): Number 3 individuals are ruled by Jupiter, which governs growth, liver function, metabolism, fat regulation, and overall expansion of the body. Strong Jupiter energy gives optimism, confidence, and good vitality, but imbalance may lead to weight gain, liver disorders, digestive disturbances, high cholesterol, or sluggish metabolism. Jupiter also influences the hips and thighs, so joint stiffness or circulation-related issues may develop with poor lifestyle habits. Overindulgence in rich, oily, or sweet foods can worsen physical imbalance. Emotional excess such as overconfidence or mental stress may gradually affect digestion and energy levels. Maintaining discipline in diet, moderate exercise, proper sleep, and avoiding excessive sweets or alcohol helps stabilise Jupiter’s expansive tendencies and supports long-term physical strength. Healing Mantra: Om Graam Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namah - Chanting Instructions: Sit calmly on a Thursday morning. Focus on steady breathing and chant this mantra 108 times to balance metabolism and strengthen liver energy. Offering yellow flowers or wearing light yellow while chanting enhances Jupiter’s positive vibrations and supports physical stability.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Empirical Benchmark Analytics (NV-EBA-42)
passages.location: Archival Node Health & Body Chemistry - Mula
passages.content: Health and Body Chemistry for Mulank 4 (Rahu): Number 4 individuals are ruled by Rahu, which represents irregularity, nervous tension, sudden fluctuations, and unconventional body rhythms. Rahu’s influence often creates unpredictable health patterns — issues may appear suddenly and disappear just as quickly. Common concerns include nervous system imbalance, anxiety, insomnia, digestive disturbances, allergies, skin irritation, and breathing irregularities. Because Rahu disturbs normal rhythms, hormonal imbalance and stress-related fatigue are also possible. You may overthink, suppress emotions, or carry hidden mental stress, which gradually affects digestion and sleep quality. Irregular eating habits, excessive processed foods, or overstimulation from screens worsen Rahu-related imbalance. Maintaining strict routine, grounding activities, regular sleep cycles, and avoiding intoxicants or extreme diets helps stabilize your system. Physical discipline and mental detox practices are essential to control Rahu’s erratic energy. Healing Mantra: Om Bhram Bhreem Bhraum Sah Rahave Namah - Chanting Instructions: Sit in a calm place on Saturday or during Rahu Kaal. Chant this mantra 108 times with steady breathing to reduce anxiety and stabilize nervous energy. Lighting a sesame oil lamp while chanting enhances grounding vibrations and supports mental balance.

passages.location: Archival Node Health & Body Chemistry - Mula
passages.content: Health and Body Chemistry for Mulank 5 (Mercury): Number 5 individuals are ruled by Mercury, which governs the nervous system, lungs, skin, speech, and mental coordination. Strong Mercury energy makes you intelligent, adaptable, and mentally active, but imbalance may cause nervous weakness, anxiety, restlessness, insomnia, and stress-related digestive issues. Because Mercury influences respiration, you may be prone to allergies, throat irritation, cough, or breathing sensitivity. Excessive thinking, irregular sleep, and overstimulation weaken your system over time. Digestive problems such as acidity or irregular appetite often arise from mental stress. Maintaining a disciplined routine, practicing breathing exercises, eating light meals, reducing stimulants, and ensuring proper rest helps stabilize Mercury’s fast-moving energy and protect your nervous and respiratory health. Healing Mantra: Om Braam Breem Braum Sah Budhaya Namah - Chanting Instructions: Sit calmly on Wednesday morning and chant this mantra 108 times with steady breathing. Focus on calming the mind and strengthening clarity. Wearing green or offering green moong enhances Mercury’s stabilizing vibrations and supports nervous balance.

passages.content: Health and Body Chemistry for Mulank 6 (Venus): Number 6 individuals are ruled by Venus, which governs the reproductive system, kidneys, skin, throat, hormonal balance, and overall vitality related to pleasure and comfort. Strong Venus energy gives charm, physical attractiveness, and good recovery power, but imbalance may lead to kidney or urinary issues, hormonal disturbances, reproductive concerns, skin sensitivity, and throat infections. Excess indulgence in sweets, oily foods, or a luxurious lifestyle can weaken metabolism and increase weight-related problems. Emotional sensitivity and relationship stress may also affect your nervous balance and energy levels. Overattachment or overindulgence can create physical exhaustion. Maintaining moderation in diet, proper hydration, balanced sleep, and controlled sugar intake helps stabilize Venus energy and protect reproductive and kidney health. Healing Mantra: Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namah - Chanting Instructions: Sit peacefully on Friday morning and chant this mantra 108 times with steady breathing. Focus on emotional balance and physical harmony. Wearing white or offering sweets in moderation enhances Venus vibrations and supports overall vitality and hormonal stability.

passages.content: Health and Body Chemistry for Mulank 7 (Ketu): Number 7 individuals are ruled by Ketu, which governs the subconscious mind, nervous sensitivity, hidden toxins, and psychosomatic responses. Strong Ketu energy makes you intuitive, analytical, and spiritually inclined, but imbalance may lead to anxiety, nerve weakness, sleep disturbances, digestive irregularities, and unexplained fatigue. You may experience sudden health fluctuations or mysterious ailments that are difficult to diagnose. Skin allergies, foot-related issues, and problems caused by stress or overthinking are also common. Because Ketu affects the subtle nervous system, emotional suppression can gradually disturb digestion and immunity. Irregular eating, isolation, and lack of grounding worsen imbalance. Maintaining meditation, light physical activity, simple vegetarian meals, proper hydration, and emotional expression helps stabilize Ketu energy and protect nervous and digestive health. Healing Mantra: Om Straam Streem Straum Sah Ketave Namah - Chanting Instructions: Sit quietly on Tuesday or Thursday and chant this mantra 108 times with focused breathing. Visualize calm white light surrounding you to clear negative vibrations. Practicing grounding activities along with chanting strengthens mental clarity and stabilizes subtle energy.

passages.content: Health and Body Chemistry for Mulank 8 (Saturn): Number 8 individuals are ruled by Saturn, which governs bones, joints, teeth, nervous endurance, chronic conditions, and the body’s long-term structural strength. Strong Saturn energy gives resilience and high tolerance for hardship, but imbalance may lead to joint pain, arthritis, back problems, dental issues, slow digestion, and circulation disorders. Saturn also influences chronic stress and fatigue that develop gradually rather than suddenly. You may ignore early symptoms, allowing minor problems to become long-term concerns. Poor posture, irregular routine, and lack of movement can worsen stiffness and muscular tension. Emotional suppression and prolonged worry may also weaken immunity over time. Maintaining disciplined daily habits, regular stretching or yoga, proper calcium intake, warm meals, and consistent sleep patterns helps stabilize Saturn energy and protect skeletal and nervous health. Healing Mantra: Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaye Namah - Chanting Instructions: Sit calmly on Saturday and chant this mantra 108 times with steady breathing. Focus on grounding and stability. Lighting a sesame oil lamp while chanting enhances Saturn’s balancing vibrations and supports endurance and long-term health strength.

passages.content: Health and Body Chemistry for Mulank 9 (Mars): Number 9 individuals are ruled by Mars, which governs blood circulation, muscles, bone marrow, heat in the body, and physical stamina. Strong Mars energy gives courage, high vitality, and strong recovery power, but imbalance may lead to inflammation, high blood pressure, headaches, fevers, skin eruptions, or accident-related injuries. Because Mars represents heat and aggression, excess anger or stress can disturb blood flow and increase internal heat, causing acidity or digestive irritation. You may also be prone to cuts, burns, or muscular strain due to impulsive actions. Overexertion and irregular sleep weaken stamina over time. Maintaining controlled physical exercise, cooling foods, proper hydration, anger management, and disciplined routine helps balance Mars energy and protect circulatory and muscular health. Healing Mantra: Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namah - Chanting Instructions: Sit calmly on Tuesday morning and chant this mantra 108 times with steady breathing. Focus on calming internal heat and strengthening courage with control. Offering red flowers while chanting enhances Mars’ positive vibrations and supports physical strength and balanced energy.

THE THREE IMPORTANT NUMBERS IN YOUR BIRTH CODE
You have many numbers in your birthday and birth-certificate name. (Every
letter translates as a number too, which we will discover in chapter 2.)
However, there are three numbers that impact you the most. Throughout
this manual, they will be referred to as the Three Important Numbers in
your Birth Code.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The first two important numbers that define your Birth Code are both
derived from your birthday. The third important number is derived from
your birth certificate name.
1. Your Day of Birth Number—the day of the month you were born
2. Your Life Purpose Number—the total sum of your full birth date
3. Your Destiny Number—the total sum of letters in your birth-
certificate name (see chapter 2)
Combined into a powerful triad, your Birth Code is a spiritual and
practical formula that is totally unique to you. (Even identical twins do not
share the same Birth Code, due to their different birth names.)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Your Birth Code unlocks the secrets of your birth promise—special gifts,
talents, your personality, the nature of your mission, and corresponding
lessons. Each of your three individual personal frequencies describes how
you think, feel, act, and experience life. Your Three Important Birth
Numbers form the basic building blocks that make up your divine DNA
code.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You’ll refer to the Three Important Numbers in your Birth Code in every
part of your life. In fact, they are having an impact on you right now,
whether you are aware of them or not!
Later in this guide you’ll discover how to use your Birth Code to create a
personal forecast map. However, in order to unlock the fortunate Personal
Days, Months and Years (intensifications of your Birth Code), you will
need to know your Three Important Birth Numbers first.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)

Now let’s discover the first two important numbers in your Birth Code:
your Day of Birth number and Life Purpose (full birthday) numbers. Both
are derived from your birthday. Let’s begin with your Day of Birth number
—the easiest to calculate!
Every person and entity (like a business, book or product launch, live event,
ceremony, first meeting) is born on a specific day of the month. The Day of
Birth is one of Three Important Numbers in a person’s Birth Code.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)

natural disposition, their way of being and tendencies, w ho they are day-to-
day, moment-to-moment—even if you do not know their age. This allows
you to do a quick reading on anyone, as long as you know they were born
on the 5th, 22nd, 17th, etc.—so, regardless of whether you know their year
of birth or not, you can read this part of their Birth Code.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)

corresponds to that number. If you are born between the 10th and the 31st
of any month, you will be impacted by one additional double-digit number
(sometimes two) along with the single-digit or “root number.” Find the root
number by adding together the digits of your Day of Birth (twice, if the
result is another double-digit number). Read the descriptions in chapters 4
and 5 for your Day of Birth number and your root number(s).

Numbers in your Birth Code. No one has just one number in their Birth
Your Life Purpose is a powerful frequency revealing how you need to
express your soul purpose. It answers the following questions:
What is the main reason you are here? What is your main lesson? How

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
OW IT’S TIME TO DELVE INTO THE POSITIVE GIFTS AND SHADOW SIDE FOR
ALL NINE SINGLE-DIGIT ROOT NUMBERS. You are both supported and
enlightened by your beautiful soul code. Each of our Three Important Birth
Numbers will illuminate moments that shift us (both challenging and
exciting!) so that we can acclimate and make the most out of them!
Root numbers by their very name define the underlying energy of any
number when it is reduced to its origin—a single-digit. Please refer to
chapter 4 for all double-digit “Master Numbers” 11, 22, 33, 44, etc. and
chapter 5 for all double-digit “compound” numbers (10–99).

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Each single-digit number can be compared to the key of a piece of
music, such as A minor or D major, from which the building blocks of
melody and harmony are formed. Numbers are aligned to music and to the
stars—they form a code that is both visible and invisible. This chapter will
unveil the deep mysteries of each single-digit and forms the basis of the
whole book itself.
It’s important to note that most people have at least two different root
numbers in their Three Important Birth Numbers’ code. Only on rare
occasions will you meet someone who has the same three root numbers as
their Day of Birth, Life Purpose, and Destiny Number.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If one of your three numbers appears twice (for example, you have a 7
Day of Birth and a 124 Destiny which reduces to 7) then you have an
“Intensification.” Refer to chapter 11 for more on intensifications, both in
your Birth Code and other areas of your life.
We begin with the three numerology triads, since they reveal how each
single-digit belongs to a unique number “family.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The three numbers that compose the Mind Triad are 1, 5, and 7. Those who
have one or more of these three Mind numbers are analytical, intellectual,
intuitive, ambitious, independent, witty, and psychic. This Mind Triad is
comfortable with information, both analyzing and gathering facts and
figures and using the mind to solve problems and make decisions. They
enjoy learning and exploring new territory.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Mind Triad people may have a tendency to worry or overanalyze—
getting caught up in the net of information overload. Encouraging a Mind
person to feel the outcome of their solutions in advance instead of thinking
through them may make them feel a tad uncomfortable—but is truly the
way into experiencing that missing link—the blissful factor. Fortunately,
Mind people have a natural intuitive side that is always ready to listen once
they switch off (or at least turn down) their “inner analyst!”
The three numbers that comprise the Manifestation Triad are 2, 4, and 6.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Those who have one or more of these three Manifestation numbers are by
nature more patient, have a peaceful, grounding energy, use order and
discipline to manifest results into physical reality, and are a stable influence.
Manifestation Triad people know how to get things done and overcome
obstacles to do so. Thus having a 2, 4 or 8 in your Three Important Birth
Numbers is an invitation to implement result after result, building a solid
foundation for now and the future.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Manifestation people may have a tendency to implement before intuiting
or feeling out the efficacy of their plans. So they may be perplexed when
they don’t achieve their intended result. This happens because their
intentions were not fully aligned with how they feel before they go into
manifestation mode. Taking the “heart” and “fun” out of the intention
process can lead to frustration. With their natural thirst to manifest, they just
need to carve out some quality time to enjoy the process, introduce a sense
of play, and check into their feelings. Then, the outcomes of their steady
implementation process will be extraordinary and lasting.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Numbers 3, 6, and 9 form the Triad of Creation. Those people who have
one or more of these three Creation numbers are by nature compassionate,

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
loving, emotionally engaged, highly creative, nurturing, enthusiastic, and
social and have a great need to be of service in order to uplift others.
Creation Triad people must have their heart engaged in every part of their
life experience. Feeling good and expressing their good vibes in some way
is their key to happiness. Thus they must have an outlet to talk, write, dance
—create in any format of their choosing.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When expressing the shadow side of this triad, the person can get
moody, dissipate energy through distractions, stop manifesting altogether
and abdicate responsibilities. They can feel sorry for themselves and blame
the world for what they perceive as unfair treatment. The best “cure” for
distractions and doldrums is—to go play and create. Laughter and humor
are wonderful healing balms for the 3-6-9 triad to create a “pattern
interrupt” and press the mood reset button! Their feelings are their soul-
food, and so getting into a positive state allows them to feel valued,
appreciated, and loved again. Then they can share the love, uplift others,
and thrive. After all, to love is their ultimate motivation.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
A special note about this triad. The 3-6-9 triad governs the creation
process. Thus the building blocks of the universe reduce down to these
three numbers. In astrology, for example, all the different “aspects”
(connections between planets or angles) add up to numbers that reduce to
either 3, 6, or 9, such as the 120-degree “Trine,” which adds up to 3; the 90-
degree “Square,” which adds up to 9 and the 60-degree “Sextile,” which
adds up to 6 (Any aspect will reduce to 3, 6, or 9.) The 24 hours in a day
add up to 6, and 12 hours add up to 3. 60 minutes is 6.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Multiples of 3, 6, and 9 are repeated over and over again no matter
which number is multiplied.
Use the three triads—Mind, Manifestation and Creation—to get a quick
read on anyone. For example, if you know a person with a 10/1 Day of
Birth (which is in the Mind Triad) and a 33/6 Life Purpose (which is in the
Creation Triad), you can deduce that this person likes to analyze and think
things through, craves independence, is motivated (Mind), has a great
capacity for compassion, enjoys helping and advising others, has good
people skills, and must express their feelings (Creation).

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
These three numerology triads alone are a great starting point to gain
instant understanding of a person’s outlook and natural ways.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The number 0 hovers between worlds—between numbers of positive value
and numbers of negative value, between the seen and the unseen. It
therefore represents a unique power. In fact, if you add 0 to any number it
expands and empowers that number—3 becomes 30, 7 magnifies to 70—
and the more zeros you add, the bigger the value becomes—2,000 and
8,000,000—carry far more impact and influence than 2 and 8.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Thus the number 0 represents the “God Number,” symbolizing the
greatest power and multidimensional reality—the supreme balance between
light and dark. 0 is the full circle, representing all the universes, galaxies,
multiverses—all there was, is, and will be to experience. When you loose
track of time, you experience the power of hovering between worlds in a
space where life just is—and each moment expands into timelessness.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
0 takes you to your Origins—Original Source, where there is and always
will be Only light, total Omnipotence. Even the word “zero” ends with the
letter O, representing 0. The full circle in O is both everything and nothing,
full and empty. It is both a container and an entry into another dimension. It
can hold all energy, while allowing all energy to pass through it. There is no
time, just eternity.
Look at zero as the ultimate existential experience. Zero puts a divine
sparkle into everything it touches. Zero holds divine light.

For example, your Birth Code comprises a 3 and a 9 (Creation) plus 5

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
(Mind). Or do your Three Important Birth Code Numbers all belong to
different triads? For example, a 3 Day of Birth (Creation Triad), a 2 Life
Purpose (Manifestation Triad), and a 7 Destiny (Mind Triad).

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
1 is the number of new beginnings and originality. It is the vibration of free
will, individual pursuit, innovation, and daring—the original spark of
creation. 1 represents courage, and enthusiasm. 1 people following their
primary impulse. They are natural born leaders who want to leave a unique
legacy. They resist taking the beaten path, instead follow their instinct to
create new experiences for others—introducing innovative new ways—by
following their own, individual path. When in positive alignment, a 1
person animates energy, stays in motion, always creating something new,
and guides others to break through into new territory by the very nature of
who they are at soul level. They rebel against being asked to follow others,
since it is their role to take command.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
1 is the first number in the Mind Triad, and so this vibration means the
mind is always on fire with ideas springing up freely and uninhibited,
always with the intent to create something new. Putting the ideas into
practice takes its form in unique ways. 1 feels like they are “number one,”
seeking to stand out in some way and direct others, or be the “star.” They
usually become important and influential in some area of life.
Mediocrity frustrates a 1 person—they need to feel value and the
original, intelligent spark of creation in everything and everyone.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Confidence and fearlessness are their natural gifts (a lack of these qualities
means they are out of alignment energetically).
The image of the one is of a straight line coming from heaven to earth and
back. It is dignified and straightforward, and has a penetrating sense of
direction. 1 is a vibration that represents the masculine aspect of our human
experience.
All number 1 people carry dignity. 1 likes to stand out, is proud,
achievement oriented, represents the primal impulse, and has a strong self-
worth. 1 always will demand respect and feels set apart from others. 1 has

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
strong views and definite beliefs, and protects those that are vulnerable.
They are private, value their solitude, and enjoy spending time alone.
1s are very affectionate with those whom they love and trust but not keen
on having an immediate familiarity with people they have just met. 1 is
comfortable around younger people and children, though they may at times
feel a sadness arise from childhood memories. 1 enjoys exquisite clothes
and jewelry and tends to have impeccable taste with a penchant for the finer
things in life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Since 1s are naturally self-centric and here to learn to be self-sufficient
and self-reliant, they also have a great desire to be in love and be loved by a
partner. This paradox exists perhaps because they need to explore first being
independent and then reach out and learn to be interdependent. Of all the
nine numbers, 1 people may know best how to bypass codependency due to
their underlying need for self-reliance.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
1 is in the Mind Triad, thus blessing 1 people with mental resources and
an active imagination. Appealing to a 1 person’s intelligence leads to the
best results. This is true for children and adolescents as well. 1s do not do
well with authority and control, and they will eventually rebel and even turn
aggressive. 1s need to guard against overanalyzing and worrying about a
future that is totally hypothetical. Staying focused on the present in a
flowing, creative state of being allows 1 people to thrive and reach their
highest goals, often with astounding speed.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
1 must feel like they are an authority in something. They are natural
leaders and use their original ideas to move energy with dynamic power.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
1 people are very good at starting but have a more difficult time completing
projects and goals. Their pride can get the best of them—they can even go
against their true values when their pride is wounded. 1 does not respond
well to criticism, though they can dish it out. 1 in its shadow expression is
stubborn, will complain when ambitions are thwarted and can be quite self-
centered. 1 can suffer from “bruised ego” syndrome and will only help
others if they do exactly as the 1 person expects of them. When a 1 is
ignored, they can lash out with anger.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When out of alignment, a 1 person can be boastful, aggressive, cynical,
and egotistical, and even can turn to bullying others to create a false sense
of power. Their repressed feelings can turn to anger, and they are unwilling

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
to join forces with others or cooperate with people easily, preferring their
own way or the highway. They won’t want to be told what to do and may
even lash out aggressively to stop anyone whom they view as an
unwelcome parental figure.
Other out-of-alignment expressions for number 1 are lacking iniative or
being indecisive, lazy, low in confidence, or easily influenced and swayed
by others.
If you have hurt a 1 person in some way and want to come back into
harmony with them, share your sentiments with great humility—a 1 won’t
necessarily wrap their arms around you, but will accept your apology with
grace and gratitude.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
1 people believe they are superior to others and can attract resentment
for these airs of superiority, since they can come off as pedantic, arrogant,
and conceited. Thus they can be obstinate and do not accept opposition in
any way, shape, or form. Or they can be inconsiderate of other people’s
feelings even while they themselves are very sensitive.
The way to harmony and peace is to be carefree and spontaneous, loosen
the reins of control, use their good humor, and tap into their love of new
discoveries, as this positive mindset instantly presses the reset button, aligns
1s to their heart-center, and lets bygones be bygones.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Affirmation: I am at one with my mind, heart and soul. I magically
create miraculous opportunities for me to accomplish anything!
2 is the number of peace, balance, and unity—the union of opposites. With
a strong emphasis on balance, 2 is designed to merge realities, bringing
opposites together. 2s are the peacemakers, mediators, and diplomats—
wanting harmony to prevail even under the most trying conditions. Thus
their patience and listening abilities are highly prized.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
2 carries ancient wisdom, and a sense of mysticism and secrets and has
wonderful artistic gifts. It represents duality, pairs, couples, the feminine
vibration, receptivity, and one-on-one engagement. 2 people are very
sensitive, so be extra gentle with them. 2 is connected to imagination and
dreams. They love to connect to and correspond with others.
As the most diplomatic of all nine numbers, 2 people get along with
pretty much anyone. This is especially true since 2s don’t seek to measure

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
up against others at the cost of harmony and maintaining equilibrium. They
don’t feel the need to impose their views or beliefs on others. They are also
peaceful people to be around, since they exude a calmness when making
decisions.
The visible representation of number 2 looks like a person bowing to the
left, in the direction of the number 1. This innate desire to merge with
another, join with them, and create peace is integral to all 2s.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
2s have a need to look for advice, support, and approval from others—
making sure all bases are covered before they break new ground. This
cautious approach requires a need to understand and know as much as they
can before making a decision and then proceeding with care. This moderate
approach is appreciated and respected by others, giving 2s the gift of good
judgment.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
This, coupled with their kind disposition, warmth, and understanding
makes them easy to be with and welcome in any situation. 2s are excellent
managers, as they have a miraculous touch of persuasion which opens doors
for everyone to see eye to eye—often discreetly getting others to view
things their way. This tact, mediation, and diplomacy enables the 2 person
to make major inroads in securing consensus between different parties,
allowing them to open doors and succeed where others could not.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
2 is the first vibration in the 2-4-8 Manifestation Triad. Thus 2s are
naturally responsible, conscientious, and efficient. 2s are usually humble,
but can initially lack self-confidence.
2 people are very psychic, though they may keep that side of themselves
secret. They are extremely sensitive to other people’s feelings, sensing them
instantly, and so they are very concerned for their close loved ones’ well-
being. Their highly developed intuition serves them well when they meet
people, since their natural shyness can lead them to not trust others easily.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
2s are generous friends and make great companions. They have a natural
interest in the psychology of human nature due to their acute observation
skills and ability to intuit body language, sounds, and facial expressions.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
2s are naturally very romantic, stemming from the number’s connection
to two people in partnership. One of their main lessons is to be in
partnership with lovers, friends, and associates without losing their
independence and sense of self. Not falling into codependent relationship
patterns is a major lesson for any 2 person. 2s are very affectionate and
tender. They have a primal urge to please others.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Due to their sensitive nature 2 people are secretive and don’t readily
share their intimate thoughts, their plans, or even what their next move will
be. At the same time they are wonderful conversationalists and can
naturally get others to reveal parts of themselves. When they approach their
goals, they are the opposite of 1 people, who just go for it—2s will move
forward, then course-correct and then might head right, left, and even
backwards before lunging forward again, often with great force. This zigzag
pattern towards their goals gives them a sense of balance, which they so
crave. A 2 person will usually attract financial well-being—if anything, it is
rare to see them struggling in conditions of poverty. However, if trained to
have a “poverty-conscious” mindset, 2s must consciously extricate
themselves from this paradigm first before experiencing their natural gift to
attract prosperity. 2s are very giving with their resources. They find it more
difficult to accept gifts, having an innate tendency to feel inadequate if they
accept support, especially financial.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
2s trust others implicitly. They can’t imagine anyone having a “bad”
intention or being anything but kind and noble. This means they believe
what others tell them. So they must learn to discern between what feels
right and what feels just a little “off”—use their intuitive gifts to separate
the manipulators from those who will not take advantage of their kind
hearts and good faith.
A 2 person loves to dream and live in their imaginary, idealistic world.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
These sensitive, kind souls are highly adaptable and intuitive, giving them
all the qualities they need to fulfill their beautiful dream of bringing peace,
love, and harmony to the world. In their most positive state, 2s are a true
blessing to everyone around them.
A 2 person living in the shadow expression of their number may have a
tendency to fear the unknown and be unusually cautious. They need highly
sensitive support to come to terms with the unfamiliar. In fact, 2s can fear

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
every kind of pain or loss, allowing their very active imagination to fuel
their fears and worries. They may appear calm and balanced, but this can
also hide a neurotic, touchy, nervous disposition. If they feel hurt by
someone, they don’t tend to react aggressively; rather they will retreat into
silence and even shut down.
Due to their natural humility, 2s, when out of alignment, can sometimes
slip into feeling inadequate and suffer from low self-esteem. This sets up a
situation where they can easily get depressed and in turn will create
problems for themselves to almost “prove” their perceived state of lack. The

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
2-4-8 Manifestation Triad that number 2 belongs to is very meticulous and
demands thorough attention to detail—but the sensitive 2 person can go
overboard and demand too much of themselves. Expectations that are set
too high can spiral into complexes and inhibited behavior, as they doubt
their own abilities and react fearfully when the unexpected shows up at
their doorstep. This self-criticism is a big lesson for the 2 to overcome, so
they stay centered and live their life free of inner conflict.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Being in a secure, loving home base is integral for their equilibrium
across all of the spectrums in their life. If they feel obligated to live in a
disharmonious and tense environment, or with people who are
argumentative and aggressive, they will loose their sense of equilibrium.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
This is when 2s can become bitter and broken. Since conflict and a
disharmonious environment have a very detrimental effect on 2s, they must
always have a “safe place” to go to in order to feel loved and nurtured;
otherwise they will lash out and be temperamental. Loud noise, aggressive,
violent movies and blasting music will also harm the energetic field around
a 2 person and can easily throw them off balance.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
At the same time, 2s will sacrifice much to get their life back into
harmony. It is very important for all 2s to accept that life is filled with both
positive and negative situations so that they don’t react to the challenging
moments with tension, depression, and inner turmoil. This is why having a
harmonious home environment is so integral to their spiritual, mental, and
emotional health.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Their shyness may make them “freeze” around strangers. Once they feel
their heart engaged in a conversation (and sense that there is no danger of
being hurt), they open up the soft petals of their sweet, tender heart to
others. They are deeply affected by inconsiderate or rude behavior.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
However, once they regain their balance they will figure out how to justify
such actions by others and forgive them.
2s can be very cautious and may not easily take a chance. They also can
become possessive of things and people. Indecision can lead to feeling
separate and divided.
To remain balanced and strengthen their inner confidence, 2s must
release their desire to please and be “perfect;” otherwise doubt and
indecision will run their lives in circles. Their need to please can lead them
to sacrifice their own unique ideas for someone else’s cause—thus 2s need
to be diligent and maintain boundaries.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
They must not get preoccupied with unimportant matters—like surfing
the internet and obsessive attention to social media—which create a false
sense of connection the 2 craves without yielding meaningful results, and
the end result is that the wasted time reinforces a sense of inadequacy and
incompletion. 2s must always discern between what actually matters and
what does not. . . what is for their highest good, and what is not.
Getting to this place of peace means learning first and foremost how to

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Relax. Relaxation is the key for a 2 to regain and maintain inner harmony
and peace. In this place of serenity their moods and emotions won’t get
repressed or overwhelm them—both sure signs that they are imbalanced
and just need to take a moment to regroup. Deep breathing, exercise, and
meditation are wonderful and necessary on a daily basis for all 2s. Bypass
division, separation, or indecision through listening, deep breathing, and
gratitude.
Affirmation: I am indivisible. I breathe deeply and feel connected
to the divine at all times. I am grateful for every experience that
comes my way and see hidden benefits to each encounter in my life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
A 3 person is highly creative, action oriented, and truthful and radiates with
joy. They are fluid in how they move through their life experiences, and
love to explore everything from their heart-center. 3 is connected to truth,
fertility and creation. It is the number representing the trinity of Mother-
Father-Child. This trinity governs creation—which is the numbers 1 (primal
impulse) and 2 (desire for peace) propelled into action. 3 people are usually

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
very talented, very vivacious, interested in many things, ingenious and
brilliant. They are curious and love to learn—asking questions all the time.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
3 is the first number in the Creation Triad and thus is fiercely
independent, seeking total freedom of movement. 3s have the artistic touch
even if they are not in the arts. This number requires that they express
themselves in some capacity, either through writing, speaking, performing
as a musician, dancer, or actor, being the star of a radio or TV show or
having a platform of some kind to share their message. 3s, above anything,
must communicate. They always have something to say! They are fierce
advocates of freedom of speech and expression. Their natural yearning for
renewal and birth gives them tremendous powers of creation.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The 3-6-9 Creation Triad that number 3 belongs to infuses them with
compassion, tenderness, and a loving, affectionate disposition. They are
magnetic, and their smile lights up any room. 3s are impressionable and can
be easily influenced. This is especially true if others appeal to their giving
and generous nature—or show them appreciation so they feel valued and
appreciated.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
3 people have a great sense of humor and a cheerful disposition. Their
optimism is contagious, and they tend to see the world with the glass half
full—searching for the bright side of everything and in everyone. When
energetically aligned with their gifts, 3s are the most positive, uplifting
people to be around. No other vibration gives such light, grace and is as
enchanting!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
3s can take any challenging situation and move quickly through
bitterness (or bypass it altogether) into a place of acceptance and seeing it in
a positive light. Their ability to “see” future positive impact and outcomes
for any current or past challenge stems from an uncanny “bird’s-eye” view

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
3s have, which allows them to fully move through pain and trauma and
come out the other side seemingly whole and reborn. Thus their ability to
reboot—literally create their reality—as well as acknowledge the bright
side in everything and everyone, is one of their most powerful gifts. These
talents, coupled with their natural gifts of expression and outgoing
personalities, make 3s adept at helping anyone feel good, whether it is an
intimate friend needing their support, or in brand new social situations.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
They are experts at comfortably mixing with any group and have a knack
for adjusting quickly to different personalities or changing situations.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The image of the 3 is two wide-open half circles facing to the left, gathering
inspiration form the past and remolding it to manifest a new creation. It has
a welcoming feeling to it, and thus the embracing, congenial nature of the 3
person—wrapping their two arms around everyone they meet—is
represented by the figure 3.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
3s are born to inspire. They cast a spell by just being delightful,
motivating others to act through their passionate enthusiasm, happiness,
positive mindset, and optimistic attitude. Their spontaneity blends with an
effortless capacity to connect with anyone—be it in an elevator for 10
seconds or in any other social setting. Their natural charm, coupled with
their brilliant and personable magnetism, relaxes and “disarms” anyone
with whom they make contact.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
For 3s everything comes down to furthering a deep ideal, something they
are so passionate about that they can’t imagine anyone else not sharing the
same ideal with them. This ideal is their truth, and 3s, adherence to what is
true is one of their major drivers. They will leave no stone unturned to find
the truth. Thus they make great detectives. If you answer a 3 in an evasive
way, they’ll not let you get away with it! 3s can spot a lie in a second. Even
if they are somehow heading down a misleading path, they will never stop
trying to search for the truth.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
3s are not as driven to be successful in order to achieve a high position
or power in as much as they appreciate success due to the pleasures and
good life that achievement brings. 3s love a deliciously prepared meal as
much as beautiful surroundings and adornments. They like to spoil
themselves and their loved ones (and need to watch their wallets).

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
3s thrive when they can travel. . . being with others, seeing the world,
and going on journeys wakes up their innate creativity and yearning for
independence. Plus they love to explore other countries, cultures, music,
and people—getting to know other ideas, religions, lifestyles, and cultural
paradigms. 3s are also deeply spiritual because 3 aligns with their quest for
truth.
3s love defending the underdog and are advocates for animals. They will
take risks—and when they couple their natural passion with their
willingness to take a chance, their impact is beautiful and great. Their

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
delightful, charming, magnetic personalities are a breath of fresh air
invoking a lightness of being.
Having a higher education is important for 3s and makes them feel part
of the higher ideals and philosophies they so cherish. They must have a total
sense of independence in any marriage union in order to feel the freedom
that is integral to their happiness. 3s appreciate and enjoy luxury, which
reflects the beauty and vibrant nature of their soul.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
A balanced 3 will not succumb to moodiness or depression and will
easily forgive themselves as well as forgiving others. Having a good circle
of friends can help 3s to express their ideas and feelings, though the key to
their happiness is to engage in creative activities that totally absorb them.
The key to a happy, meaningful life is for a 3 to focus and specialize.
3 people must persevere in their chosen specialty and not get offtrack
and distracted by frivolous activities. They must only promise what they
can deliver and intend to accomplish.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When 3s know they are uplifting people, nothing will stop them. In their
natural, connected state, 3 people are luminous, vibrant beings of joy.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
3s can and will multitask; however, their tendency to scatter and go offtrack
results in wasted energies when they are tired or out of alignment. They can
delay or dilute the impact of their divine mission if they don’t learn to how
to focus and specialize in one direction at a time. Vacillation can lead to
indecision or going on tangents for hours, days, or weeks at a time. 3s like
to begin projects, but may have a more difficult time completing them,
since they can get distracted, and that is when they go off course.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
A 3 person also gets bored if not intellectually or creatively engaged and
may slack off if they lack self-motivation. 3s need to play and have fun but
can go too far and forget about their responsibilities (disliking the whole
idea of responsibility to themselves and others). This happens especially
when they don’t have the organization to help them stay focused on
priorities. Thus they can get lazy about practicing and developing their
gifts. Dedication to their often outstanding talents is supported by a
systematic approach of their priorities. 3s believe anything is permitted
because it is so easy for them to attain success as it is, so they use their
natural happy and congenial nature as an “escape” to chill more than is
necessary.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When 3s stop consistently pursuing goals, during both easy and difficult
times, they may attribute their lack of practice to other factors. But in the
end, most inaction and lack of commitment is due to their lazy attitude. This
confusion about the origin of their lack of initiative can throw them for a
loop. It occurs especially when 3s encounter mental blocks or tiredness and
won’t work through their resistance with a conscious decision to act.
3s can be wise and philosophical, then witty and funny the next moment,
while abdicating discipline. This results in a lack of steady growth. One of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
3’s lessons is to persevere steadfastly with their goals.
A 3 person also may have the tendency to be too talkative, sometimes
compulsively, so they need to guard against speaking when they don’t have
something valuable or new to say.
There can always be too much of a good thing, and 3s can exaggerate
and even be superficial and “fake” or may make promises they can’t keep.
The quickest cure for a negative emotional state or depression is to “just
do it”—to be creative. Express yourself in whichever way you want to.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Then, eventually, and usually quickly, you reconnect with the beauty and
joy in your soul and are happily on track and back in the flow again—eager
to share your gifts on some kind of stage.
Affirmation: “I am happily engaged with what I love to do. I lavish
my focus and full attention on activities that uplift me. I spend
time with those who allow me to feel light and free.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
4 both is a grounding frequency (symbolizing the Earth) and carries a
mysterious quality connected to the divine. As a 4 you are practical,
trustworthy and have a hands-on approach to your life. When you commit
to something, you can be counted on to complete it. This is epitomized by
the square: four equal sides that symbolize architecture, home, balance, and
building something that lasts. So, on the one hand your reliability,
organizational skills, stable and calm demeanor, self-discipline, meticulous
attention to details, and responsible character make you sought after as a
family member, colleague, and friend. But 4 is also an enigma, and you like
it that way! (Even though it results in others being perplexed by you.)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The paradox of the 4 is that you always have one foot in the future—this
is the inventor in you wanting to go the unconventional route and thwarting

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
all expectations. Your ideas and values are ahead of their time,
unconventional and even prophetic. You often just have a “knowing” about
what will transpire ahead of time long before it happens. This other side of
you favors individualism, a marked originality, and sudden, unexpected
events. As a living, walking paradox (organized and unpredictable) you are
seldom fully understood, but it is what makes you so unique. You like being
unconventional!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
There is a “genius” quality to your 4 vibration allows your natural
curiosity to go off the beaten path. You naturally have the focus and
discipline to explore your hunches and intuitive downloads. After all, you
love a good quest to sink your teeth into! You are rarely deterred once
you’ve started on such a mission.
Though you are eager to explore all possibilities that exist beyond your
own personal life, when it comes down to making internal adjustments—
shifting your personal habits—you are very stubborn. This four-square
“box” can be your hiding place to avoid taking responsibility for your own
growth and transformation.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you look at the visual image of the number 4, it stands on one leg and
points a big triangle to the heavens. Thus 4s are taking the powerful 3-6-9
Triad of Creation and grounding it, bringing it down to Earth—making it
real and practical. The lesson for a 4 person is to stay connected to Earth
while exploring the wonderful gifts in the Triad of Creation—at the same
time. Then the discoveries and shifts are mirrored in their personal lives as
well, as reluctance to make personal changes dissipates.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The balance between heaven and Earth is reflected in the merging of
intuition and intelligence—applied equally across all four areas of
human life—physical, mental, emotional and spiritual.
Thus 4 symbolizes the real reason for our life on Earth: We are divine
beings of light having a human experience. We are always connected
through the Triad of Creation to Source, to the Creator, and are here to
internalize the light into practical, real-time results. We are reflectors of the
love of God—and the number 4 invites us to remember we are members of
one big galactic family.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Living in a clean, organized environment is very important for you to
stay balanced and healthy. 4 governs feng shui—the art of keeping your
physical environment energetically clear and positive—so be sure to “feng-
shui” your home and work place often. Clarity of mind thrives when you
clear your life.
4 lies in the middle of the Manifestation Triad (2-4-8), thus taking the
intuitive insights of the number 2 and manifesting them into physical form
as real, practical results.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 4 you love being part of a family and cherish your friends. You are
tolerant and compassionate. Money and status is not of great interest to you
(though the other numbers in your Birth Code may show otherwise). You
mix with people of all means, not caring about rank or class. It’s the “inner
genius” in you—your surroundings might go unnoticed in favor of your
imagination! You live for this moment. And your tolerance for others is
exhibited in “to each their own”—something you expect in return!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When you are energetically out of alignment a rigid approach to life will
appear. This fixed nature can get you stuck in a rut, as you hang on to your
opinions as if they mean more than the people you are with. Being
headstrong can also lead to arguments. A tendency to work long hours
(which naturally suits you) may turn into overwork, so be careful about
crossing the line when it comes to fulfilling tasks. If you notice it gets to the
point where you get too busy and don’t ever stop to smell the roses, take the
queue and make time to simply relax and enjoy life. Emotionally you can
close down, not demonstrate affection.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You may also get too serious at times, forgetting to lighten up and go
with the flow. When you find yourself not responding to humor—and
leading a humorless life—it’s a sign for you to loosen up! Hanging on to
old habits and mind patterns or living in a disorganized space will
exacerbate being stuck.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Guard against being careless and not fulfilling your responsibilities. A
real disconnection from the positive expression of your number 4 results in
dishonesty and a completely undisciplined lifestyle. In this disoriented
emotional state you can inflict needless pain on yourself through envy,
jealousy, self-pity, and resentment of others. You will waste your most
precious commodity—time—as well as other resources while fixating on

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
comparing yourself to others or feeling self-blame and guilt, rather than
lifting yourself out of the situation (no matter how challenging it seems at
the time) by taking a step of faith, owning your experience of it, and being
accountable. For you, just doing something valuable, no matter how big or
small the gesture is, sets you back on track!
Affirmation: I am whole, I am complete, I am more than enough, I
am who I am—I live and let live.
We have arrived at the midpoint. 5 is the number right in the middle of 1
and 9.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you look at the image of the number 5 you can see that it faces left (the
past) at the bottom and right (the future) at the top. 5 has two straight lines
and a curved line. Thus 5 is a visual representation of the pivot point,
representing versatility, movement, decisions, risk, and a new beginning of
some kind.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
5 also lies in the midpoint of all three triads, as well as being in the
middle of the Mind Triad (1-5-7). In this position, 5 expands your original
creative ideas through a keen intellect and intelligence. You are adept at
capturing all the various angles of a question with your uncommon
perception. You are naturally connected to higher consciousness by virtue
of your keen sense of freedom and adventure.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Exploring the unknown is your forte—whether through physical travel,
or in your mind. You are inspired by your insatiable curiosity to experience
all there is to experience! 5 governs the senses, so you want to taste, see,
smell, touch, and hear as much as you can. Though this can result in
distractions (something to watch!) you are also the ultimate multitasker and
so are designed to handle multiple tasks at one time, depending on the
nature each task requires your full attention or not. The 5 vibration is by
nature very sensual and spiritual.
You have a great magnetism and charm, which make you very attractive.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content: When you feel fulfilled and happy your enthusiasm makes you irresistible,

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content: and you naturally become the center of attention in any gathering or group.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Connection is one of your key themes. . . connecting via voice, the
internet, writing, publishing, video, radio, television, film, the arts. You use
some kind of media to meet others, gather information, share your message
—all with the goal of bringing people together. 5 governs groups or crowds
of people, making you an adept social networker as well as performer,
writer, or speaker. You enjoy big crowds! This gift of connection also makes
you a wonderful salesperson—you can sell ice to Eskimos as long as you
passionately believe it to be of value. This persuasion power and your
natural charm aligns you magically with anyone who experiences your
words, music, art, or message.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The 5 vibration is very alert and bright—not much escapes your notice.
You have an innate connection to your surroundings that makes you
extremely fine-tuned, noticing everything in great detail.
Other keywords for a 5 person are change and freedom. You are very
adaptable and thrive when there is movement—stagnation and boredom are
your greatest fears. You are the intrepid adventurer and enjoy travel or
anything that opens your heart and mind to new things, ideas, and cultures.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Being fearless is something you naturally teach others just by the virtue of
who you are. Being so engaged in the moment makes you flexible and
versatile, which delights not only you but others who come into contact
with you. You win people over with your irresistible charm and wit, making
you popular in general and helping you personally to create momentum to
bring your divine gifts to a greater audience.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Thus freedom of movement is integral to your life. You may change
where you live, travel, or wander all over the world looking for inspiration
and excitement. You also can change your mind, sometimes abruptly from
one moment to the next. Oscillation is the nature of the 5, also due to your
restless, adventurous nature. You need to feel your imagination engaged.
Stimulation of all your senses is an important factor in your well-being.
This excitement factor shows your ability to dazzle with your brilliance.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Applause and accolades are natural by-products for you when you live at
your highest vibrational frequency. Your personality is vivacious. Due to
your alignment to subtle energetics, you have a great sensitivity for
beautiful things—both artistic and intellectual. Just be aware that you tend
to keep from emotionally engaging with ideas or people, and this can lead
to an indifference about relationships.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 5 person you are an agent of change for others. Your enthusiasm
and daring exhibit a wonderful zest for life. It’s as if you never grew up and
have the radiant mind of a child in your heart throughout your life. Your
willingness to experience all that the world has to offer and every facet of
our human experience is both inspiring and motivational. Due to your
natural versatility and openness, setbacks don’t affect you for long—you
are able to rebound quickly and move on living so beautifully in the present
moment.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
5 encompasses the whole human experience, all five senses, and all
contradictions as well. Wherever you are, something is “happening,”
something is moving. You love life, adventure, and liberty. You thrive to
experience, vibrate, and live to your fullest capacity. The pivot point aspect
