of your number also indicates that you may fluctuate from feeling totally
exalted to profoundly down for seemingly no reason—except that others
just don’t understand how intensely you experience life and that you thus
need time to adjust. Your approach is one of total immersion—taking in the
obvious and all the subtleties at once. Others around you may not be as
tuned into the subtle energies that you pick up, but it is this full-immersion
experience that delights and inspires you the most.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You may be very critical when you are not energetically aligned with the
positive expression of number 5, and this will lead to an urge to spot
mistakes and flaws and point them out (others, and your own). Try not to be
impatient when doing so, or refrain altogether.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You may be quick to use your mind instead of your heart to over-analyze
people and situations, using the intellect instead of your feelings to find
answers. Logic appeals to you however, you must be vulnerable and open
up the tenderness in your heart. Getting analytical at the expense of heart-
to-heart connections, especially in your intimate relationships, can lead to
endings and breakups. Yes, love runs deep, but under too much incessant
scrutiny, it has no breathing room to live and thrive. Using your instincts to
navigate love, instead of talking through it or intellectualizing the
experience (thereby not allowing the space to assimilate feelings), is
important if you are to maintain deep, loving relationships.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You can be high-strung, have a nervous disposition, and crave change for
the sake of change. Guard against impulsive actions—and reactions. Any

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
restlessness you have can be channeled into doing something new!
Addiction is another shadow side of this number, since you want to try
everything. If you go too far, then you forget to use discernment and to
choose only what is for your highest good. Since you crave change and are
so versatile, you may enter and exit relationships quickly, rather than
allowing them to evolve and grow.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you find yourself criticizing others while at the same time not being
responsible for your own life, you will vacillate through life blindly, not
seeing a need to course-correct, not recognizing the valuable feedback
coming your way, and not benefitting from the experiences that would
enable you to mature emotionally.
Your attention is captured by many things at once, and so you may not
stay true to your initial impulses. Patience and learning how to center your
brilliant, magnificent gifts are the key for you to maintain calm and peace
and your delightful enthusiasm for life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Affirmation: I sing a song of delight. I take pleasure in everything I
encounter. I surrender. I feel blessed!
As a 6 person you are deeply compassionate, loving, and responsible
toward your family and friends. You have a calming influence on others. 6
is aligned with beauty and is the middle number in the 3-6-9 Creation Triad
giving birth to the creative seeds and impulses received from the number 3.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you look at the image of the 6, it is shaped in the form of a woman who is
with child—pregnant with a large belly, about to give birth and take on the
responsibility of a parent. This is the key to the number 6—nurturing others,
being of loving service to others, being supportive and utterly devoted. You
naturally want to “mother” and share your advice. Inevitably people,
friends, even strangers, will come to you and tell you their deepest secrets,
share private and personal information with you that they wouldn’t with
others. You exude a warmth, compassion, and wisdom that holds the space
for love. It’s like you hold an invisible invitation for others to seek you out

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
as an advisor, healer, mentor. . . without you actually having put out any
conscious signals. Thus make sure you consciously create boundaries,
otherwise you will feel energetically depleted. Also, make sure you make
room in your life to nurture yourself—with massage, reflexology, energy
healing—to recharge your vibrational field. You love to give, and you must
learn to receive the bounty of love and luxuries life has to offer!
You love to give affection and hugs and are very generous with your
resources and time. Your natural poise and charisma make you highly
magnetic. . . when you walk into a room, people take note!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
6 governs human love and romance as well as money and abundance. In
your intimate relationships, once you commit to a partnership you are
devoted. This devotion extends to your loved ones and friends—who
genuinely love you. You can get sentimental (and may try to hide this) and
very idealistic. You are attuned to exhibiting good manners and are tasteful,
yet will not shy away from expressing yourself strongly when you feel
passionate about something.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Harmony and beauty are so important to your well-being, and to attract
abundance you must surround yourself with high aesthetics. Jarring noises,
conflict, arguments, discord, jealousy, and unresolved issues are best
eliminated or dealt with as quickly as possible in order for you to pursue the
rest of your day at peace.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Your natural artistic side needs to be expressed. You naturally enjoy
beautiful music, exquisite art, furniture, and clothing, so adorn and surround
yourself with beauty to feel good and whole. When at home, though, you
like to dress comfortably. As a 6 it is important for you to live in a sensually
pleasing environment. Anything that feels “ugly” needs to be removed—
you are so sensitive to vibration, sound, and visuals. You love having your
favorite colors and artwork in your home. Living in a place of serenity and
beauty pleases you to no end.
Money is attracted to you when you are positively aligned with your

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Birth Code. Sometimes it can appear without much effort through
inheritances, wealthy friends, or sponsors, but just as often it is through
your talents and abilities that magnetically attract abundance.
You are highly creative and must find an outlet at work or elsewhere to
express your innate artistic gifts. Use your voice whenever you can, the
sound of your voice carries healing vibrations. You can use it in your career

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
to speak, teach, counsel others, share information, or sing, in the healing
arts or in politics. Like the number 3, you have a smile that is irresistible!
You also are very attuned to justice, seeking to find the underlying fair
response to any situation. This means you want the law to be upheld and
understand the need the rules of law has to honor the basic needs and
sanctity for any person.
As a 6 you are good at finishing projects once you can get yourself
started.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
6 out of alignment can lead to a controlling and interfering nature, where
you meddle in other people’s business. This can be reflected in your family
relationships, partnerships or friendships. Then you’ll argue your point to
stay in power and cause a lot of disruption. This bossy side will replace
your natural nurturing instincts with a domineering attitude towards others.
You can be a perfectionist and this can lead to criticism of others, since
you will expect them to perform to your high standards. Sometimes you can
resort to self-righteous behavior. Another shadow side of the 6 expression is
total self-absorption.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When not aligned, money matters can range along a spectrum from
where you overspend and are too extravagant or extremely stingy.
Regarding overindulgence, you need to watch your sweet tooth!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Another challenging aspect of this 6 vibration is that you may want to
follow the path of least resistance (and keep a false sense of harmony). You
can be careless concerning your responsibilities, especially regarding the
obligation you have to yourself to fulfill your divine mission. This will
create a quality of being a “drifter,” someone who does not make
commitments to themselves and would rather “go with the flow,” drifting
from here to there to nowhere, since there was no conscious dedication to a
specific mission or project or goal. Your indecision, laziness, and feeling
like you are being inconvenienced by choosing to commit to something will
make you the root cause of your failed half-hearted attempts. It also creates
a spiraling tendency to magnify difficulties and obsess on problems, which
are quite often not even real.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
In order for you as a 6 to accomplish something meaningful and joyful,
something that has real impact on your life, you must be motivated
internally and externally to do anything—preferably through a goal or
deadline—so as to overcome your occasional passive nature. Then you will
shower the world with your loving radiance and brilliance!
Affirmation: I share my love freely and generously. I practice using
my gifts every day. I nurture myself. I care deeply about my divine
mission to uplift others through love and joy.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
7 is a number of the spiritual seeker, the sensitive, mindful philosopher, and,
brilliant analyzer. As a 7 you are driven to understand the mysteries of life,
to grasp the unknown. You are comfortable with secret subjects, the healing
modalities, and usually have vivid dreams. Even if you are not attracted to
spiritual subjects, as a 7 you love to learn, read books (you may have books
in every room of your home), and educate yourself—exhibiting a quest for
gathering knowledge and gaining understanding.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Ultimately 7 is the number of spiritual completion. Inner peace and calm
are brought about through bridging the higher world with the world below
—heaven and Earth—as the inner and outer realms are understood to be
one and the same.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The image of the number 7 has a horizontal line at the top, symbolizing the
world above, or heaven, with a diagonal line reaching below, signifying a
bridging to the lower world. 7 also looks like a lightning bolt and
symbolizes lightning insights, intuitive downloads that come out of the blue
and light up your mind. So 7 can bridge anything, making connections
between ideas and subjects that seemingly have no common ground, such
as good and evil, light and dark. As a symbol of lightning, 7s can
experience sudden profound shifts in their lives that take them by total
surprise. The effect of the lightning bolt also makes 7 a “change agent.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content: Often their presence alone can soothe and heal.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Notice, too, that the 7 “opens up” to the left—the past. Thus 7 has a good
memory, and enjoys looking back at history to gather wisdom and
understanding of the present. 7 “points” diagonally to the upper left, which
signifies its interest in developing new ways of being, future technological
or scientific breakthroughs, psychic premonitions of the future, and an
intuitive understanding of reaching into other dimensions. Thus a 7 person
often has unorthodox, unique beliefs and values.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Due to their quest for knowledge, 7 people need to travel extensively at
some point in their lifetime or read many books about other lands, other
cultures, and even beyond Earth, space, and time.
Financially it is important for 7s to have a nest egg. Otherwise they get
nervous about the future. This anxious tendency can interfere with their
ultimate mission to be a channel for new wisdom.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
7 symbolizes the original seven Wonders of the World, great mystery,
magic, and ceremony. Thus as a 7 person you have a tendency to look
deeply at everything. You are an observer of the mysteries of life, a seeker
of wisdom, and a natural researcher. You do best when you have extended
periods of time alone—sometimes even going through periods where you
are a hermit. In fact, it’s best for you to work alone. As Pythagoras said,
“Those who desire wisdom should look for it in solitude.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Your views and values can at times be mysterious to others, as your
quest for wisdom possibly changed the beliefs of your early life and helped
you connect your divine nature.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
7 is the final number in the 1-5-7 Mind Triad. Thus it carries tremendous
intelligence. You can be taken aback at times by the lack of understanding
and intellectual capacities in others. For you the questions of “Why?” are
truly integral to your thirst for knowledge. You like to approach life from a
logical perspective, yet eventually must merge intuition with logic to get to
the deeper mysteries you yearn to solve. Specializing in any field suits you
well, as you can then put all your eggs in one basket and delve into the
infinite depths, exploring knowledge and wisdom indefinitely. If you ever
feel the well has dried up or been explored completely, it is important for
you to find another source of life to satisfy your natural curiosity and to
expand your knowledge and inner capacity to cradle great wisdom. You’re
naturally not a fan of anything frivolous or superficial.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You do not like to be under anyone’s watchful eye! That includes an
abhorrence of “Big Brother.” Any person or entity that invades your

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
privacy, which you guard like a lioness guards her cubs, is not welcome.
You keep your private life secret and at the same time have “eyes in back of
your head,” taking in everything around you. When you enter a space you
feel what’s going on, even though you’d never let on about it. . . this is what
makes 7 a number of holding secrets. It is no coincidence the most famous
fictional spy, James Bond, is “007”!
If a 7 person goes into the creative arts, their ability to both learn and
intuitively channel makes them quite a magnetic and unique performer,
writer or artist in any field.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
In your intimate relationships you need privacy and a “cave” to escape to
for solitude. You can be very loving and devoted, as long as you don’t
expect your partner to live up to your long list of ideals. Since you can
intuitively sense the true from the untrue, you can jump ahead and not
create the space for your partner to discover the wisdom and truth in their
own way and on their own time. Others need to earn their trust with you,
but once they have it you embrace them with complete non-judgment and
openness—and in turn expect the same from them!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You thrive when you are in nature—especially near the ocean. Take
many getaways—7 rules rest, rejuvenation, meditation, and sabbaticals.
Refresh your heart, mind, and soul with long stays in places that feel like
spiritual sanctuaries.
The bridge that 7 symbolizes will be a metaphor for growth all your life.
Bring the sacredness of bridging light and dark, seen and unseen, into your
daily life. Make your life a ceremony, a devoted song to Spirit, Source, or

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
God. You understand the reason for darkness, and you, as the lightning bolt
of truth, radiate brilliance. You are a beacon of light in the world. Shining
your light in darkness in whatever way, shape, or form that takes, is your
divine gift. Opening up the sacred halls of wisdom within you will give you
direct access to the truth—as revealed in the records of time and
timelessness.
Always remember, your divine mission can benefit a big community of
like-minded souls—and then reach out to inspire the world.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Due to your wisdom and natural quest for knowledge, you can get impatient
with those who in your mind cannot “catch on” fast enough. Also, since you
can easily spot when something is wrong, your perfectionism may turn you

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
into a critic with a need for perfect results—rather than being open to what
is for the highest good of the situation. Guard against being cynical about
life, either because others have disappointed you, or due to unresolved
emotions arising from previous life experiences.
You have a strong personality, so it’s important for you to balance your
strong energy with time for playfulness. Otherwise you will focus on the
powerful, accomplishment qualities of the 7 at the expense of joy and love.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You can be very secretive, not revealing much about your true
motivations. It’s natural for you to keep your own issues private, yet not at
the expense of being distrustful or not trusting of others. In intimate
relationships it is important for you to be vulnerable emotionally, not just
intellectually (sometimes you mistake the intellectual openness for
emotional vulnerability).

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When out of alignment you get pessimistic and frustrated. Know, this is
when you try to direct your aha moments in an obsessive way, rather than
being a channel for light and love, without conditions on how or in what
area that wisdom is to stream through you. A change of place or time in
nature will usually help you reconnect very quickly!
Affirmation: I am truth embodied. My soul is my true home. I live
to share the light of wisdom.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
8 is the vibration of leadership and strength, abundance, financial security,
and power. 8 people have a vision that must be made practical. Thus 8
governs entrepreneurship and the executive. 8s are responsible and patient
by nature, allowing them to take an idea from its inception to a successful
outcome. It is natural for an 8 person to at some point in their life to
experience obstacles and ups and downs—however, these are designed to
be overcome in order to gain confidence and strength. As an 8 person you
use any challenges as stepping-stones to success.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are shy and reserved by nature. It is not immediately obvious that
you have the fortitude to push forward, but you persist every step of the
way, and eventually reach your goal. Nothing and no-one will stop you
from achieving your mission. Your quiet nature is a protection of your
intensely driven nature to reach the pinnacle of your profession. Your

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
strength, fortitude, and internal power to succeed are exhibited in the visual
image of the number 8.
8 is the final of three numbers in the 2-4-8 Manifestation Triad.
8 looks like a vertical infinity symbol—and it does represent eternal life.
This is the only number besides 0 which you can draw repeatedly without
lifting your pen. 8 is also visual representation of two windows, with the
window above giving a vision of the spiritual and the one below relating to
the material. Thus 8 represents making visions (messages from spirit) real,
bringing them to Earth, and materializing them into goods that can be
exchanged for money.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content: 8 represents the energy exchange of money.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
8 is aligned with business, in that this vibration takes a vision (spirit),
creates a product or service (matter), puts it out into the world (enterprise),
and in return receives payment for that product or service. This is one of the
core spiritual and human energy exchanges to life. Whereas the number 4
symbolizes the manifestation of creative ideas, 8 takes it one step further by
adding the financial energy exchange. Both the spiritual and material realms
represented by the number 8 are necessary to experience fulfillment and
abundance. In some way or another an 8 person will be focused on money
manifestation—whether they have it or not. Usually they will have
experiences of both. Either way, it is only once their soul is completely free
to manifest those messages from spirit that 8 people realize their dreams of
lasting abundance and fulfillment. Often, they end up as an example or
teacher of spiritual, manifestation, and/or financial laws.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
An 8 person is meant to lead in some capacity. They need not be a
success in the financial or business world, as long as they have access to an
environment where they can inspire others to greater heights with their
vision. The infinity symbol also implies that 8 people are like a battery that
keeps going and going, never giving up.
At the same time, you as an 8 are very realistic and have great
organizational skills. Your innate patience and intelligence allow you to
excel at anything. You are born with a desire to take on responsibilities, so it
is rare to find an 8 who is careless, since they pride themselves on living up

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
to the highest expectations. Their reliability is legendary, and so is their
warmth.
8s like to keep a certain image of themselves that is strong as befits the
leaders they are. However they do care about what others feel about them,
especially when it comes to their accomplishments, and do (privately) enjoy
compliments.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The symbol of infinity is also reflected in the balance of justice and
honor that 8 people represent. They have a very advanced sense of what is
ethical and true, representing honor, impartiality, and dignity in everything
they say and do. Thus they also like to mix with dignitaries, seeking the
company of important, influential people—a group that they naturally know
they “belong” to.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
It is important for you as an 8 person to share your resources with others
in a philanthropic way. When positively aligned, 8s can materialize
anything—they are magical at turning their visions into reality. Their
penchant for persistence and courage as well as their cooperative nature,
allows 8s to accomplish anything they set their mind to when it comes to
working with others. 8 people are ambitious, enjoy challenges, and strive to
be the best they can be. They have both originality and inspiration, so as
long as they create something that fulfills them at soul-level, combining
their multiple talents in a practical way, they will be successful. They can
act as instruments of positive shifts in other people’s lives.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As friends they are loyal, dedicated, and so sweet with those whom they
trust and care for deeply. However, due to their need to appear strong with
no need in the world, 8s can feel lonely, with a great need to be loved and
cherished. If a dear friend or family member needs them for any purpose,
the 8 person will make sacrifices for them—no questions asked. They will
do the same for an ideal.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You as an 8 person are only attracted to quality and will not be seen
shopping for secondhand clothes. You value the best and will wait to secure
the highest quality in favor of a cheaper version. This is because you are
aligned with the vibration of longevity.
As an 8 your dreams are never small! Everything you do has to exhibit
your highest expectations of what is “the best.” 8s have the inner courage,
the natural leadership, and the vision to achieve greatness in any field. Their
enjoyment of challenges and creating the best possible outcome for the

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
highest good of all makes them unstoppable and wonderful contributors and
influencers.
An 8 out of alignment is egotistical, materialistic, and forceful—or
succumbs to passive and powerless behavior. Their longing for success can
outweigh their desire for happiness. Thus 8s must pay attention to their
heart. . . if there is a feeling of loneliness, if there is a sense of longing for
something that is missing, an 8 must not be afraid to pursue happiness with
the same wisdom, maturity, and discipline that they devote to their divine
mission.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
8s are demanding of themselves and transfer that quest for excellence
and success onto others, which is not necessarily a negative unless it is
expected and those who do not measure up are judged. You may take your
ambitious drive too far if you are out of alignment energetically. You will
work without reservation for many hours to achieve your goal but can
forget to stop and smell the roses, not allowing yourself to enjoy anything
else on the journey you are taking. This means you may not be able to fully
enjoy the actual goal once you attain it. . . you have put so much focus on
the getting the result that when it happens, you refocus on the next goal
without taking some time to appreciate the beauty you’ve created.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Eventually this lack of appreciation along the way can lead to frustration
and dissatisfaction.
Your are dedication to being actively engaged in the pursuit of your
vision is commendable as long as you pay attention when you feel restless,
or that there is something “missing” along the way. If not, you might
eventually react with tremendous anger when provoked or exhibit a
suctioning of strength in your physical body that translates into health
conditions or a need for rest.
Guard against being egotistical and vindictive, obstinate, intolerant, and
stubborn.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Affirmation: I give everything to inspire others to be the best they
can be. My deeds are my expressions of wealth and well-being. I
am enriched by helping to enrich others.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content: 9 is the number of transformation—something needs to end to begin again.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Thus 9 can regenerate itself over and over again and exhibits a great
determination. This number symbolizes evolution and an enhancement of
psychic abilities and clairvoyance. You’ll see shortly how the regeneration
quality of the number 9 is confirmed in mathematics and the whole human
experience on Earth—9 is the King of Numbers and will reign forever. A 9
person is warm, outgoing, and loving with a dramatic flair, exuding a
magnetic personality that allows him or her to get along with pretty much
anyone. 9s are compassionate, romantic, filled with unconditional love,
kind, empathetic, patient, tolerant, and wise. You as a 9 are an inspirational
and compassionate humanitarian with great idealism and strong willpower.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content: Your imagination knows no bounds! And you absolutely love to give.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 9 you have a powerful personality, and you can use it to fulfill your
greatest desire—to be useful to others by manifesting inspirational
accomplishments and/or beneficial products or results. You represent
leadership by example—others will look to you as an example to be
followed, whether you are aware of it or not. Your charisma exudes loving
confidence, so you need to accept the example you set and allow the quality
of life you lead to speak for itself, since it will be emulated by others. You
live your talk. You want your high ideals to inspire others so they too
experience their highest potential.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Your sweet-natured soul does not like seeing anyone in pain. When you
see someone who is suffering, you reach out to them since you truly care
about how others feel. And if you have healing balm or stress-alleviation
tool, you will share it. You are a natural at teaching, healing, and giving
counsel through the highest values of love and beauty. Your ultimate goal is
to raise the vibrational awareness of humanity.
You are naturally very direct and expect the same from others—what
you say is exactly how you feel. So you don’t tend to play games to get
what you want; you just ask for what you want!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
9 has a circle at the top, representing a big head filled with wisdom (or ego)
learned from the numbers 1 through 8 that preceded it. The “head” is
connected to Earth by a line on the right side, representing the artistic,

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
creative side of the human experience. The wisdom and leadership of 9
make it very evolved. You are here to help people, often through major
transitions, since 9 also represents endings. In order to have the capacity to
love deeply, without judgment or expectation, you yourself experienced
hardship and tests. Those who are born to help others experience the pain
and loss themselves in order to forgive and have compassion at the deepest
level of the human experience.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Another result of your emotional connection is that you understand
people from all walks of life. You respect all their various qualities and
missions. You also love giving back—having a charitable and philanthropic
nature. Your sensitive, artistic nature blends with your quest for perfection.
As a leader you demand only the best from yourself.
9 is the final number in the 3-6-9 Creation Triad and thus represents a
culmination and celebration of a mission accomplished. Your main lesson is
to elevate what is seemingly everyday and ordinary into something that is
extraordinary and meaningful.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are naturally honest and direct—getting straight to the point and
penetrating directly to the heart of the matter. When others are not direct
with you, it takes you by surprise. Other people’s dishonesty, manipulation,
or indirectness can catch you off-guard, so you need to learn to be more
cautious with others, but not when you are teaching. Another quality to
guard against is your impatience with those who think more slowly than
you do or others who don’t recognize the thought patterns and actions that
lead up to a mistake. You like to be in control on some level, so this can be
a challenging area for you.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
No detail escapes your keen observation—as you have a clear, sharp
mind that penetrates quickly to the root of the matter while grasping the
overall picture. So you are conscious of all energy, subtle and visible,
happening around you.
In relationships you may strive to be in control. With your independent
streak, you may keep your distance, which results in a lack of true intimacy.
You can be an enigma in this way, due to your warm, generous nature and
your lack of commitment to a serious relationship. This is also connected

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
9’s symbol of endings, so you somehow know that everything will come to
an end, and this may keep you from fully engaging with another heart-to-
heart.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You approach life with total passion and a profound intensity. Your
vibrant and noble nature, enthusiasm, and generosity are noted by everyone
who is blessed to be in your presence.
When you are energetically out of alignment you hold onto resentments or
memories, not letting them go. You become resentful of life and can shut
down emotionally. Guard against being arrogant, tyrannical, or dishonest.
An abdication of leadership can result in you closing your mind to wisdom
and drifting through life aimlessly—dissipating your gifts. Frustration is a
sign that you must reconnect with your heart-center and surrender to love.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Guard against focusing on limitations. This will push you to want to
control others, since you are not healing your own sense of lack within first.
Rather than feeling the need to control, shift your focus onto creating
beauty, love, and excellence. Your role is to exude the joy of living a life to
its highest potential. When you focus on what is for your highest good, your
emotional touchiness will naturally disappear.
When out of alignment you can be stubborn, reacting with aggressive
action and creating conflict as a result. Though your temper can rise to a
boil quickly, you can just as quickly move on, ready to forgive and forget.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Your natural inclination to be direct can turn into a frankness that is too
confrontational or aggressive. Speaking your mind without caring about
how this might affect the other person(s) results in consequences that are
not healing or beneficial. Refrain from reacting instantaneously, especially
when the result is biting in nature.
Deep down you can have a fear of rejection and then will feel a lack of
confidence. Then, reassurance that you are appreciated, understood,
respected, and loved is something you need and crave.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Affirmation: I serve others with love and wisdom. I stay true to my
heart, leading always with love and for the highest good of all.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
OW WE WILL ENTER THE MYSTERIOUS REALM OF DOUBLE-DIGIT NUMBERS
11, 22, 33, 44, 55, 66, 77, 88, AND 99, ALSO REFERRED TO AS “MASTER
NUMBERS.” A Master Numbers is an intensification of a single-digit number,
so the core meaning of the single-digit before it is doubled, is incorporated
in a new experience, which takes on messages of the single and double digit
and blends them into a new vision.
Master Numbers by nature carry a greater responsibility than single-digit
vibrations. In order to elevate yourself to the higher calling of a Master
Number you must listen intently to your inner calling, which always will
reveal your soul’s chosen path.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If your Day of Birth is 11 or 29 or your Life Purpose or Destiny reduces to
11 (such as 38, 47, 56, etc. and 119, 128, 137, etc.), then Master Number 11
is one of your Three Important Birth Numbers.
Please read the meaning for number 2 (in chapter 3), the “root number”
for 11, as well.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When 1 becomes 11, the original creative mind and leadership of
number 1 are incorporated into 11 as the Psychic Master, blending 1 into an
experience of double new beginnings and enlightened leadership. 11 is
supreme balance. Balance between light and dark, masculine and feminine,
the seen and unseen, the known and unknown. Thus you as an 11 symbolize
both the seen and unseen, which need to be brought into equilibrium.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
However, there is an illusion heaven and earth, visible and invisible, are
separate, and you must bypass this illusion of division by uniting seemingly
separate energies and goals. When you do so, you will stop feeling a sense
of incompletion and division running through your life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a “Master Number” you are being asked to master something at a
high level. For the 11 you are mastering listening to your inner voice—the
only true voice connected to your divinity, your soul. Anytime you feel a
sense of separation or division, tune in. This division could appear from a
person or an interfering idea or ignorance. If you refuse to see both sides,
listen and understand, you will prevent a rebalancing of energy from
occurring. In all cases of conflict or separation your role is to find out the
source of opposing energy. Then the magical shift happens when you
understand the Law of Opposites. That in order to experience light you
must also know darkness. Then, exquisite harmony and peace infuse your
heart as you listen intently—surrendering to the light of wisdom within you.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Any nervousness, which comes as a result of 11 ruling light and
electrical currents, can be healed through establishing routine and order in
your life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The ancient temples of mystery had a pillar on each side of the entrance,
looking very much like the figure 11. These pillars are a doorway and
symbolize an initiation. Your overall divine mission is to delve into the
mysteries and miracles of life—to walk through the two pillars and unite
active and passive, emptiness and fullness, receptivity and action. All
becomes one within you. When you enter the Temple of Awareness, you
have made a choice to live fully, with total acceptance of every situation
that appears before you as being by your design, your beckoning—and
always for your highest good. No matter how it appears!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
“In order to elevate yourself to the higher calling of a Master
Number you must listen intently to your inner calling which

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
always will reveal your soul’s chosen path.”
Anything can be channeled through this opening—a new invention, an
intuitive download, a piece of music or art, a book. Channeling a gift is the
highest expression of this number. The gift is always bringing forth brand-
new information and inspiration—the initial experience of the unknown,
thus making the unknown visible.
It is no surprise then that 11 symbolizes light (the word “light” adds up
to 29/11 using the Pythagorean system).

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As an 11 you illuminate the truth. You have a choice to illuminate
negative or positive energy, but you will channel energy and bring it to
light. To prepare to channel what is for your highest good, it is initially
important for you to discover your “inner teacher.” Reconnecting to your
inner voice is another way of describing your conscious engagement with
your spiritual guides. You also receive great inspiration through symbols,
music, art, and sacred geometry. Aligning to your soul opens up a universe
of wisdom that you can access at will, instantaneously, and then share with
others. It is by walking between light and dark, keeping the balance,
standing secure on both feet, like the 11, that allows you to open up your
creative vessel and let the divine pour through the 11.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You must always choose which endeavors in your life bring unity and
which cause separation. You will need to get off the fence and make a
choice. That choice will enable you to enter the 11 gateway, take that risk,
and live fully in the present moment. This is when you feel whole. Once the
way to unity is recognized, honored, and practiced continuously, you leave
the struggle and division behind. You feel at peace. It is in the act of
surrender that you fulfill your role to be a Master of Light and Love.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you don’t step through the gateway, explore your inner world—both
the light and the darkness—you will project your fantasies and neuroses on
others instead and eventually sabotage your goals. Life is filled with
paradoxes, so there is no reason to doubt the importance of every
experience as being valid. If you exclude exploring all sides of an issue you
leave out part of the human experience. Your role is to be unconditional in
your tolerance of those people and experiences that seem different. Then
your 11 gateway is totally about freedom and unconditional love.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
In exploring the dark and the light, the seen and the unseen, nothing
escapes you, and you walk the world an avatar of love. Instead of fighting

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
injustice, you heal. Instead of resisting oppression and pain, you understand
that all that happens to you has been called in by your soul. Nothing
happens to us that is not ultimately for our highest good.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As an 11 you understand there is a veil of illusion—maya—that appears
once we are born on Earth, protecting us from knowing everything we’ve
experienced and will experience. Otherwise we would be overwhelmed and
not able to function. That veil is lifted for a bit every time we enter the 11
portal. In the entering of the gateway, light beams through our third eye and
reveals our true divine origin. We become “seers” enlightened by entering
the light. This is the moment-to-moment enlightenment, the union with love
we so yearn for. So, the more you as an 11 trust and surrender to your
intuition, the higher you raise your vibration. 11 is the Master teacher.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Anyone who crosses your path will be enchanted by your undeniable
charisma. You just change people by the sheer influence of your powerful
aura. For you personally this spiritual essence appears as unexpected
windfalls, seemingly coincidental, that appear in synchronicity with your
goals—guiding you to the light so that you can play the leading role you are
meant to. Surprises and unexpected events are part of your life. Allow
yourself to be guided by this invisible force—as you too wield an invisible,
magical influence on others.
If you are born on the 22nd day of any month or have a 22 Life Purpose

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Number and/or 22 Destiny Number, you have the qualities of not only root
number 4, but the Master Number 22.
Please read the meaning for number 4 (in chapter 3), the “root number”
for 22, as well.
You are the Master Architect of Peace. You manifest achievement and
build your dreams into reality. You work hard and embody the power of the
Buddha Principle. I refer to 22 as the “Buddha” Number.
Master Number 22 intensifies the single-digit 4, representing work,
discipline, and honesty, which arrives in 22 through peace, intuition, and
cooperation. Thus your work encompasses spiritual self-study, spiritual self-
discipline, and spiritual honesty.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
“11 is supreme balance. Balance between light and dark,
masculine and feminine, the seen and unseen, the known and
unknown.”
As a 22, you are …
* Able to download higher divine wisdom into physical reality
* Designed to build a project/business/idea from the ground up with
lasting results
* A master at invoking peace and calm in daily life

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
In order to create peaceful solutions and manifest results with lasting
impact you need to be highly disciplined. At times you might feel like you
are inferior or don’t have all the internal tools necessary. This false belief
will propel you to rely too much on outside sources or people’s opinions for
approval. Understand that you are here as a Master Number 22 to rely on
your own abilities—which requires tremendous inner strength. In order to
be a master of manifestation you need patience and strong vigilance to stay
“on track.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The root number 4 that 22 reduces to gives you the gifts of planning,
dedication, and order so that you don’t veer off into areas that are irrelevant
or even detrimental to your well-being. Without consistent monitoring of
your actions, though, done with full integrity and honesty, you may get
blinded by negative actions of people around you that will lead to delusion
and frustration. You will experience illusion instead of inner illumination.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Master Numbers ask more of you—they also give you the tools to
accomplish more! So use your ability to discern truth from illusion. Slay the
dragons of fear and nebulous energy and replace them with the magnificent
light of truth.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Recognize your spiritual mastery—reflected in how you take
responsibility, in spiritual acceptance of how life shows up for you. Practice
this spiritual responsibility in your daily life, in your relationships, and to
accomplish your goals. Remember that the roles other people play in your
life are for multitude reasons—including showing you what not to do! This
is just as valid a lesson as the person who inspires you as a positive role
model. Accepting all experiences and relationships as valid and useful in
some way is the key to helping you to the inertia to inner change you can
encounter. Some situations or individuals are so challenging that you will

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
make major shifts that result in life-changing readjustments and end up
wielding a positive impact on you. Others will refine your sensitivity,
propelling you to step into a new role in uplifting society.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Thus if you refrain from inner growth by avoiding pain, you can miss out
on developing an incredibly profound understanding of peace—of what
creates peace and what keeps us from feeling at peace. The basics
surrounding the question and answer to what constitutes a life of peace are
there for you to unlock in your soul. You know that there is a necessary
process that we as human beings need to experience to create that inner
transformation from ego self to spiritual being, and that this awakening
comes as a result of self-awareness and self-acceptance. You understand
that when we become adults we must move into self-realization, not rely on
others to replace our parents, previous guidance. In the same way it is
important for you not to be caught up in fads, the latest trends, and keeping
up with your friends or neighbors in an attempt for outside approval.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Conformity is the shadow side of 22/4. Being independent and free to create
your own order based on your own truth and accepting the consequences of
your actions as feedback from the universe (not judgment) is vital to your
peace and well-being.
When you as a 22 are out of alignment you can succumb to indifference,
being aimless, reckless, apathetic, self-important, frustrated. You may resent
a lack of recognition, be envious of other’s successes, and exaggerate.
22/4 encompasses two of three numbers in the 2-4-8 Manifestation

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Triad, and thus it carries great energy—accomplishments made real. Any
area you pursue will allow you to achieve a position of distinction because
you are not afraid of challenges and see them as necessary, even welcome,
stepping-stones to success. Master Numbers carry majesty and greatness,
and your expression of that power comes through your capacity to manifest
by planning great projects which you direct into existence (rather than
manage the intricacies—you must leave the trivial matters to others). As the
“Architect of Peace” Master Number you always want to be at peace with
your work and values so you can also enjoy the benefits of the power
bestowed on you. Guard against using your ambition to manifest only for
personal profit without caring how you arrive at your goals.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you have a 33 Life Purpose Number and/or 33 Destiny Number, you have
the qualities of not only root number 6 but the Master Number 33. (There is
no 33 Day of Birth.)
Please read the meaning for number 6 (in Chapter 3), the “root
number” for 33, as well.
You embody the Selfless Giver and the Cosmic Guardian. Others look to
you as an example. You have to discern between martyrdom and
compassionate service.
As a 33, you are …
* Highly sensitive and could be a powerful empath
* Designed to be a teacher of compassion
* Concerned for the welfare of the masses

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When expressed at its highest vibrational alignment Master Number 33
symbolizes a person who embodies unconditional love. 33 carries all the
qualities of its root number, 6 (see chapter 3), yet is even more sensitive—
feeling people’s emotions as deeply as their own. This is the kind of love
that says to anyone who crosses your path, “I accept you and love you no
matter what you do or don’t do. I will always continue to love you
regardless.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
This unconditional love is extended to you as well. When the time comes
and you are at the point of transitioning to another dimension, you will only
remember whether you have been of service and loved to the fullest extent
possible. Nothing else will matter more than having led a life of meaning
and a life of love. Service and compassion create our most profound
experiences of love and joy. And 33/6 encompasses the gamut of this
underlying yearning for human beings to serve and love one another.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
In order to tune into the depths of heart-centered connection required for
this level of compassion there are times when you may experience great
doubt or distress, delusion, and disappointment in your life. There are many
responsibilities a 33/6 Master Number person takes on to understand how to
consistently activate the deep empathy of this powerful vibration. It is said
that Jesus died on the cross at age 33, accepting all the whole human
experience as his own, welcoming it all with great humility, in service to
humanity’s awakening to love. This is the ultimate expression of the 33, a
love that gives birth to the highest ideals through the death of the ego.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Note that our spinal column has 33 verterbrae, which act as the backbone
of our human body. Thus 33 takes on both the physical and emotional
expression of our human experience and embodies the chakras.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You may struggle with issues of intimacy and loyalty. Putting yourself in
a loved ones, shoes is integral to your emotional growth. This means
looking in the mirror and reflecting on how your words impact others, how
your actions impress everyone affected. You also can have a tendency for
being a perfectionist—expectations of perfection are contrary to forgiveness
—and you must learn to forgive others for not measuring up, beginning first
with forgiving yourself for being imperfect (a perfectly natural state to be!).
“As a 44 you have great magnetism, leadership abilities, powers of
persistence and self-control. These qualities allow you to reach
the highest echelons of power and wealth giving you a great
capacity to serve the world.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are here to uplift others through unconditional loving service and
joy, embodying the empath, unpretentious and concerned only with the
welfare of all—a teacher of balance and harmony who leads others by
example.
When you as a 33 are out of alignment you can succumb to criticism of
your self and others, pretentiousness, perfectionism, irresponsibility, setting
no clear boundaries, resisting reflection, worry, insensitivity, anxiousness,
rigidity in your beliefs, abuse of power, and using money to control.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
33/6 comprises two of three numbers in the 3-6-9 Creation Triad. You
are extraordinarily intuitive and can use your gifts in artistic and creative
endeavors. With your supreme appreciation of beauty, your sense of
aesthetics are exceptional, and you can master music, artistic line, color,
creative movement, and/or form to the highest degree.
If you have a 44 Life Purpose Number and/or 44 Destiny Number, you have
the qualities of not only root number 8, but the Master Number 44. (There
is no 44 Day of Birth.)
Please read the meaning for number 8 (in Chapter 3), the “root
number” for 44, as well.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You embody the Practical Visionary and Ingenious Director, here to
empower others by restoring order and dedication in their life.
As a 44, you are …
* A builder and manifestor of group consciousness
* Designed to create new modalities of greater income and abundance
* Trusting of the order of the universe

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are very resourceful and able to manifest valuable ideas in service to
others. Your creations are designed to help others rebuild their lives. Your
mental abilities are great, as is your strength of conviction. 44 exudes a
powerful personality, which matches their expansive goals. As a 44 you
have great magnetism, leadership abilities, and powers of persistence and
self-control. These qualities allow you to reach the highest echelons of
power and wealth giving you a great capacity to serve the world.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are innately practical and strong. Your big ideas germinate from an
expansive imagination, which is able to conceive of intricate and grand
visions. This ingeniousness allows you to manage and bring together many
different aspects of power and personalities—thereby finding seemingly
magical solutions to problems others can’t solve. You do this by including
them in the process, allowing their ideas to blend with the ultimate solution,
thereby acting as leader, manager, and magician all at once and bringing
complex projects to a harmonious conclusion. This natural genius for
directing also stems from your innate ability to analyze and reason while
applying compassion and leadership with total confidence and control.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
There is a serenity and integrity in you that instantly allows others to feel
secure and grounded. You are just, efficient, strong, and ethical—having
both tact and an incisive intellect that wields enormous power, as all your
energy is poured into making your ideals and ideas real.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You do not shy away from work and are tirelessly engaged with your
responsibilities and projects, reflecting the self-discipline and tenaciousness
required for any great leader or organizer. Like all the Master Number
vibrations 44 also requires high ideals and complete integrity in order to be
of service. Your great desire is to improve people’s lives, their quality of
life, and you use your influence, power, and fortune to manifest all levels of
improvements and elevation in your community.
When you as a Master Number 44 are out of alignment you become
inconsiderate, overworked, and overstressed. You use money to control

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
others, expect others to manifest your good ideas, have no personal
discipline, are critical behind the scenes and envious of others’ success,
resist responsibility, and are dominated by your own ambitions.
As a 44 you use discipline, humility, perseverance, and total dedication
to stay on your soul’s chosen path. Often your satisfaction for having
completed a goal brings the greatest fulfillment—you know that you have
prepared for this moment, this life, and the satisfaction of completion is
superior to any other reward you may receive.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you have a 55 Destiny Number, you have the qualities of not only root
number 1, but the Master Number 55. (There is no 55 Day of Birth or Life
Please read the meaning for numbers 1 (in chapter 3) and 10 (chapter 5)
as well.
When your Destiny Number is 55 your life is reflected by great,
fundamental changes. You are a Freedom Seeker and embody Double
Intelligence, indicated by your openness and willingness to be adaptable
under all conditions.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 55, you are …
* Adaptable to change
* Designed to consistently free your mind of rigid, outdated thought
patterns
* Able to pivot easily in order generate an internal shift in yourself and
help others do the same
It is of vital importance that you don’t mistake minor, even superficial
changes for true, fundamental shifts. You vibrate to adventure—initiating
risk as an instrument of creation. Thus you are a creative force on every
level. You always need to propel your energy into new directions—with the
ultimate goal of bringing about fundamental change.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
See number 10 (chapter 5) and numbers 1 and 5 (chapter 3) for more
layers on the shadow-side expression of Master Number 55.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you have 66 Destiny Number, you have the qualities of not only root
number 3, but the Master Number 66. (There is no 66 Day of Birth or Life
Please read the meaning for numbers 3 (in chapter 3) and 12 (chapter
When your Destiny Number is 66 your life is imbued with Double

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Creative Power and a Voice that needs to heard while being of service to
others. This can be in any realms of self-expression, from the arts and music
to writing or speaking. Your double 6 makes you a cosmic parent to all and
allows your heart and soul to approach every action, word, and thought with
utmost empathy and compassion. You empower others with your loving and
supportive words and beautiful message.
As a 66 you are …
* Able to easily step into your responsibilities
* Designed to nurture, since you embody mastery of the Mother/Father
Principle–the Life Principle of merging masculine and feminine into

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Divine Parent
* Able to help transform other people’s emotional state through joy and
gratitude
As a natural intuitive you need to surrender to the subconscious realms.
This allows you to come home to love over and over again. When you are
out of alignment you will become oblivious of the spiritual realms and
ignore your intuition and responsibilities—even embracing victimization
instead of spiritual victory. Be aware that the strength of any Master
Number will be reflected in both the negative and positive expression of its
meaning.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
See numbers 12 (chapter 5) and numbers 3 and 6 (chapter 3) for more
layers on the shadow-side expression of Master Number 66.
If you have a 77 Destiny Number, you have the qualities of not only root
number 5, but the Master Number 77. (There is no 77 Day of Birth or Life
Please read the meaning for numbers 5 (in chapter 3) and 14 (chapter 5)
as well.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When your Destiny Number resonates to Master Number 77 your life is
filled with double Spiritual Insight and Psychic abilities. This is a vibration
of transcendence, and those whose full birth-certificate names resonate to it
will transcend all obstacles through surrender to the light. You are here to
uplift and inspire many! You channel change in quite mystical ways …
often unbeknownst to you, as the energy aligned with 77 is the double
lightning strike from heaven to Earth—a striking shift that bubbles up in
your conscious awareness quite miraculously. You have the gift of tuning in
to your spiritual guides and the angelic realm without even being aware of
your exquisite connection. 77 represents double intelligence and
inventiveness, allowing you to reach great heights of spiritual wisdom.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 77, you are …
* Able to penetrate straight into the core of any matter
* Designed to release others from mental and spiritual pain
* Able to share your intelligence with those who are afraid to take risks,
so their courage bubbles up inside of them and they are energetically
brought back into balance
Your ability to focus is acute, and your understanding of the
psychological state of human nature great. You are able to “sell” and inspire
from the stage, are media savvy, and embody fearless expression and joy.
You also have a strong interest in mystical secrets.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
See number 14 (chapter 5) and numbers 5 and 7 (chapter 3) for more
layers on the shadow-side expression of Master Number 77.
If you have an 88 Destiny Number, you have the qualities of not only root
number 7, but the Master Number 88. (There is no 88 Day of Birth or Life
Please read the meaning for numbers 7 (in chapter 3) and 16 (chapter 5)
as well.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When your Destiny Number resonates to 88 your life is one of incredible
leadership and the ability to overcome seemingly insurmountable obstacles
and gain strength as a result. This is the Master Executive who leads with a
profound vision. You embody dignity and excellence to the nines, love
going beyond perceived limits, and thus symbolize the human version of
infinite possibilities—limitlessness.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 88, you are …
* Able to manifest anything
* Designed to determine the outcome of your future by using the intense
force of your creative imagination
* Able to successfully own every facet of your life to the nth degree by
directing natural spiritual laws
You are the Abundant One and feel like God’s Gift—this 88 Master
Number also signifies taking on major responsibilities as a trailblazer.
See number 16 (chapter 5) and numbers 7 and 8 (chapter 3) for more
layers on the shadow-side expression of Master Number 88.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you have a 99 Destiny Number, you have the qualities of not only root
number 9, but the Master Number 99. (There is no 99 Day of Birth or Life
Please read the meaning for numbers 9 (in chapter 3) and 18 (chapter
When your Destiny Number resonates to 99 your life embodies the
qualities of Fulfillment through Unconditional Love. All answers and
wisdom are contained within you. You are accomplished and have the
answer for pretty much anything (and know it!). Your abilities can create
fortunes.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 99, you are …
* Knowledgeable of everything and adept at answering most questions
* Designed to give—your life is dedicated to helping causes and
uplifting humanity
* A supreme leader who leads by example, exhibiting the highest
integrity and wisdom
You are very poetic, deeply romantic, and compassionate—and this
allows you to comfort others by your very presence. In your highest
expression, you are able to completely transcend the ego and merge with
unconditional love.
See numbers 18 (chapter 5) and 9 (chapter 3) for more layers on the
shadow-side expression of Master Number 99.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
OW WE WILL DISCOVER THE MEANINGS FOR DOUBLE-DIGIT NUMBERS 10
If you are born on the 10th or 28th day of any month or have a 10, 28, 37, or
46 Life Purpose Number or Destiny Number—or 55, 64, 73, 82, 91, 109
(etc.) Destiny Number—you internalize the qualities of number 10.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
10 is the vibration of “Instant Manifestation.” This means you can
manifest ideas, thoughts, goals, and emotions easily and often instantly. The
in 10 adds an element of divine protection. Your words also have a great
impact on others. The strong implementation gifts of this frequency carry a
big responsibility—since your thoughts and feelings will manifest whether
they are positive or negative. So be sure to see your life from a “glass half
full” perspective as often as possible. 10 is made up of 1 and 0—the straight
line and curve/circle—the building blocks of sacred geometry and the
universe, giving you direct access to cosmic wisdom. (Our computer code is
made up of 1s and 0s and indicates the expansive impact that the number 10
wields.) Dedicate your life to creating love and light in all ways, and you
will manifest magical outcomes.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 10 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You are fixed and inflexible, opinionated,
stubborn, or prone to exaggeration. You can also become tyrannical if your
spiritual awakening and quest for awareness are being neglected.
Be sure to read the section on number 1 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 10.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you are born on the 12th day of any month or have a 12, 38, or 48 Life
Purpose Number or Destiny Number—or 57, 66, 75, 84, 93, 129 (etc.)
Destiny Number—you internalize the qualities of number 12.
You have selected a life of service and being invested in education on
every level—from physical to spiritual. You are highly creative and must be
able to express yourself. You are naturally affectionate and loving and strive
to make the world a better place in which to live. You may need to give up
something in order to achieve the knowledge and wisdom you seek.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Remember, you carry a “knowingness” within you, so look within when
seeking a solution. When you focus on expanding your spiritual and
intuitive education you reap success and experience happiness.
The shadow side of number 12 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You feel like you are a victim (or are
victimizing others), sacrificing your life to the point where you’ve
compromised your mission or values to be in servitude to another person or
cause, or you’ve given up your sovereignty, are a doormat, or are feeling
bitter.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Be sure to read the section on number 3 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 12.
If you are born on the 13th day of any month or have a 13 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number—or 58, 67, 76, 85, 94, 139 (etc.) Destiny
Number—you internalize the qualities of number 13.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 13 you experience many changes that are meant to transform and
empower you throughout your life. 13 resonates to a genius quality, and you
definitely have an “out-of-the-box” approach to life. You can attract sudden
changes that are meant to keep you alert and aware. Birth, life, death, and
rebirth is a consistent theme weaving through all areas of your life. Thus
you’ll naturally experience many shifts as twists and turns suddenly appear
to replace the old and introduce new beliefs, people, and perspectives. You
are able to access the seen and unseen worlds, manifesting and building
innovative projects in both at the same time.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 13 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You focus too much energy on the
material at the expense of your spiritual nature. You may participate in

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
destructive actions or overpowering behavior towards others. Your
impatience and temper can flare up and suddenly destroy what you have so
easily built.
Be sure to read the section on number 4 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 13.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you are born on the 14th day of any month or have a 14 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number—or 59, 68, 77, 86, 95, 149 (etc.) Destiny

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Number—you internalize the qualities of number 14.
The ancients associated the number 14 with the scribe. 14 is what I refer
to as the “Media” number—imbuing you with the ability to connect and
share information on any platform. So, 14 represents magnetic
communication with the public. You are full of ideas, have a vivid
imagination and great energy. You like excitement and motion yet must stay
on the positive expression of your number in order not to feel unstable.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 14 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You are easily distracted, overly nervous
and stressed out, overanalytical, or neglectful of responsibilities or you feel
unstable and imbalanced. You can experience both temporary gains and
losses under this vibration—so it is most important that you don’t rely on
others, but turn to your intuition, your inner communicator, for advice.
Be sure to read the section on number 5 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 14.
If you are born on the 15th day of any month or have a 15 Life Purpose

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Number or Destiny Number—or 69, 78, 87, 96, or 159 (etc.) Destiny
Number—you internalize the qualities of number 15.
15 is referred to by the ancient Chaldean priests as the “Spiritual

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Alchemist.” As a 15 you have great magnetism and carry enchantment in
everything you do. You are aligned with music, drama, and/or art with a
charisma and flair that make you compelling. When you are positively
aligned you easily attract prosperity and people who help you with gifts and
favors. Your main mission is to uplift others by blessing them with
happiness. You are not afraid of working to make your goals a reality. You
persevere and have a strong will—and your strong convictions help you
secure what it is you envision.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 15 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can step on people’s toes, be
overbearing, or be overly curious to the point of nosiness. You also may
sacrifice your own needs by helping others, or be indecisive. With this
number you must always focus your intention on the highest good for all.
Be sure to read the section on number 6 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 15.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you are born on the 16th day of any month or have a 16 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number—or 79, 88, 97, or 169 (etc.) Destiny Number—
you internalize the qualities of number 16.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
16 is a powerful number of spiritual transformation—symbolizing the
intuitive lightning strike of awakening. Listening to your inner voice, a
powerful message of number 7, is heightened even further in the 16, as your
intuition will always warn you of unexpected changes and even danger—
whether through dreams or your gut feelings. In order to live at the highest
expression of this powerful number of awakening, it is of absolute
importance for you to perfect your intuitive hunches, as ignoring them can
result in the immediate attraction of challenges. You work best when you
are alone. That’s when you receive powerful and sudden illuminations. You
like to feel empowered. You also prefer quality over quantity.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 16 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: It is important for you to learn about
being faithful and honest, so be guarded against promiscuity and
unfaithfulness. Other shadow-side expressions are impatience,
overanalyzing, and being impulsive or reckless. A tyrannical side and using
words or actions in an abusive way are extreme negative expressions of this
vibration.
Be sure to read the section on number 7 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 16.
If you are born on the 17th day of any month or have a 17 Life Purpose

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Number or Destiny Number—or 89, 89, 98, 179 (etc.) Destiny Number—
you internalize the qualities of number 17.
17 is what I refer to as the “Immortality Number.” With this number in
your Birth Code you will leave behind a legacy—to your family, your
community, or the greater world at large. You are attracted to explore and
make visible secret, hidden mysteries of the universe. You also want to help
create peace and love for humankind.
“16 is a powerful number of spiritual transformation—symbolizing
the intuitive lightning strike of awakening.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The ancients referred to 17 as the “Star of the Magi.” It is a deeply
spiritual number, having also symbolized the eight-pointed Star of Venus to
the ancient Chaldeans. Often people with this number in their soul
Blueprint will have challenges earlier in life, which they overcome later on
—and so are able to align to love and peace. You have the mindset and
resilience of a true survivor.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 17 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: Your challenge in life is to achieve a high
degree of detachment, in order to understand that power and influence are
only to be used for the benefit of uplifting others. You may be stubborn and
pessimistic and lose complete faith with where the world is heading. These
doubts can create a superficial quality that has its roots in the meaningless
aspects of life, not in natural ever-expanding abundance and the infinite
nature of the universe.
Be sure to read the section on number 8 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 17.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you are born on the 18th day of any month or have an 18 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number—or 99, 189, or 198 Destiny Number—you
internalize the qualities of number 18.
18 loves to dream and requires more time to rest in order for your
amazing imagination to become conscious. Your creativity and compassion
coupled with your natural charisma and intense emotions can carry you to a
