leadership position. You have the capability to move mountains and build
empires. You are very sensitive to the rhythms of life. Sometimes this high
sensitivity turns into a nervous energy, so it is important for you to meditate
and chill on a regular basis.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 18 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: Either you lead by inspiring others—or
you can mislead and are made as an example to others of what not to do.
So, you may use your power for the sake of ego gratification. You may be
touchy, easily irritated, deceived by others, not aware of close dangers, or in
a state of conflict about spirituality and materialism, or you may
consciously profit from conflict.
Be sure to read the section on number 9 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 18.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you are born on the 19th day of any month or have a 19 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number—or 199 Destiny Number—you internalize the
qualities of number 19.
The ancients called 19 the “Prince of Heaven,” where the “prince”
symbolizes the Sun. 19 comprises both the first and last single-digits,
1 and 9, and represents a vibration of initiation, because you’ll be pushed to
stand on your own two feet having accessed the gamut of wisdom contained
within the 1 and the 9. Thus you may attract many changes and shifts in
your life that require you to start from scratch.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You attract others into your energy field. You have a wonderful
creativity, which may be accompanied by equally strong insecurities. Your
purpose is to believe in yourself and to stand on your own two feet by
yourself. That is when you’ve reached true happiness and peace. Being your
own Sun!
The shadow side of number 19 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You feel insecure and lack the confidence
to make a decision, or turn to self-pity. You might get impulsive and
impatient. You like to keep your secrets close and may turn to deceit, even
going so far as experiencing a “fall” from grace.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 1 (in chapter 3) and 10 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 19.
If you are born on the 20th day of any month or have a 20 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number 20.
20 is called “The Awakening” by the ancient Chaldean priests. At some
time during life, you will experience a powerful awakening, bringing a new
purpose and new goals. The in 20 adds an element of divine protection. As a

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
20 you may find success in life as part of a team. You work well with
groups and can create harmony when there are different viewpoints. The
choices you make bring tests, and this requires that you decide which
direction you want your life to go. You are constantly adapting and
renewing your life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 20 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You are resentful, exhibit uncontrolled
emotions, identify as being weak, are easily disillusioned, feel separate
from the world, resist change, and are uncooperative or undiplomatic in
your communication style.
Be sure to read the section on number 2 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 20.
If you are born on the 21st day of any month or have a 21 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number 21.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
21 was called “Crown of the Magi” by the ancient Chaldean priests. It is
the mystical number of cosmic consciousness. 21 also governs truth. Our
twenty-first century is defined by “The Truth shall set you free.” You are
here to help set everyone (including yourself) free from what is false,
superfluous, or misleading. You are a highly creative, versatile, and well-
rounded person and can express yourself through any modality, career,
form, or material—as your message penetrates all forms and reaches
people’s hearts.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
It is important for you to address any self-doubt, including feelings of
inadequacy, insecurity, or rejection. Once you realize your worth by
bypassing your inner insecurities, you will develop sound confidence and
be grateful and generous to all of life and everyone you meet—a wonderful
gift that flows from your heart to everyone around you.
The shadow side of number 21 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You fear rejection, you become overly
critical, you dissipate your gifts with frivolous activities, you resort to lying,
or your insecurities result in self-centeredness.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Be sure to read the section on number 3 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 21.
If you are born on the 23rd day of any month or have a 23 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number 23.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
23 is the number of life (23/5). You have the desire for freedom and want
to explore and enjoy life to the fullest. 23 was called the “Royal Star of the
Lion” by the ancients and thus is a very powerful number. Your strength lies
in your ideas and intelligence. You have a quick mind and, a great memory
and you learn easily. You also have the confidence to manifest your ideas in
the physical world. Communication and research come naturally to you. 23
is an ambitious and courageous vibration, befitting the “Royal Star of the
Lion” symbol. You are loyal and passionate.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 23 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You act hastily and are headstrong with
quick outbursts of temper, impatient, self-centered, and patronizing of
others
Be sure to read the section on number 5 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 23.
If you are born on the 24th day of any month or have a 24 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number 24.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
With your magnetic presence and powers of suggestion you make a big
impact on others. Once you realize how you can serve others with passion
and joy, you can easily attract abundance and nurturing relationships. Your
success is supported by others helping you. You are a warm, loving
companion and you adore your home, children, and nature. You take
responsibility for your life and goals, and this drive and love of life make
you a lively partner. Your visions and dreams nurture your soul and uplift
others. You have a desire to live in abundance and surrounded by beauty.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 24 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You easily become jealous, you are
domineering and controlling—interfering in other people’s lives. You are
unfaithful and put too much pressure on yourself to the point of sacrifice.
Be sure to read the section on number 6 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 24.
If you are born on the 25th day of any month or have a 25 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number 25.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are a thinker and an idealist who is selective, analytical, and
scientific. You need peace and quiet and tend to be more reserved. People
look up to you because you because of your knowledge and wisdom. In
fact, you are adept at observing people and situations with great care—and
gaining wisdom about them as a result. Like any 7 you want to know the
hidden mysteries of life. 25 can be a spiritual crusader. You have a rare
quality of learning from past mistakes. It is important for you to have great
respect for your partner—otherwise you’d rather be alone.
“I refer to 27 as the ‘Gandhi’ number. You love to share and uplift,
and you do so without expecting anything in return.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 25 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: With your need for privacy, you can be
secretive and hard to get to know. It can be a real challenge sharing your
feelings. Notice when you feel internal conflict—it will dissipate your
energy. Guard against starting something and not following through. When
totally out of alignment you can resort to cruelty.
Be sure to read the section on number 7 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 25.
If you are born on the 26th day of any month or have a 26 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number 26.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are gifted with natural leadership and are excellent in business,
money matters, and management. You have the endurance and stamina of
an athlete. You understand the material/physical world and intuitively know
what makes virtually any enterprise work. You are not a detail-oriented
person—it is your overall vision that inspires and nourishes you. Due to
your high standards and drive for recognition and success you can do
almost anything well, rise above challenges, and stand out. You are very
generous.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 26 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can be impulsive and impatient. You
don’t spend enough time on your personal relationships—which can lead to
a disorganized personal life. Guard against craving too much power or
being overly materialistic.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Be sure to read the section on number 8 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 26.
If you are born on the 27th day of any month or have a 27 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number 27.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You exude a sense of excellence and authority blended with a
humanitarian spirit. 27 is a vibration of courage, love, compassion, and wise
leadership. I refer to 27 as the “Gandhi” number. You love to share and
uplift, and you do so without expecting anything in return. Make sure you
focus on your own creative ideas and not listen to other people whose
opinions differ from the messages aligned with your internal compass.
“As a 30 you are highly artistic and/or have a strong desire to
express yourself. This expression can be either positive or
negative.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 27 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can get indecisive and confused.
When others don’t measure up to your idea of perfection you become
intolerant. Your perfectionist standards can make you quite critical.
Be sure to read the section on number 9 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 27.
If you are born on the 28th day of any month or have a 28 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number 28.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 28 you have an original approach to life and unique, inventive
ideas. This makes you want to explore life to the fullest and ignites your
ambitious nature. You have an innate “remembering” of who you are at soul
level and are here to remind others of that eternal connection. Remember
that everything that happens to you, positive and negative, is a reminder of
your true origin. Thus any contradictions you experience are “special
attractions” you have summoned into your life to awaken you to your true
nature and destiny.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 28 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can lack self-discipline and caution,

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
and not look before you leap. You trust the wrong people, which can attract
opposition in all parts of your life.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 1 (in chapter 3) and 10 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 28.
If you are born on the 29th day of any month or have a 29 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number 29.
As a highly intuitive 29 you are here to develop undeniable faith in your
gifts and trust in the goodness of your soul. This total faith in your divine
origins creates a natural optimism about your life. 29 reduces to the Master

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Number 11, which you vibrate to as well. You take your life and role
seriously. When you honor yourself as an individualist—a creator of
original ideas and visions—your vitality and trust in the goodness of
everything create miraculous healing. You have high standards that never
waiver and thus you can demand much from yourself. At your highest
expression, you are a leader and teacher of wisdom.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 29 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can be fearful and uncertain,
resulting in division and indecision running through your life. You may
attract unreliable friends, trust too easily, and get anxious easily around
others. Your anxiety can lead to “feeling frozen” and stubbornness.
Be sure to read the section on numbers 2 (in chapter 3) and 11 (chapter
4) to discover a complete overview of number 29.
If you are born on the 30th day of any month or have a 30 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number 30.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 30 you are highly artistic and/or have a strong desire to express
yourself. This expression can be either positive or negative, but it does
come out. Express your feeling through words or creative projects, such as
writing, music, dance, or other media. You will inspire others to do the
same. You have a very strong, superior mind. Though you are wonderfully
easygoing and warm socially, you also need your alone time, so be sure to
retreat from a fast-paced life style into your sanctuary. This will allow you

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
to protect and nurture your talent. You will take chances easily and need
beautiful surroundings to be happy. 30 is here to uplift, share the optimistic
side of life, and celebrate. The 0 in 30 gives divine protection.
The shadow side of number 30 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can doubt yourself and get easily
distracted. This results in wasted energy and going around in circles. Guard
against avoiding your responsibilities. Any moodiness is signal for you to
refocus.
Be sure to read the section on number 3 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 30.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you are born on the 31st day of any month or have a 31 Life Purpose
Number or Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number 31.
31, like 13 signifies, genius and out-of-the-box thinking. You are very
determined, but need time alone to make your ideas and thoughtful
approaches real. You have a natural retrospection and a mental superiority.
You like to be self-sufficient and need your own space—which will allow
you to take your ideas and turn them into successful results. You have a
great desire for security, though not at the expense of personal freedom.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 31 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can get nervous and isolate yourself,
becoming a recluse and poverty conscious. Any loneliness is a sign that you
need to confront lingering anger issues, resentment, or misunderstandings.
Guard against overwork and being disorganized.
Be sure to read the section on number 4 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 31.
If you have a 32 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 32.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
32 was known by the ancients as the “Politician’s Vibration.” It stands
for ultimate freedom and connection to people, especially through magnetic
presence or speech. You have a natural charm and magnetism. Your
message tends to be positive and about good visions for the future. You are
like a warrior, activating both your sense of responsibility and what is for

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
everyone’s highest good—the highest values expressed in a leader or
politician who is truly aligned with his or her divine mission.
The shadow side of number 32 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You only live for the adrenaline rush and
excitement. You may be high-strung. You can resort to overanalyzing,
impulsiveness, and impatience. You may easily give up. You can feel
superior over others and proud.
Be sure to read the section on number 5 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 32.
If you have a 34 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 34.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
34 governs order, steady growth, and a patient approach to manifesting
your goals. You are naturally attracted to the hidden mysteries and secrets
of life. You have a way of combining the creative in an organized way in
order to elevate your understanding and mindset. Learning from the past,
good and negative, is something you do well. You are a quick thinker, an
excellent planner, and logical in your approach to life’s challenges. Your
growth is one of steady development with a trust in the divine.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 34 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can get impulsive and impatient. You
may talk too much. You may use violent tactics to get what you want.
Be sure to read the section on number 7 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 34.
If you have a 35 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 35.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Creating wealth, position, and power are your main goals. The energy
exchange of money fascinates you. Self-expression (3) and freedom (5) in
combination create abundance for you. You are recognized for work well
done. You are generous, affectionate, charming, and fully engaged in your
independence. You are on an ultimate adventure to find the true meaning of
prosperity. You have naturally large energy reserves.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 35 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can be judgmental and self-indulgent.
You may have false beliefs about money and impose a negative mindset on
abundance, when money is a tool—here to be understood and used to make
a positive change. You may be unreasonable and unpredictable as well as
undisciplined.
Be sure to read the section on number 8 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 35.
If you have a 36 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 36.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 36 you are here to live in alignment with your heart-center. As you
make peace with your true mission, your vision in how to implement it will
enable you to step fully into the life you were born to live. 36 reduces to 9
and is made up of the complete 3-6-9 Creation Triad. Thus you must use the
energy living in your inspirations and inventions for good. You are
dependable and honest. Use your deep acceptance of truth to overcome any
doubts—and you’ll go straight to the core of the source of all creation. Your
creations can be of a genius quality.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 36 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may experience cycles of ups and
downs, which lead to imbalance. You may act in haste, before thinking. You
may be emotionally distant due to your great sensitivity. You can be
concerned about completions and endings.
Be sure to read the sections on number 9 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 36.
If you have a 37 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 37.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 37 you are sensitive and private. You tend to have good friendships
throughout your life. This vibration can also emphasize love and romance.
Partnerships in general are good for you, in both business and your personal
life. You have a magnetic relationship with the public—especially in the
arts. You are wise in how you express your emotions. You are also deeply
spiritual. You have a desire to be prominent and successful in your chosen

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
field so you can express your feelings and connect others to the divine in
themselves.
The shadow side of number 37 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may be dishonest, deceitful, or
manipulative. You may not trust your intuition and may turn to others for
answers. Guard against emotional conflicts. You can get aggressive.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 1 (in chapter 3) and 10 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 37.
If you have a 38 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 38.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 38 you are highly intuitive and attuned to the divine. You trust in
that bridge between your conscious and unconscious, connecting to the
unseen. This is a number of natural clairvoyance. The creative 3 fuels the
11, resulting in a number of spiritual leadership and entrepreneurship. You
are happiest when being in service to others. Your energy field (aura) can
sometimes be larger than average. You are an instrument of wisdom and
peace.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 38 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may lack a connection to your
spiritual nature, have emotional and physical challenges due to blocked
creativity, live extravagantly (beyond your means), be immoral, and use
deception. You may get paranoid and have phobias.
“You demand a lot from others, but even more from yourself. You
are a natural peacemaker. The 0 in 40 gives you divine
protection.”
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 2 (in chapter 3) and 11 (chapter
4) to discover a complete overview of number 38.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you have a 39 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 39.
You are gentle and love humanity—thus you want to be of service to
others in some way. Making the world a kinder, gentler, better place in

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
which to live is one of your visions. You must live and create in a place of
peace and contentment. You love to learn and are very philosophical. You
can tap into both your mind and heart, giving you an easy grasp of matters
at hand. Your life feels smooth and happy when you embrace your ability to
speak with feeling and vulnerability—not just from the mind. This is when
you surrender to Source.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 39 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may overindulge in the sensual. You
can be insensitive to others or get lazy or be easily distracted. If life feels
like a drama or you resort to exaggeration or lies, it is a sign that you are
creatively unfulfilled.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 3 (in chapter 3) and 12 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 39.
If you have a 40 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 40.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are dedicated to following a strategy or plan of action and will
persevere until each project is fully completed. This sense of order and
structure makes you feel at ease and happy. You also carry an
entrepreneurial streak and are a natural at managing others. You demand a
lot from others, but even more from yourself. You are a natural peacemaker.
The 0 in 40 gives you divine protection.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 40 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may have a negative disposition,
which leads to pessimism and confusion. You can see life as a series of
obstacles. You may be undisciplined and unreliable. You can chase goals
that are illusions and squander money.
Be sure to read the section on number 4 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 40.
If you have a 41 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 41.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You have an open and flexible approach to life, giving you the ability to
bounce back quickly from challenges, which don’t leave a long and strong
impact on you. Being totally open and authentic will give you the same
openness and freedom in any relationship. Your feelings and senses are
filled with enthusiasm, a pioneering spirit, and wonderful versatility.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 41 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may be resistant to change and
inflexible in your attitude. You can feel timid and afraid to take on
responsibility. You may be impulsive and lose ground when you act too
quickly. Guard against overindulgence.
Be sure to read the section on number 5 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 41.
If you have a 42 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 42.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
42 governs affection and the law of giving and receiving. Your deepest
intention is to love and to be loved in return. People appreciate you and the
compassion and empathy you share, and they are willing to go the distance
to keep you close by to them. You may have visions that inspire your
creativity. Your home environment must feel beautiful and exude warmth.
In the same way, you need an outlet for your creative imagination. You are
charming and charismatic and very generous.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 42 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can be selfish and think you’re here
to save the world. You may feel misunderstood, neglected, or
unappreciated. You can feel overburdened. You can be dishonest and
irresponsible.
Be sure to read the section on number 6 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 42.
If you have a 43 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 43.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
43 symbolizes a strong intuition—when everything is in flow and your
mind is clear. You are practical, creative, and strong, in both the physical
and spiritual realms. 43 can also symbolize revolution. Your biggest

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
breakthroughs come when you are by yourself, or alone in nature. When in
alignment you can attract happy endings and plenty into your life.
The shadow side of number 43 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can experience emotional and
physical pain due to excess. You can feel isolated, angry, or conflicted. You
enjoy wielding power.
Be sure to read the section on number 7 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 43.
If you have a 45 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 45.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
45 is the number showing how the manifestation of freedom helps you to
access the highest wisdom. 4 gives you a firm foundation—visualize the
Great Pyramid sitting on a perfect four-sided square. 5 gives you the ability
to communicate and experience freedom of movement, and the root number
9 completes the picture, holding the wisdom and love of all the previous
eight single-digit numbers. This combination gives you a magnetic energy.
You are a born humanitarian, merging independence with discipline.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 45 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: At times the practicality of your ideas will
be in conflict. You may be regretful and discouraged. If you brood over the
past and any lost opportunities you can feel gloomy. You may come across
as egotistical and proud.
Be sure to read the section on number 9 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 45.
“As a 46, others see you as intensely motivated and independent—
a person who is going places.”
If you have a 46 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 46.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 46 others see you as intensely motivated and independent—a
person who is going places. You embody manifestation and passion turned

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
into action, with the discipline, creativity, and compassion to really make an
impact. It is your role to take the lead. Make that your mission. You are
well-rounded and able to delegate to others, guiding them to manifest your
ideas. Your intuitive abilities may also birth new inventions to serve the
world.
The shadow side of number 46 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may be childish and irresponsible.
You can take advantage of those who admire you. You may be self-centered
and thoughtless. At times you may resort to judging or even condemning
others. Guard against pride and not being able to forgive.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 1 (in chapter 3) and 10 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 46.
If you have a 47 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 47.
Having specific and inspiring goals is important to your success. By
implementing your visions you activate your natural charm and magnetism,
thereby soliciting help in fulfilling your dreams. Walking through the 11
gateway (4 + 7 = 11) you enter the hallways of truth and total liberation.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Thus you activate what inspires you by taking risks and using your gifts
professionally. You have much to give, and this instills confidence. If you
try to partake in work that is mundane … you’ll not be happy. Always
discern what is important, and discard what is not. This daily balancing is
crucial for your peace of mind, abundance, and happiness.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 47 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You do not discern and are indecisive,
which dissipates your energy. You may succumb to distractions and
temptations that take you away from your purpose. You may latch on to
delusions—or get too emotional.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 2 (in chapter 3) and 11 (chapter
4) to discover a complete overview of number 47.
If you have a 48 Life Purpose or Destiny Number, you internalize the
qualities of number 48.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are incredibly independent. It’s not likely you’ll be tied down by
anyone since you crave total freedom of speech and movement. Your
thoughts like to focus on attaining higher knowledge, and you enjoy
expanding your understanding by traveling and seeing other cultures in the
world. You are a logical thinker—focused on manifestation and the belief
that there is plenty to go around. You have a wonderful artistic sense and
can thrive in the arts, or areas that require creative solutions to problems.
Focus on one area you are passionate about, and commit fully.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 48 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may get moody and blocked
creatively. You can be cynical and intolerant. You may feel too sensitive. If
you turn away from the spiritual, you will not find fulfillment.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 3 (in chapter 3) and 12 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 38.
If you have a 49 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 49 your compassion and brilliant ideas blend to manifest into
outcomes that will benefit many. You have a variety of gifts that are rooted
in your integrity, intuition, executive skills, and attention to justice. Your
financial success is assured when you apply these gifts to any enterprise of
your choosing. You are naturally patient and honest as well as diplomatic
and therefore know when it is important to wait … an essential ingredient
for success. You are also loyal and affectionate.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 49 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may have no drive to succeed and
resort to greed or excess. You may fear taking risks or be afraid of change.
You can distrust the unknown, unseen, and spiritual and hesitate, thereby
losing an opportunity.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 3 (in chapter 3) and 12 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 38.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you have a 50 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of
number 50.
5 blends your quest for freedom and joy with the 0 of divine protection.
Your life is filled with movement, achievement, and a quest for adventure.

often the decision-making needs to move quickly. As a leader of freedom
and joy, you need to balance pleasure and work.

chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 85.
If you have an 86 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.content:

The shadow side of number 86 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can be insensitive to others. Guard
against focusing too much on yourself. You may abdicate your
responsibilities and overindulge in sensual pleasures.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 5 (in chapter 3) and 14 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 86.
If you have an 87 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.content:
87 brings leadership to a level of magic, as the energetic alchemy you
create can turn into a healing experience. You have the ability to mesmerize
and magnetize. Your charisma and compassion are irresistible and allow
you to help facilitate a spiritual awakening in others. Even if you travel the

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 87 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may struggle to create a balance
between the practical and spiritual realms. Your intense passion can turn
into obsession. You can give too much and dissipate your core energy
resources.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 6 (in chapter 3) and 15 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 87.
If you have an 89 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
89 is aligned with infinite resources and is comfortable being in the
spotlight. You enjoy international travel and the accolades that come with
leadership. Your confidence is merged with wisdom and love, which imbues
you with an air of royalty. Wealth is attracted to you, and you yearn to leave
behind a legacy. You have a unique perspective on life that may not always
be understood by others.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 89 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You tend to need to be admired and feel
lost without consistent accolades and praise. Understand that power and
influence are only to be used for the benefit of uplifting others. You may be
stubborn and pessimistic.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 8 (in chapter 3) and 17 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 89.
If you have a 90 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:

bettering the state of humanity. This number brings a strong sense
commitment towards inspiring others. 90 includes the 0 of divine protection
and imbues a spirituality blended with unconditional love. This life can be
singular in its approach; however, the objective is always to bring positive
energy to all endeavors and people. Love and wisdom shared with courage
and humility are the main themes.
“91 is a combination of endings and beginnings, bringing the
power to shift and create new experiences that reboot and repower
others.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 90 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may be so caught up being a
messenger that you become aloof and removed from others. Your ego may
be greatly inflated, signifying the image of the number 9 with a big head at
the top.
Be sure to read the section on number 8 (in chapter 3) to discover a
complete overview of number 80.
If you have a 91 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.content:

shift and create new experiences that reboot and repower others. 91 is a
highly creative number and brings tremendous manifestation abilities. As a
91 you are driven to lead by example, carve your unique place in the world,
and create success. You have an out-of-the-box approach to life.
The shadow side of number 91 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can be opinionated and stubborn. You
may isolate yourself. Guard against wanting to dominate others.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 1 (in chapter 3) and 10 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 91.
If you have a 92 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a highly intuitive 92 you take your life and role seriously. When you
honor yourself as an individualist—a creator of original ideas and visions—
your vitality and trust in the goodness of everything create miraculous
healing. You balance love and intimacy, compassion and cooperation, in all
you do and say. As a wise leader, you set an example for peace. You have a
major mission to help and support humanity.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 92 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can have division and indecision
running through your life. You may trust too easily and get anxious around
others. You have to protect yourself against those who don’t wish you well,
due to your high sensitivity.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 2 (in chapter 3) and 11 (Chapter
4) to discover a complete overview of number 92.
If you have a 93 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 93 you are highly intuitive and need outlets to express your
feelings. You want to use your creativity to be of service to others. You
must live and create in a place of peace and contentment. You love to learn
and are very philosophical. You can tap into both your mind and heart,
giving you an easy grasp of matters at hand. Your life feels smooth and
happy when you embrace your ability to speak with feeling and
vulnerability—not just from the mind. This is when you surrender to

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 93 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You can be insensitive to others or get
lazy or be easily distracted. If life feels like a drama or you resort to
exaggeration or lies, it is a sign that you are creatively unfulfilled. You may
have difficulty committing to projects or partnerships.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 3 (in chapter 3) and 12 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 93.
If you have a 94 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
94 creates a strong urge to manifest wisdom and love. Thus you want
compassion to be implemented in practical ways. You are very open to out-
of-the-box approaches and carry genius in your ideas. You need stability
and a secure home base to feel at peace, though, paradoxically, your growth
is tied to surprises and unexpected shifts that run through your life. You
have a variety of gifts that are rooted in your integrity, intuition, executive
skills, and attention to justice. You are naturally patient and honest as well
as diplomatic and therefore know when it is important to wait … an
essential ingredient for success. You are also loyal and affectionate.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 94 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You are not that comfortable with change.
You may fear taking risks or be afraid of change. You can distrust the
unknown, unseen, and spiritual and hesitate, thereby losing an opportunity.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 4 (in chapter 3) and 13 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 94.
If you have a 95 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As a 95 you embody creating freedom from a soulful place of
compassion. You love movement and travel, and the excitement of taking
your gifts to as many people as possible stimulates you to take the
leadership role you so deeply desire. Your quest for independence governs
all you do, and communicating that quest makes you a force to be reckoned
with. Though you are not practical in how you manifest your humanitarian
nature, your ability to reach people bypasses most structural challenges, and
you can still implement your vision. You thrive when there is variety and
where you can use your compassion and quick wit to tackle any situation.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 95 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may have goals that are too idealistic.
You must learn to discern between what is supportive and positive and what
is not. Guard against impulsiveness and jumping into action too quickly.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 5 (in chapter 3) and 14 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 95.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you have a 96 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number
96 is a powerful vibration of unconditional love, compassion, and
alchemy. Your kind, sweet nature loves to focus on those you care deeply
about, whether it is family, friends, clients, or humanity as a whole. You
have a mission to uplift everyone through joy and change their lives with
the magic of a smile. You are highly artistic and very creative, imbuing
magical vibrations in every heart you touch. To share your heart lovingly
and unconditionally is your greatest mission.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 96 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may sacrifice too much of yourself
for others or a cause. Guard against serving others at the expense of taking
care of your own needs. You may be greedy or corrupt.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 6 (in chapter 3) and 15 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 96.
If you have a 97 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
97 is a vibration of the spiritual channel of unconditional love. You need
peace and quiet due to your natural internal serenity. A calm environment
and close vicinity to nature help you to channel wisdom. As a 97 you reflect
a strong intelligence, which is merged with your compassion for humanity.
97 is a vibration of royalty and can indicate a position that influences a
broad spectrum of mankind.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 97 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You may be too sensitive and shut
yourself off—become reclusive. You may abdicate your mission to lead by
example, showing the way to utilize intuition in all parts of life. Guard
against being self-righteous.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 7 (in chapter 3) and 16 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 97.
If you have a 98 Destiny Number, you internalize the qualities of number

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
98 is a very idealistic vibration and represents leadership through love.
You care about abundance and the importance of giving everyone tools to
manifest prosperity. Your quest for sovereignty and financial security
inspires others to follow your example. You believe in the infinite resources
of the universe and make this a big part of your life and mission. Your
confidence is merged with wisdom and love, which imbues you with an air
of royalty. You yearn to leave behind a legacy. You have a unique
perspective on life that may not always be understood by others.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The shadow side of number 98 is expressed when you are out of
alignment. Watch for these clues: You are highly sensitive and may have a
challenging time sharing your true feelings. You can come across as aloof.
Understand that power and influence are only to be used for the benefit of
uplifting others. You may be stubborn and pessimistic.
Be sure to read the sections on numbers 8 (in chapter 3) and 17 (this
chapter) to discover a complete overview of number 98.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
UST LIKE EVERY NUMBER CARRIES A UNIQUE MESSAGE, EACH LETTER IN THE
ALPHABET RESONATES TO A SPECIFIC MEANING. The alphabet conveys sacred
symbolism. It is a wonderful tool to access another part of a person’s soul
contract and give a deeper, spiritual meaning of words. Use this chapter as a
key to discover how language, names, and words impact you all day long.
You’ll be amazed at the profound impact the numerology of letters has on
your life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Your current name and birth name are made up of several letters. Some
are your initials, some are repeated, and others appear only once. Letters
that begin or end a name carry extra weight, as does the middle letter of a
name, if the name has an odd number of letters. (Discover the meaning of a
letter’s placement and repeated letters in chapter 11.)
You’ll notice that all twenty-six letters look different. This is your first
clue that they impact you differently! As you discover the meaning behind
each letter, you’ll see certain words that begin with that letter in capitals.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Pay attention to words and names that activate each letter for even more
insights.
Pay particular attention to the letters that correspond to your initials,
the first vowel in each of your separate names, any doubled letter that is
side by side (like aNNa has two Ns next to each other, and JiLL two Ls side
by side), or letters that are repeated. These will carry extra emphasis in
your life (more in chapter 11).
Let’s delve into the secret meaning of each letter of the alphabet!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
A is balanced on two feet and shows initiative, Action, Activation, and
leadership. A likes to take charge!
A has a line in the middle that balances the spiritual and physical, higher
and lower realms.
A reaches up to one point of arrival—A is Ambitious. An “A” in a
student report card in the U.S. means the highest or the best.
A must decide quickly or else it will be overly Analytical.
A is the first letter of the alphabet and represents the Air we breathe—the
first breath we take when we are born. Say “Ah” and it sounds like a breath.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Thus A also is highly engaged and creative, confident and active. The word
“A” means “one,” as in “A” house, “A” picture.
A needs to curb its enthusiasm if it turns negative. This can be expressed
as being overly ambitious, self-important, egotistical, bossy, blunt, or
jealous.
A is completely made up of straight lines, which gives focus, clarity,
direction, directness, and awareness.
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF A IS WHEN … A Activates
Accomplishments and Acknowledges that Anything is possible!
B looks like two rooms that make up a home. These rooms are closed, so it

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As the second letter of the alphabet, B represents the number 2—two
sides of the coin. Balance.
B has a middle line that divides the top and bottom “rooms.” This
delineates the spiritual from the physical world, bringing an understanding
of both, yet also keeping them separate.
B governs the word Body, the physical “home” of our soul.
B is a visual representation of two Breasts—the mother’s Bosom
designed to nurse the Baby. “Baby” has two Bs and requires Breast milk to

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
To “Be” verbalizes the letter “B.” Thus B symbolizes a body in balance
(feminine and masculine), with a brain, temporarily housing your soul—and
“to Be” is a Bringer of Beauty.
B needs a good home, is loving by nature, makes a caring companion,
and thrives in partnership. B dislikes jarring sounds and noise and is deeply
moved by music.
As an enclosed letter, B can hold secrets but needs to guard against
secrecy, moodiness, being lazy, codependent relationships, oversensitivity,
and needing to please.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
B is made up of a straight line, representing the spine—energy and
inspiration coming down from Source—and two curves, cradling those
inspirations and ideas, holding them close to the chest (Breast) to provide
security so these seeds of inspiration Begin a new journey. B can handle
more than one activity at a time.
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF B IS WHEN … B Births and Breathes life
into Being, Balancing the Best in everyone.
C is a Circle that is open, Cradling Creativity and yearning to share it
through Communication.
C sits on a “rocker” and is Changeable and flexible.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
C sounds like “see” and is open to the right (the future)—thus C can
“see” into the future.
As the third letter of the alphabet, C represents the number 3 and the
C must share with their voice, writing, music, art, singing. C has a great
facility and fluid sense of sound, words, color.
C is shaped like a half moon and shines the light of Clarity. Cs love to
shine and are the happiest when uplifting others. Cs may hesitate to be
visible, so the light must be shined on them.
Turn C on its side and it looks like a smile—Cs love to bring joy and
smiles.
As a smiling mouth, C symbolizes your voice and music.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
C is artistic and not interested in mundane jobs. Rather, C wants to feel
enjoyment in everything and is aligned with playfulness, creative
exploration, and “seeing” the beauty before it is made real—in the abstract
Concepts. C should leave managerial matters to others.
C wants to share their heart and emotions, allowing their feelings, words,
art, and music to flow unimpeded by barriers.
C can be critical of self and others and, may share too much, get offtrack
or gossip, Close up their gifts of expression and then become intolerant of
joy, dissipate their energy, and get too serious.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF C IS WHEN … C Communicates
Childlike joy and Connects us to Cosmic Creation through the Creative process.
D comes from the Greek “Delta” and means Door.
D is a closed “room” and looks most like a square, symbol of number 4.
D is rooted in the physical experience—using Discipline to make the
Divine a visible Design. Thus D governs architecture—“Domus” in Latin
means “home,” and D is Domestic by nature.
D loves the home and is Dependable, Dedicated to family and country,
strong, Defined, and a good Delegator, Decision maker, Defender, and
Director—with a great Desire to open the Door to the Divine.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
D is connected to Doing and Discipline and holds Dominion over Death
and the Divine.
D can be too Disciplined and set limits on growth and expansion.
D likes to work and is reliable and good at completing projects but needs
to guard against Dedicating too much energy to work and no play.
D is Direct and honest—representing 4, D likes to get a “square” deal.
D is made up of a straight line, bringing the divine down, and is fully
enclosed by a C curve—creating a secure foundation for making the Divine
manifest.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
D is great at seeing the Details but is not a “seer” like C or S. It needs
proof and visible evidence—see it to believe it. Ds are methodical, patient,
and best left to grow and work at their own pace.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF D IS WHEN … D Develops a Divine
Design to manifest its Destiny with Discipline.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:

otherwise confusion results.”
E is open, like the number 5, and faces to the right—the future.
E has a line in the middle, which balances the spiritual and physical
worlds.
E is Energy. (N is the fourteenth letter, and 14 reduces to 5. Both E and
N are representative of Energy and appear often in names.) E Explores the
five senses and is open to change
E is Extroverted, talkative, Expressive, Emotional, and likes to speak and
sing.
E loves to Experience all of life, including the mystical—the seen and
unseen.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When E is doubled in a word as “ee,” it Expands the Expressive nature
of the word while also activating the five senses—such as in Feel, Deep,
See, Seer, Speech, Seeker, Teeth, Sleep, Freedom.
E is made up of only straight lines, giving clarity, focus, and awareness.
E can be impatient, restless, and too changeable. E can overexplore and
get tied to the sensual pleasures. Too much self-indulgence can create poor
health.
E looks forward and is progressive, living to express and explore future
joys, rarely looking back. E likes the new (all letters in the word “NEW”
resonate to the root number 5)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF E IS WHEN … E is Excited to Explore
and Embrace all Experiences and trusts in Eternal Expansion.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
F is a straight-line letter, Focused and Firm—depicting a direct line from
heaven down to Earth with two arms stretching forward in service to others.
F likes to take Fundamental responsibility for Family, Friends, and the
F is loyal, compassionate, artistic, forgiving, and caring and needs
harmony, beauty, and music in its environment.
F can be nurturing but may take the “mothering” to the point of
“smothering.”
F needs to Feel calm and Free in order not to take on burdens; otherwise
confusion results. Guard against wanting control, meddling, and being

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
F Feels deeply and wants to Feel appreciated. Their sense of Family
extends to their community. F has strong views. One of their greatest joys is
to help or mentor others so they can express their emotional confidence.
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF F IS WHEN … F expresses Loving
Forgiveness and Feels Fulfilled when extending Freedom to Family and Friends.
G is a visual representation of a spiral and symbolizes a Galaxy.
G sits on a rocker, so it can change easily.
G is expressive like the C and open to the left, but more internal and
quiet. G is not as verbally active as the C.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
G symbolizes the Grace and Gratitude of a Great force and spiritual
Greatness, as in God/Goddess energy, a specialist or Guru, and Galactic
awareness and Genius.
As a spiral, G epitomizes constant Growth.
G, like P (both 7 root numbers), strives for perfection and wants to find
solutions to secrets to unveil the hidden meanings of things. The ability to
“Spiral” their thoughts and imagination allows Gs to understand people’s
underlying motives, penetrating to the origins of human behavior and
actions.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
G is wise, clairvoyant, and determined. G loves music and its ability to
heal. G is discerning and very selective. G is very sensitive to sounds and

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
needs peace and quiet. Being in contact with nature is important to G’s
emotional equilibrium. G prefers mental exercise to physical exercise.
Gs can be Guarded and loners and afraid of intimacy. G is not happy in
big crowds. G has to guard against aloofness and criticism.
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF G IS WHEN … G Guides others to
experience Galactic expansion and God consciousness through Gratitude and Goodness.
H is a symbol of a window, looking above and looking below. Homes and
Hotels have windows—H is a window the soul. Thus as an H your vision
must encompass the wholeness of life and include all experiences.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
H is a made up of straight lines—two vertical lines representing
opposites and one Horizontal line representing the balance of light and
dark. H has great clarity and focus once it sees clearly. The view for H can
be happy or sad, light or dark, and embracing all visions as part of the
totality of our Human experience is critical for H.
In order to see clearly H has to look above and below—the eighth letter
also represents infinity. H Heals with Honesty and by seeing beyond the

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
H begins and ends the word Health. Good health is very important for H
to stay coordinated and balanced. Exercise imbues H with strength and long
life. H can work well under pressure.
H must be very discerning about how to spend precious time; there may
be a tendency to squander all Hard-earned progress through the openings at
the top and bottom of the letter and dissipate energy. H can be selfish,
intolerant, demanding, suspicious, and too cautious with money.
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF H IS WHEN … H is a window to the soul,
bringing people Home to themselves by leading them beyond the Horizon.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
I is a straight vertical line from the heavens to Earth, representing
Exhibiting only one straight line makes I very focused and singular.
“I” is the word for referring to yourself, as in “I am—the Indvidual—and
looks like the number 1. I feels Important!
I brings Insights and great Interest in both Intuitive and Intellectual
solutions.
I brings an Immunity from distraction (depending on other letters and
numbers in the person’s overall soul code).
I Invokes Ideas, which are Infused with an Infinite sense of possibility.
I represents Income, and the prefix “in” can add Intensification.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
I is highly creative and impressionable and needs to feel deeply—music
and the arts are important tools, helping I feel encouraged to express itself
clearly and fluidly.
As the ninth letter, I has a knowing and wisdom to grasp the abstract
while being a humanitarian.
I needs to guard against Intolerance, moodiness, self-centeredness,
Ignorance, being too Intense, and arrogance
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF I IS WHEN … I Inspires through
Intuition—the Intelligence of the heart—reaching for Infinite outcomes.

partner—personal and/or professional.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
J looks like a hook and faces to the left, using its excellent memory to hook
others into ideas and stories and knowledge.
J takes inspiration from above and brings it down, and the curve allows a
repurposing of information for any occasion or goal.
J is unique and forges its own path as a leader; thus it does not want to
be told what to do.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
J is daring and Jumps into situations. Since J sits on a rocker at the
bottom, it needs to use care and not rush into things.
As a 10/1, J is ambitious and highly creative in accomplishing goals.
J has excellent Judgment and makes a good Juror, due to its strong sense
of Justice.
J can be clever, a “Joker,” witty, and humorous and is often deeply
spiritual or religious.
Jesus, John, Jeremiah, Joseph, Jakob, Judith—many great Bible figures
were master storytellers, with a “hook” to pull you into the narrative and

L yearns to be educated and is wise, Loving, and romantic—devoted to

happy disposition.
L Likes turning on Lamps and curling up on the couch with a book—a
natural homebody.
L is very creative yet, due to being a purely straight-line Letter, is not as
flexible or spontaneous as the C.
L governs Law, so L has a good Legal sense and a natural understanding
of universal and human Laws. L easily understands people’s underlying

L has a voice that can carry and enjoys speaking, especially about Love
and what it has Learned—though L needs to refrain from gossip.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:

L may get overly emotional or negative and find fault with everyone and
everything. L also can be indecisive—as the two lines of L reach in two

THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF L IS WHEN … L follows the natural
Laws of Life by uplifting with Love and Light

N begins the second half of the alphabet and thus represents a pivot point
and new beginning.
Like the number 5, which is open to the left and right, N is open to the
top and bottom—welcoming all experiences and wanting to explore.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
N looks the same when turned 180° and stands balanced at the bottom.
N is a completely straight-line letter and has Vs opening diagonally
towards heaven and Earth, exhibiting an openness to receive spiritual and
material insights. N embraces versatility, is not afraid of change, likes to
travel and be with people, and is Nimble on its feet.
Turning the N clockwise 90° to the right or counterclockwise to left
results in a Z, showing intuitive abilities that may be hidden. (Z is made up
of two interconnected 7s, representing powerful intuitive gifts.)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
N carries goodness and has healing abilities. Being connected to the
number 14 also imbues N with abilities in media-related endeavors and a
yearning to communicate a message.
N loves to move and is imaginative and ambitious. However, N needs to
be careful not to be busy for the sake of feeling alive. Unnecessary

may be attracted to risky behavior or be stubborn and like to argue.
N is like an antenna, picking up ideas from anywhere—Notice
“aNteNNa” has three Ns.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The highest vibrational expression of N is when … N is the eye of the Needle, pulling through
the thread of life to sew a New story, an invitation to only experience the Now.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
O is the image of a circle, representing the unifying cosmos and everything
in it, the eye and the zero. O never changes its shape, no matter how you
flip or turn it.
O is a magical letter encompassing the wholeness of human love.
O loves the home, family, beauty, and abundance. As the fifteenth letter,

O also looks like a mouth that is Open. It represents expression, warmth,
sensuality, poise, and security. Love is physically expressed through an

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:

O has access to all wisdom and can be an Oracle, so it is highly gifted in

A negative O is moody and Opinionated, may Ostracize others, goes

possessive, and jealous, and can get despondent.
Words or names with two side-by-side Os look like a pair of eyes. Words
like “look” and “book” require the use of the our eyes.
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF O IS WHEN … O is Open to Our

passages.content:
Original Source, embracing the Opulence of its gifts and being the Oracle of love and joy.

P carries Power. Many Prominent Professional Positions begin with P,
such as President, Pope, Prime Minister, Principal, Physician, Pharmacist,

passages.content:

Prophet, Philosopher, Pilot, Politician.

P needs to be completely Present to lead and succeed.
P is a Professional—focusing on Perfection by building a Pyramid and
getting to the Prime Position.
P feels its life is of Paramount importance. It is a highly Private letter.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
P is the sixteenth letter and highly Psychic. It symbolizes the Pituitary
gland, a master gland that controls many highly important functions,
including libido in men and ovulation in women. It regulates serotonin,
which impacts our emotional state and ignites Passion in love.
P likes to analyze but may overthink as well. A negative P is unfocused,
aloof, and unable to express feelings and can be tactless, domineering,
possessive, intolerant, and deceptive. They carry a perfectionist streak and
are not always the easiest partners.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Like any 7 letter—other being G, P, and Y—P needs rest, Peace, and
quiet time, especially in nature. It enjoys uncovering mysteries and is
interested in the unseen.
P can be a Prophet—seeing and understanding concepts ahead of its
time.
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF P IS WHEN … P is a Prophet of Peace,
Pointing to the Present as the Portal of Positive empowerment.
Q represents a circle with a balancing line at the bottom right.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Q is the seventeenth letter of immortality and needs the balancing line to
ground its tremendous power—keep the balance. Otherwise the Q can focus
too intensely on one Question or direction.
“P can be a Prophet—seeing and understanding concepts ahead of
its time.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Q is a leadership letter as represented by the Queen.
Q holds the same ability to see as the O but elevates the vision to
clairvoyance.
Q symbolizes Quenching a thirst for knowledge—used in order to
manifest.
Q will ask many Questions and always seek to find the highest Quality.
Q connects to Quantum physics and Quantum wisdom, imbuing it with a
wide range of talents. Thus Q has many interests.
Q also exhibits genius and can come off as peculiar.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:

physically active. Q can work under pressure and wants to join with a

In the negative, Q can be too strange, unstable mentally, directing its
power into negative areas, greedy, and prone to exaggeration. As a partner
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF Q IS WHEN … Q is on a Quest to reveal
the unanswered Questions by tapping into the Quantum nature of the divine.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)

that Reaches out to the Right into the future and creates forward

R Represents the power and wisdom moving forward. R has a wonderful
mind and the ability to retain and Repurpose knowledge.
R is connected to Royalty and Regal leaders. Their thoughts are meant to
Rise above the norm to seek higher understanding and wisdom.
As the eighteenth letter, R has tremendous compassion and tolerance. 18
can sacrifice to bring about brotherhood and sisterhood.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
R is also a great teacher—creative, passionate, selfless, loving, and kind.
R also Resonates to the Root number 9 and is a letter of completion, so it
Represents an initiation into the mysteries, a celebration of life, and a

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:

search for truth define this letter.
The Royal nature of the R is so powerful it can either destroy or create

Radiance, Reliability, and Refinement of this letter.
In the negative expression, R needs to guard against being too emotional,

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:

THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF R IS WHEN … R Raises vibrations and

The horizontal top line can represent either a burden or a tremendous

passages.content:

T does well when in a partnership, though it needs to maintain a private

Taking Time to reveal the Truth and using its Talents to Transform Trauma through
U represents a cup holding the wisdom of the Universe.
U is open to the spiritual insights from above and can hold that wisdom

spiritual realms.
V resonates to 22, the Master Number of Peace and the Master Builder.
V likes to claim Victory and knows how to work to accomplish its goals

management.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
V does not have a middle line separating the spiritual from the physical

I call 22 the “Buddha” number, making the V a peaceful, strong, and
determined leader. V is a completely straight-line letter and carries great

V can easily Visualize when the intention resonates with V’s Soul
Blueprint and mission. With patience and a methodical approach, V can
accomplish anything.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
V symbolizes a Vortex of energy, indicating a tremendous source of
manifestation power.
V likes Vitality mixed with Velocity and can live a life that is fast paced

V needs to guard against being suspicious and selfish and feeling like a

THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF V IS WHEN … V Volunteers to be

path to Victory.
W is Wide open to the top (spiritual) and bottom (physical).

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:

W needs to work at a mission where there is adventure, change, and
much activity—W does not do well in monotonous situations. W likes to

The word “NEW” represents all three letters in the alphabet that resonate
to the number 5!
W is sensual (five senses) and loves deeply. W is generous and shares
with those it loves.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
W in the negative can be impatient, cut corners, and cause
instability (not going into the valleys before climbing the mountain). The

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
up-and-down nature of W means there is a fluctuation of energy, in which
hasty actions might be regretted at a later time. W needs to Watch Worry.
Wealth is attracted to W, while health must be taken care of. Walking is
W represents the Woman and the Womb of Creation—and is a powerful
letter of Winning and Wisdom, representing an unbeatable strength that
allows W to transfer power to others. It is a very magnetic letter and can
accomplish rapid success.
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF W IS WHEN … W has the Will to flow
with the Winds of change and Walk into each adventure with a Winning attitude and a

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
X is open on all sides and can be vulnerable.
X either exhibits a spiritual, high vibration or can be materialistic and
attracted to lower energies.
X can have a bipolar-like or double personality.
X may “cross out” or put an X on progress and growth.
Or X may rush too fast into a situation and unwittingly push the delete
button.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
X represents the number 24 and single-digit 6 of human love. X can
bring love into a situation but needs to guard against confusing sex with
loving intimacy. Love and sex are both related to the 6 vibration, which has
an X in the word “six”. So, due to the openness of the X, it can be
