XXX denotes a high sexual content of lower vibrational force.
A positive X has a wonderful strong intention to uplift humankind
through love, wisdom, intellectual knowledge, and inner strength.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
A negative X can attract challenging karma and lead a life of turmoil. It
will seek pleasure at all costs and turn to the dark side for power and
answers. The word “hex” can apply to the negative applications of this
letter.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
All 6 letters have deep emotions and have a need to be appreciated. Thus
X has a deep underlying need to help others, is artistic, holds strong,
passionate views, and makes a wonderful teacher and counselor.
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF X IS WHEN … X is eXcited to serve
humanity by opening all channels in service to love.
Y is the symbol of a decision and a person who is at a crossroads. A big
question is—which of two paths do I choose? Y introduces many choices
that need to be intuitively investigated.
Y reaches to the heavens for answers. As a 25 letter, Y is very psychic.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
So it must use its intuitive gifts to listen and hear the answers it will
inevitably seek to make choices.
Decisions will be the main theme in a Y person’s life. They will
encompass going left or right, up or down, diving deeply or skimming the
surface, warm or cold, past or future.
Y must always choose the spiritual path.
As a letter made up only of straight lines, Y is very focused and clear.
Y resonates to the root number 7 and Yearns to know the mysteries of
life.
Y needs rest, quiet, nature, and peaceful surroundings.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Y’s ability to listen will be especially important when quick decisions
need to be made—that is when Y must “trust their gut” for guidance.
A negative Y will feel moody, restless, intolerant of others, overactive,
and touchy. Y can be critical and quite self-centered, which can lead to a
fanatical approach to life.
Y looks like a dowsing rod and represents dowsing for gold, Yearning
for the golden nugget of truth.
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF Y IS WHEN … Y sees both the Yin and
Yang in You and Yearns to feel Youthful with a Young attitude—saying a big Yes to life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Z is the final letter of the Western alphabet, representing the Zenith.
Z is made up of two 7s that are joined as one horizontal line connected
by two horizontal lines—the upper symbolizing heaven and the lower
Earth. Thus Z can channel powerful wisdom between planes of existence.
Z looks like a lightning bolt, signifying an electrical aspect to the sudden
insights this letter attracts.
Z is an N turned on its side and resembles an antenna. It can scan the
skies for ideas and manifest them into physical reality.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Z represents numbers 26 and 8—the number of infinite strength,
overcoming obstacles, leadership. As an 8 letter, Z can attract abundance.
Z works well under pressure and has a great desire for achievement and
recognition. There is no limit (8) to what they can and will do to manifest a
successful outcome.
In the negative, Z may exaggerate and has a hard time sharing, so can be
challenging as a partner. If it abuses its natural power resources, it can
easily loose what it has gained. Z must always lead with integrity and
honorable intentions.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
THE HIGHEST VIBRATIONAL EXPRESSION OF Z IS WHEN … Z strives for the Zenith,
embodying the powerful Zero-point—and a life of Zen.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
UMEROLOGY DESCRIBES THE ENERGY OF THE PLANET EARTH. The
numbers you see—the numbers in your Soul Blueprint, the numbers in your
name, and the numbers of your current cycles (chapter 8)—are a description
of your soul and your future timelines. Just like you, the Earth and all
beings emit vibrations that are translatable as numbers.

Universal Year number shifts every January 1, we all feel the change. But
your Personal Year begins on your birthday, not on January 1.

birthday every year. Besides, that’s the day your age changes too!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:

your age and your Personal Year on your birthday, not on January 1. So for

year and runs until May the following year.
This means that within one calendar year, a person born during any
month except January would experience two different Personal Year
numbers:
1. One carried over from the previous calendar year until their birthday.
2. One from their birthday month onwards.

currently in a 9 Personal Year, in which case your next Personal Year will

S YOU CONTINUE READING THIS BOOK ON THE SECRET MEANING OF

DAILY SYMBOLS IN YOUR LIFE—YOUR DIRECT LINE TO

passages.content:

everywhere and, as you can see—easy to understand. So, paying attention

* Is it an overall fortunate vibration?
* If yes, does the vibration resonate with one of your Three Important

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:

influence?
Address numbers have different effects on your life, so it is important to
understand how your address affects you, whether it is your personal
address or business address. This knowledge alone will have a major effect
on your daily life. You’ll be able to know which addresses keep you in the
flow, with minimal challenging interference and distractions—and just as
importantly, which do not.
In any address that impacts your life, only the number is important to you.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You do not need to calculate the street name. The only instance where a
letter will be considered as part of the calculation process is when a letter
appears in your actual address number, such as 555 Cedar St., #9H.
Let’s look at variations of addresses you may encounter in your life: First
write down the number of your address.
1. For a simple street address, without an apartment number, simply
write down the number.
If you live at 4816 Main St., write down 4816.
Add all the numbers until you can bring the total down to a single-
digit “root” number:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The address number for this property is 1.
2. If you live in an apartment or condo, you must calculate both the street
number of your whole building and the unit number of your condo
separately. Your building number is of lesser importance than the unit
number—since only the unit number is unique to you. The unit
number is your personal address vibration.
The address number for this unit is 7. We already know that 4816
Main St. adds up to a “root” number of 1. But 7, the unit number, has
the greatest influence on the inhabitant(s). Number 1 for 4816 Main

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
3. For addresses with letters, you must add the numeric value for the
letter with and without the equivalent number value of the letter.
An address of 32 Apple Dr. #8B would be added:
Without the Letter B this address also vibrates to number 8. So this
condo unit activates both the numbers 1 and 8. It is important to
calculate both versions—with and without the letter—whenever a
number and letter are present. Thus, look at the number as a
standalone vibration and the total of the number and letter.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
HOW YOUR ADDRESS ALIGNS WITH YOUR BIRTH CODE
Look at all the single-digits that make up your Three Important Birth
Figure out which of the three triads they resonate to (chapter 3).
If one of your Three Important Birth Numbers is activated by your

However, you still need to check whether your address activates a
“challenging” vibration. Even if it resonates with you, it may attract

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)

REMEDIES FOR CHALLENGING ADDRESS NUMBERS (AND
HOW TO ALIGN THESE TO YOUR SOUL BIRTH CODE)
If an address number is either challenging or not in harmony with one of
your birth numbers, there is an easy remedy to diminish a challenging
address and infuse it with a secondary positive vibration.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Place a number inside the front door—anywhere on the door, but it must
be inside the main door of the residence or office—thus facing into the
home.
This number is added to the single-digit address number.
Make sure the new digit double-digit and single-digit address number
resonates with one of the Three Important Numbers in your Birth Code.
Make sure the number is positive and is not listed in the “Avoid” section.
For example, if you live in a 12 home (which is in the “Avoid” section
under 3 addresses), you want to add the root number 3 (12 = 1 + 2 = 3) to a

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
single-digit for which the new sum reduces to a number that supports you.
Let’s say you would like to add a secondary positive vibration that
reduces to 6. Add a 3 to the existing 3 (3 + 3 = 6). Place a 3 inside the
front door to your home or office or condo and start benefitting from the
fortunate secondary influence of a 6 address in your life.
Keep in mind, the dominant address vibration will still be 12 (which
reduces to 3). However, now you have diluted the influence of this
challenging address number by placing a 3 inside the front door, thus
creating a new secondary positive influence of number 6.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
NY DOUBLE LETTER IN A NAME OR DOUBLE NUMBER IN A BIRTHDAY OR
CURRENT CYCLE MAGNIFIES THE ENERGY, creating an intensity that needs to
have a way to resolve. This is a good thing—a call to action to step up in
your area of expertise or area of learning. Either way, you are expanding
your influence on your life.
Your birth name and current name (which can often differ from your
birth-certificate name) may carry additional unique qualities. Let’s look
now at intensifications—the impact of numbers or letters that are repeated
—a powerful magnification of a lesson and message.
DOUBLE LETTERS, INITIALS, LETTER INTENSIFICATIONS

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Intensifications in names come in three forms:
1. Letters that are doubled within a single name.
2. Initials in which the same letter is repeated.
3. A higher than average occurrence of a specific letter in our name.
If you are born with an intensification in your birth name, it has a
lifelong impact. If it occurs in a current name that you have chosen, the
impact lasts while you use that name.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
1. A double letter appears when you have two consecutive letters within
one name that are the same. For example my last name, “Gabrielle,”
has a double L. The name “Madonna” has a double N, “Brad Pitt” has
a double T, “Eckhart Tolle” has a double L, “Deepak Chopra” has a
double E, “Emma Thompson” has a double M, and “Johnny Depp”
has both a double N and a double P.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
2. Another way that a letter can carry a deep impact on your life is when
any of the letters in your initials are repeated. Examples of this are
Hay House and Howard Hughes (HH) (HH), Wayne W. Dyer
(WWD), Daniel Day-Lewis (DDL), Steven Spielberg and Susan
Sarandon (SS), Calvin Coolidge (CC), Ronald Reagan and Robert
3. The final way a letter carries a deeper impact is when it appears more
often than average in your birth name. If you have more than the
average of letters in any group, that is an intensification.

birth-certificate name:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You must stay active! Your mind is filled with ideas, and movement to
fulfill your goals is vital for your well-being. When you feel stimulated by a
project you can go for it with boundless energy reserves. You know how to
start but not necessarily how to complete (unless you have other prominent
letters or initials that signify completion). You can make decisions quickly
—and if you don’t, you will feel out of sorts. You have the courage to stand
up for yourself and are very independent. Leadership fits you like a glove.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When you can express your highly innovative and original ideas, you are
most happy. Guard against self-centeredness, arrogance, single-mindedness
to the point of excluding others, and aggression.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You know how to cooperate and often provide a soothing peaceful presence
for others. You are highly sensitive (which can easily get your feelings
hurt). For this reason you want to be accepted and liked by others and may
go beyond your comfort zone to please. Practice not taking criticism
personally and focusing on the facts, not your worries or fears. Receiving
emotional reassurance, even through human touch (a hug, the holding of
your hand), imbues you with joy and confidence. You may need a partner to
feel comfortable moving forward, unless you have a strong presence of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
number 1 or 8 letters in your birth name. You can adapt easily to people and
change.
You are very artistic and must have a way to express yourself creatively.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Explore all there is to explore regarding writing, music, dance, or art. You
crave creating something with your life that brings beauty and joy and
uplifts others in some way. You tend to be romantic. Guard against
distractions and spending time on frivolous things. You may have a
tendency to scatter your creative energy by focusing on too many
endeavors. Your natural sweet nature and childlike qualities may at times
turn into childishness—this is when you act irresponsibly and don’t stick to
your daily routines and goals. You like to talk or write—it’s your way of
sharing feelings. Watch overspending without regard to a set budget.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You actually enjoy work and have tremendous self-discipline. People can
rely on you to deliver. Manifestation and implementation are your gifts.
Having a plan, schedule, or routine suits you well. You tend to overprepare
so as not to loose control—including spending an inordinate amount of time
getting ready for a social occasion. Try not to get to caught up in the details.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Also guard against rigidness. Having an achievement or goal to focus on
will allow you not to get stuck in a rut, as you might lock yourself into a
relationship or career that is no longer elevating your life. Keep your life
flowing and be open to new ideas and different ways of seeing things.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Change and adapting to new conditions is natural for you. You are fun
loving and need your freedom above all else. You enjoy traveling and being
in the media spotlight. If you don’t have a project to focus on, you can get
restless and be prone to irritability. You are very sensual and need an outlet
for your natural sensuality. Guard against multitasking and losing the
original thread of your daily or overall goal. When you feel passionate
about something—whether it is a product or performance—you know how
to “sell” it to anyone no matter what your profession is. Be sure to exercise

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
so you can release some of your restless energy. You have an innate sense of
humor—use it to see the humor in all of life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are devoted to family and love to nurture others. You are highly
sensitive to energy and aesthetics and feel best when your environment is
beautiful and the relationships in your life are all harmonious. Disharmony
will distract you from your mission to love and uplift with grace and
gratitude. Being of service is a natural for you; however, you must guard
against giving too much at the expense of your own well-being. Having a
secure, lovely home is vital to your happiness—you love to decorate and
make everything beautiful. Be careful about taking control to the point of
meddling in other people’s lives.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
This intensification enhances your ability to analyze and research subjects
with great depth and beyond any boundaries. Your concentration goes a
long way in allowing you to understand and retain knowledge. Practicing
some kind of meditation is important for your well-being. You may get too
“into your head”—the abstract entices you yet needs to be balanced with
heart-centered feelings—trust your intuition! You like to ask a lot of
questions (which may irritate others) and need alone time to process your
tangential discoveries. Guard against isolating yourself and coming off as a
“know-it-all.” Due to your highly sensitive nature, any enhanced substances
(drugs, alcohol) are not recommended. Your highly distinct body of work
has the potential to transform people.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are highly motivated to accomplish a body of work that brings you
influence and financial security. You have a very strong will, and your
powerful aura has a major impact on people when you walk into a room.
Guard against overpowering others and coming off as authoritarian, or
being impatient and judgmental with those who are slower to understand.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You desire to make a change in the world—be sure to pay attention to
changing yourself as well. You do best when in a leadership position and
can leave behind a lasting legacy. You desire quality and will strive to
secure the highest possible outcome. Overcoming obstacles strengthens
your resolve to succeed.
“If you are born with an intensification in your birth name, it has a
lifelong impact. If it occurs in a current name that you have

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
chosen, the impact lasts while you use that name.”
You love to serve from a place of unconditional love and wisdom. Clearing
old cobwebs—past patterns of behavior and outdated paradigms—is your
specialty. You reach beyond personal love—and activate universal
compassion. Forgiveness is one of the keys to your inner peace and
happiness. You are a humanitarian, sharing resources and being of service
for a higher purpose. Guard against wanting to “save the world” and
helping others at the expense of dissipating your own energy and resources.
You have an innate artistic nature and must have a way to create and use
your powerful imagination.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
In chapter 2 you learned how to assign each letter in your given birth name
to a number. Did you happen to notice if there was any number from 1 to 9
that was missing? Most people do not have all nine numbers represented in
their birth name. If you notice one or more numbers that are not
represented, check out the meaning of your missing number below.
First, turn to your birth name again. Assign each letter to the
corresponding number.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you are missing a number, discover the effect it may have on your life
—and how you have been given a wonderful opportunity for growth in this
area! Also, keep in mind, if one of the numbers missing in your name is

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
prominent in your Birth Code (Day of Birth or Life Purpose Number), the
impact is greatly lessened or even completely negated.
Missing the 1 vibration is unusual and indicates you can be more interested
in others’ welfare than in yourself. You will be prompted to assert yourself,
be courageous, be more independent, and make your own decisions. You
have a naturally lovely nature and must stand your ground when around
strong-willed people.
Don’t waste any energy on what others may think of you. Be self-
confident and promote yourself. Trust in your ability to make good
judgments. Have the courage to act on your strong convictions.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Missing the 2 vibration indicates you must practice cooperating with others
as you refine your listening skills. Being tactful and caring and exhibiting
the utmost patience are often required in order to come to a resolution or be
able to proceed. You may need to stay in the background and learn to be
part of a team. Be sensitive to other people’s emotional states and needs.
You will find yourself in situations where patience, peace of mind,
conflict resolution, and attention to details are required in order to achieve
your goals.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Missing the 3 vibration can indicate your lack of experience with fun and
spontaneous creativity. Lightening up and seeing the humor in life will
allow your inner child to express your innate joy and passion. You truly
yearn to freely express your happiness in all that you say and do, so use
your imagination without placing any boundaries! Focus on staying positive
—you are here to explore how to play. Do things “just for the fun of it.”
Missing the 4 vibration means you need to establish a methodical and
disciplined approach to your life. Structure is vital to your success.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Otherwise you will feel like you are drifting, and results will be fleeting and
few. If you focus and use discipline you will be able to master your gifts at
the highest levels. Apply yourself through diligent work. A combination of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
concentration and order will enable you to express and foster your natural
talents.
Missing the 5 vibration is seldom found in Western names, since letters E
and/or N are usually present. You may have a dislike of crowds and a desire
to be left alone. Learn to embrace change. Adapting to new circumstances
will be important in your life. Guard against being rigid and inflexible.
Trust and have faith. You will learn a great deal through experience and
embracing freedom. Communicating your thoughts and feelings needs to be
practiced.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Missing the number 6 may mean committing to long-term relationships is
more challenging. You need to learn to show your true emotions. You may
need to take on extra family responsibilities, which broaden your
understanding of responsibility and nurturing. You may feel isolated and
lonely yet not understand why. Instead of being guarded in your
relationships, open up your heart, and you will discover the magic of
feeling deep compassion and love.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Missing the 7 vibration means you may not naturally want to look more
deeply at issues or understand the “why” and “hows” of life. Your interest
in underlying motives and reasons or asking questions to get more
information is not as strong. You may be less cautious than others and less
prone to analyze. One of your lessons is to have faith and to trust. At times
you may not to trust yourself and others. You are here to rediscover the
power of your immortal soul and to trust that Source is your home.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Missing the 8 vibration means you are highly independent. The number 8
can, surprisingly, be missing even in the names of highly successful people.
No 8s can signify less strain about finances in the long run and more
support coming from others who will step in and help you achieve your
goals. Or you may just not make financial abundance and power a major
focus in your life. You are less likely to want to take a leading role.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Missing the 9 is rare and means you are learning about human nature and
may be asked to feel more compassion, tolerance, and understanding for
others. Experiences will ask you to expand your heart-center and connect
and engage emotionally. You have great potential to influence your own
destiny and the destiny of others once you stop withholding energy to help
people.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Each letter in the alphabet forms an image. This image is drawn with either
straight lines, curved lines, or a combination of both. Most people have two
or three initials—the first letters of their names. As you know, every letter is
also a number with a powerful symbolic meaning. But what about the shape
of the first letters of your name? The image of your initials reveals even
more about your disposition and approach to life.
Now we will delve deeper into the sacred geometry of letter images,
since they reveal hidden information about the quality of every letter—and
how it affects your life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The first letter of each of your names is always capitalized. This
brings extra attention, and thus the impact and influence on your life is
enhanced as well.
Are the first letters of your names both curved and straight? For
example, the letters B, G, J, and R have both curves and straight lines.
Or are all the letters straight lined only, such as M, T, A, and Y?
Or do you have capital letters that are all curved, like the letters S, O,
and C?
Straight-lined initials give you an intense ability to focus on your goals.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Many accomplished athletes have this combination. Having only
straight-line initials means you are more stubborn and rigid—single-
mindedly focused on your goals. You like to be perfect. You have the
discipline and drive to accomplish any task you set your mind on.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Shows flexibility and openness. You are multitalented. However, you can
get distracted more easily. You are highly creative and must have a
consistent outlet for self-expression.
7 COMBINATION CURVED AND STRAIGHT-LINE LETTERS
Combination letters bring balance, flexibility, and focus—all in one
package.
These letters give you the ability to see all sides. Many politicians have
this combination so they can appease a broader group of followers and get
elected. For the same reasons, high-profile Hollywood stars and musicians
benefit from this combination as well.
DIFFERENCE BETWEEN YOUR BIRTH AND CURRENT NAME

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
In chapter 2 you discovered how to calculate your birth-certificate name
and arrive at your Destiny Number. You cannot change this number—it is
your Birth Code. Just as you can’t change your birthday, birth time, or birth
place.
(If you are adopted and your birth name is officially changed on your
birth certificate before 6 months of age, you will take on your new adopted
name as your Destiny Number.)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Whereas you only have one birth name, current names can change a few
times in the course of a lifetime, sometimes through marriage and other
times through choice. Many people have more than one current name—they
use a middle initial in some areas (like bank accounts or credit cards) and
not others, or they have a nickname that is used with friends and family and
another name professionally. (Remember, any time you change a letter, add
a letter, or subtract a letter your whole name frequency changes—it is a
matter of math.)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Current names are a unique, separate branch of numerology. They are
calculated using a very complex set of rules and a completely different

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
numerology alphabet—the Chaldean system. The impact of your current
name on your life is completely different as well. It does not describe you in
any way; however, your current name number does show how easy or
challenging it is for you to fulfill your birth promise. There is not enough
space in this book to cover the intricate rules on how to check and change
current name vibrations. Discover all there is to know about current names,
including how to create fortunate names for personal and business use, in
Discover the “Secret Power of Your Name.” Go here to learn more:
numerosvision.internal

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Once you begin playing with and paying attention to numbers, you may
notice how certain numbers appear more frequently in your life—and in the
codes for the people closest to you. This is no coincidence! All energy
aligns to similar vibrational frequencies.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You can notice this often in families. There may be one number that
many family members share. Or a “family of numbers” appears over and
over again, like 3-6-9 or 2-4-8 or 1-5-7. This is a spiritual DNA numerology
code that links families to each other. I have seen each parent share a
different number with their child—for example the child has an 11/2 and 6,
and one parent shares the 11/2 and the other the 6, forging a connection.
Sometimes certain children align more closely to one parent, and you can
see that in their Birth Code.
You’ll notice how you will share certain numbers with your close friends
or colleagues.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
ANY PEOPLE REPEATEDLY SEE 11:11 AT UNEXPECTED TIMES. Or notice
patterns such as 3030 or 5566 and sequences like 1-2-3-4 and 3-6-9. Every
number that appears in your life is a nudge to listen—Source is engaging
with you! Universal language is expressed through symbols and numbers,
so you are constantly receiving messages from Spirit.
Take note of any sequences when you happen to see them. Once you pay
attention at the moment they catch your eye, you’ll notice that codes engage
with you all day long! In our digital age the presence of numbers opens the
door to continual communication with the divine.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Let’s discover how to interpret number sequences—so you can start
receiving messages from Spirit!
PATTERNS AND SEQUENCES: CREATING MOMENTUM
The meaning of patterns, such as 3030 or 5566, and sequences, such as 1-
Whenever you notice a pattern or sequence, the universe is sending you
a message. Patterns exist in nature, in geometry, in music. You can’t help
but pay attention to a rhythmic pattern, color code, or number’s sequence—
your mind is being elevated and your soul inspired to listen.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
In chapters 3 and 4 you discovered the meaning of each individual digit
from 1 through 9 and the Master Numbers (11, 22, 33, etc.). Keeping the
meanings of these numbers handy, let’s look at a few common sequences
and patterns that will help you decipher future sightings with ease.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Whenever you see a consecutive numbers sequence, such as 1–2–3–4 or 2–
4–6–8 or 9–8–7, momentum is generated. Momentum is a powerful call to
action. Movement creates direction—thus a sequence is always moving
somewhere.
Any sequence can be continued, sometimes in both directions! So, when
you notice a sequence, you are being called to follow through on an idea,
insight, project, or conversation—whatever has been appearing in your life
at the moment that you see the sequence needs your passionate devotion
and supreme attention.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When the number sequence rises upwards, as in 4–7–10–13, you are
gathering steam, lifting into a higher vibration, getting energized. Looking
at the first and last number in the particular sequence 4–7–10–13, notice
that the sequential pattern is created as the numbers rise up by a count of 3
—symbolizing creativity, self-expression, and joy. Look even closer and
notice the first and last numbers in this pattern—4 and 13. Number 13 can
be reduced to a “root number” of 4 (13 = 1 + 3 = 4). So the number 4
figures at the beginning and end of this 4–7–10–13 sequence, and that
means an intensification of the number 4 must also be taken into account.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
4 stands for getting organized, making a step-by-step plan, implementing
a more disciplined approach, and thinking outside the box—while
maintaining boundaries. In this case the rising nature of the sequence
inspires you to take your creative self-expression and apply it to an
endeavor that makes you happy while making sure you follow through
with a plan of action that brings security and stability. This will enable
your life to rise up to a higher level of well-being. As a result, a greater
fulfillment naturally propels your goals and energizes you.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When the number sequences go downwards, as in 27–25–23, you are
pivoting in a new direction and changing course in some way as a result of
letting go of a past idea, behavior, or decision. So pay attention to insights,

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
synchronicities, and clues on how you are to proceed next. A downward
motion indicates the energy is slowing down to help you gain wisdom about
what has transpired. This “relaxing” of energy allows you to take a moment
to breathe and reflect so you can make an inspired, informed decision on
how to proceed. A falling sequence is a call to review and release—
readying you vibrationally so you are energized for the next lift off!
This is very similar energy to when a planet is retrograding in astrology.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Once you know the meaning of the number or planet that is in a “reflect and
review” motion, you can recognize, assimilate, and apply it into your life
with greater ease and grace.
In the example 27–25–23, the numbers are falling by a value of 2. Make
note of this whenever there is a pattern. Number 2 adds an important
message to the story line, of bringing something into balance,
communicating with another, and creating harmony and peace through
cooperation, sensitivity, and kindness.
All sequences indicate movement in a very clear direction. Make sure
that you assimilate and interpret …
1. The meanings of the individual numbers

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
2. The value number of the sequence (is it going up or down by 1, 2, 3,
etc.?)
3. The upwards or downwards direction message
If the numbers rise or fall without a discernable pattern, such as 5–7–11,
note the direction of the sequence (rising or falling) and read the specific
meanings of the numbers involved.
Occasionally you will see a sequence that is composed of an up and a down
numerical pattern.
In this case there is a 5-8-11 pattern merged with a 2-3-4 pattern. Since
both individual sequences are moving upwards, this would still be
considered mainly a rising sequence with some additional downward
“release and review” energy added.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Whether one single number repeats two or more times (such as 555, 77,
660, 3388) or the repeated numbers are embedded around or within other
numbers (as in 3772, 884, 19980), repeated number patterns create an
intensification of a specific number. Its corresponding meaning is always
enhanced and very significant to you.
Intensifications are clearly designed to grab your attention through
repetition! Anything you experience more than once has a greater likelihood
to stick.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When you notice a repetition of any number, first look up what the
meaning of that number is. If the pattern is defined but just one number,
such as in 555, 88, or 220, then look up the meaning of the digit, and you’ll
get a clear message of how one area in your life is being intensified.
(Remember that 0 is not a value; however, 0 will enhance any sequence or
pattern.)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you notice a repetition of the number 555, for example, it is an
indication of change, a possible unexpected turn of events, a quick decision,
and an invitation to take that risk, be more adventurous, and explore greater
freedom and independence. On the other hand, seeing multiples of 8, such
as 88, places a strong emphasis on gaining more courage, stepping into
leadership, focusing on manifesting abundance, paying attention to
financial flow, overcoming obstacles, or manifesting your vision.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When you see an intensification of a number while it is embedded with
one or more other numbers, look at the meaning of the repeated number
first. Then check the meaning of all other numbers (that are not doubled up)
to add an additional layer of understanding.
Going back to our 555 example: If the pattern is changed to 5554, then
the overall freedom and adventure experience is the most important, with an
added message that in claiming independence and taking a risk, you will
ultimately also experience security, plus the process may require greater and
more meticulous attention to detail.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
In another example, the difference in changing 88 to 2880 means your
financial abundance or big vision is expanded through one-on-one
communication, relationships, and creating more balance in some area in
your life.
As you begin “speaking the language” of the single digits (chapter 3) and
the double-digit Master Numbers (chapter 4), you’ll discover a wonderful
new modality, a language of the soul. Decisions will be easier, insights

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
instantaneous, and inspiration accessible at any time. Interpreting the
symbolic language of the universe will open vaults of wisdom—answers
will be there, at your service, at all times of day and night!
Any combination of 1-5-7, as in 571 or 715, including with and without 0,
such as 1750, will activate the meaning of the 1-5-7 Mind Triad (see
chapter 3).
Any combination of 2-4-8, as in 482 or 824, including with and without
0, such as 8042, will activate the meaning of the 2-4-8 Manifestation Triad
(see chapter 3).
Any combination of 3-6-9, as in 693 or 936, including with and without

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
0, such as 6309, will activate the meaning of the 3-6-9 Creativity Triad (see
chapter 3).
11:11—ENTER THROUGH THE PORTAL OF TIMELESSNESS
Most likely you’ve experienced seeing 11:11 on a digital clock. Something
happens in that moment—like waking up from a deep sleep, seeing 11:11
stops you in your tracks, even for a split second, and you feel suspended
somehow. Waking from a dream can leave you feeling bewildered … as if
you are in between two worlds, hovering. Something is crystal clear, vividly
alive for just a moment.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When the double 11:11 portal appears, you may feel suspended in time
—a wondrous floating sensation of momentary timelessness. It’s a
connection that is undeniable, and hard to describe, because it transcends
our human mind—it feels otherworldly. Anytime you step through a door
into another room or building or garden, you enter a new zone—literally or
symbolically your space has changed. Stepping over any threshold
translates into an internal shift.
At the moment 11:11 appears, you cross a threshold and forge a
connection.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
As you learned in chapter 4, the number 11 is a gateway aligning your
heart with the love of God. So, anytime you experience the 11:11, it is an
open invitation from the universe, your spiritual guides, the angelic realms,
to listen up and tune in, because a divine message—however small—is
asking for your attention!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The momentary suspension when you see 11:11 hovers in “no time” (a
reminder that you are never separate from God). You feel in that instant at
one with the universe. There is no past, no future. All you know is the
present moment—all else is unknown—and not important. This is the
major gift of 11:11—that the past and future are no longer on your mind and
of interest anymore. You are set free to experience life the way it is meant to
be experienced, without worry and without projection. True living only
happens right now.
“In our digital age the presence of numbers opens the door to
continual communication with the divine.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
You are ultimate stillness and ultimate motion at once. You are yin and
yang—everything and nothing—the ultimate expression of the 11 portal
experience.
Anytime you are witness to 11:11, it is a spiritual wake-up call to
embrace the unexpected. All inspiration comes from this unknown space—
an infinite void of pure, pulsating potential. Creation is born in this void.
Worry does not exist here—as worry is a projection of past experiences (the
known) into the present (the unknown). So 11:11 beckons you to wake up to
now—where fear is nonexistent.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
The illusion of separation from divine Source ends the moment you trust
in its eternal presence in your life.
One thing is certain: It’s not possible to go back once you’ve crossed the
threshold. Like life or death, once you cross into another realm of existence,
your experience cannot be erased or reversed. In the same way, the insights
and illuminations, small and large, that you receive upon seeing 11:11 leave
a lasting internal awakening.
The letter values of the word “light” add up to 29, which reduces to 11 (29
= 2 + 9 = 11). 11 is the number of light; 11:11 magnifies the light of truth in
your life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When you see 11:11, light is illuminating an issue in your life, shining
the light in darkness, enlightening you with inspiration … In order to walk
through the two pillars, you must leave everything behind—all preconceived

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
ideas, beliefs, suppositions, expectations, worries, fears, the past—and
embrace the only constant: eternal life and timelessness.
As you fully immerse your energy into now, many doors will start to
open. As you realize you are never alone, your confidence soars. You accept
your true divine origin. You feel invincible. Because you are! You have
reconnected with our true self at soul level.
There is no greater serenity. No greater joy!
All pain, sorrow, confusion, envy, anger, hatred, fear, and jealousy is
transmuted when you surrender to the 11:11 present-moment experience.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
In the human experience we need contrast to appreciate the diversity of
life. Contrast allows us to recognize and discern what we want. We need to
experience loneliness to appreciate oneness, sadness to appreciate joy, dark
to recognize light, war to choose peace, aggression to feel the gift of
kindness. 11:11 reminds you: The only thing that matters is that you are
connected to all of life as an expression of divinity itself. There is no
judgment in this place of love. No good or bad. There is just life itself …
the passion for living fully.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Even as others may still judge you (and you them), you are set free of
personalizing their issues with you when you live in this eternal space—and
you will not take their judgments to heart. Your heart is now cleansed, as
you begin to realize that judgment is only a projection born of ignorance—a
lack of understanding. No one can cross the threshold with you; no one has
walked in your shoes.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
11:11 reminds you that you are an eternal flame, and to yourself only
shall you be true. Let others be. Love them, forgive them, be kind to them—
but you focus only on how you can rise to any occasion. A life of rising is a
life lived fully and exquisitely.
Engaging consistently with your internal light (through your living soul
code and your guides) is how you access and activate abundance.
If you are self-conscious and not actually fully present, you’re only half
aware—pretending to be fully there. Yes, you can function—you can
answer, you can respond—but you are not fully tuned into your heart and
soul through intentional listening.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When you open up completely, with no strings attached—stepping
through the 11 gateway by risking everything to be fully present—you

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Abundance manifestation cannot be separated from the rest of your life.
Many find this concept challenging … What you do and feel and say every
day is how you do and say and feel about everything else. 11:11 invites you
to play like a child would, to explore and enjoy the act of creating your life
every moment of your day. To live in prosperity, with joyful anticipation,
the internal and external must align. Your feelings and intentions must be in
sync—be one and the same. This is the key to money manifestation. Clear
all your resistance and emotional debris, and you create room for the
universe to bring you abundant gifts.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
If you don’t feel in balance with money, in harmony with financial flow,
you cannot easily generate it. Inner fulfillment enriches you on all levels.
In this beautiful space fear is magically absent. You can’t get attached to
the past or worry about future outcomes when you are totally engaged with
what’s in front of you. 11:11 is a reminder of your constant connection to

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
All the abundance you could ever imagine already exists. The universe is
expanding constantly. There is no lack of good fortune and prosperity. Reset
your inner palate to vibrate at a highly positive frequency and watch your
natural, childlike passion create magical outcomes.
DECODING 11:11—CREATING CONSCIOUS MANIFESTATION
A mathematical view of 11:11 reveals more about this profound spiritual
activation:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
2 is the number of balance, peace, connection, tenderness, sensitivity,
and awareness. 2 represents loving communication with another. It can be
two people, or you and an entity, or an intimate conversation as you listen
to guidance from your inner voice, your intuition. In its highest expression,
2 facilitates communication with the divine realms.
2 + 2 represents the lines of communication between you and the
universe. The first 2 is you listening to your intuition, and the second 2 is
you experiencing a connection with Spirit.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Adding the single-digits of 11:11 results in the number 4 (1 + 1 + 1 + 1 =
4). 4 is the symbol of making your ideas real—manifestation into physical
reality. Thus embedded in every 11:11 experience is the urge to make your
inspirations manifest. You are consciously applying the subtle message
(received in a moment of timeless suspension) … into action.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Think of it another way. When you are engaged in an activity that fulfills
you to the core, time flies, right? You’re in love with what you are creating
or doing, and it’s as if time doesn’t exist at all. Now, imagine if you could
bring that quality to your everyday life. When you live every moment with
conscious awareness, no matter how mundane it may seem to you at the
time, and you engage fully with the task at hand or the person you are
talking to, then division and separation end. You stop feeling divided, torn,
and incomplete.
11:11 says to you: The universe has your back! The force is with you!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Trusting your hunches is inspiration, being one with Spirit. Inspiration
means “in spirit.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
In these fast-paced and hectic times, the volume of information we need
to navigate day in and day out is astonishing. We are inundated with news,
sounds, interruptions, endless to-do lists and distractions—an overload of
stimuli overwhelming our nervous systems. Being too stimulated can get
you out of sync, exhausted, and unfocused, and then it’s easy to get
ungrounded, untethered, and imbalanced. You’ll know right away, because
you start to take things personally. Emotional overwhelm results in
partaking in unnecessary drama, as you separate from Source only to feel
alone, unsupported, and unloved.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
When you find yourself in this state, invoke the 11:11 code.
* Visualize the 11:11 on a big screen in front of you (choose a serene
color). or write 11:11 down on a piece of paper.
* Inhale deep, long breaths for a few minutes while visualizing the 11:11
code.
* Enter the 11:11 portal.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
1. I am open to embracing the unexpected and seeing opportunity
everywhere.
3. I completely trust that everything occurring in my life is always for
my highest good and the highest good of others.
Feel free to visualize and set your intention while listening to beautiful
music. (I recommend classical music, as its beauty and complexity naturally
take you into heavenly spheres.) Bask your heart and soul in your vision as
you enter through the timeless 11:11 portal.
Now you are one with the universe. You can play!
Connect this way with Spirit anytime, anywhere.
11:11 is a tool, helping you create an instantaneous moment of
illumination.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)
passages.content:
Walk through the 11:11 gateway with no agenda … only a pure intention
to embrace joy. Now you are receptive to divine inspiration and can fill
your cup until it runneth over!
When you open up to endless possibilities—risking all to be present—
you unlock the secret to abundance and bliss.
Now go and manifest money, miracles and magic!
Keep aligning with Source through your soul code, listen for intuitive
prompts, and always be guided by love.

I thank Pythagoras, the great philosopher, musician, mathematician,

Massachusetts, while I was a student at the college. This book featured

passages.source: Numeros Vision Master Numerological Matrix (NV-MNM-03)

So much gratitude to my wonderful core team—Nancy, AJ, and Jelena—

Big thank-you to Jill Alexander for your support and encouragement!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content: Relationships and Characteristics of Numbers Table

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Numerology uses numbers as a key to human behavior. It is an easy-to-
learn method that exercises the mind’s intuitive faculty to fathom the depths
of human personality.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Numerologists have to forget their own identities and devote themselves
totally to exploring the personalities of others. They must learn to become
calm and empty before they are able to use their intuition. Practicing the art
of numerology creates endurance, patience, and pointedness. Experience
teaches numerologists more than books can teach. The information
contained in books only opens the windows of the mind. One then has to
work with one’s personal understanding of that information. Information
alone is not knowledge; direct experience must be added before information
becomes knowledge. Numerology is simple to learn and very engaging, like
the creative arts. It teaches one sympathy toward others.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
I advise my readers not simply to accept blindly the information that
follows. By observing their three numbers (psychic, destiny, and name) and
the relationship of these to the numbers of other people, they should
formulate their own language to explain what they understand. They should
remember: All numbers are both good and bad. No one number is superior
to any other. All numbers work differently through different human bodies,
each with its own genetic behavioral pattern. All numbers are influenced by
the unique qualities of their environment and by the collective unconscious.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
We can try to understand them, but we have no right to judge and categorize
them.
Numerology is a method of linking the microcosm with the macrocosm.
With practice, a numerologist starts to comprehend the influence of celestial
bodies on human understanding and conduct. All objects of the material
world are related to the nine planets.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
For a numerologist the planets become embodied in a human form, and
he or she can closely observe them as a part of the cosmic play.
Those people who do not allow themselves the freedom of seeing the
influence of the celestial and astral bodies cannot observe this play. Planets
for them are objects in outer space that have no influence on their physical
and mental make-up. To them all predictive sciences are useless. People
who have time, faith, and enough patience, however, can watch this play
and learn from it the lessons that will guide the consciousness of coming
generations.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Numerology is not a complete science. It is just one branch of the
predictive sciences. To be a good numerologist one must become a good
observer and a patient listener. Study of physiognomy and astrology is very
necessary. Numerology is much simpler than astrology and does not require
complicated mathematical calculations. There are just three things a
numerologist needs to know: the day of the month a person was born, the
numerological value of his or her popular name, and the person’s total birth
information (date, month, and year). From astrology, the numerologist
needs to know about all the zodiac signs, and a person’s day of birth, sun
sign, and moon sign. In India, the season during which a person was born
also has to be known, since that has an effect on one’s temperament. Certain
information from physiognomy needs to be learned as well, such as how the
shape and form of the various body parts correlate with an individual’s
thinking process. (It is known, for example, that the perceptual world of tall
people is different from that of short people.)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
The purpose of working with numbers is to save energy. People who act
without a proper understanding of the right moment to start a job waste a lot
of energy by making the wrong moves. Numerology provides the
knowledge for such things as how to select the right moment, the right
relationship, the right dwelling place—thereby saving energy.
Numerology must not be used to gain power and control over others.
Also, money should not be earned with this knowledge. Using one’s mind
to explore the personality of others for money alone will result in stress.
Through the selfless use of numerology, one earns good karma.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Simply guessing what number a stranger is could be fun, but it is more
fun to know how to practice numerology. By asking someone his or her
date of birth, one can then find out what sort of person he or she could be.
This exercise is also a good mind game. On one hand, it makes students of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
numerology use their memory (their numerological information bank) and
their intuition; on the other, it makes them stay in the present and pay
proper attention to the person in question. The student becomes free from
his or her little world and launches an adventurous trip into a new
personality.
Through numerology, all the aspects of life in various forms are explored.
The student sees how planets act differently within different people. The
study of this science requires that one have the alertness and openness of an
explorer—it also brings with it the joy that follows a successful exploration.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Having knowledge of the numbers and a good memory can save much
energy and time. A keen interest in numerology can work to enhance
memory and pointedness; it can also promote the intuitive faculty of the
mind.
The advice that accompanies the discussion of each number regarding
fasting or gemstones is based on Ayurvedic and Tantric knowledge.
Following the prescriptions given will help to create a better environment
for the microorganisms living in our bodies. As receptors of cosmic energy,
they serve to create harmony in our lives.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Thus, numerology can provide:
a better understanding of both our good and bad sides
a method of accepting our weaknesses, and those of others
a vehicle for discussing these weaknesses
a joyful way of passing time
freedom and escape from our own personal worries
a good focal point, or method of paying attention and getting attention
popularity and respect
a tool for entering into the unknown
friendly interactions.
To practice numerology, we develop:
the mind of a scholar researching life
the alertness of an explorer
a good memory and pointedness
an intuitive mind
good conversational skills.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
For a numerologist there are only nine numbers from which all calculations
of the material world are made. All numbers beyond 9 are repetitions. By a
simple method of addition, they can be reduced to single whole numbers.
The number 10 is not a whole number; it is simply a 1 with a zero.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Zero is not a number and has no numerological value. In the Western occult
tradition, zero is regarded as a symbol of eternity. It is surprising to learn
that the zero made its first entrance into the Western hemisphere only a few
hundred years ago. Its introduction helped considerably in the development
of mathematics, science, and modern technology. In the East, where it was
known from the dawn of civilization, the zero is known as Sunya (shoonya)
or the Void, which is the foundation stone of Buddhism. Zero has no value
when it is alone, because it is abstract and numbers are concrete. When zero
combines with a number, it gives birth to arithmetical progressions and the
series of double, triple, and multiple numbers, such as 10, 100, and 1000.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
When you do not know about zero, you cannot play with numbers beyond 9
(that is, beyond the material world). When you do know about it, its mystic
nature leads you towards eternity and impairs your material progress. Zero
is considered unfortunate. When a zero appears in a date of birth, it brings
misfortune. Even the tenth month of the year (October), being a 10, brings
misfortune, although to a lesser degree. The appearance of a zero in the year
of birth brings the least misfortune. The combination of zero with any
number reduces the influence of that number. People with a zero in their
birthdate numbers generally have to struggle harder than those without. The
presence of more than one zero—October (tenth month) 10, 1950—makes
one have to work even more in life. All numbers from 1 to 9 are present in
zero, and when zero combines with these numbers, a whole series of
numbers evolves. For example, when zero combines with number 1, the
numbers 11 through 19 that belong to that series evolve.1 The introduction
of zero aided the development of math, science, and the modern technology
that brought mankind to the computer age, but it does not “exist.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Numbers can be categorized into two basic groups:
Odd: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 and Even: 2, 4, 6, 8.
Odd numbers have an odd total; there are five of them. Even numbers
have an even total (four).
Odd numbers are solar, masculine, electrical, acidic, and dynamic. They
are additional (they add).
Even numbers are lunar, feminine, magnetic, alkaline, and static. They
are subtractional (they reduce). They remain without movement, because
they have an even group of pairs (2 and 4, 6 and 8). If we pair odd numbers,
one number always remains without a counterpart (1 and 3, 5 and 7, 9).

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
In general, two similar numbers (two odd numbers or two even) are not
very good.
even + even = even (static)
3 + 2 = 5
odd + odd = even (static) 3 + 3 = 6

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Some numbers are friendly; some are in opposition to each other. Their
relationships are determined by the relationships between their ruling
planets (see chart on pages 188-189). When two friendly numbers come
together, they are not very productive. Like two friends, they both relax and
nothing happens. But when enemy numbers come in combination, they
make each other alert and active; both people have to work more. Seen in
this way, enemy numbers are actually friends, and friendly numbers are
really enemies that stop progress and activity.
Neutral numbers remain inactive. They do not give any support nor do
they induce or oppose activity.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Number 6 is unique in that it is common to both odd and even numbers. It
can be the result of a combination of either 3 (odd) even numbers, or 2
(even) odd numbers. In 2+2+2=6, the even number 2 is repeated three
times, which is an odd number of repetitions. In 3+3=6, the odd number 3 is
repeated twice, which is an even number of repetitions.
Being common to both groups, number 6 is therefore known as a
“universal friend.”

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
There are nine single numbers. The relationship of numbers to planets is the
key to numerology. In the Hindu system, this relationship is the same as in
the West, with the two following exceptions. The number 4 in the Hindu
system corresponds to Rahu (the north node of the Moon), whereas in the
West this number is related to the Sun and Uranus. And the number 7 in the
Hindu system corresponds to Ketu (the south node of the Moon), whereas
in the West it is related to the Moon and Neptune. The nature or behavior of
a number comes from its ruling planet:
Sun 1 kinglike, kind, royal, disciplined,
authoritative, strong, original

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Moon 2 queenlike, royal, attractive, everchanging,
delicate
Jupiter 3 spiritual, counseling, friendly, self-
centered, disciplined
Rahu 4 rebellious, impulsive, short-tempered,
secretive
Mercury 5 princely, entertaining, wily, intelligent,
sensitive
Venus 6 romantic, slow, sensual, sweet spoken,
diplomatic, manipulative
Ketu 7 mystical, dreamlike, intuitive, inventive
Saturn 8 wise, malefic, servant-like, laborious,
struggling, suffering

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Mars 9 warlike, strong, rough, rustic, perfectionist,
doubting, fighting, alienating,
discriminating
Each individual is influenced by three numbers: psychic, name, and
destiny. The influence of these numbers is distinct from that of the nine
planets in the astrological houses. The influence of the Sun itself, for
example, changes depending on the house and the zodiac sign in which it is
posited in a natal chart. With the Sun sign change comes a change in one’s
behavior.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
In numerology, all psychic number 1 people have some characteristics of
that number (1), regardless of the month in which they are born. The
difference in month, Moon sign, Sun sign, and ascendant only changes their
attitude.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
All number 1 people have the same good days, dates, and years; they also
have the same colors, gems, deity, and mantra. By contrast, in astrology the
power of a planet, and therefore its ruling number, changes, depending on
the house it is in. For example, an exalted Sun posited in Aries sitting in the
eighth or twelfth house becomes fruitless, because it is posited in an
inauspicious house. The same Sun in Aries becomes great when posited in
the tenth house. Similarly, an exalted Saturn is not good in the first, fourth,
seventh, or tenth house, but is very good in the third, sixth, ninth, or
eleventh, and so on. Astrology is more precise than numerology. These
specific details help an astrologer understand the status of an individual.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Numerology is a more general study and covers only the behavioral aspect
of human personality. It has developed its own language that deals with
broad personality traits. But it is also simpler to learn than astrology. It
easily engages the mind without going into elaborate detail, such as
studying the movement of the planets. Numerology is a do-it-yourself
science.
Our mental make-up is directly related to the date, time, and place of our
birth—to that moment when we breathe air in for the first time from the
outer environment. It is sad that this moment starts with a cry instead of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
laughter. An astrologer gives a precise shape to this moment with a chart,
but for a numerologist the actual date of birth itself is enough.
The psychic number is obtained by making a simple whole number of the
date of birth. For example I was born on May 12 and since 1+2 equals 3,
my psychic number is 3.2
A person’s psychic number reveals the way the person looks at oneself.
The psychic number plays an important role in one’s choice of food, sex,
friendship, marriage, as well as one’s needs, ambitions, and desires. In

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Hindu astrology, the Moon sign is the sign of the psyche. In the Western
system, people try to understand the psyche through the Sun sign.
Numerology does not concern itself with a Sun sign, Moon sign, or
ascendant, but rather it approaches the individual directly through numbers.
As we have seen, however, numbers are related to the influence of planets
on behavior, ambitions, needs, and desires.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
The planetary influence affecting one’s psyche can be easily understood
by knowing the psychic number. This number remains active throughout
one’s life and is very powerful up to the age of thirty-five to forty. After
thirty-five the other significant number, which is called the destiny number,
becomes more active. One starts feeling a change in attitude. The psychic
number, however, never loses its importance. The psychic number can be
influenced by changing one’s name. It can also be influenced by education,
initiation, and marriage (by marrying someone whose influence changes
one’s mental make-up). The numerologist must know that each person has
two images: one’s self image and one’s image in the eyes of others—the
community, society, and world. The psychic number indicates what one
thinks about oneself; the destiny number indicates what the world thinks of
that person.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
The single whole number obtained from the addition of the date, month,
and year of birth is called the destiny number.
For example, I was born on May 12, 1934.
The 25 here must not be ignored, as the 2 and the 5 will have some effect
on one’s destiny. However, the 7 will be the dominant number. Of these

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
three digits, the 7 and the 2 play an important role, whereas the 5 will have
much less influence.
The destiny number is more important than either the psychic number or
name number. One always thinks in the same way, but destiny does not
always work the way one wants. Because destiny is more powerful after
thirty-five, one has to start compromising what one wants to have and to
achieve. The psyche is free to think, expect, and desire, but destiny brings
only what one really deserves. This is because destiny is related to one’s
past life karmas. In the Bhagavad Gita rendered by Veda Vyasa, Krishna
says to Arjuna:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
O, Arjuna, man is free to perform any kind of action, but there is no
freedom in getting the fruits of one’s karmas as one wants.
So one should become selfless—in performing actions, one should not
care about the outcome, the fruits. By not caring for the fruits of one’s
karmas, one gets beyond pleasure and pain. Pain is caused by attachment to
one’s karmas. Expectations are the real cause of pain. Up to the age of
thirty-five one learns this lesson. Then, to the extent that one gets away
from expectations and performs one’s duty for its own sake, one remains
happy. The destiny number is not subject to external influences.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
The destiny number is related to our samskaras—vibrational patterns
acquired by actions in past incarnations, or karmas. It allows us little
freedom of action, but much freedom in reaping the fruits of our past
karmas. Whatever we do now will be returned to us in the future or in our
next life; whatever fruits we are receiving now reflect what we have earned
in our past lives.
Life is a continuum. It is not a broken mosaic. Death is not the end. In
fact, there is no death. Death is a change from one pattern to another.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
Whatever we sow, we will reap. There is no getting away from the fruits of
our action, our karmas. The residue of my karmas, good or bad, come to me
as my debits or assets. Work done in a past life comes easily; work I have
not done before brings with it challenges and obstacles. Knowing this, my
mind and my attitude direct me on a natural life course, one through which I
can easily move. My past life karmas help me and come to me as friends,
gifts, rewards, and I am able to fulfill my duties. When I have done bad
karmas, the same efforts bring enmity, opposition, loss, and punishment.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
The fruits of my karma are according to their seeds, which I have sown in
my past lives. This friendship or enmity, unexpected reward or punishment,
is all the result of pastlife karmas—its cause cannot be traced in the present
life. The fruits of karmas performed in this life can create a good and
supporting environment for a person—in this case, the cause of the fruits
can be traced.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
When one’s destiny number is bad, a good psychic number, a good name
number, the use of gems, and donations to charity can create a congenial
inner environment. One will have to go through what destiny brings, but it
will be easy to bear. There are many stories of saints, and saintly beings,
who performed good karmas but had to face much opposition and suffering
during their lifetime. And, as well, there are many stories of bad people
who performed only bad karmas but lived happy and luxurious lives. These
stories point toward the destiny of these people: they performed good (or
bad) karmas in their past lives, and the good (or bad) karmas of this life did
not affect them. They either lived happily or miserably.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
This number is obtained by adding the numerological value given to the
letters of the popular name.
For example my popular name is Classical Ayurvedic Numerological Tradition. According to the
Unit System, the value of each letter is as follows:
The numerical value of my letters comes to 7.
In most cases, people are known by their first name or family name. The
numbers obtained from these two names are also important, but popular

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
name means the name with which one is identified in work—the full name.
So we find that three numbers are important:
first name number
family name number
full name or popular name number.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
The influence of these three numbers is experienced in three different
circumstances. The effect of the first name number is in whichever circle
one’s first name is used. The effect of the family name number is in
whichever circle one is called by that name. And the effect of the full name
number is in the area of official documents and business. Generally the full
name, which is used with the bank and on a driver’s license and passport, is
called the name number. But it does not always work out so simply. For
example, the name on my passport is Harish Chandra Vedic Tradition, but with the
bank and on my books I use the name Classical Ayurvedic Numerological Tradition. A small group of
people in India call me by my first name, Harish, and an even smaller group
of people call me Mr. Vedic Tradition. Since my popular name is Classical Ayurvedic Numerological Tradition, and
the numerical value of this name is 7, my name number will be 7. This is
the name I am most known by in my worldly dealings. (A considerably
larger group calls me Dada, which is a 1. However, since I do not use this
name on my books and official documents, my name number will remain

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
While the name number has a strong influence upon an individual life,
and it does affect the psyche, it has no influence over the destiny number.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Classical Ayurvedic Numerology Compendium (NV-ANC-04)
passages.content:
The name number plays a key role in one’s social life and marriage. This
is the reason it was popular to add the family name to the maiden name
after marriage. Adding the family name to the maiden name creates
harmony with the husband in the family name; the woman shares the
advantages of the new family name. Yet even though the addition of the
husband’s name can bring desired harmony, sometimes this addition can
change the woman’s name number into an enemy number, creating
problems in social relationships and business. Adding the family name
changes a woman’s identity and also influences her psyche. One should
check the proposed name number before adding or dropping a word or a
letter in a name. In some cases, this addition can bring good luck and
increase one’s happiness. The name number is very important for such
