passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
The repetitiveness of the 9th in the date of your birth is something very interesting. It
speaks of the way your life is supposed to go: one of compassion, creativity, and a
desire to influence the world positively.
Numerology is one very exciting way to get to know the deeper aspects of yourself
and why you are here. Knowing what the number 9 in your birth date means can be
the key to new understanding and insight about your personality and potential, and it
can be a doorway to a life of purpose and joy. So the next time you see the number
9, remember the power of its energy and what awesome potential it brings to you.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Numerology is ancient science that supposes to have deep insights about
personality, life path, and spiritual potential. Every number holds its vibrational
energy and has a meaning of its own, that consequently adds to the person's
development. There is something like "missing number" in numerology.
In the number 1 through 9 sequence, the missing number 1 is such a big deal. We
 will talk about what the missing number 1 in numerology is and how it impacts
different aspects of your life as well as ways you could overcome the challenges it
presents.
Understanding Numerology and the Missing Number 1

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Number 1 relates to such qualities as independence, leadership, ambition, creativity,
and confidence. It is the number of the first pioneer and gives a natural drive to be
number one or different from others. In the numerology chart, this number usually
points to a person who takes the initiative and has love for himself, his individuality,
and has a strong sense of self.
People who belong to a strong number 1 in their chart may reflect the qualities of the
leader, the originator of something new, and the founder of new ventures. They are
confident with their choices and have the natural instinct to lead.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
However, when number 1 is not present, then the qualities it undertones may be
more challenging to live by. A person may fail to express himself or herself as an
individual, or look for self-confidence, or take charge in special areas of life .
The Consequences of Not Having Number 1 in Your Life
If number 1 is missing from your birth chart, you would face issues related to self-
expression, leadership, and independence. Here's how this absence may affect the
other areas of your life:
1/ Challenge in Self-Confidence and Self-Esteem
One of the immediate effects of this missing number 1 is a lack of self-confidence.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Such people tend to have difficulties trusting either their abilities or decisions. They
might be constantly on the lookout for validation from others and feel insecure about
their talents or worth. This makes a person incapable of taking risks or pursuing
goals with conviction.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Most likely, if you suffer from low self-esteem, you will be reluctant to be different
because you will fear criticism or outright rejection. The fear of mistakes may well
prevent you from realizing your full potential.
Without the number 1, you'll lack that innate assertiveness and leadership quality,
and many times, you may struggle to start things. This could be a new project, any
passion, or making a decision. Sometimes, there might not be enough of a reason to
take action, but more often than not, you will sit back more often and wait for others
to take the lead or guide you along instead of trusting yourself to get things
underway.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
In professional fields, you tend to be hesitant to take up leadership positions or
express your opinion on matters that are of value. It also puts you in relationships
 where you avoid conflict and fail to express your needs and wants.
As for those individuals whose number 1 is missing, they usually find a problem
arising - inability to express independence. You may feel more comfortable simply
following the crowd rather than striking out on your own or looking to others to advise
you.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Dependence on others thus impedes personal development, subduing your sense of
frustration or powerlessness because you are not capable of finally embracing your
individuality.
Excessive reliance on others to support you may also mean that you fail to acquire
some of the skills and dence needed to handle life's trials alone.confi

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
The number 1 is very associated with ambition and goal setting and pioneering
spirits. If you don't have this number in your chart, then you might find it difficult to
 write clear aims or having the impulsion to pursue them. In that case, you may be
content staying within the status quo as long as you're happy with it.
Sometimes, this lack of ambition would mean missing out on the chance to move up
or grow personally and professionally. Unsubconscious striving to excel brings a
tendency to get stuck or unfulfilled in different aspects of life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Remedies for Missing Number 1
  Install the fountain or aquarium in the northern corner of the house.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Often try to follow the number 1 in every corner of your life, even in house
number, mobile number, and car number.
  Pray and worship the Surya Yantra to please the God of Number 1, the Sun,
and offer water to the Sun.
How to Deal with Problems of Missing Number 1
Although a deficiency of the number 1 in your birth chart creates problems for you, at
the same time, it is considered as an opportunity for development too, by knowing
and focusing on the regions related to this number. Thus, you can outsmart its
 weaknesses and boost your leadership, assertion ability, and also independence.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
By repeating daily affirmations, emphasize your self-worth and potential. Examples
include "I am confident and capable.".
Justify and imagine yourself doing well and in control of your life. This thought
experiment may help you feel bold enough to act in the real world.
Do tiny, scary things for yourself. Gradually, this will be enhanced with increased
confidence and courage.
Start by taking charge of small scenarios. Either it's to organize events, or perhaps
you're leading a small team at work; start as a leader.
Learn to Learn to trust your instincts and judgment. Become less dependent on
others in making decisions and in life in general.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Another area you may need to work on is independence if you have a missing
number 1. Start by finding those areas you feel too reliant on others for emotion,
finance, or professionally. Challenge yourself by learning new skills, setting
boundaries, and making decisions without needing constant approval.
This is going to make you take on new responsibilities or force you out of your
comfort zone but, with time, you will be more independent. Remember that true
independence is about not being that separate isolated individual but confident in
facing and tackling all life's challenges as if you're doing it alone.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Finally, overcome the inability to be ambitious by taking some time off to set clear
goals in life. Decide what you really want from life and in the both your personal and
professional settings. Then set specific, measurable goals for realizing your desires.
Break them down into actionable steps that you can check off along the way.
Having a clear vision for the future can help reignite your motivation and drive. Dwell
 with inspiring people who encourage you to engage with your passion and hold you
accountable for achieving your targets.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
In numerology, the missing number 1 implies difficulties in independence,
confidence, and positions as a leader. However, those obstacles also open up great
potential for growth. Work consciously to develop self-confidence, take on the
attitude of a leader, increase independence, and set high ambitions: that's how you'll
overcome the limitations of this numerical deficiency and accomplish your fulfillment.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Do not see the absence of the number 1 as some weakness but as a path toward
self-awareness and empowerment. This way, patiently put in work. Transform the
qualities of the number 1 into strengths and add those to both your personal and
professional life.

passages.content:

(If you're new to numerology, you might want to start with What is Numerology? How it
Numerology number is derived from an individual’s birthday hence it can be described as
your personal number numerology or it may also be referred to as the numerology number.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
This number harbors some information on what kind of personality one would develop in
addition to its associated future ramifications.
You can easily locate the numerology number, for example, the birth date September 1,
1984 just by concentrating on the day you were born. That’s the 1st day of September in this

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:

first day of September is made up of one digit, which is one (1) of the numerology numbers.
So, your numerology number is 1. Now, let’s explore what this number means.
(To understand this better, you might want to explore these three numbers: What is a Driver

What is a Kua Number? How to Calculate It)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:

any given calendar year, then it is most likely that your ruling planet happens to be the sun
and you belong to category Number 1! Here’s a closer look at their characteristics:

and like to be in control. They often find themselves in charge at school, at home, or
in their activities.
  Self-Reliance and Maturity: These individuals are very independent. They rely on
themselves and are often very mature for their age. They focus on their personal
growth and are good at making decisions on their own.
  Patience and Thoughtfulness: Even though they like to take charge, number 1s are
also patient. They don’t rush into things. They think things through and make careful
decisions, which helps them do well in life.
  Creativity and Innovation: Individuals who have 1 as their particular number
possess a high degree of creativity that stands out. The artistry stands out since they
are good at generating brand new ideas as well as answers. These kinds of
individuals are never pleased with unchanging surroundings that always call for new
advancements and advancements in their lifestyle.
  Resistance to Influence: Number 1s does not simply conform to the ways of others;
instead he/she/they chart their own course then there's no looking back from there it
may appear like they are obstinate yet on the other hand this implies that they are
being themselves.
  Areas for Improvement: Just like any other person, people who are number 1s also
have areas where they need improvement. They have to understand that there are
times when they simply must stop chasing after unattainable dreams and when it is
better to let someone else be in charge. Their desire for control often borders on
being pushy and conceited.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
In the future, number 1s will do well in jobs where they can be leaders and use their
creativity. Here are some careers that might be a good fit:
  Entrepreneurship: Number 1s might start their own businesses. They have the
vision and drive to make their own ventures successful and enjoy being their own
boss.
  Creative Fields: Jobs in art, media, and entertainment are great for number 1s.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Their creativity shines in these fields, and they enjoy bringing new ideas to life.
  Law and Marketing: These careers let number 1s use their strategic thinking and
communication skills. They can be persuasive and effective in these roles.
  Freelancing: Working as a freelancer can be perfect for number 1s. It gives them the
flexibility to work on different projects and maintain control over their work.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
In love, number 1s are just as dynamic as in other areas of life. They like to take charge,
 which can sometimes cause problems if their partner also likes to lead. But their dedication
and loyalty make them great partners.
  Dominance and Compatibility: Number 1s like to be in control, which can be tricky
if their partner also wants to lead. Relationships with other number 1s can lead to
power struggles. However, pairing with numbers 3, 5, or 6 can be better because
these numbers balance out the strong traits of number 1s.
  Dedication and Loyalty: When it comes to their commitment, number ones are
usually very dedicated and give their all. Nonetheless one may get consumed by
their work and forget to show love and attention to one's spouse. In return, passion
and dedication can be felt in everyday things done for an individual.
  Family Dynamics: In home, people with number one often make decisions in a
family. It is important that they hear partners out to avoid arguments even though it
gives a feeling of security.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
From strengths and weaknesses of the number 1, it can help them utilize the most from what
they have while making improvements on the areas which are difficult for them.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Strengths:
  1. Leadership and Initiative: Number 1s are great leaders. They take action
immediately and get things done. They wait for no one to tell them what they should do.
  2. Independence and Self-Reliance: They are very independent. They trust
their own abilities and don’t rely on others for things. This makes them confident and capable
of handling challenges.
  3. Creativity and Innovation: Number 1s are full of new ideas. Their expertise lie in
generating brand new and innovative choices; enabling them to think uniquely.
  4. Responsibility and Reliability: They are dependable and take their commitments
seriously. People can trust them to follow through on their promises.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
5. Loyalty and Dedication: They highly place devotion on things or someone in their
care; they can do anything to support those they care about.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Weaknesses:
  1. Bossiness and Dominance: Number 1s can be bossy individuals. People
often find it tough to work with them since they are very controlling.
  2. Arrogance and Ego: Their confidence can sometimes turn into arrogance. They
might think they are better than others and dismiss other people’s ideas.
  3. Impulsiveness and Restlessness: In spite of being normally patient, they can at
times feel like they want it all now. Decisions could be made by them very fast without
thinking them over much.
  4. Stubbornness and Rigidity: It is difficult for them to accept and maybe become
resistant to change they might find it hard to allow new ideas or to compromise.
  5. Self-Centeredness and Isolation: A typical characteristic of Number 1s is their
exceptional self-centeredness. They could be referred to as selfish on some occasions due
to this trait hence causing them to withdraw from others.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Lucky and Unlucky Aspects
  Lucky Colors: Number 1s believe that bright colors such as red, orange, and green
are lucky for them. These colors symbolize energy and success, which match their
dynamic personality.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)

your date of birth will be 8

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)

Healing Remedies for Number 2 in Numerology

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)

These practices would mend the energy inside as if the missing number 2

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
It is this ancient metaphysics that considers the role of numbers in

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
In this blog, we'll plunge deep into what Missing Number 3 in Numerology
is, the implications if it's missing from the Lo Shu Grid, and the powerful
remedies to restore the balance.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
The Signicance of Number 3 in Numerology
 The expansive, optimistic planet Jupiter rules this number according to the
language of numerology. This is the number that indicates creativity, joy,
expression, and communication, growth, as well. People bearing a robust
presence of number 3 usually have a strong presence that is mostly
energetic, enthusiastic, and lively. They are found with innate talent in
creative ways, such as art, writing, public speaking, or any form of
communication.
 The number 3 brings the attributes of good fortune, freedom, and
inspiring others. It represents energy into expansion-type action-not
unlike its equivalent celestial counterpart: Jupiter, the largest planet in our

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
solar system. The number 3 allows inward growth as well as outward
growth, for one to manifest success in any given situation of their lives.
People inuenced by this number have a feeling of optimism, good sense
of humor, and show childlike enthusiasm toward life.
When number 3 is missing in the numerology chart or Lo Shu Grid, it may
give an impression of a lack in the areas governed by Jupiter. Lacking
number 3 indicates that there is a deciency of creativity, self-expression,
and optimism. This happens in dierent ways depending on the patterns
one creates in his life pattern.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Some of the common challenges a missing number 3 person experiences
are as follows:
1/ Cannot express emotional thoughts: The person missing the
number three cannot convey his or her thoughts and feelings, and he/she
ends up in most irritating situations due to not being able to convey
feelings.
2/ Not creative: Feelings of stagnation or lack of inspiration when it
comes to doing creative work. The urge to create, innovate, or express
oneself creatively is felt dampened.
3/ Emotional stir-up: Since Jupiter governs one's sense of positivity and
positive growth, without it, one feels stagnant or emotionally stuck.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
4/ Too careful or no risk-taking ability: Missing number 3 would make
the person unwilling to take risks, too cautious, or afraid of chances where
one needs to express him- or herself or engage in an act of adventure.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
In the Lo Shu Grid, the number 3 has been embodied with the element of
wood. It is considered a symbol for growth, vitality, and creativity.
 Therefore, the lack of the manifestation of this number shows that life
lacks its essential elements of growth, vitality, and creativity, hence
stagnated, and it suppresses the joy and the birth of new prospects.
 The good news is that there are several remedies which can rectify this
energetic imbalance so that creative and expansive energy seen with the
number 3 return to life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
1/ Putting the Tilak on the forehead with Saron:Cure for the
missing number 3 in numerology is putting the tilak on the forehead using
saron. Known as Kesar in various parts of the world, it is used due to its
immense spiritual worth. It has been utilized as an element in traditional
treatments since ages, providing a powerful catalyst in balancing energies
and establishing mental clearness and emotional stability.
Signicance of Saron Tilak: Saron tilak is the auspicious mark that
reinforces spiritual energies, more specically the energies of Jupiter.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Since Jupiter is the ruling planet for number 3, applying saron on the
forehead can get better qualities evoked with this planet-positive, growth-
enhancing, creative, and wise.
How to Apply: Dye a few strands of saron in water or milk into a paste.
After taking your morning bath, put a tiny tilak upon your third eye
chakra. This practice leads to an increase in emotional clarity, enhanced
focus, and creative energies.
2/ Bring in the Wood Element in Your Life
Since the no. 3 is much more relating to the wood element in the Lo Shu

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Grid, this deciency needs to be compensated by bringing that into your
living environment. That means this element represents growth,
creativity, and progress, and the resulting negative could be stagnation.
So, in case of such a deciency, increase the amount of wood energy
brought to your immediate environment.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Putting Green Plants or Plant Sceneries in the East: The best
method to welcome the wood element into your life is by placing green
plants or plant sceneries in the east direction of your home. This is
because new beginnings and growth are presented by the east direction,
and it's also where the energy of the wood element is at its peak.
Recommended Plants: Bamboo, money plant or any lush green plant
representing the two energies - life-giving and growth

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Use Wooden Furniture: Wooden furniture in terms of table chairs or
decorations within your home or oce space, but especially on the east
side of your room. Natural wood feels earthy and gives the feeling of
growth that can help activate the energies of creativity and expansion.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Graft Bamboo in East Direction: Normally, bamboo is an auspicious
crop signifying prosperity and rebound. Such plants attract the energy of
growth and movement in the eastern direction of your home.
Install Pictures of Running Horses in East: Running horses are a very
powerful emblem of movement, energy and progress. In the east direction
of placing pictures or images of running horses amplies the wood
element further, therefore, fostering creativity as well as the dynamic ow
of life.
3/ Wear Three-Faced (Teen Mukhi) and 5 Mukhi Rudrakshas
Rudraksha is a seed which has been believed to possess spiritual powers.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
According to its varieties, the types of Rudraksha beads are said to cater
to dierent needs; missing number 3 can be well covered by wearing a
 Three-Faced or Teen Mukhi Rudraksha and a 5 Mukhi Rudraksha.
The Three-Faced (Teen Mukhi) Rudraksha: This Rudraksha is
believed to be associated with the re element and is known to generate
creativity, self-condence, and ability to face even the toughest of
challenges. A wearer of the Teen Mukhi Rudraksha is said to spark his
inner re, empowering him full of self-expression and allowing him to

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
5 Mukhi Rudraksha: The planet controlling the number 3 is Jupiter, and
thus the ruling planet of the 5 Mukhi Rudraksha. Wearing this Rudraksha
brings wisdom, knowledge, and spiritual advancement. It helps enhance
the eects of Jupiter, furthering the qualities of positivity, expansion, and
creativity in life.
Another very powerful remedy when a number is missing is wearing ve
Mukhi Rudraksh with Tulsi Mala. The reason is that in most spiritual
traditions, Tulsi or holy basil is considered sacred plant and used only for

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
It further enhances growth, creativity, and emotional balance in life with a
combination of Tulsi mala with a 5 Mukhi Rudraksha. It does not only heal
emotional imbalances, but it also attracts wisdom and prosperity to the
wearer's life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
According to numerology, the planet is governed by Jupiter-the Guru or
teacher, who rules wisdom, guidance, and mentorship; so, in order to
facilitate a stronger missing number 3 in your life, you have to respect
and appreciate your elders, teachers, and mentors.
Honoring the wisdom of your guides connects you to the expansive,
benevolent power of Jupiter. Maintaining acts of respect and service to
your mentors unlocks the ow of blessings, creativity, and growth to you.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Lack of creativity or self-expression of emotions and depth can occur if

Numerology is a profound tool to understand subtle energies that influence our lives.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
According to numerology, each number carries specific vibrations and characteristics
that play out to give distinct personality, behavior, or destiny about the person. A
missing number in a numerological chart or Lo Shu Grid may suggest an absence or
 weakness of some qualities that the number represents.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Number 4 in numerology is represented by practicality, stability, discipline, and hard
 work. It creates the foundation of a life that is stable and secure. The absence of this
number creates imbalance within the chart of an individual, particularly at times when
one tends to lose focus, fails to organize the tasks, and most importantly seems not
to achieve long-term objectives. Fortunately, there are focused remedies for these
imbalances to be restored into harmony.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
According to numerology, number 4 is ruled by Rahu. The number symbolizes
structure, order, discipline, responsibility, and the practical approach that needs to be
adopted for building a foundation in life. People under this number are usually very
methodical, hard-working, and well-rounded. The best way to describe them is that
they are architects who design their own fate while being excellent plan-makers and
implementers.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
The energy that number 4 brings into someone's life encourages a person to be
persevering, watchful, and dependable. Material success is controlled, helping
someone establish an existence of stability and security. It brings one a bit of order,
persistence, and grounding when balanced.
What Does It Mean When Number 4 Is Missing?
When the digit 4 is absent in the numerological chart or Lo Shu Grid, it means a lack
of qualities such as stability and practicality. A person might be observed
demonstrating these shortcomings in one or more of the following ways:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
1/ Lack of Discipline: They are generally unable to do routine activities, usually
disorganised, and not focused.
2/ Procrastination: There might be procrastination in essential tasks or
responsibility-avoiding.
3/ Unstable Foundations: The person with the missing number 4 struggles to
create a stable personal or professional life. He or she may be changing jobs,
homes, or even relationships too often to find stability yet is not able to maintain it.
4/ Impatience with Details: Due to the negligence of the grounding energy coming
 with number 4, people tend to miss important details, leading to mistakes or
incomplete work.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
5/ Hard Struggle with Long-Term Goals: Setting and enforcing a goal may bring
unnecessary burden that results in inconsistency and frustration.
To counteract the lack of number 4, a number of physical as well as spiritual
remedies can be applied. These remedies are intended to boost the qualities that
characterize will-power, stability, and focus, as well as attract the grounding energy
of this number.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
1/ Access the Energy of the Earth Element
Number 4 is closely related to Earth, representing stability, grounding, and support.
Using this element in your life may also smoothen out the energies surrounding
number 4.
  Keep Earthy Colors in Your Environment: Keep your home or workspace
furnishing with earthy colors such as brown, beige, green, and all other earthy
tones, that may ensure stability.
  Spending Time in Nature: Walk barefoot on grass or spend time in natural
environments like forests, gardens, or parks to connect with the Earth element
and feel more grounded.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Apply a saffron tilak on your forehead. It has great spiritual healing properties for
missing number 4. Saffron is auspicious and helps one balance energies, enhance
focusing capabilities, and increase grounding qualities.
  Application: Mix some saffron with a few drops of water or milk and make a
paste. Apply a small dot or line on the forehead daily, preferably in the
morning after a bath. This helps cement your connection to structure and
sensibility, which are the values controlled by number 4.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
4 flows best with the application of schedules and routines. When there is no such
thing, habits must be created and adhered to.
  Plan Your Day: Create a diary or to-do list to organize daily tasks.
  Set realistic goals: Divide large tasks into more manageable steps to
prevent feeling overwhelmed by your objectives.
  Commit to consistency: work on developing a culture of stability-be it
maintaining a steady work schedule, regular exercise routine, or even set
practices of self-care.
Wood is synonymous with growth and structure; therefore, using wooden elements
can fill the gap when number 4 is absent

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Furniture: Wooden furniture will do, such as tables, chairs, or shelves to keep
your living area anchored.
  Decorative Items: Fill your home or office with wooden decor or sculptures to
foster grounding stabilizing atmosphere.
  Location: Wooden elements should be kept on the east or southeast sides of
your home.
5/ Respect and Give Credit to Hard work and Responsibility

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
The energy of the number 4 will only get further fuelled by making us respect hard
 work and responsibility. This can be done by:
  Expression of Gratitude: Thank those people around you, your family
members, colleagues, workers; no one should be ignored.
  Assuming Responsibility: No need for procrastination and assumption of
responsibility from your actions and commitments.
  Learning Patience: Patience in times of crisis is an important aspect as the
energy of number 4 feeds on perseverance and persistence.
6/ Wearing Four-Faced (Chaar Mukhi) Rudraksha

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Four-Faced Rudraksha. This is governed by Lord Brahma and the planet Mercury,
so it is a very powerful antidote for missing number 4. Rudraksh gives extra
sharpness of the brain; it gives extra focus and creativity in the case of people who
lack number 4, which grounds us.
  Benefits: Chaar Mukhi Rudraksha fights for improving memory and enhances
organizational skills and practical decision-making abilities.
  How to Use: Wear the Rudraksha around your neck or keep it in your pocket
once properly energized by a qualified spiritual guide or astrologer.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Since the number 4 is dominated by Rahu, activating its positive energies may be
able to balance an otherwise missing number 4.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Rahu Beej Mantra: Repeat the mantra "Om Bhram Bhreem Bhroum Sah
Rahave Namaha" 108 times in a day to attract good energies by Rahu.
  Meditation: Sit with Ajna Chakra, third eye point, during meditation to aptly
use the energy that Rahu offers.
  Fast on Saturdays: Fasting or charity on Saturdays can balance the
imbalances in Rahu.
8/ Fill Your Mind with Inspirational Images

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
To imprint stability and focus, add pictures and icons that symbolize these attributes:
  Mountain or Solid Formations: Showcase paintings or photographs of
mountains, since these are stabilizing forms in real life.
  Tortoise Statues: Tortoise is the Feng Shui icon for long-term stability and
protection

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Number 4 is a labor-loving number, and activities that involve labor or are a gesture
of respect for labor can help build this energy.
  Volunteer work: Activities engaging the person in helping others through
practical means, like building or repairing.
  Physical activity: Activities like gardening, carpentry or yoga to balance the
grounding energies of number 4.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Dogs, considered loyal and grounding animals, are associated with the planet Rahu,
 which governs the energy of number 4. By feeding stray dogs, you not only nurture
their well-being but also balance the vibrations of Rahu, inviting stability, focus, and
order into your life.
  Significance:
Feeding dogs is symbolic of gratitude and service, two qualities that
help balance the karmic effects of Rahu. This simple act enhances
positive vibrations and strengthens the qualities of discipline and
responsibility tied to number 4.
  How to Do It:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
o Choose clean, fresh milk and bread.
o Offer this to stray dogs, preferably in the morning or evening.
o Perform the act with a pure heart and an intention to bring balance to
your life.
The missing number 4 in numerology symbolizes a lack of grounding, structure, and
discipline, which can lead to challenges in achieving stability and long-term goals.
However, by employing remedial measures such as application of a saffron tilak,
introduction of earthy and wooden elements, wearing four-faced Rudraksha, and
structured routine, individuals can restore balance and invite the stabilizing energies
of number 4 into their lives.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Attention and spiritual work in careful attentiveness will utterly develop inside
qualities like concentration, perseverance, and stability on the way to a more
meaningful and grounded life.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
In numerology, each number has its unique vibrations to the person's personality,
decision, and life path. Number 5 is one of the critical parts of the spectrum in
numerology, representing freedom, adaptability and versatility, and communication
and vibrational keys to movement, progress, resilience, and handling the factors in
life that are unsure. If this number is present in a chart or Lo Shu Grid with an
imbalance regarding the individual's ability to get along with changes, then it impacts
the whole aspect of personality in tune with the numerology system.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
This blog post unravels the meaning behind missing number 5, the potential
obstacles it may bring, and how it might be cured to restore balance and harmony.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Number 5 is a Mercury planet. This digit pertains to communication, curiosity, and
dynamic energy. It rules versatility and adaptability, and the urge to explore.
Generally, such a number relates to an adventurous, communicative, and life-loving
person.
Energetically, the number 5 is the middle of numerology, between 1 and 9, and
represents the balance of transformation and coping with the ups and downs of life.
It is related to the throat chakra, which symbolizes communication and self-
expression.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Extreme versatility and negotiation skills, natural multi-taskers and flexible leaders,
the number 5 high-energy people are energized by exploring new ideas, situations,
and experiences.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
When number 5 is missing in a numerology chart or Lo Shu Grid, then the person
lacks the qualities which are being governed by Mercury. This also results in fear of
change, and they often resist changes taking place. They get cranky, irritated, or
even chafed if changes happen because they cannot cope up well. They fail to
explain themselves and thus make others misunderstand them.
  Rigidity: A missing number 5 can make individuals unyielding, where they
cannot multi-task or accept changes.
  Boredom and Stagnation: Life becomes very monotonous because there is
less curiosity or adventure due to the absence of number 5.
  Fear of the Future: Lack of the energy of Mercury makes people too
conservative and concerning about life's unpredictability.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Some specific remedies for balancing and restoring the dynamic energy of number 5
may include enhancing adaptability, communication, and curiosity. It is important to
learn from life, change, and explore new opportunities in life.
Since number 5 is ruled by Mercury, chanting the mantras associated with Mercury
can effectively activate its positive energy.
  Mantra: "Om Budhaya Namaha"

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
How to Practice: Chant this mantra 108 times daily, preferably in the early
morning or during Mercury’s planetary hour (Wednesday is especially
auspicious). Sit in a calm, quiet place and focus on the qualities you want to
strengthen, such as adaptability, communication, or mental clarity.
This practice helps balance Mercury’s energy, improving your ability to adapt and
express yourself effectively.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Ready to find your Conductor Number? It’s easy! Follow these steps:
Write your birth date in numbers. For example, if you were born on 23rd July 1989, write it as
Step 2: Reduce Day, Month, and Year to Single Digits
Break down each part of your birth date into single digits.
Day: If your birth date is 23, add the digits together: 2 + 3 = 5.
Month: If you were born in July, it’s the 7th month of the year, so the month remains 7.
Year: For 1989, add the digits together: 1 + 9 + 8 + 9 = 27, and then reduce this to a single
digit: 2 + 7 = 9.
Step 3: Add the Reduced Numbers Together

passages.source: Numeros Vision Core Root Vibrational Series (NV-CRVS-19)
passages.content:
Add the reduced numbers for the day, month, and year together: 5 (Day) + 7 (Month) + 9
(Year) = 21.
Finally, reduce this sum to a single digit: 21 = 2 + 1 = 3.
Congratulations, your Conductor Number is 3!

passages.content:
An Introduction to Crystal Astrology
“As above, so below”
For millennia people have looked upward to the stars, interpreting patterns,
cycles and symbols; and for as long, people have been looking below at
 birthstones and gemstones. Crystal Astrology unites and maps spiritual truth and
guidance with the stars and the Crystal Elements. The power contained in our

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Crystal Elements enhances our native talents and attributes; it energises our life.
“Crystal Astrology” is a completely new phrase in our spiritual vocabulary. It is a
system whereby unique Crystal Elements are allocated to each degree of the zodi-
acal wheel – a unique energy assigned to each degree of the Zodiac, 360 different

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Most people not only know their own star sign, they also know other people’s
star signs and what those signs mean astrologically. Have you ever noticed how
another person can have the same star sign as you but be significantly different in
personality? Have you ever wondered why? Traditional astrology explains much
of why we are so different in that all the planets need to be taken into considera-
tion, not just our star sign. Aspects, placement, cusps, houses, and all that
 ‘technical jargon’ go a long way to explaining those details. However, many of us
never really get round to fully understanding traditional astrology. With Crystal
 Astrology we use Crystal Elements to explore these differences and details, as
most of us can relate energetically to crystals in a more obvious way than we do to
traditional astrological, mathematical listings.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Crystal Astrology follows the lead of the New Age ideal that we are now within
the ascension process, and that we have a greater capacity to understand and a
greater desire to know than ever before. Heightened awareness and experience
show that in this age we need more than 12 simple, broad, astrological or zodiac
sign interpretations – we can actually understand and take in 360 of them, 360
being the number of degrees in a wheel or circle.
Early in the book, we discuss how to use crystals in astrology, what the infor-
mation means, and how best you can utilise it. We will explore Traditional and

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content: Crystal Astrology 001-037:Crystal Astrology I 17/5/09 22:21 Page 8

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Modern Birthstone Lore; Crystal Astrology; Astrological Numerology; Sabian
Symbols and the corresponding key words from the astrologer Dr. Marc Edmund
Jones’ book, The Sabian Symbols in Astrology; Healing Body Points as listed by
astrologer Jane Ridder-Patrick in her book, A Handbook to Medical Astrology ;
Crystal Expression; Crystal Message; Sun Focus and Crystal Affirmation. Together
we will rediscover who you really are, using relevant sections in this book to
transform your Natal Astrology Chart into a Crystal Astrology Chart.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
But first, with a minimum of fuss you can look up your birthday and find out
your solar Crystal Element and Crystal Message. The crystal element associated
with your birthday is known as your solar Crystal Element because the crystal
energy is linked to the specific degree of the sun when you were born. Your solar
Crystal Element promotes personal power, good fortune, karmic direction, and
abilities. For example, if your birthday is the 22nd of March then your solar Crystal

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Element is Orange Aventurine, and the Crystal Message includes jovial and merry
emotions, optimism, self-confidence and enthusiasm. Also, look to the Crystal 
 Elements and Crystal Messages directly before and after your solar Crystal
 Element and take notice of them – they play a fundamental role in who you are
and indicate which crystal energies are available to you. Use the Crystal Message
given with your birth date in Crystal Astrology to crystallise your life. You can
also visit numerosvision.internal to find out your Crystal Elements.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Crystal Astrology has been waiting on the sidelines for some years now,
 waiting for the ‘new’ rocks and crystals to surface and become available, such as

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Tanzanite, Avalonite, Aqua Aura and Lemurian Seed Crystals. I would like to add
that it is by no means necessary to try and obtain your Crystal Elements in their
physical form, and that a great deal of benefit can be obtained from looking at a
picture or touching a stone in a natural environment or museum. Some of the
elements are difficult to acquire and may require a treasure hunt on your part. As
you read on, you may well find that several Crystal Elements resonate with you,
and it is my firm belief that the best Crystal Element for you will come to you if
you are meant to work with it. The focus in Crystal Astrology is a positive one –
look to the energy in each of the 360 Crystal Elements to support you in your
 personal ascension process. My hope is that you look at various Crystal Elements
to see and feel how each is important in your life, and then use them to energise
yourself.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content: Crystal Astrology 001-037:Crystal Astrology I 17/5/09 22:21 Page 9

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Your solar Crystal Element works in powerful harmony with your traditional
birthstone. Birthstones are believed to support a positive life, protect from harm,
bring good fortune, and aid healing. It is a long-held belief that our birth stone or
gem is lucky, and that the power of the gemstone enhances our native talents and
attributes, and energises our life. Crystals and other valuable mineral kingdom
gifts are used as talismans, amulets and birthstones. Many cultures and religions
hold crystals in high regard, utilising them in religious services, garments,
crowns, sceptres, orbs, swords, and rings, as personal adornment and to signify
and amplify spiritual power.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
One of the surviving birthstone traditions is attributed to the Hoshen
 Breastplate, which was written about in the book of Exodus. Along with a great
deal of energy and power, the Hoshen Breastplate contained one precious gem for
each of the 12 tribes of Israel: ruby, topaz, aquamarine, turquoise, sapphire,
 emerald, jacinth, agate, amethyst, chrysolite, onyx and jasper. Each stone served
as an expression of faith and optimism within the spiritual community.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
There are a variety of birthstone charts linking gemstones with calendar
months. All of the various charts differ with tradition, age and culture. The
 modern birthstone list most commonly referred to is from the American National
Association of Jewellers, and was adopted in 1912 . The Ayurvedic birthstone list is
derived from Indian medicine and dates back to 1500 BC. Other birthstone lists
also exist: traditional birthstone lists from various traditions and customs from
the past 600 years; mystical birthstone lists of Tibetan origin that date back over a
thousand years; and ancient birthstone lists also dating back over 1000 years for

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Arabic, Hebrew, Hindu and Roman belief systems. Planetary gemstone lists link
particular crystals with planets, indicating that certain gemstones enhance the
power of certain planetary influences in your life.
Zodiac Birthstones are linked with a zodiac sign instead of being associated
with a calendar month. Zodiac Birthstone lists often cite up to five or more
 gemstones for each star sign and these lists vary. Table 1 is a cumulative list of
 modern, commonly-accepted zodiac birthstones.
Crystal Astrology 001-037:Crystal Astrology I 17/5/09 22:21 Page 10

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:

There is even a birthstone allocated for the day of the week on which you were born,
known as your day stones: Monday is Pearl; Tuesday is Garnet; Wednesday is Cat’s
Eye; Thursday is Emerald; Friday is Topaz; Saturday is Sapphire; and Sunday is Ruby.
Interestingly, there are also planet-metal affinities, that have been known for
eons, and were added to after the discovery of the outer planets (Table 2). These
metal-planet affinities are used in alchemy, homeopathy, and astrology. In

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Crystal Astrology, metals are included in the list of Crystal Elements.
Crystal Astrology 001-037:Crystal Astrology I 17/5/09 22:21 Page 11

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Just as a traditional birthstone vibrates to a Zodiac Sign, the same is true for
 metals. Work with metals in your life in the same way you work with Birthstones.
Traditional and modern birthstones systems, and the variations within them,
work. These systems provide a strong tone, a strong crystal presence in our lives.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
These birthstones resonate with broad-scale aspects in our life such as love,
health, prosperity and protection. Many people resonate with divine affinity to
their chosen birthstone. Birthstone lore is valuable to us, and has been for
 thousands of years, and we should always honour these traditions and
 incorporate them into our life. Crystal Astrology expands on this concept and
lists 360 Crystal Elements to provide a more detailed and personal Crystal
 Element. The Crystal Elements should be considered a ‘harmony’ to the
 underlying strengths of traditional birthstone systems.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content: Crystal Astrology 001-037:Crystal Astrology I 17/5/09 22:21 Page 12

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Crystal Astrology
‘Crystallise your life’
• Crystal Astrology provides added insight into an individual astrology chart by
allocating a Crystal Element to each and every degree in the astrological wheel.
• Crystal Astrology lets you look up your solar Crystal Element and helps
 redefine your natal astrology chart with crystal energy.
Crystal energy is unique energy, and everyone will vibrate uniquely to a given
crystal type, and to varieties within a crystal type; no two stones are exactly the
same to the sensitive crystal worker.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
For each Crystal Element there is much traditional and modern information,
but many writers concentrate this information to resonate with the chakra
 system or major aspects such as love, prosperity, healing or protection. Within
Crystal Astrology I put forward a brief and distinctive analysis of each Crystal 
 Element, presenting it in a simple and clear information sequence that resonates
with the stone’s attributes, but also assigns each stone an astrological point so
that we can easily use them to learn and grow.
Let us start with traditional astrology, based on a circle and planet placement.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
There are 360 degrees in a circle, and therefore 360 degrees in an astrological
wheel. We are all familiar with the 12 star signs of the zodiac, Aries through to
Pisces; there are 12 segments in the circle, and with a little maths we calculate 30
degrees for each star sign of the zodiac.
• 360 degrees in a circle divided by 12 star signs = 30 degrees for each star sign
• One Crystal Element for each astrological degree
• 30 DIFFERENT Crystal Elements for each star sign
Crystal Astrology 001-037:Crystal Astrology I 17/5/09 22:21 Page 13

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
So, for Aries there are 30 degrees of Aries and 30 Crystal Elements; 30 Crystal
Elements for Taurus, and so on till we get to the end of the astrological wheel at
Just by looking up your birthday, you can work out so much about yourself. For
instance, if your birthday is April 2 nd, simply look for your birthday in the book
and you will see:
Schalenblende is your Crystal Element Focus.
Your Focus is the Crystal Element that applies specifically to you.
Solar Crystal Element = Birthday Crystal Element = Focus

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Reading through Crystal Astrology you may notice that your birth date does not
link neatly to one Crystal Element. This is because there are 360 degrees in a
 circle, 360 Crystal Elements, but 365 days in a year, so your Crystal Element Focus
depends on where you were born and at what time.
In the next section we will discuss how the Crystal Elements either side of your

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Focus are potent in Crystal Astrology, so even using the book as a quick reference
guide will give you your significant Crystal Elements. But to accurately define
which Crystal Element is your Focus, visit numerosvision.internal for your
free, personalised Crystal Astrology report; or numerosvision.internal to obtain your free
natal astrology report. You can, however, utilize this book without an astrological
chart. More information about this is given in the Detailed Crystal Astrology section.
Crystal Astrology 001-037:Crystal Astrology I 17/5/09 22:21 Page 14

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
What tools do I have? How do I move forward? Where am I headed? These are 
the questions answered by the Crystal Sequence. As we have discussed, within
 Crystal Astrology you can look up your date of birth to obtain your Crystal
 Element Focus and its associated information. This crystal energy is the Focus of
your abilities. But each degree holds so much potential, energy, description and
consequence, you should always look to the Crystal Element directly before your

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Focus, known as your Karmic Condition, and the Crystal Element directly after,
known as your Quest. The astrological information on either side of your Focus
gives valuable insight into your astrology.
Karmic Condition is the mission you have set out on, and the tools you have
available to you to succeed.
Focus is your strength and power source, your movement through life.
Quest sheds light onto the outcome and experience; it is the culmination of your
efforts.
Example: Born on the 19th of August, your Crystal Element Focus is Rainbow Flu-
orite. Look to the Crystal Elements directly before and after the Crystal Element

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
You may be drawn to a significant Crystal Element in your Crystal Sequence and prefer
to work with that crystal as a significant energy force in your life. In the body of the
Crystal Astrology book you will find a significant amount of information: born on
August 19th, there are three relevant sections, Leo 25, Leo 26 and Leo 27 (see below).
The astrological degree directly before the Focus degree is the Karmic Condition.
The Karmic Condition provides valuable insight into what tools are available to
Crystal Astrology 001-037:Crystal Astrology I 17/5/09 22:21 Page 15

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
you and what strengths you have. The Karmic Condition may also indicate past
life memories, early history or “baggage”, and it provides insight into the causes
of certain traits and patterns. Leo 25 is the Karmic Condition for Leo 26.
For someone born on August 19 th, Leo 26 is their sun Focus, the significant
 section that relates to this person’s birthday. This section describes and lists the
main symbols that this person should evaluate in their life. It offers the greatest
gifts, and highlights subtle challenges. It provides a valuable summary of
 information pertaining to the individual’s natal chart.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
The Quest is the third part of the crystal sequence and is the astrological degree
directly after the Focus, in this case Leo 27. The Quest offers insight into where
you are headed, and information to assess purpose, possible outcomes and future
potential.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Leo 26 is the degree at which your sun was sitting at the time of your birth. Leo 25
sheds extra light on your abilities and personality. Leo 27 helps you toward your
future. This crystal sequence provides you with three potent Crystal Elements to
exchange energy with, learn from, and work with. Choose the crystal from your
crystal sequence that you are most attracted to, and honour the energy and
 support the other crystals have to offer you.
The brilliantly original concept of the sequence of Karmic Condition ~ Focus ~

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Quest was defined by Lynda Hill, author and astrologer, and is regularly used as a
tool in reading the Sabian Symbols. Kindly, Lynda Hill provided me with guidance
and permission to transfer her Sabian Symbol Sequence definitions and methods
to Crystal Astrology. Read more about Sabian Sequence in the Sabian Symbol
section.
Crystal Astrology 001-037:Crystal Astrology I 17/5/09 22:21 Page 16

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Transforming your natal astrology chart into a Crystal Astrology chart
Fundamentally, Crystal Astrology substitutes a Crystal Element for a significant
astrological degree in your natal chart. In the case of a birth chart, Western

passages.source: Numeros Vision Mineral Frequency & Sabian Resonance System (NV-MFSR-28)
passages.content:
Astrology represents the positions of the planets and houses as seen from the

Religious remedies include mantra chanting,
charity, and simple worship, which can be
easily followed in daily life. Non-religious
remedies focus on behavior, such as choosing
certain colors, changing food habits, or
improving daily routines. These can also help
create mental balance in a scientific and
psychological way.

passages.content:
**Chapter 1: Introduction to Astrology**
Astrology is an ancient Indian science that
links life with the influence of planets. The
nine planets—Sun (source of energy), Moon
(ruler of emotions), Mars (symbol of courage),
Mercury (giver of intellect), Jupiter (source of
wisdom), Venus (planet of love), Saturn
(controller of karma), Rahu (cause of illusion),
and Ketu (sign of spirituality)—shape our
destiny. Positive planetary effects bring
success, health, and prosperity, while negative
effects create obstacles, stress, and failure.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Planetary Harmonization & Remedy Protocols (NV-PHRP-29A)
passages.content:
Remedies help balance these influences, such
as offering water to the Sun to increase energy
or donating milk for the Moon to calm the
mind. Simple religious actions and small daily
changes, like choosing suitable colors or
practicing meditation, guide planetary energy
in a positive direction. Astrology not only
predicts the future but also shows a path of
self-improvement, where planets and remedies
together help life flow smoothly.

while he stood by the riverbank, something extraordinary happened—a
giant tortoise emerged from the waters. But this was no ordinary
tortoise.

vertically, or diagonally—the sum always came out to 15. The
emperor believed that this was a divine message, a secret code
from the universe about balance and harmony.

When a number appears more than once in a person’s Lo Shu Grid, it
amplifies or strengthens the traits associated with that number.
Repeated numbers indicate a strong focus on certain qualities, but
having too many of the same number can sometimes lead to
imbalances.

Numbers, play an important role in understanding a person’s life path
and personal growth. Kua Numbers are calculated from a person’s
birth date and represent key aspects of their character, strengths,
and life direction. Each Kua Number is also linked to specific colors
and traits that support personal development.
1. Calculation of Kua Numbers Based on Birth Date
To find a person’s Kua Number, we follow a few simple steps. The
calculation method differs slightly for males and females, as each
has a unique formula. Let’s look at how to calculate it.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Lo Shu Grid Planetary Vectors (NV-LSPV-31B)
passages.content:
Step-by-Step Calculation for Males and Females :
Take the last two digits of the birth year and add them together.
Example: If someone was born in 1994, add 9 + 4 = 13. If the result is a two-
digit number, add those digits together until you get a single digit. For

passages.source: Numeros Vision Lo Shu Grid Planetary Vectors (NV-LSPV-31B)
passages.content:
For Males: Subtract the single-digit result from 10.
For Females: Add 5 to the single-digit result.
If the result is two digits, add them together to get a single digit.
Example for a female born in 1994: 4 + 5 = 9. So, the Kua Number is 9.
Let’s calculate the Kua Number for a male born on July 7, 1993, and
a female born on February 29, 1994.
Last two digits: 9 + 4 = 13
 Simplify: 1 + 3 = 4

helping others, spreading wisdom, or creating positive change. The
three main Master Numbers are 11, 22, and 33.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Lo Shu Grid Planetary Vectors (NV-LSPV-31B)
passages.content:

they represent deep spiritual lessons or life challenges. These
numbers are divided into Master Numbers and Karmic Numbers.
Master Numbers are connected to a higher purpose and spiritual
growth, while Karmic Numbers indicate lessons that a person needs
to learn from past experiences.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Lo Shu Grid Planetary Vectors (NV-LSPV-31B)
passages.content:

and the ability to turn ideas into reality.

inspire others, share knowledge, and uplift people with their wisdom.
They may be called to spiritual or creative work.
Higher Purpose: People with Master Number 22 are often skilled at
organizing and leading projects that benefit many. They have the
potential to make a big impact in the world, building structures,
organizations, or movements that last.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Lo Shu Grid Planetary Vectors (NV-LSPV-31B)

energies of both 11 and 22, emphasizing the importance of helping
others without expecting anything in return.
Higher Purpose: Individuals with Master Number 33 often dedicate
their lives to humanitarian work or teaching. They feel fulfilled when
they are helping others and making the world a kinder place.

Properties of the Lo Shu as a Magic Square
- 3x3 Grid Layout: The Lo Shu Grid is a 3x3 magic square using
numbers from 1 to 9 arranged in a specific pattern. Each row,
column, and diagonal sums to 15. This balance symbolizes
harmony and order.
The Lo Shu Grid holds a special place in numerology and
mathematics as one of the earliest known magic squares. A magic
square is a grid where numbers are arranged so that the sum of
each row, column, and diagonal is the same. This unique
mathematical balance has made the Lo Shu Grid and other magic
squares symbols of harmony and order in various cultures.

meaning in Chinese culture, Mathematical Significance and
Magic squares have appeared in various cultures, each with its
unique properties and symbolism. One of the most famous
examples is Albrecht Dürer’s 4x4 Magic Square.
Albrecht Dürer, a German artist, created the 4x4 magic square in
1514 as part of his engraving titled “Melencolia I.” Unlike the Lo
Shu Grid’s 3x3 layout, Dürer’s square consists of 16 numbers
arranged in a 4x4 grid, where every row, column, and diagonal
adds up to 34.

passages.content:
CONVICTION JAIPUR July 13, 1992 I am happy to note that Shri
B.N.Reddy, a Vaastu Shilpl (Architect) and a former Member of the
Parliament has published a book: “A GLIMPSE OF PRACTICAL

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
VAASTU” , which , I mderestand, within a short period has become
extremely popular and is in great demand. Naturally, he is encouraged and
decided to publish the revised edition adding more useful information to the
subject Vaastu Shastra is an ancient science and one of the eminent features
of our heritage. It is a science which outlines the methods of construction of 
houses and other structures. It used to be the main guide for construction
activity both in urban and rural areas in the past. Like many of our 
traditions, Vaastu too got neglected over the centuries for want of patronage
. The logic behind this great tradition was not available in a presentable
form, hence the present society could not very much appreciate and utilise
this science in their construction activities . I do not claim to know the
subject in depth, but I am certainly aware of some of its basic principles . I
have developed a conviction with my own experience. In 1967 when I was
in the - Union • Cabinet, my house in Hyderabad was constructed. Being in

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Delhi I did not have enough time to monitor the construction work. Due to
wrong advice of some body, one pucca guard room was constructed with
R.C.C. roof in the north-east of my house. During me of my visits I noticed
this and felt very unhappy because it violated the basic principle of keeping
the north-eas t open in any construction. As it was a pucca construction, I
was hesitating to dismantle it One day an old Vaidya, with considerable 5

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
experience in Vaastu Shastra, who had great concern for our 
welfare , strongly pleaded for the complete demolition of the structure .

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Though took some time to act upon his advice,! finally decided in favour of 
dismantling the room, . In an unexpected manner without any special effort
, the marriage alliance of my daughter got materialised even before the
dismantling was completed. / have also removed a fancy pond built in
south-west, which was another violation of Vaastu. Further in consonance
with a basic Vaastu point of having a higher and heavier structure in south-
west, I had constructed a garage in the south-west portion and above that I
 built two floors in order to raise its height to the desired level. With my
conviction in Vaastu Shastra, I took up the above steps which -of course
meant considerable expenditure, but these things certainly helped me
menially and furthered my progress in life. It was again in 1973, 1
 purchased my adjacent house and made a number of changes as per Vaastu

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Shastra. I had a good progress in my political career. I became Governor of
Uttar Pradesh in 1974. Again in 1977 became PCC President and then the
Chief Minister of Andhra Pradesh in 1978. In 1952 as a minister of food
and agriculture, in erstwhile Hyderabad State, I was residing in a
government house. There I had effected a series of changes. Similarly when
I was a Minister in Central Cabinet in 1967, 1 was staying in 3 Janpath and
there again I got some changes made in that house as per Vaastu. As the

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Governor of Uttar Pradesh and Punjab also, I did the same thing. I knew
very well that they were not my houses where I could stay permanently, .
 but I felt that whosoever would be there should be happy and healthy so as
to perform their duties properly in the interest of the State and people. 6

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Now I am at Raj Bhavan in Rajasthan and here too 1 planned to
make some changes in order to satisfy the basic principles of Vaastu Shastra
 by acquiring some land in the north-easi so that the north-east comer could
 be extended which is an important aspect of Vaastu. A pond in the north-
east is being taken up, while an existing pond in south-west is removed. My
 purpose of quoting all these examples is only to show that irrespective of 
the place whether personal or government where I lived, the Vaastu was
corrected. Though the government buildings are not meant for the
incumbant ’s permanent stay, the Vaastu defects should be corrected so that
the dwellings are auspicious for whosoever reside there. In fact it was in

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
1976 when I was inaugurating the All India conference of engineers at
Agra, as the Governor of Uttar Pradesh, I told the gathering that the
engineers should learn and follow Vaastu Shastra in all their constructions. I
am very happy that Shri B.N.Reddy with his experience in architecture and
expertise in Vaastu Shastra is trying to make an analysis of different aspects
of Vaastu Shastra in a convincing manner so that it will be useful to the
common man in the society. Now I should say that it is time, the
government at the centre and those in states should endevour to make

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Vaastu Shastra a part of syllabus, in their colleges, particularly in the
colleges of Engineering and Architecture, which will go a long way in
reviving this ancient science, and also make a happy admixture of ancient
heritage and modern science. I wish that this and similar works by him and
other experts . come out in larger numbers to help revive the finer aspects of 
our great PARAMPARA (heritage). I wish Shri B.N.Reddy, and his
 publication all the success. Dr.M. CHANNA REDDY 7
