immense pleasure to go through this book UA glimpse of practical Vaastu
** by Vasthushilpi Sri B. N. Reddy, an old friend of mine. Sri B . N. Reddy
is a man of versatile nature who is good in several fields including poetry ,
fine arts and on the subject Vaastu. The admirable fact ' is that though he
has done his post graduation from USA., he kept his mind open to the
native ethos and studied every aspect connected with house building
activity . In this connection , he observed our ancient traditions in building
houses and the science which would keep the inmates happy. After detailed
analysis he came to a scientific conclusion that there are certain subtle
forces which work in a house thatis built according to Vaasthu Shastra. It is
this conviction that 'has resulted in this book which will be of great use for 
all people for all times . I congratulate Sri B.N.Reddy for writing this
excellent hook and sharing his experiences with others . H.J. DORA

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
POTTURI VENKATESWARA RAO HON. EDITOR, TTD
PUBUCATIONS 330/2RT, P S NAGAR, HYDERABAD
COMMENDATION Date : 15.8.92 The word Vaastu is not an equivalent of 
the word architecture . Vaastu is architecture and much more. While
architecture is the science , art or profession of designing and constructing
 buildings etc , the definition of Vaastu extends into the realm of occultism.
Vaastu Vidya is one of the sixty four identified ancient Indian arts i.e. one of 
theChaiushasti Kalas. The meaning of the word Vaastu according to Sir

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Monier-Williams is the site or foundation of a house, the ground, building
or dwelling place, habitation, homestead or house but Vaastu Shastra is a
science which tells us how to build a house so as to be happy and
 prosperous. Architecture was a highly developed knowledge in ancient

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
India. The Ramaycma speaks of seven or eight storied buildings and well
laid out towns. The Mahabharata tells of Mayasabha, the architectural
marvel that stunned Duryodhana, the king of kings. The ancient
architectural styles and principles are slowly disappearing yielding place to
the modem, except in the temple complexes. The temple complexes
continue to be built in the from of Vaastu Purus ha lying on his back. The

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Sanctum Sanctorum lies right below the dome (gopuram). The gopuram has
its own significance. A learned author described the dome of a temple as a
mechanical device to harness the spiritual energy. According to him just as
there are lightreflectors, the dome of a temple is a reflector of sound. The
saying of prayers and chanting of mantras are perhaps more effective in a
dome than in other structures . The ancient silpacharyas would not have
 built the temples in that form without mystic significance. It is only the

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Indo-Moghul architecture that is presently known to the connoisseurs of art
outside our country. Foreigners, particularly of the West, on a visit to India,
see the Taj Mahal and the Pearl Mosque at Agra, Red Fort at Delhi, the Jodh
Bai *s Palace at Fathaepur-Sikri, the Charminar at Hyderabad and a few
other 9

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content: similar monuments . They got no opportunity of knowing ancient

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Indian architecture . Is Vaastu an art or a science ? The closing years of the
twentieth century do not consider this a live question . For all those with
some knowledge of the subject , it is an art, for it appeals to the aesthetic
seme of everyone. Many accept it as a science. There are some who do not
consider it as a science at all for according to the postulates of Descartes
ctwe reject all knowledge which is merely probable and judge that only
those things should be believed which are perfectly known and about which
there can be no doubts ” Shri B.N. Reddy, who postgraduated himself with
distinction from a reputed Amercian university believes Vaastu as a shastra
in its entirety. He has studied whatever material was available to him on

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Vaastu Vidya. He is convinced that Vaastu sutras are as valid today as at any
other time in the past. His experiences convince others also of the
effectiveness of Vaastu. His book aA GLIMPSE OF PRACTICAL

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
VAASTU 39 is in great demand and hence is going into more editions. A
special feature of his book is that many of the Vaastu principles (Sutras) are
 based on his own deep study and observatiom. His experiences together 
with those of others who consulted him convincingly establish that Vaastu
contributes , for the success of concerned, lam personally aware of the fact
that several industrialists found his advice beneficial and sound in many
respects. People who invest huge amounts in the construction of buildings
and large industrial enterprises can not afford to risk their moneys by going
agaimt or by ignoring the well established Vaastu principles. A non-believer 
that I wa£ a few years ago, had to change my views on the subject after 
some personal experiences. Certain modifications sugesied by Shri B.N.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Reddy, did help me. Knowledge comes out of experience but experience
does not come out of knowledge. The knowledge that Mr. B.N. Reddy
 packed in every page of this book is useful and authentic. One stands to
gain by following the principles suggested by the author, whatever one ’s
faith and philosophy may be. FOTTURI VENKATESWARA RAO 10

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Preface to the First edition HOW I GOT INTERESTED IN
VAASTU! On my return to India from USA in 1963 , 1 have taken up
consultancy as an Architect and established a firm by name VIRGO
Architects and Engineers , Hyderabad. People of different social milieu
used to approach me to draw plans mainly for their residential buildings.
Once in a while a client used to insist on a plan drawn as per Vaastu.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Initially I was rather reluctant to accommodate Vaastu as I was sceptical
about its efficacy, which usually resulted in the loss of clientele. Then as a
 business proposition I started taking interest in the subject and gradually
found that those who followed Vaastu were more prosperous than others.
This enthused me to study more about the subject and the statistics found
thus infused enough confidence in me to design houses and other structures
as per Vaastu. After sometime, I thought of writing a book on Vaastu in

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
English since most of the books available were in Telugu and Sanskrit or in
some other south Indian languages. But it got delayed, for want of enough
statistical data based on scientific approach which required further research.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
It is a matter of great regret that such a good subject/ did not receive any
encouragement from the government so far. Since it required more time to
 bring out an exhaustive book on Vaastu, I had to bring out this small one
giving a glimpse of important points on Vaastu, so as to serve the needs of 
one and all. I had the good fortune of being associated with the famous
temples at Tirupathi, Srisailam, Srikalahasti and Yadagirigutta etc. I must
say that the principles of Vaastu are very much followed in the temple at

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Tirupathi, whereas at Srikalahasthi , it was the reverse. It is anybody’s guess
that the temple at Tirupathi built in accordance with the tenets of Vaastu has
really flourished whereas Srikalahasthi temple did not make a mark as a
financially sound pilligrim centre. 1!

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Similarly, I had the occasion to glimpse into configuration of the
houses belonging to people of different strata and it may not be
exaggeration to say that the houses built according to Vaastu have bestowed
all round prosperity on the grihasthas. By this it may not be construed that

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Vaastu is an exact science but neverthless it s judicious use confers peace,
 prosperity and holistic joy on the grihastha. The principles of Vaastu are
known to the blessed few only and an endeavour is made here to help the
common man glimpse into this ancient Shastra. This author has extensively
travelled across the length and breadth of the country to give Vaastu advice

passages.content:
PREFACE TO THE REVISED EDITION Thousands of years ago
, men of great wisdom bestowed on us the ancient knowledge of Vaastu ,
and other occult sciences. Some of the classical texts of this treasure are
Brihat-Samhita, Aparajita pritcha, Samarangana Sutradhara, Maya-Vaastu
and Viswakarma- Vaastu. We remember with reverence , Brihaspati,

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Bhriguy Sukra , Vasisia, Maya, Viswa Karma, Varahamihra and other sages
and scientists, for enriching our knowledge of this discipline. The physical
world comprises of five essential elements , i.e. earth, water , fire , air anrf 
space. The human body is also made of these five elements , and again it is
the very same elements that we see in the construction of a house or a work 
 place. The vast expanse of these five elements outside , and those at the
micro level within , are beyond the purview of man's manipulative abilities.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
The interplay of various forces of Nature involving the five elements
sustains life and maintains a near equilibrium on this planet. Any imbalance
in the interplay of these forces could result in a chaos or cataclysm. An
invisible equation operates , between the elements outside, the elements
within the individual and his living place. While the first two are near 
constants f the third is a variable. Man can better his conditions ' to a great
extent by properly planning , designing and constructing his house and
work-place. It has been the belief of Indians , fortified by experiences of 
generations after generations , that the location , direction and composition
of the buildings have a bearing on the health, happiness and harmonius
relationship of the inmates. The Vaastu influence of building on human
 beings is like the cosmic influence of the sun on our ecosystem. The
 principles of Vaastu were obviously formulated keeping in view, the cosmic
influence of the Sun , its light 13

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
and heat, the direction of the wind, , the earth’s magnetic field and
the influence of cosmos on our planet Earth In Vaastu , east and north
directions are given great importance. The East, as we all know, is the
gateway to the Sun s rays. The North identified with the help of the pole
star is the roof of the world The tilting of the earth by about 23 degrees at
the meridian on its either side , each for six months called Ayanams and the

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Precession of the Equinoxes also seem to have been reckoned with while
formulating the Vaastu Sutras . I am overwhelmed with joy at the
tremondous response from readers for the first two editions which inspired
me to place before you the revised edition incorporating several new
features , such as multi-storeyed flats , industries, colony layout and group
housing etc. An honest and sincere effort is made in this revised edition to
 project the cause of Vaastu and its scientific basis, in the interest of 
mankind. No tall claim is put before the readers by the author for this work 
 but asks for the continued patronage and welcomes their constructive
suggestions. B. N. REDDY

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
PREFACE TO FOURTH EDITION Within a short span often
months A GLIMPSE OF PRACTICAL VAASTU is appearing in its fourth
edition The overwhelming response the book had in this country and abroad
indicates the increasing faith of people in the wisdom of our ancient sages
ami seers who founded this science of Vaastu ; and my rendering of some of 
the fundamentals of Vaastu into English in a manner that meets the
requirements of international readership ; is only to fulfill their noble came
of serving the mankind Ever since this book was first published, scores of 
 people have been calling on me for guidance as to how they can match the
modern styles of architecture with the scientific principles of Vaastu, at
home or work , for greater environmental harmony resulting in enhanced
health, happiness and fortune. In April 1993 , I had the opportunity to visit
couple of industries at Bangkok in Thailand* It was a pleasant surprise to
know that in this part of the world they follow Chinese Feng-Shui whose
tenets are almost akin to Vaastu. It is significant to note that Feng and Shut
speak about the importance of the two elements of nature , wind and water,
laying emphasis on the site, location, environment and finally the
orientation. A comparative study of these two ancient sciences could
significantly contribute to the polarisation of cultural ethos of the two Asian
countries. In the previous editions, I tried to impress upon the readers that a
well in the North-east, kitchen in the South-east, with more open space in
 North and East are good for the well being of the inmates, whereas a bore
well in South-east, kitchen in North-east and depressions in South or West
are not supposed to be good for the owners of that plot or house. There , the
 positive and negative effects of Vaastu were not dealt with in detail, lest
they might cause embarrassment and unhappiness to the readers. But
experience showed that the readers are nevertheless eager to know the good

and bad influences of Vaastu so that they would work out the
 priorities and venture to correct tha adverse points. Hence , an annexure
exclusively touching this aspect is added in this edition. Opinions of some
of the industrialists , who applied Vaastu to their places of work and living
are also added in the last annexureLetters to the author for the benefit of the
readers. I owe a debt of gratitude to His Excellency Dr. Shankar Dayal

to contribute significantly to a better understanding of the richness of
Vaastu. June 7, 1993 HYDERABAD. R.N. REDDY 16

NINTH EDITION mien my first edition of “A Glimpse of
Practical Vaastu ” was published in June, 1992, it was the first Book in
English, a handy booklet, giving basic principles of Vaastu. It h as a time
when Vaastu was treated as a set of house building principles followed by
some people with blind faith. But there was a great demand and I had to

Chinese Vaastu, known as “ Feng Shui ” has become very popular in

on practical experiences and statistics gathered over a period of several
hundred years, and it has come to stay. Solar energy, coupled with electro
magnetic energy field, generated in the plot or the structure, is influencing
the well being of human beings, connected with that plot or living structure.

 profoundly thank my readers for using my book as reference book for 
correcting their plots, houses and working places, and patronising me for all
these years. 21-06-2000. HYDERABAD BN REDDY 16a.

In this age of reason it is considered embarrassing to be superstitious . 'But
when it comes to money matters, few -can resist a success-mantra ,
however far-fetched it may seem. In sophisticated Hong Kong, the Chinese
 pay attention to Fung Shui for b usiness success, believing that good or bad
luck depends on how furniture is placed or in which direction a building
faces. The Indian belief in Vaastu Shastra is similar. ” Says Jatin Kumar,
owner of Sujana Appliances , makers of Padmini fans » in Hyderabad: “Till

the north-east comer of my factory and my fortunes changed dramatically 7
Within three years annual sales rose to 35, 000 fans. “ AU my new units
will be constructed according to Vaastu , ” he declares. Even a hi-tech
company like Bull Powers Systems Pvt. Ltd. which sells computers in
technical collaboration withFuteba of Japan , consulted a Vaastu pandit,

GROUP HOUSING Construction of a number of dwelling places
or a conglomeration of housing units built in one place is called Group

Housing. Multi-storied apartment buildings, and housing colonies come
under this category. The plans of apartment complex, twin blocks and group

flow and ventilation particularly the sun rays from the East entering the
living rooms. Therefore it is advisable to avoid the common walls as far as
 possible, in colonies. In apartment buildings, where the common walls are
unavoidable, these Vaastu defects have to be compensated by implementing
all other Vaastu Sutras. The lay out of a colony is of primary importance.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:

ground, the underlying principle being the rain water should flow towards
north, east or north-east direction. The roads have to be formed exactly in
north-south and east-west direction, so that the plots are good rectangles or 
squares which will be best according to Vaastu (see diagram on page 59).
Referring to the apartment building plan on page 61, the site selected is
good having north road, with north-east projection. A well and sump are to
 be provided in north-east. Kitchens are designed to the extent possible
either in south-east or north-west. 56

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
VAASTU FOR. FLATS : Construction of flats as per vaastu is not
that simple. The number of flats in one complex, common walls for 
adjacent flats, placement of kitchen and bathrooms - all these, make things
complicated. Nevertheless, if one follows meticulously the principles of 
vaasto in selection of the plot and construction of building, satisfactory
results could be obtained in majority of cases. The principles given below
should be followed strictly so as to give maximum benefit to the flat
owners. 1 The site should be a good square or a rectangle if possible with
south-west comer equal to 90°. 2. North, east or north-east roads would do
more good with two gates, one in the east and the other in the north.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)

should essentially be dug in north-east, before the construction takes place.
5. While designing the complex, more open space should be left in the east
and north compared to west and south. 60

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)

Main roads towards east, north or north-east are advisable with wide gates

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)

Administrative Offices are to be located either in north or east, away from

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
LIMITATIONS OF VAASTU Many examples could be cited to
show that Vaastu, if followed in constructing one’s house, office or business
 place, one could be happy and prosperous. A question arises whether one
can achieve every thing in life by simply living in a house built as per

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Vaastu. The answer is ano” because Vaastu has its own limitations. Just
 because one has a house as pei Vaastu, one can not become a top celebrity.
 Neverthless, if plot is good as per Vaastu -and house is also built according
to the shastra, one may achieve many of the following: One may have
health and happiness. Children may come up in life. One may succeed in
getting good promotions, if in service. One may make good money, if in
 business. One may attain position and power, if in politics. One may get the
 benefits as enumerated above, as per the degree of perfection in following

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Vaastu. If one can satisfy 70 to 75% of Vaastu, he should be very happy. It
is interesting to note that some fortunate people have been living in good
houses built as per Vaastu, without knowing even elementary principles of 
the subject. Construction of a house or a work place following Vaastu
 principles cent percent is not possible, because of the levels in and around
the plot, shape of the plot, number of roads and direction of the roads
abutting the plot. Hence one has to work with the available plot and
construct the house or office to suit one’s requirements under the given
circumstances to provide maximum benefit to the inmates of the house. An

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Architect bestowed with the knowledge of Vaastu designs the building,
striking a balance between the two depending upon the importance of one
or the other as the case may be. Considering this practical aspect, the title of 
the book is chosen as aA GLIMPSE OF PRACTICAL VAASTU”. 67

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
SHOPPING ARCADES AND COMMERCIAL COMPLEXES: If 
the site selected Is as per Vaastu, It Is fine. Otherwise the very site must be
corrected prior to the starting of construction In such a way that there Is a
reasonable projection of north-east comer. This will be very handy to make
all the shops a bit projecting towards north-east. Such commercial
complexes which satisfy other vaastu principles also will become popular 
and would make good profits. Commercial complexes or shopping arcades
have to be designed with lot of open area for car parking. If the parking Is
in cellar, the building can be designed with little more open area in north
and east than south and west to satisfy Vaastu. If there is no cellar for 
 parking, lot of areas should be kept open in north and east for car parking
and for green patches. If the plot is facing west or south and more open area
is left in south or west for car parking the owner will run into financial
difficulties. In such cases where the plots are facing south or west, it is
 better shopping complex is built on to the road with minimum open space in
south or west. The complex should not be built covering the plot upto the
north or east boundary. Instead more open area in the rear i.e., in north and
east should be left, where car parking,lawns, fountains etc., should be
designed. Sumps and bore wells also have to be planned in north and east.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Drinking water in shops has to be kept in north-east. Show cases have to be
avoided in north-east direction; better in south and west. Latbe machines
are to be installed in south or south-west directions. If some shop is used as
a work shop. Stocks are to be stored in west, south-west and south side
 portions of shops. Better to have lofts and low roofs towards south and west
directions, within the shops. North-east corner is to be kept open with all
the sanctity, within the shop. In this comer a water tap or a small puja place
could be designed. North-east comer should never be used even for a day,
for storing any kind of materials. 68

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
HOTEL COMPLEX After the site is selected, taking into
consideration, levels, roads and angles etc,, one has to plan the open spaces
for lawns and car parking. While cellar could be designed for car parking,
for kitchen, stores and for servant’s stay etc., the ground floor could be used
for reception, and restaurant. As the area required for kitchen has to be
sufficiently big, with light and ventilation, it is better that kitchen is planned
on ground floor earmarking complete south-east portion for ovens, grinders
.and vegetable cutting etc. On first floor they could plan conference halls,
and more restaurant area if necessary and the upper floors could be used for 
rooms. Care has to be taken that the balconies are provided in east or north.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
The toilets should be avoided in north-east -side of the rooms. Store rooms
with huge stocks should be in south or west, or south-west. Airconditioning
Plant: A.C.* equipment is to be kept in southeast of the complex and there
from it is to be operated. It should never be installed in north-east under any
circumstances. Electrical Generators and Transformers: These are to be
installed in south-east directoe. Wash Basin: It is not advisable to keep wash

 be arranged in north or east or north-east of halls. Main Entrances of

Restaurants: It is better to have main entrance in east or north or north-east
directions. If it is to be kept in west direction, it should be towards north-
west but not' in shouth-west under any circumstances. If it is forced to keep
main entrance in south, it is advisable to keep it in sduth-east rather than
south-west. Mezzanine Floor: Mezzanine floor in any hall have to be
 provided along west or south walls. Cash Counter and Reception: These,
may be provided in southwest with elevated platforms but if it is provided
in north-west or other places the floor level should not be higher than south-
west. Water Bodies: Swimming pools, water ponds, fountains, borewells,
and sumps etc., have to be planned in north or east and northeast 70

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
VEEDHl SHOOLA (Spearing Road) Roads or lanes running right
into the plot from different directions cause Veedhi Shoola (spearing road).
These Vaastu defects are of eight types. In the diagram, they are shown in
certain forms, but actually, the plot - road formation could be different from
what is shown. The effect could be in varying degrees depending upon the
size and direction of the spearing road. Veedhi Shoola is generally
considered to be bad. There are, however a few exceptions nos.(l) and (2)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Veedhi Shoolas in north - east are good whether it is coming from north or 
east directions; (see the diagram) whereas the north-west road coming from
west direction i.e., no. (7) is good and not the one from the north direction
i.e., no. (8) The other four Veedhi Shoolas nos. (3) and (4) from south-east;
nos. (5) and (6) from south-west are considered bad, with an exception for 
no. (4). All the eight Veedhishoolas are shown in one plot only to make the
readers understand all the types but in reality such a situation does not arise;
even if it happens there will be only one or two veedhi shoolas. Hence
readers need not get scared looking at tire diagram. While searching for a
 plot, if one comes across such a situation, he should take the advice of a

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Vaastu expert so as to avoid complications at a later date. Veedhi Shoola on
to the plot and building from a wrong direction would give more negative
results. 72

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Aanexnre - 1 VAASTU - A SCIENTIFIC PERSPECTIVE: Like
many a rich tradition of the yore, the vaastu Shastra is also built on
scientific base. Though the propounders handed down to us only the
summum bonum of the discipline, yet, for an inquiring mind, it is not a
difficult task to dig out its scientific underpinnings. The Vaastu Shashtra
was evolved keeping in view the influence of the Sun and the earth’s
magnetic field on the living beings on earth. That the Sun is the life-giving
and life-sustaining force is a fact well-known even to the most primitive of 
the people. The practice of Sun-worship by various civilizations founded at
various times and strewn over the various parts of the earth collaborates it
unabigjously. The advocates of the Vaastu, therefore, worked out the
 principles of the discipline in such a way as to derive the rich benefits of the
sun rays to the inmates of the house. The second factor that influenced, is
the earth’s magnetic field on the householders, given die position and
direction of the various components of the house. Dr. H. G. Belfrage, M.D.,
opines: “The electrical energy which pervades the living universe is derived
from the Sun in the form of light and heat. It is under the influence of this
energy derived from the Sun that the dead material of the Universe becomes
endowed with sufficient energy to form living matter.” Dr. H. C. Menkel M.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
D., says: “Ultra violet rays of the Sun are die only reliable source of
Vitamin D. Vitamin D is absorbed by the blood directly when the bare skin
is exposed to the Sun rays.” The Sun rays, being a rich source of Vitamin-
D, are vital for the sustenance of life on earth; and the rays early in the
morning from the east emitting more light and less heat are the 74

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
best, lienee the eastern direction assumes great significance.
Precesion of the* equinoxes, Uttarayanam and Dakshinayanam. are known
to have great scientific importance. It is in this context that north-east and
south-east directions also attain importance along with eastern direction.
The following principles as. enunciated by Vaastu are but a few examples. *
More windows in the east and north-east are good. * Main doom in the east
and north-east to be provided. * More open yard in the east and north-east

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Is advisable. * Providing east and north-east verandahs is good. * Water 
tanks and wells have to be in east & north-east. * Terrace on first floor is to
 be in north-east, east and north. * Big boulders & big trees in north-east and
east are not good. * Solid and thicker walls in the west, south and south-
west are better. * Less window openings in south and west, are
recommended. As the early morning Ultra-violet sun rays are a rich source
of Vitamin-D, doors and windows in the east allow them penetrate into the
house, bestowing their benefits to the inmates. In the afternoon, on the other 
hand, the Sun coursing to the west grows hot emitting the infrared rays
which are detrimental to health. Therefore, less number of windows .and
thick walls in the rooms in west and south-west prevent radiation to a
considerable extent. The verandahs in east or north or north-east will get
good breeze and ultra-violet rays in the morning so as to give alf the benefit
to the inmates. Presented below is an analysis of a few more of the Vaastu
 prinicpies from the scientific stand point that helps reinforce the aforesaid
facts. 75

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Wafer in north-east: A well, placed in the north-east will have the
 benefit of the morning sun rays which have the power to purify the water by
killing the disease-causing-bacteria and other germs therein. Kitchen in
south-east: A. kitchen in south-east gets benefical snn rays from east and
gbod breeze from south. Terrace in North-east: Similarly, the North or east
 part of the terrace on first floor, when kept open could be used for morning
sun-bathing that does immense good to one’s health. Northeast pergola is
also good. Boulders in North-east: Vaastu also enjoins that big boulders
inside or outside the eastern or north-eastern boundary are not advisable.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
The reason is not far to seek. The morning sun rays will be obstructed by
these boulders and the inmates of the house will be deprived of the rich
morning sun rays. Trees in North-east: Even the big trees with multiple
 branches and thick leaves are not advised to be grown on the east and north-
east portion of the plot because they prevent the morning sun rays from
entering the house. Like the Sun, the earth’s magnetic fields also wield
significant influence on the well-being of the inmates of the house.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Contingent upon the place and position of the house, it is indeed baffling
that the founders of the Yaastu were so well aware of the influences of the
earth’s magnetic fields. For, each of the postulates helps reap good number 
of benefits, that the magnetic fields are capable of offering if the house is
constructed and the inmates observe conforming to certain scientific laws.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
For example, Yaastu recommends the inmates of the house to sleep with
their heads towardthe south. The reason is that the human body acts as a
magnet with the head as the north-pole. If the head is directed to the north,
the earth’s north-pole and the head acting as the north-pole of the body 76

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
repel each other. As a consequence the blood -circulation would
 be affected, causing tensions and distrubed sleep. These are but a few
examples that testify the scientific rationale behind Vaastu Shastra.
However further research is required to strengthen the Vaastu principles on
scientific lines and unravel many more secrets. PYRAMIDAL

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
STRUCTURES WITH AMAZING RESULTS The Pyramids of Eygpt, built
in their mysterious past, continue to baffle the modem scientific minds. It is
scientifically proved that the vegetables and other food stuffs could be
 preserved for a longer period under pyramidal structures. It Is also seen that
the razor blades retain their sharpness under pyramids for a considerable
time. We also see that a few of the churches and chapels look like modified
 pyramids. Some of the temples and mosques are also found to reflect
 pyramidical shape. Many of the temple structures face east. Even the
hutments and granaries In some villages are made In the shape resembling
 pyramids with eastface. In the temples, the garbha griha, the sanctum
sanctorum where the main deity Is Installed Is constructed In the shape of a
 pyramid. The shape has Its own Importance besides the fact that the
 prasadam, fruits and other oblations could be preserved for a longer period.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
The authors of “Pyramid power” Maxtoth & Greg Nielsen say that “Much
that has been * considered the superstition of past civilizations is now
 proving to be the core of an ancient science; many a modem discovery
 betrays its origin and basis In this secret science. Certainly, Pyramid Power 
is at the fore front of tnese rediscoveries”. If a pyramidal structure has such
miraculous effect on the living organisms, no wonder If the houses built in
line with Vaastu Shastra bestow their inmates health, wealth and prosperity.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Anaexiire -2 CASE STUDIES Following are some of the case
studies wherein the Vaastu defects are explained. These facts are being
given without any prejudice to any one, only with a view to make the
 people understand that how the same plot and house could give health and
wealth to the inmates after certain alterations were made in the defective
one. In all the cases cent percent correction would not be possible, yet one
could try his best under the given circumstances. DEFECTIVE PLOT Some
time back a plot of (5000) yards was purchased by a developer much
against the advice of Vaastu Pandits. He paid five lakhs as advance, and
tried to dig a borewel! in the plot but in vain. For a year no construction
could be started. Meanwhile the Incometax Department served a notice on
him to the effect that the department would take over the plot by paying
some extra cost. The matter had ultimately gone to the court. For five years
the capital invested on it yielded no returns. Added to that the buyer 
incurred further expenditure of rupees two lakhs. Needless to say that both
 buyer and the seller were in distress. The following are some of the defects
in this plot: i) Gate in .south-east direction facing east. ii) North & north-
east - very big sheet of rock, and very high levels in the north-east iii)

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Shape of the plot was odd and irregular and not at all good as per Vaastu.
EXTENSION OF EXISTING BUILDING Normally building should not be
extended on south or west joining the existing building. A business man
was. doing well in real estate business along with his partners. He did some
extension in his 78

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
house towards south by constructing a garage, connecting the
main building. From then onwards he went into lot of problems. He lost
considerabale amount of money in business. His partners made an attempt
on his life. When he showed his house to a Vaastu pandit the mistake was
found. When the garage was disconnected by creating a gap In between '
the old and new building, .and some modifications were done on the first
floor, things changed fast. He could sort out problems with his partners
amicably. He even recovered from his Ill-health thereafter. GATE AND
EOREWELL IN SOUTH-WEST An air force officer built a house in

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Hyderabad, with lot of open space in the west with main entrance in the
south-west. He had two borewells one in the south-east and another in the
south-west. All these are against Vaastu. The couple soon lost their health.
His wife became a mental patient and had to be admitted In an asylum.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
When the owner was told about defects of Vaastu in his house, he did not
 believe in the first instance, but later on, he took the advice of a pundit and
corrected the house as per Vaastu. The borewells in south-west & south-east
were closed. The west open space was covered and south-west gate was
changed to north-west. After making these corrections both of them
recovered their health and living happily. ACCIDENTS Here is an example
of a house with a road on west. The northeast comer of the plot was cut off 
which Is a big defect in the plot as per Vaastu. Added to that a room and a
 bath room in north-east comer were constructed In the ground floor and a
similar structure on the top of it. The ground levels were higher in. the east
and lower in the west. The bore well was dug in south-east. All these were
against Vaastu and caused lot of problems to the owners. After some time
the person living In the north-east quarter died in an accident and his wife
 became seriously ill. 79

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
HOUSE OF TWO A Vaastu pandit of Guntur town while
discussing Vaastu and its influence, narrated one special feature of a
 particular house, with two roads; one on the south and the other on the east,
meeting in a T’ junction. This is called south-east block. There was a well in
north-west. Levels in west were low. He said that the owner of such a house
may have two wives according to Vaastii. How true! the owner of that
house indeed had two wives. The more astonishing fact was that not only
the father had two wives but his son also got married twice. Interesting to
note is that the ladies outlived the males and enjoyed the property for long.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
CINEMA THEATRE Construction of a theatre at Hyderabad was started
during 1976, but could not be completed until 1986. After completion it was
inagurated in a big way but that happiness did not last long. It was closed
for more than a year. Then landlord took over the theatre from the lease
holder and spent more money, remodelling the same and got reopened in

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
1990, but before long it was closed again. The efforts of the management io
start the theatre once again did network, except every time they tried to do
something, they incurred heavy expenditure, and the people who invested in
this project have gone bankrupt and the theatre is closed permanently. The
following defects of vaastu were found in the plot and the building. 1 . The
very site was not in accordance with vaastu. North-west comer, and north
side were bad as per Vaastu. 2. The south-west comer of any building
should be 90°, but here in this case it was not in order. 3 . The east vacant
space must be more than west, but west open space in this case was much
more than east. 4. This plot was neither a rectangular nor a square. It was
having more than four sides which is against vaastu. 80

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Aoaexure - 3 MERITS AND DEMERITS This chapter highlights
the merits and demerits of certain aspects, in respect of site, location, shape
of the plot, placement of rooms, furniture, water bodies and direction of 
doors and windows etc. I. SHAPE SQUARE: This plot is the best, since it
assures alround happiness and prosperity. RECTANGLE: In a good
rectangular plot, the length of the plot should be in proportion to the width
and should not exceed double the width. This plot is said to be good, for it
 bestows health, wealth .and happiness. POLYGON: Houses built on plots
with more than four sides may create problems for inmates who may be
subjected to constant mental tension, for one thing or other. TRIANGLE: To
live in a plot having only three sides is as good as sitting on a three legged
chair which is unstable. This may cause litigations of civil and criminal
nature, besides other problems. CIRCLE AND OTHER ODD SHAPES:

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Plots with round and other odd shapes may lead one into some problem or 
the other constantly. EXTENSION TO A PLOT: Adding a piece of land to
the existing plot is deemed as extension to a plot. Extension in South-west
to an existing plot, may result in loss of health, loss of money and other 
unsurmountable problems. 82

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Extension in South-east may lead to fire accidents, thefts and
court litigations. If the extension is towards North-west, it may lead to
heavy expenditure and mental unrest. Extension in North-east assures
alround prosperity, i.e., health wealth, name and fame. Extension towards
 North is good for health and wealth. Extension towards East gives name,
fame and success. Extension towards South and West is bad and may cause
loss of wealth. ACQUIRING NEW PROPERTY : Purchasing a new piece
of land towards East, North and North-east of the existing plot either 
adjacent or away from the plot increases inflow of money and enhances
name and fame, provided the adjunct is also in accordance with the
 principles of Vaastu. Similarly purchasing plots adjacent to or at a distance
towards South or West may cause ill-health and other unexpected problems.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
PROJECTION : Projection of the plot in different corners has got varying
influences. South -east : If South-east comer is projecting towards East or
South, there may be litigations and monetary loss South-west : If South-
west comer is projecting, owners may have health and wealth problems.
 North-west : If North -west comer is projecting, heavy expenditure and
restlessness may be the result. North-east : If North-east comer is projecting
it will give name and fame, health and wealth. If North-east is cut, there
may be loss of money and loss of progeny. S3

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content: II. PLOTS FACING DIFFERENT ROADS PLOTS WITH FOUR

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
ROADS: Plots with four roads in four directions without any Veedhi Shoola
(Spearing road) are supposed to be the best which will give health, wealth,
name, fame and alround prosperity. PLOTS WITH THREE ROADS: Plots
with three roads, give varying results. In some cases health and wealth and
in some other cases name and fame are achieved with certain other 
limitations. PLOTS WITH TWO ROADS: North and East Roads : Good for 
health, wealth and peaceful living (North-easi block) South and West Roads
: This is good for earning lot of money (South-west block) subject to
satisfying other Vaastu principles North and West Roads : Ensures success
and prosperity with certain limitations. t North-west block) South and East

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Roads : This plot does more good for ladies (South-easi block) and female
children, with certain lim itations. PLOT FACING SINGLE ROAD: Plots
having North or East roads are good for health, and wealth; South roads are
good for making money, wheras West roads give success and name. Ill
VEEDHI SHOOLA: Street (Veedhi) or road touching (Shoola) the plot
from different directions has different effects. North-east : If a road is
approaching the North-east corner of a plot from North or East, it assures
health, wealth and allround happiness. 84

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
North-west : If the road is approaching from North and touching
 North-west comer of plot, it may cause litigations and restlessness. If the
road is approaching from West and touching the plot, it may give success
and good fortune. South-west : Roads touching the South-west comer from

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
West or South, both are said to be bad. Inmates may be subjected to loss of 
money and prestige. Progeny also may be affected. South-east : If the road
is approaching from East and touching the plot it may cause ill-health and
litigations. If the road com ing from South touches the plot, it gives
financial and other benefits, with certain limitations. IV. LEVELS : Levels
in a plot which control the rain water flow in and around the house, will
have positive and negative Influences on the inmates. a) If the ground levels
in South are higher than North and rain water flows from South to North,
inside the plot, it is good for alround prosperity. b) If the ground levels in

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
West are higher than the East and rain water flows from West to East, it is
good for health, name and feme. c) Similarly if there are mounds and
hillocks either in south or West, outside the plot, they will give health and
wealth to inmates. If there are depressions or the road levels are lower in
South and West of the plot, they may cause loss of wealth and other 
 problems. $5

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
V. WATER BODIES: WELLS : Presence of water or flow of 
water in certain directions improves finances, helps attain name and fame,
gives comfortable positions and status to children. Converse is equally true.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Water body in North-east assures influx of wealth and helps family
members get prominent positions. Longevity of children and sound health is
also assured. A well or a water body in South-east is said to be harmful to
ladies and children. A well or a water body in South-west may result in loss
of wealth, accidents and serious illness. Well in North-west may cause ill
health and some other problems to children. Well in East improves finances,
and gives prosperity Well in South causes ill-health and loss of wealth. Well
in North gives health and wealth. Well in centre of the plot may create many
hardhsips. UNDER GROUND WATER TANK: Watertank in North-east,
 below the ground level or below the floor level of main building gives all
comfort and happiness. OVER-HEAD WATERTANK: Over-head tank 
should not be built in South-west or North-east because water in North-east
is good but not so much of weight at such a height. Similarly height and
weight of tank is good in South-west but water in South-west is a taboo.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Hence it is advisable to keep the over-head tank in North-west. VI. LOW
LEVELS AND DEPRESSIONS: Low levels and depressions in the plot
may augur well or ill, depending on the location. 86

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Depression in North-east Ensures health, wealth and prosperity.
South-east : Bad for women and male children. North-west Enemity and
litigations. South-west Loss of health, wealth and progeny. South : Restricts
the growth, besides West financial problems. : Causes ill health and loss of 
name and fame. North : Good for wealth mid general prosperity. East :
Good for health, and popularity. \TI. KITCHEN : Location of kitchen in the
house is equally important. Kitchen in South-east : Kitchen plat-form in

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
South-east comer in a South-east room without touching eastern wall is the
 best, which would give health and happiness. Kitchen in North-west : This
may cause heavy expenditure and restlessness. Yet, this is the second the
 best and convenient for south facing houses, with Oven in South-East
comer of the room. Kitchen in South-west : This is not good; may cause ill-
health. Kitchen in North-east : May cause heavy expenditure and mental
tension. * In any room, cooking plat-form in South-east comer of that room
without touching East wall may be the only alternative when there is no
 provision for a kitchen in South-east room. 87

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
VIII. MISCELLANEOUS : PLATFORM: In South and West
directions, platforms higher than the floor level of building, are good for 
 prosperity. Platforms in North or East lower than the floor of main building
may give material happiness, but not good if higher than the floor level.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
STAIR-CASE : Except in North-east, staircase may be built in any comer,
depending on the convenience-. South-west staircase is good for health and
wealth. If the staircase is in North-east, there should be a room in South-
west at a higher level than the stair case roof. If the North-east staircase is
higher than South-west portion of the building, native will have health and
other problems. BED ROOM : Bed room in South-west is the best to give
allround prosperity. Bed rooms in South or West may also make one happy
and prosperous. South-east bed room is not so good. One in the North-west
is good for guests. North-east comer is not for bed rooms. PUJA ROOM :

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
The puja room should be placed in the North-east comer of the building
which will give health and happiness but it should not stop Sun rays
entering the house. Small puja place in other rooms also can be placed
facing preferably east or north. STOREROOM: Better if store room is
located in South, Wrest and South-west comer, which would give good
financial strength. CELLAR : It is better to have cellar in North or East or 
 North-east, which will give prosperity. It is no good to have them in South,
West and South-west because it may cause ill-health and loss of money.
South-east and North-west cellars also are not advisable. LOFT

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
ORATTICK: It is better to keep loft or attick contiguous to south and west
walls. COVERING DPTO boundary wall : Covering upto boundary on
 North-east may cause loss of health and wealth. North and East covering
also works adversely. Covering North-west and 88

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
South-east touching North wall or East wall should be avoided.
South-west covering is very good but one will be deprived of good
ventilation if proper care is not taken. GATE : Gate in East or North or 
 North-east may give health, wealth and happiness. South-east gate for an
East facing house brings ill-health and hardships. But for a South road.
South-east gate is better than South-west gate. On West road North-west
gate is alright but South-west gate is a taboo because it may cause serious
illness, accidents and loss of wealth. OPEN SPACE : More open in North or

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
East gives name, fame and prosperity but more open space in South, West
and South-west causes loss of wealth, hardships and ill-health, whereas
open space in North-east gives allround success, and happiness. AVENUE
TREES: Avenue trees are not advisable in residential buildings. But
ordinary trees in South and West give not only coolness to the building but
gives health and wealth also. Trees in South-east and in North-west are not
 bad but not advisable to grow trees in North, East and North-east directions.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
GARAGES : Location of a garage in North-west or South-east comer will
facilitate free movement without touching North or East wall since open
space would be much more in East and North directions. This will bring
health and happiness. SERVANT QUARTERS : Servant quarters should be
>n south-east comer or north-west comer but they should be constructed
without touching east wall or north wall, so that they will be happy and
healthy. If the quarters are built in North-east, neither the owners nor the
servants will be happy. The South-west portion in the house should be
highest and if the servant quarter is built in this comer less in height than
the rest of the building, people living in those rooms will not be healthy and
happy. 8?

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
TERRACE: Open terrace should be towards North, East and
 North-east directions to give better health and wealth. PORTICO: Portico
may be located towards North-east, leaving sufficient open space in North
and East and should be lower than the roof level. COMPOUND WALLS:
High and thick boundary' walls towards South and West directions and low
walls towards East, and North directions may give success, and happiness.
BALCONIES: Never keep any balcony in Sourth and West diections.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Balconies should be towards North and East directions to attain health and
wealth. It is better to cover the South and West Balconies with glass and
curtains, if built alreay. FLOORING: Flooring in South-west should be
higher than South-east, and North-west respectively whereas North-east
should be the lowest to achieve health and wealth. MEZZANINE:
Mezzanine floors are to be built in South or West which will give prosperity
to the inmates. DOORS AND WINDOWS: Doors and windows towards

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
East, North, and North-east are good. Doors in South looking exactly South
are alright. Doors in North looking North are also good. Doors in East
looking North-east gives name and fame; specially good for children’s
 prosperity. Doors in North-east may cause alround health, wealth and
happiness. Doors in South, looking South-west creates hurdles. Doors in
West, looking south-west gives hardships and checks progress. The number 
of doors and windows should be even but they should not be ten or twenty
with a zero. PLACEMENT OF FURNITURE a) Office table and chair 
should be placed close to South wall or West wall so that one faces north or

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
East when he sits on the chair. Facing North-east is also good if possible.
 No

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
furniture, should be kept in any room touching North wall or East
wall. North-east comer should be always kept free and clean. There can be a
door in north-east to achieve maximum benefit. b) Bed or Cot also should
 be placed touching West wall or South wall, so that one sees East or North
while he sleeps and head is in South or West. c) Almirahs and Wardrobes
also should be placed in South or West directions facing towards North or

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
East. No aimirah should be kept in North-east comer. If some wardrobes are
made in North or East wall, very light material should be kept in these
wardrobes. Placing the furniture in correct directions as explained above
attracts financial gains. d) Cash chest, as per shastras, is to be kept in North,
 but heavy cash chests and almirahs used for keeping cash and jewellery
may be kept in South, West or South-west to give financial stability.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
CAUTION: The reader is cautioned not to make any hasty conclusions as to
the advantage or disadvantage of certain aspects of Vaastu which may not
manifest at all in some cases due to the influence of certain other aspects.
Conclusions are to be drawn only after considering the overall impact of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Vaastu. None of the indications made in this annexure as to the positive or 
negative influences of Vaastu is meant to scare the readers but to make the
invaluable knowledge in shastras available and inform them of the
correctives for their betterment. It mav not be out of place to mention here
that the author strongly feels that more and more research has to he done in
this field to die into this hiddm treasure of VaastU± 91

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Annexure-4 The ancient science of House - building
(Vaastiishastra) Pushtim bhootim putrahanim Purandhree nmharn mrityum
sampadam satrubadham Kinchitsoukhyam sambhukonadi kuryat Koopo
madhye geham - arthakshaycunehcL THE above stoka highlights the
importance given to Vaastu Sastra In ancient times while designing
 buildings, towns and cities. The meaning of the Sloka is that a well in North
east brings all round prosperity. A well in the East improves finances
whereas a well in South east is dangerous to sons; a well in South causes
loss of spouse and one in south-west s pells death to the native. A well in
 North-west creates enemity with others; a well in North gives some
happiness and a well in middle of the Building leads to bankruptcy. In those
days Vastu . Sastra comprised of civil engineering, architecture and
sculpture - the building technology in toto. Viswakarma, the greatest
architect of Mahabharata times, designed and built the Indraprastha

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Incorporating all the upto-date layout, wide roads, water facilities and
drainage connections. Similarly Maya Sabha, designed and built by the
architect "Maya’ was the majestic manifestation of the ultra imaginative
structure of a beautiful fairy palace. It was a marvellous, melodramatic
comedy of illusions rendered into marble and mortar with all its sensational
suspense and tantalising twists. In short it was a dreamland. Special fields
in modern times, the knowledge of house building technology has grown so
vast that it has been branched off into special fileds such as arcitecture,
engineering and interior decoration while the importance of Vastu has mne
into oblivion. _ Article on Vaastu Written by the author and published in

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Indian Express sometime back is reproduced again for the benefit of 
readers. 92

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Whereas architecture denis with the Interna! comfort and external
 beauty. Civil engineering deals with the stuructural stability but Vaastu

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Provides with the knowledge of the principles to be adopted in building a
house so as to make the native happy, healthy and proper ous. Some of the
important principles of Vastu are as follows > 1. The plot should be either a
square or a rectangle with its south-west angle of 90* and north-east angle
of less than 90*. 2. The levels in the north and east of the plot should be less
than those in the south and west. The surrounding levels should be such that
the natural rain water flows towards the north or east . 3. An underground
water-tank or a well should also be situated in the north eastern part of the
 plot. 4 . The height of the building in the south and west should be more
than that in north and east. The terrace of the first floor should preferably be
in the north and east. More open space should be left in the north and east
than in south and west. 5 . The kitchen should preferably be in the south-
east or in the north-west as second best. 6. Toilets should be avoided in the
south-west and north-eastern corner of the house. 7. Entrance should
 preferably be from the north or east with more door and window openings
in these directions. Some Vastu pundits are of the opinion that colour and
odour of the soil should be taken into consideration while some others see;
that the measurement of the building or garbha (central kali ) should be
calculated as per the birth star of the native. It is practically found that if a
tank or waterspread is situated in the north-eastern side of the huiding, the
native gets ail the desired good results such as health and wealth It is also
said that these principles are applicable not only to individual houses , but
also to industry , educational institutions , commercial complexes » theatres
, hospitals and temples etc. If colonies » villages and cities are planned on
these principles,, it is said that they will all be very prosperous. 93

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
Some examples Here are some examples to substantiate the
above-mentioned principles. 1. The temple of Lord Sri Femkaieswara at
Tirupati is found adhering to the principles of Vastu ie., the main entrance is
on the east while the water tank is in the north-east and as such this God is
the richest in World having an income of around Rs. 50 crore every year. 2.
Sri Saibaba of Puttaparti made his abode in such a place where water flows
in the north-eastern direction and some hillocks are situated in the south-
west He is virtually considered to be a living God by many of Ms followers.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Spatial Geometrical Resonance Canon (NV-SGRC-32A)
passages.content:
3. In contrast to the temple at Tirupati , the one at Kalahasti is not so
 prosperous. The reasons are that the river Suwarnamukhi is on the western
side of the temple due to which the ground level towards the east of the
temple is high and towards west it is very much low. One political leader 
 built a house as per the adivce of a Vastu pundit in 1974 and soon became

passages.content:
The Book of Nakshatras by Prash Trivedi by Chistabo, A.D. 2012 

In Vedic system of Astrology, know n in Sanskrit as Jyotish, 27 constellations and not 12 Rasis form core of 
understanding celestial influences on our planet. These 27 constellations are known as 27 Nakshatras.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Term “Nakshatra”, when broken down into its constituent parts – “naks” meaning “sky” and “shetra” 
meaning “region”, translates into ”Sky Map ”. Another translation is arrived at by a different dissection – 
“nakhsa” is “map” and “tara” is “star” and so Nakshatra is “Star Map”. Both meanings clearly show that in 
eyes of ancient Vedic Seers it is 27 Nakshatras (constellations) and not 12 Rashis (zodiacal signs), which map 
sky.
Jyotish (Vedic Astrology) without Nakshatras is as incomplete as human body is without eyes. If Jyotish is 
”eye of Vedas”, then Nakshatras are ”eyes of Jyotish”.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
27 Nakshatras, in a way, represent our journey from moment of birth to moment of death. Ideal path of one’s 
passage in life can be viewed through 27 Nakshatras in a short, general way: 
 Aswini relates to first year or so of our lives, where we are totally dependent on outside support for our 
survival and operate from a purely instinctual awareness. 
 Bharani represents time, when , as infants, we start growing teeth and undergo other transformative 
processes like change of diet. Here we have to take on more re sponsibility, such as starting to learn to eat 
by ourselves. One notices that a sense of primeval will, which usually relates to wanting and not wanting, 
is seen here. 
 Next comes stage of learning process where we learn to walk, talk etc. All this initial learning process 
happens under influence of Krittika. This stage can extend up to four or five years of age. Process of 
learning to write is also part of this stage. A sense of discipline is required at this stage and one has to 
outgrow purely primordial awareness of Aswini and Bharani. 
 After this follows Rohini, where one starts understanding and enjoying material world with their 
newfound knowledge gathered in previous stage. 
 Mrigashira is point where we follow wherever our curiosity takes us and in Ardra it is time to analyze and 
understand our experiences. 
 Purnavasu is where emotions come into being for first time. One begins to understand one’s role in family 
and society. Playfulness is combined with a sense of caring. 
 Pushya represents stage when more responsibility is taken. This is age around 16, where one falls in love 
with life and everything seems so full of promise and wonder. 
 Ashlesha comes into picture at around 18 - 20 years, where harsh realities of world dawn upon us and we 
have to wriggle our way through. There is no place for naiveté, as one tries to find one’s own way through 
jungle of life. This coincides with Rahu’s maturity age. 
 Once we find our way, our identity and individuality are established under auspices of Magha. This 
usually takes place around 21. Here, one also becomes aware of one ’s roots and how they are relevant in 
scheme of things. 
 After one ’s individuality is established, one tends to relax and be creative under impulses of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Purvaphalguni. Search for a partner begins. Some might marry and think of having children at this time. 
 Uttaraphalguni follows, making one concentrate on having a fixed role in society and on family issues. It 
is about finding one’s social individuality, rather than personal individuality, which occurs in Magha. 
 In Hasta, one immerses themselves in worldly responsibilities and affairs and tries to be clever and crafty 
in it. This is time for making plans and starting projects. 
 Chitra is where we create our works, plans having being formed in Hasta are now manifested in reality. 
 Swati is where we sell our creations to world. In other words, we relate to world through business. 
 After business is done and riches are acquired, a longing arises for something more meaningful. This 
catharsis happens within domain of Vishakha. 
 This longing is only fulfilled in Anuradha, through wisdom gained in understanding secrets of nature.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
The Book of Nakshatras by Prash Trivedi by Chistabo, A.D. 2012 

 Once this is achieved, one begins to be seen as a respected and responsible elder figure, under energies of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Jyeshta and a feeling of pride and superiority sets in. 
 Mula crushes whatever we have built so far, and shows us that there is a lot more left to unravel an d 
understand. In a way this is beginning of impersonal. 
 In Purvashadha stage which follows, one feels invincible as results of overcoming trials and 
transformations experienced in Mula. One begins to share its wisdom and experience with world, but still 
in a somewhat individualistic way. 
 In Uttarashadha, one is forced to look at bigger picture and sublimate one ’s individuality for collective 
purposes. 
 After one’s individuality is sublimated, one becomes receptive to fainter but deeper universal voices under 
auspices of Shravana. 
 Whatever we have learnt from our receptivity in Shravana, is used for working in tune with rhythm of 
universal mind, as symbolized by Dhanishta. This often bestows wealth, abundance and fulfillment on all 
levels. 
 After one has enjoye d abundance, there is a longing for something even more fulfilling. This catharsis 
takes place in Shatabisha, a place where one ponders over question of existence itself. 
 This questioning ultimately leads one to severe penance and austerities under influen ce of

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Purvabhadrapada. One is ready to sacrifice everything on a material, mental and emotional plane, in order 
to gain ultimate knowledge. 
 Real path to gaining this knowledge is shown in Uttarabhadrapada, which shows that ultimate wisdom 
and knowledge can be gained through easier, milder and more peaceful means. This is where 
understanding of middle way or middle path comes into being. 
 Following of middle way finally leads to attainment of complete enlightenment under care of Revati, final

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Nakshatra. All d ualities, complexities, philosophies, actions and reactions merge in celestial ocean 
represented by Revati, and like Vishnu, one rises above this ocean free from all of them.
It goes without saying, that for most people, stages represented by Nakshatras hold more meaning, 
depending on those Nakshatras which are occupied by Grahas or Lagna in an individual ’s horoscope.
Especially in today ’s out-of-balance society, ideal path outlined by Nakshatras, as described above, only 
applies partially to majority of us.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Nakshatras, however, still form core of understanding a nativity. For example, if a learned astrologer sees a 
chart with Kumbha rising on Lagna and goes about making a character sketch of native on basis of general 
traits of Kumbha as a Rasi, they woul d find that their derivations are too general, non -specific and even 
completely wrong in some aspects. This is because Kumbha carries energies of three Nakshatras - Dhanishta,
Shatabhisha and Purvabhadrapada - all of which have totally different nature, characteristics and functioning.
Same applies to all planetary placements.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
One cannot expect a person to have an amiable and harmonizing nature just because their Chandr is posited 
in Tula. This would be case if Chandr was placed in Swati part of Tula, but s cenario would be entirely 
different if Chandr was placed in relatively more complicated Nakshatra, Vishakha.
In this work, study of each Nakshatra has been divided into 23 sections, which simplifies process of dealing 
with multifarious aspects of their functioning.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
It is author’s hope, that this work will fuel further research on these cosmic transmitters and in time we would 
be able to attain clear and complete understanding, which our forefathers possessed.
Throughout this work, t erm ”Ketu” refers to South, and t erm ”Rahu” refers to North node of Chandr.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Ashvini, beginning of everything, especially Ketu ’s 
energies, is represented in celestial firmament by two bright 
stars in constellation of Mesha. Ancient Vedic Seers saw 
constellation of Mesha as forming a horse ’s head, and thus 
these two stars were seen as making a similar pattern. These 
stars are known in modern astronomy as Alpha Arietes 
(Hamal) & Beta Arietes (Sheratan). Alpha Arietes is slightly 
brighter with a visual magnitude of 2.02, while Beta Arietes 
has a visual magnitude of 2.66. These relative ly bright stars 
lie very close to planetary ecliptic, right below bright 
constellation of Andromeda, and are easy to locate in night 
sky.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Name 
”Ashvini” can be translated into either ”born of a female 
horse” or ”horse-woman”. First meaning is clear , but 
second one leaves one confused as to whether woman is 
riding a horse, or is she a mythical creature with a horse ’s 
head and woman ’s body. As we shall discover later, it is 
probably latter.
Its alternative name is ”Asvayuj”, which translates into ”she who yok es horses ”. Once again a strong 
emphasis on horse and a female is seen, root of which we would discover when we get to its ruling deities.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Ashvini’s main symbol is a ”horse’s head”. This symbol, as we can see, is in keeping with its name. A horse ’s 
head conveys idea of ”a beginning”. One can notice how riders pat their horse ’s neck before beginning any 
journey. From time immemorial, a horse has been seen a s symbol of power, courage, movement and vitality.
A horse’s head signifies an eagerness to act and a swiftness of approach. A horse, as we know, is always ready 
to make journeys, not for its own ends, but for ends of its rider or others in general.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
If one has had chance of being close to a horse, one will realize that a horse ’s head conveys a certain amount 
of sensitivity and alertness. Since Ashvini lies in beginning of Mesha, which is seen as representing head of
Kala Purusha (eternal being), it makes sense that Ashvini be related to a head of some kind. Head of course 
relates to brain, controlling organ of all body functions. Thus Ashvini automatically relates to mental impulses 
and leadership. Horses are nervous, fidgety and highly strung animals. Therefore this Nakshatra carries all of 
these qualities in good measure.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Its alternative symbol is a ”horse carriage consisting of two horses carrying two people ”. This symbolism 
relates to presiding deities of this Nakshatra. This symbol once again emphasizes a need for movement and 
relates to transportation of all kinds. This movement can relate to mat erial transportation on earth or 
travelling between different worlds, realms or planes.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Ashvini Kumaras, two celestial horsemen, are regarded as main presiding deities of this Nakshatra. Their 
names are Dashra and Nasatya, which translate into ”bringing help” and ”truthfulness” respectively. There’s 
no ancient culture where one cannot find stories and legends carrying their symbolism. Tales often show two 
heroic brothers travelling around, solving problems of whosoever they encounter in their travels.
In Vedic legend they are twin brothers, who were born out of union of Surya and his wife Sanjana, when they 
were in a form of a stallion and a mare. One can refer to previous author ’s book ”Surya - The Cosmic

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
Powerhouse” (Sagar Publications, India) for fu ll story. These two brothers are seen as celestial physicians in 
ancient Vedic texts. This is where healing and rejuvenating aspect of this Nakshatra stems from.

passages.source: Numeros Vision Stellar Constellation Resonance Canon (NV-SCRC-08)
passages.content:
The Book of Nakshatras by Prash Trivedi by Chistabo,
Ashvini Kumaras are supposed to have knowledge of all herbs on physical and astral plane, and are 
supposed to possess supernatural powers to cure any disease or fix any problem. They are particularly 
concerned with friction or obstacles which might come up between married couples. Thus Ashvini is a
